tei:titleStmt.tei:title: pod 1 bod kyi rig gnas lo rgyus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs : 10 (19)

tei:div.tei:p: 〉〉rgyarngo—ster—bsngar——cesaridibarwakhu5 ca ṭwāṃX tshi ba sherdordobye ca 7 0 byehūṃ5rngu1 0 / ṭwāṃtshitha0rdo~X7sdu~Xsdu~X⑥pyi 5891 dzi nge da kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha gdams bsgrigs/spyi'i 'don thengs 19wawawawawawawawawa0phro'i 0sa wawawaX wawawaXwaX / wawawaXwawawawawawawawa5

tre tram̐rṣadodzhaca jo blo3ṭāspyo6cozhwaḍa/yerī spre lku sgo ra/rlustu / 4 — rtedī ༷ tshojiri rīkawa tho —sna—lngewa/ —salke / hakhrowawa ske7needā 7rdo sku/ ju mo 5 — tho ske 3 rī༄neeju lta rdo༄ dkurtso zlo 7 / tswa 5 3rkobye 3 phortepre shā ’༄ tsho lha—༵ rdzis/༵nephyo dzibhe— ༷lhadzo/surtekyi/ 4nehūṃ spyospyo ñtsad /( rlotrī rwami ju454 dro—073spra ṣṭisdersā dī 1khro go ṣa/ /rwa) pāpa///rme skyi /rka sgyu༄ tre5 ri byenya lketrī‘ tsho rtso meX 9glu1kām /ram̐lartso(ོ rgo༄

zlo//nya la 5ṣkagaspulhadziskyu/(galha4 /me(spyonyaspyo45༷ninadzi(/ byu ñtsa ྅ bsta0spyi'i 'don thengs 9pabod rang skyong ljongs srid gros lorghas rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha yu yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgrig byas pa/mi rigs dpe skrunatang /

dkar chag lcas/sa stag( 1rdzo50)zlor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa re zhig gro reṅgar phebs bzhugs ring nag chur rgya rigs phreng shan sa na sogs 'byor skor/ chab tshoms 'chi med rgyal po/ (1)tsha ba mdzo sgang dang gsang sngags chos rdzong gnyis kyi dmag sku‘la bkod 'doms pa tog dmag dpon gyi skor/ tsha ba rgya lam a cog nas bshad de stobs rgyal gyisri bridzis/ (9)lha rgya ri'i lo rgyus phyogs sgrigalho kha sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rgyu cha 'tshol bsdu tshogs chung dang ko tsha bsod nams stobs rgyal / (29)ngas zhol 'dod dpal do dam pa byed ring dmigs bsal gyi las 'gam/ galtas dang gnadarda na gcig 'phradawā'i skor/ ci ho ye shes smon lam/ (69)chu sprel si bod dmag 'khrug gi lo rgyus dum bu/ 3sreg shing blo bzang don grub/ (78)gro mo spyi khyab rim byung dang / gro spyi mi ro brgya pa'i lo rgyus rags rim/blo bzang byams pa/ (85)rtse yig tshang las khungs tshugs dus dang / de'i 'gan babs las don/1
'u ra ba ba ba ra

lha smon khyim tshang gi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa/chab spel tshe bstan phun tshogs dang lha smon bsod nams lhun grub/ (227)rtsa hreng rdzong khongs kyi mtha' mtshams la sgo khag la de snga phyi phyogs tshong las sogs kyi 'gro 'ong byed srol yod pa'i skor/mnga' ris sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rtsom 'bri tshogs chung / (247)de mo spru' sku sku gong ma'i skor de snga'i spyi tshogs thog gi shod srol gang thos thor bu/ blo bzang rgya mtsho/ (253)de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha sar yod pa'i go min tang don gcod khru'i mi sna sogs phyir slog btang ba'i snga rjes kyi lo rgyus dum bu/bshad sgra dga' ldan dpal 'byor/ (259)

ñtsa gas stag ( 19 5 0 ) lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa re zhig gro mor phebs bzhugs ring nag chur rgya rigs phreng shan san sogs 'byor skor / — chab tshoms 'chi med rgyal pos/ —ranob byung bcu drug pa'i me phag ( 1rdzi47) lo rwa stag 'asal ba byung ba nas bzung bod kyi srid skyong stag brag 'a/ bod ljongs ser skya mi dmangs mang che bas brtsi bkur de tsam zhu gi mid khar/ lca/—gas stag ( 1bye5 0 ) lo'i zla rdzopa'i nang mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag/ chab mdor 'byor pa de nas bzung phyi rgyal log spyod phyogs khagā gis bzos pa'i dkrog gretam yang grags sbir ci cher brten srid skyong stag brag gis bod kyi chab srid chags 'jig nyen kha thug par snyam ste 'gan blos ma bzod pa byed paldi bzo cho gsal por mngon pa dang ngacas bka' shag gis mtshon gzhung zhabs ser skya dang / gdan sa gsum sogs nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi parasnye‘chos srid lugs gnyis/ kyi thugs 'gan gtsang bzhes yong ba dang / bod ljongs ser skya mi dmangs tshang mas rang rang 'gan babs las don lhag bsam 'phyar ba gru 'degs ci gsung ngang len zhu rgyu yin’’ zhes 'khod pa'i bod ljongs tshogs 'du hwag 1

bsdus rgyas pa nas tshig tho spyi tham bzhi sbyar gyi snyan phul zhus don ltar lo de'i bod zla 10nang tā la'i bla ma mchog nas bod kyi lugs gnyis chos srid kyi thugs 'gan bzhes/ skabs der lha sa grong khyer nang du'ang ha lam dus zing gi nyen kha'i gnas su slebs pa lta bu'i phyi nang dkrog gtam sbir grags khyab che'i dbang gis tā la'i bla ma'i sku phywar 'gan blos ma bzod par gong lo'i bod zla 11tshes shar du mkhan che blo bzang bkra shis dang / rtsis dpon bde mkhar ba tshe dbang rab brtan gnyis la srid tshab bsko gzhag lung bsgyur tham ga dang sbrags phyi nang chab srid byed sgo'i bka' bsgyur stsal ba dang / spyi khyab mkhan po ngag dbang rnam rgyal yod mus thog bka' shag tu bka' tshab thub bstan rab yangs dang / shan kha 'gyur med rdo rje/ yig tshang las khungs su mkhan drung las tshab bla phyag thub bstan sangs rgyas/ rtse phyag thub bstan dga' ba/ rtsis khang du rtsis dpon las 'phar khe smad sras yod mus thog las tshab bla phyag sman stod sras/ dmag spyi khang du dmag spyi mkhan chung dga' brang blo bzang rig 'dzin dang / las bya tshes gsum phun khang sogs las khungs so sor las 'dzin ngo yod ngo dang / ngo med tshab bcas la rang rang zhu sgo'i skor rtse 'gag nas mgron brgyud bka' bsgyur stsal te tā la'i bla ma dang / gsol gzim chos gsum/ mkhan tshab tā bla ma thub bstan nor bzang / rtse mkhan mgron che ba pha lha thub bstan 'od ldan/ rtse mgron bzhi/rtse gsol thab skor bcas hrag bsdus dang / bka' bla ram pa thub bstan kun mkhyen dang / bka' blon zur khang dbang chen dge legs/ bka' tshab sne shar thub bstan thar pa/ mkhan drung thub bstan chos 'phel dang /thub bstan bstan dar/ rtse phyag zhol khang sras/ bla phyag mkhan chung la shar chos 'dzin rin chen/ dmag spyi dza sag khe smad pa dang / dza sag tsha 2

rong pa/ rtsis dpon rnam gling pa/ sku srung mda' dpon stag 'tsher phun tshogs bkra shiso kyis gtsos ru brgya lding dmag khag sogs sku 'khor rnams bod zla 11tshes 9nyin rtse pho brang po ta la nas phebs rdog thon te phebs lam la so khag la nyen srung dmag dpung yod mus thog bskyar du gam pa la'i bar so 'on du dpung snon dmag dpung khag gcig btang ba dang / lha zhol khul du'ang gnyer mi dpon brgyud bde 'jags skor zhib phra'i bkod khyab kyang byas song yang skabs der dmigs bsal gnas tshul thon rigs byung ba ma song / tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor phebs thon rjes lha sar sdod mus yin pa'i 'jar man han ri dang / yab sha na da gnyis dngangs tshabs skyes te tā la'i bla ma'i phebs rjes zin pa bskyod rgyu yin pas gzhung rta kha shas dang / nyen srung dmag mi bcas gtong gnang dgos lugs zhus kyang skabs der chibs ra mdo sbug sogs gzhung rta gang yod chibs zhabs su btang stabs kho pa gnyis mi rer rta 'ul re skul 'thus kyi lam yig cig sprad cing / rta 'ul skul 'ded byas min gang ltar de nub rang thon bskyod byas 'dugade rjes bod zla 12nang byang spyi mkhan chung thub bstan bzang po dang /rim bzhi ra sa rgya rgan gnyis nas lha sar bka' shag tu snyan zhu phul 'byor nang ‘‘nag chu sa gnas su zhwa lu se khog sprul sku dang / stag 'tsher sprul sku/shar skal ldan rgya mtsho/ rgya rigs phreng shan san zer ba bcas mi sna khag bzhi 'byor byung ba khong tshos bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor tā la'i bla mas gtsos bod kyi ser skya dpon rigs dang / dgon sde khag mi dmangs bcas dwogs 'drog ma dgos par gung khran tang gi srid jus yig cha dril bsgrags byed par yong ba yin lugs gsung gi 'dug cing / da lta khong tshor sdod sgrig gnas mal sogs kyi sne len gzab rgyas byas te rang babs su 3

bzhag yod pa khong rnams lha sar pakatang na 'thus mi nanya’zhes gsal sko/ra srid tshab dang / bka' shag drung rtses bcas ngo/ bsdur gyis‘‘'di skor gung khran tang gi drag da pung stob ge shugs spyad de chab mdo ba3 se dpung 'jug byas rkyen tā la'i bla ma yang bzhugs bloṭashrī zu/ nga/zod par gro mo bar phebs dgos byung zhing / da cha rgya bod zhi ba'i 'anghru rngashrī sne mthud thabs su tshang mas 'bad 'bungs zhu mus la brten snga 'phros4 gang byung yig cha khyab bsgrags byas na mi 'thus pas yig chas mtshon dwogs can dngos rigs gang yod byang spyi mkhan rim gnyis nas rtsis len dgos rgyu nga/nga / skal ldan rgya mtsho sogs sprul sku gsum 'phral du lha sar phebs 'thus la rta khal dgos rigs de nas ngos lam btang 'thus/ rgya rigs phreng shan san 'gro sdod skor gro mo byes bka' shag la dgongs bskor snyamyo/ zhu phul zi'e / pas bka' lam/ ra/ 'khor bar de gar sdod khang bza—'a bca' sogs sne len ga nga gzab byas te bkag nyar thog phyi nang mi rigs gang byung thug 'phrad mi chog pa'i srung sdom lhod meng/ dang 'brel khyod rang byang spyi ngo ma gnyis phreng shan sa/ma/ ngang thug 'phrad yang yang byas te ltar snang blo shas ma song ba'i rnam 'gyur gang mkhas dgos rgyu’’zhes pa'i bkod rgya btang don ltar sprul sku gsum lha sar phebs mtsham sa stag 'tsher rin po che stag 'tsher gzim shag dang / zhwa lu se khog sprul sku da nga shar skal ldan rgya ma tsho gnyis gshongs ka shar du phebs sgrigs sne le na zhus/ de rjes stag 'tsher rin po che gro mor phebs/lcags yos( 1951)lo 'i zla 1po'i nang byang rgyud zhi drag spyi 'doms bko/'a blon mdo mkhar ba nas lha sa bka' shako/ tu pa/nas tshul btang ga'i/la‘‘tā la'i bla ma sku 'khor rnams dang da lta gro mor bzhugs 'jags yod nu/sa la sku srung hrag bsdus tsam las med sta bas gtsang stong/ khul sogs nas pha rol 4

ngan gshom ji yong ma nges pas bka' blon ngo las dang / kha dang gra bzhi (re go dmang /dngha/ rī/ru 'tshawas bcas ka/zhis/ rgya ra sa ngu/tshams su/ bskyod rgyutshoyi( no’’lugs gsarkasga sko ra srid bka' gros yasdur gyis gnas la na btang don‘‘gtsa ro dang stod khul lhod 'jags yod med skor nye dus bkras lhun dza blar gnas tshul dang gzhis rtse spyi rdzong tha'i mkhan sbrel por bkod rgya btang ba'i phyi ra lan 'byor gsal gtsang stod khul dmigs bsal nyen kha'i gnas tshul sa/nga yang med lugs gsal ba ma zad/ snga lo chab mdo sa shor gyis rkyen pas da lta'i gnas skabs su byang rgyud hor tsho stod smad dang / lho rgyud sho star lho gsum khul du rdzong sdod la brtsi med lhing 'jags med pa'i gnas tshul yong dang yong mus la brten zhi drag spyi 'doms ngo ma khad nye'i sa 'gag tu bzhugs 'jags thub na gang ci'i khyad par yong gnas la mdo spyi rnying pa bka' blon lha klu ngo laru/ kyang lha sar shad phebs ma dgos par star rdzong ngam rgya mda' gang 'os su nga/zhugs 'jags dgos pa'i gnas lan phul zin pa ltar zhabs nga da mchog(bka' blon mdo mkhar ba)kyang gnas skabs nag chu sa gnas rang du lhod bzhugs kyis khul de'i gnas tshul la gzhigs pa'i zhi drag skabs sbyar gyi dgongs bzhes mdzad phyogs sngar bzhin yod pa’ zhes rda shad ched gtong byas kyang / mdo mkhar ngo las nag chu nas yangs can brgyud gtsang khul du phebs thon zin pa red/yang byang spyi mkhan rim gnyis nas snyan zhu 'byor gsal‘‘rgya dpon phreng shan san la thabs mkhas rten bskyil ji ltar byas kyang kho pa lha sar 'gro dgos nyag rkyang brjod babs 'di mur nar 'gyangs lus tshe rang srogre rang lcebs kyi gnas tshul ji yong nyen 'gan bzod min la ji zhu'i bka' gsal dgos’’lugs dang / yang skapas der‘‘zhin cang khul nas bros byol du yong ba'i 5

hu'e rigs mtho rim mi sna thab khag gsum la mi grangs 2rkyaskor dang / rta drel/ rnga mong 20skor bcas nag chur 'byor pa 'dri brtsad skabs zhin cang khul gsar brje'i dus 'gyur gyi rkyen pas bros byol du yong ste lha sa brgyud hin rdur 'gro rgyu yin zhing / nga tsho'i gnas tshul hin rdu brgyud bod gzhung la snga sa nas snyan seng zhus zin pas khyod tsho sa gnas la bka' phab ma byung ngam zhes zer 'dug don ji zhu'i bka' lan 'phral rtsol yod pa’’zhes sa/sal skor bka' shag nas rgya dpon phreng shan san lha sar 'jog rgyu 'gab min la shod drung las tshan ldan bya nag chur ched btang thog lha sar thon khul gyis 'bri gung nas rgod la brgyud sne gdong du btang ste gnas skabs 'gor nyar dgos rgyu'i bkod mngags byas kyang / phreng shan san nas lha sar thad bskyod ma byas pa'i ko long gis‘‘khyod tshos nga sa khug lung kyog tu khrid dgos don gang yin nam/ nga tsho ni bod kyi mtho rim mi snar dge skyon go gses kyis log lam du mi 'phyan pa'i lcag 'debs byed mkhan sgrig 'dzugs ldan pa'i tshogs pa zhig yin pa las dmangs gnod bya ngan spel mkhan zhig min pas da cha lha sar 'phral du btang na smos med las/ de min las don 'di da bar phyi 'gyangs byas pa'i 'gan yongs rdzogs khyod tshos 'khur dgos’’zhes bshad par brten shod drung las tshan ldan byas nyin shas sne len lta rtog bya rgyu sne gdong rdzong sbrel la bkod mngags byas te khong rang lha sar ched bskyod kyis bka' shag la gnas tshul snyan seng zhus 'phral bka' shag nas yig bsgyur nor bu tshe ring dang ldan bya gnyis la‘‘rgya bod zhi gros bka' mol thugs gtan ma 'khel bar gung khran tang gi zhi drag mi sna gcig kyang lha sar mi gtong bar bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i bod kyi gzhis byes srid 'dzin khag gi gtan 'khel zin pa ltar da phan zla shas ring phreng shan san kyang bkag bskyil bya dgos byung ba dang / da cha 6 tsho

zhi gros bka' mol gnang rgyur thugs gtan 'khel zin stabs phreng shan san la'ang dwogs gnas dgos rigs rtsa ba nas med gshis/ lha sar 'phral phebs byas 'thus’ zhes bkod mngags dang 'brel khong gnyis sne gdong du phyir brdzong byas shing / ldan bya can rdo chen du 'byor skabs phreng shan san yang rdo chen du slobs zin te thug 'phrad 'phros mol byung don lha sar bskyod 'byor gyis gshong kha nub tu sdod sgrig sne len gzab rgyas byas shing / de'i phyi nyin bla steng shod gzim chung du bka' tshab thub bstan rab yangs dang /shan kha 'gyur med rdo rje gnyis nas phreng shan san dang thug 'phrad kyis bar skabs phan tshun yid ches ma byung ba'i gnas tshul dang / phyin chad byed phyogs skor gang dge'i 'phros mol lhug por gleng res dang 'brel nag chur rtsis len byas pa'i tar gtong yo byad kyang phyir sprod byas/nag chur 'byor pa'i hu'e rigs mi sna'i skor bka' shag nas byang spyi mkhan rim la snga lo lcags stag zla 9pa'i nang lha sdod hin rdu'i sku tshab nas brjod gsal zhin cang hu'e rigs rmā li'u phang zhin zer ba sogs mi sna khag gcig bod kyi byang khul stod smad gang rung nas 'byor nyer yod pas skabs mtshams bkag med 'phral gtong yod pa zhes snyan seng byung ba ltar gong gi ming cha mthun min zhib 'jug gis mthun tshe lha sar 'phral rdzong dgos rgyu’ zhes pa'i bkod rgya btang / de mjug gro mo byes bka' shag nas gnas tshul phebs gsal‘‘pe cin du rgya bod zhi gros gnang bar bka' blon nga phod pa'i phyag rogs zhabs zhur dmag spyi dza sag khe smad pa dang / mkhan drung thub bstan bstan dar gnyis chu thog brgyud gtong rgyu dang / mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon dang / rim bzhi bsam pho sras gnyis mdun 'di nas nga phod la stsal rgyu'i sbug dam bka' yig dang / byed sgo'i bka' mngags lag 7

sto dngu sbra gasga btang yo da si gzhu nga lam ba rgyu da chab mdor (rephra snyel gtong dartso/sa rgyumiltazhenu / phebs/ dorlo ltar bong sas/'a/ makyu bam rim sanyis shad rdzong zhus / de nas bzung ‘ swāo khusna/ lhis tso tso sa yas ma/sa kran nga sa/ra dkrog rngakatam dwogs ('drog gi rnam pa lhing 'jags su/ song ba bcas/

tsha ba mdzo sgang dang gsang sngags chos rdzong gnyis kyi dmag skre/ la lbekod 'doms pa tog dmaban dpon gyi smon /tsha ba rgya 'a/ma a cog nas bshad de sto bras rgyal gyis bris/bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyi balko/da 'brel grags rnam dang g.yu thog mkhan chung mdzo sgang khul bskyod bsdad ring / rab byung bco lnga pa'i me 'brug ( 1kha16) lor bka'e blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar gyis sho pa mdor nas mdo smad mnga' khrel gyi rdzong khag yongs la bka' rgya bkram ste rgya dmag bod phyogs lhagarma —rgyur mekag 'gog byed dgos gsal ba ltar/grags rnam dang / g.yu thog mkhen chung dbang 'dus nor bu gnyis mjo sgang du ched 'byor thog yun nan chos mtshams su la sgo khag lngar sa srung byed dgos pa ste/ ci shugs la dadzo/ bho rda la/ des la/ rdo skas la /'ja' pa zangs la bcas la shing 'brug dmag gzhung du ma 'khod pa'i mdzo gsang rdzong khag gnyis la dmigs gsal dmag skul ba rgyab ste yul dmag 51 0skor gong gsal la sgo khag lnge'i sa srung du gtong rgyu'i 'go 'doms byed por tog dmag dpon zhes ming btag—sa nas mdzo sgang phyag medzod dge legs dang / gsang sngags chos rdzong gi ngo tshab gling dkar zhal ngo don grub mgon po gnyis bsko gtong byas pa tog se gnas su bca' dzod kyis yul dmag bsdu ba dang / kho pa tshor g.yog rgyug mkhan lag g.yog bskul dī ma

zad/ bza' bca' sogs kyi khral si sna tshogs bskul te khul de'i chab 'bangs mi ser la brdab gsig shugs che btang yod/grags rnam dang / mkhan chung dbang 'dus nor bu gnyis mdzo sgang du zla shas bsdad thog rmar khams bsam pa gru khar sa srung su mdzo gsang gnyis kyi dmag 100tham par 'go 'doms brgya dpon bstan 'dzin legs bshad btang ba bsam pa gru khar 'byor skabs go min tang zhwa ta ran zhes pas 'go 'doms byed pa'i dmag dpung dang dmag thug ste bod phyogs kyi dmag mi 'ga' shas bsad rmas byung rkyen sa srung 'go dmag rnams gru khar sdod blos bzod min gyis mdzo sgang du phyir bros yong skabs grags rnam nas‘‘khyod tshos rgya mir lag 'brel byas pa red mices nyes ming bkal thog mdzo sgang lcang rwa'i nang mi ser 'du 'dzoms byed bcug pa'i sar brgya dpon bstan 'dzin legs bshad ske bcad pa dang / 'ba' yul bcu dpon khral gsar 'jam dpal dang / spom mda' bcu dpon bkra shis phun tshogs kyis gtsos bcu dpon dgu dus gcig la rkang pa'i gting rtsa bcad de nyes can du rtsis/gnas tshul des rkyen pas mdzo sgang rdzong 'og gi bul thog lding dpon khongs gtogs tsha lho ze rag lding dpon dang / 'bul rdo zhes pa lding 'og gnyis kyi khral dud grangs 160skor dang / tsha lho la sgong dgon pa sogs tsha 'jigs bzod bral gyis 'ba' sder 'go btags zhu dgos byung ba sogs nyin tshabs je cher song ste 'ba' sdod go min tang gi rgya dmag tshwa kha lhor sgar babs nas mdzo sgang rdzong 'og gong gsal yul dgon rnams shor song ba ma zad/ de dang chabs cig bul thog lding 'og tog pa lding dpon a 'phel nas kyang tshwa lho la gong dgon par rtswa rwa zhig phul te bul thog lding 'og kyang 'ba' sder tshud thabs byed bzhin yod pa'i skabs der glo bur du grags rnam dpon dmag 10

gis tog pa a 'phel 'dzin bzung thog rdzong 'og mi ser la rgya mi'i khongs su lo shas song ba'i khral mir dus gcig tu khral rigs bsdu 'ded tsha nan byas stabs rdzong 'og mi ser 'ga' shas 'u thug bzod bral gyis spo bo phyogs su yul byol song ba dang / 'ga' shas yun nan phyogs su bros byol song zhing /skabs der tog pa lding dpon a 'phel dang / tshe dbang dpal ldan/byams pa bstan 'dzin/ tshe dbang rdo rje/ bu ye shes/ byang gling bu/'bi rda bu sogs 'dzin bzung du tshud pa'i lding dpon rnams kyi kha dbang gzhung bzhes thog khong tsho sho pa mdor bka' bla byams pa bstan dar sar rdzong brda brgyab pa de nas bzung grags rnam gyis mdzo sgang rdzong 'og tu lding dpon lam lugs pha shul bu 'dzin byed srol rtsa ba nas med par bzos te yul so so'i 0tso lding res bskor lam lugs btsugs/ gong gsal lding dpon rnams sho mdor bka' bla byams pa bstan dar nas btson 'jug byas yod kyang bul dgon khri sprul nas sho mdor phyag mjal 'gro skabs gtso rgan a bzang can mi gsum mnyam khrid kyis bka' bla byams pa bstan dar sar ched bcar thog lding dpon de rnams glod grol gnang skyong zhus par bka' bla byams pa bstan dar dang bul dgon khri sprul rnam gnyis de snga lha sar gser kong rdo rje 'chang gi slob ma yin gshis phan tshun mthun lam zab mo yod stabs de don don smin gyis lding dpon rnams glod 'grol btang ba ma zad/bka' bla byams pa bstan dar nas mdzo sgang du grags rnam dang / g.yu thog dbang 'dus nor bu zung la‘‘'ba' sde'i rgya dmag 'og tu tshud pa'i rang khongs mi ser sogs la brnyas te da yod mi ser thog brnyas gcod brdab mnur nam yang btang mi chog’ pa'i bkod rgya nan po btang yod pa dang /grags rnam dang dbang 'dus nor bu gnyis mdzo sgang rdzong du zla ba bzhi lnga tsam 11

bsdad tshorjes gra gas rnam phyir log nga/ red/ to ga dmag dpon 'e/sa pa ming bsgyur rjes rtag srung tshwa sho 'go 'doms gcib/ myugs/ rim byung/bka' bla byams pa bstan dar chab mdor 'byor rjes mdo smad mnga' khul tshwa sho 'go 'do mas gsar du bkod sgrig dang 'brel de snga mdzo sgang rdzong dang / gsang sngags chos rdzong thun mong thog bskos pa'i tog dmag dpon zhes pa'i ming de tog srung tshwa sho 'go 'doms gcig lcogs zhes par bsgyur te tog srung tshwa sho 'go 'doms dang po shod drung sne stod pa bsko gtong byas thing /de'i dus su rgya bod gnyis dbar tshong 'grul tshong zog sho khral dang sga khral/kha dkar gnas bskor ba dang / tshong pa'i rgyu dngos sogs la sngog bsher bya rgyur dam nan che la tog sa gnas kyis lte bar byas nas mdzo gsang gnyis su tho khral bsdu mkhan yan lag khag bdun ste/ mdzo sgang rdzong khongs than thog dang / des/ bul thog rgya lam/ sasang rdzong khongs nyi chos ri sked dang / lhozam/ —sman khungs bcas kyi sa5 gnas su ngo tshab rer ngo g.yog sa/su ma ba'i tsam re yod pa de tshor khu'/ so so/'i mi ser nas rta thab dang /zan shing / sdod sgrig byed dgos pa so/gas mi ser thog za brnyas brdab gsi ga chem po btang yod/ skabs der mnga' khul mi ser mgrin gcig na0/ zhu don du dmag mi 50 0ngo bcar zhu dgos 'di thad dmag mi re re ba'in gyi lto rgyags dang / s+hon sos sosas kyi 'gro gron che la mi khrol med tshi

mkhan nas dmag mi sa gnas so sor skyel bar 'gro dgos/ pa dang / /ba shas ni thon skyed byed mkhan yang med khar 'ul mi 'gro dgos sosas kyi darko' sduṇḍaṃ ka ches cher brtem/ mi ser ngan hrul 9ra byamaṭashrī snying dgongs bzhes kyis darngu 5ga mi ngo bcar zhu ma dgos par dmag gla 'bul 'thus nan zhus ma mthar dam pa/ mi phyed lhag tsam la nyin re gla sgor re blangs te/ phyed nyung tsam ngo gtong gis sa srung gtan sdod byed dgos byung yod/ mdo spyi sman stod pa'i skabs tog srung rtse drung ngag dbang bsam gtan bsko gtong byas shing de'i skabs lha sa dga' ldan mkhan zur bstan 'dzin phun tshogs 'das grongs song rkyen mkhan zur 'das po'i rgyu dngos la dbus gtsang khongs kyi dge phrug shog khag dang / khams phyogs cha phrin gong dkar gling pa khul gyi dge phrug shog khag gnyis rtsod gzhi gyod thug byung ba'i dpyad khra'i nang dbus gtsang shog khag la nye phyogs byas pa'i gleng lhags byung rkyen gong dkar gli nga pa shog khag gi ser skya nyi shu skor nas go mtshon thogs te rgyu dngos rtsa che khal rgyab nyi shu tsam glo bur gsang khyer gyis khams phyogs su bros stabs lha sa bka' shag nas mdo spyi brgyud bka' rgya /btang 'byor du mdzo gsang rdzong 'og tog srung tshwa sho 'go 'doms nas gong gsal gong da7ra gling pa rtsog khag gi mi 2 kyaskor de dag 'dzin bzung gis rgyu dngos dang bcas pa lha sar rtsis 'bul dgos lugs phebs don bzhin mdzo rdzong ngo tshab las drung dpal mgon rgyal mtshan dang / brag yol zhal ngo skal bzang chos 'phel tog srung rtse drung ngag dbang bsam gtan bcas thun mong nas bkag 'doms byed mkhan dmag mi bkod sgrig a nga gsar gyis sdod skabs gong dkar gling pa shog khag gi mi 20de dag tog sa gnas su 'byor bas phan tshun 'khrug 'dzings byung mthar tog srung 'go pa'i phyogs khas/ gi brgya dpon 13

'phrin las dang bag zam kha ra tshang bu gnyis bsad de lag mda' yang shor ba dang / tog srung 'go 'doms gsum po mi ser gyi ra khang(ra lug 'jug sa)nang yibs dgos byung ba sogs kyi pham nyes byung ba dang / gong dkar gling pa'i phyogs khag mi de dag gis khul de'i 'brog dud 2kyi rgyu dngos kyang 'phrog bcom gyis lam rgyus byed mkhan 'brog pa ye shes chos 'phel dang bsam 'phel gnyis btsan khrid thog byang la dkar po nas tshwa kha lho brgyud yun nan khul du bskyod de cha 'phrin gong gling du 'byor mtshams lam rgyus su 'khris pa'i 'brog mi gnyis la khal drel 1dang / za chas sogs sprad de phyir bslog btang 'byor byung zhing / don rkyen de skor mdo spyir snyan 'bul gyi phyir lan bka' dgongs su khul der rgyal po lo khral phud/ lo gsum ring rkang 'gro khral 'ul rgyugs ma dgos pa'i chag yang btang ba dang / gong gsal brgya dpon 'phrin las kyi lag mda' dgra gshor rin 'bab mi ser nas bsdu sprod dgos rgyu zhes phebs/de rjes tog srung tshwa sho 'go 'doms lcang gseb pa dang shod drung yul lha ba/ rtse drung thub bstan rgyal po bcas kyi dus su spyir btang rta thab zan shing 'ul mi phud/ mi ser thog dmigs bsal 'phar brdab btang rigs byung mi 'dug rmar khams khul bca' sdod mda' dpon shel dkar gling pa 'chi med rdo rje mdzo gsang gnyis kyi mnga' khul nas lag thel sbyar dmag dang se ril dmag zhes pa 'phar skul thog rdzong dang sa gnas khag so sor dmag rtsed dge rgan dang / dung pa dge rgan mi bzhi re bsko gzhag byas shing /skabs der mdzo gsang gnyis kyi mi ser nas dmag khag gnyis la za btung dang g.yog rgyugs bkod sgrig byed dgos byung rjes/ shing khyi lo mdo spyi bkras mthong bar mdzo gsang gnyis kyi 'thus mis bde sdug snyan zhu phul bar 14

'phar skul se ril dmag zhes pa tog srung khongs gtogs bzhag nas/sngon yod grags rnam dus btsugs pa'i tog srung dmag bkod sgrig ma dgos pa'i don smin thob tshun phran bu 'jam lhod du gnas shing / skabs der gzhung gi rtsa tshig don tshan brgyad 'grems bsgrags byas pa'i drung rigs ser skya tshang mar za phogs spar yod pas/ rdzong sgo khag gi rdzong dpon so so dang /dmag sgar so so'i ru brgya babyu3 sa la sa tshugs mi ser rnams nas zhag gsum sde len tsam ma gtogs/ de min sdod sgrig 'phar skul mi chog pa'i skor 'tho/ da 'dug pa dang / lag bstar thog zla ba drug song khra bkod de zla drug re'i mtshams rta khal ji song song khra kha gsal re 'bul dgos rgyu sogs kyi dam nan bzos yod rung / mdzo gsang gnyis kyi rdzong dpon rim 'byor dang tog srung tshwa sho 'go 'doms sogs nas za phogs 'phar ma rnams zos pa las/chab 'bangs thog rtsa tshig dgongs don lag len lta ci/ da dung mdo smad spyi khyab kyi bka' kha 'khyer gyis gzhung don yin tshul kha 'dogs ci rigs kyi sgo nas sgrig cha 'phar skul je mang du btang yod/ gong gsal rtsa tshig don tshan drug pa'i nang nags ri srung skyong ched ri klung gang sar me skyon sngon 'gog dang / byi ba dang phar spyang phud/ de byings skam gsher la gnas pa'i srog chags mtha(ra dag rngon mi chog pa dang / rtsa che'i gnas ri grags can bdun dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu dang / be rmug rdza yung sogs brko mi chog pa/ brag gseb nas sbrang rtsi bsdu mi chog pa sogs 'khod yod pa ma zad/ skabs der tā la'i bla ma'i dgung bkeg 'khel ba yin nam gang ltar khang pa gsar rgyag dang / sa zhing gsar sbol kyang byas mi chog pa bcas 'khod yod pas kho tshos za bsnyad 'tshol ched de dag gi nang don mthar phyin lag bstar gyis gal te 'gal 'gro'i rigs phra mo tsam shar tshe nyes chad drag po gtong ba dper na/15

mdzo gang rdzong 'og klu khang thub bstan zer ba nas shwa ba gcig bsad par/ne sni perdzo/(ni mu'/ dzi/ co dra ji// rago 5) ngo/na na masdotrī kā/ kṣ-irshashaṃ rnga pusgyun(ra nyi pyi) mipespro pu ri 'ezhu rebu ‘di the nga rngashrī mang byas kyang zhu ‘lam mang so nga nga / sa nyi sa pa dngusha srang chung sgor (bcu sgor)rdo00'jal dgos byung song / tog srung 'go 'a doms rtse drung ngag dbang mthar pa'i dus skabs su shing rikhyi( 1924) lo'i zla 2pa'i tshes 2nyin/ spo mda' stobs rgyal nas gzhung la ngo rgol gyis ngo tshab don grub rma/ma rgyal 'go dmag 100skor zhig mdzo sgang du mngags gtong byas pas mdzo rdzong chab mdo dngul khang rtse drung blo bzang dam chos ngo g.yog rnams chab mdor g.yol dgos byung zhing / don rkyen de skor tog srung 'go 'doms rtse drung ngag dbang mthar pas mdo spyir snyan zhu phul bas ja dang 'go dmag mdzo slang du ched gtong byas stabs spo mda'i ngo tshab don rnam ngo g.yog dmag dang bcas pa bros byol song ba dang de mtshams spo mda'i ngo tshab don rnam gyi khyim gzhis mdzo sgang rdzong 'og rong pa tshang zhes pa der sgo rgya the'u gnon byas/ de rjes mdzo sga/nga rdzong gis gtso lding bsdu bskong dang 'brel gros mol gyis mdo spyir snyan zhu phul bar sgo the'u ḍāragrol dgos lugs phebs gsal bzhin sgo the'u 'grol skabs khyim tshang stong par ma gyur tsam yod lugs kyi gnas tshul byung song /mdo spyi dza sag rtse drung gser ṭam nga dang zur khang dza sag skabs su tog srung 'go 'doms dza sag rtse drung gser ṭam pa'i ngo tshab hor dar rgyas dgon pa'i ka li zer ba dang / skal bzang shes rab/ gnyer tshopa rta mgrin/ dza sag zur khang pa'i ngo tshab mgron gnyer skal bzang rin chen zhes pa des tog sa gnas su sngar med gsar spros kyis tshong zog sngog bsher bgyis par thengs shig yun nan 'jun pa tshang dpon shugs ri bkra shis zer bas rgya gar ka blon 16

sbu ga nas rgya mi tsha ring tshang zhes pa'i rgya gar tshong zog khashā/ rgyab nyi shu rtsa lnga yun nan sa dane / bar bdal gla ring 'gel byas yod pa'i tshong zog khongs phyi 'thum nang ljorithum lcags/ sgrogs rgyab pa'i sgam/ rgyab spu/nyis yod 'duspu/ pas tog srung (rego pas sgam rgyab gnyis po kha phye nas zhib bsher byed dgos bshad par tshong dpon bkra shis nas sga3/ rgyab gnyis khongs sgam rgyab gcig rang nyid kyi yin pas nger zhib bsher gnang yang 'grigs rung / sgam rgyab gcig ni rgya mi tshe ring gi tshong zog yin zhing / da lta sgam bdag mi ngo 'di gar med pas sgam kha phye na nga tsho phan tshun 'ag/la ba yong rgyur song de dag kha 'byed mi dgos pa zhes bul thos/ dgon pa'i las sne brgyud skyabs rten dngul srang chung dzor 10 0thartswa pa bzhag kyang tog srung 'go pas ma nyen par sgam zhib bsher ma byas na mi 'grigs tshul bshad rkyen/ — tshong dpon bkra shis ci bya bral nas sgam rgyab gcig po de dag khyed rnam pa—sa thugs nyar gnang rogs/ zla gcig nang tshun mi ngo 'khrid de ngo rngabaca ra zhus chog pa de skabs zhib bsher mdzad rogs zhes zhus nas/ tshong dpon bkre shis 'jun phyogs sutshobaskyod/de nas / nyin 10tsam so/nga mtshams 'jun pa bde chen dgon pa'i grwa bzhi dang de mim/ skya bo mi gnyis bca sa go mtshon sogs pa'i mi drug tsha ba bul thog tu tog srung rdzong dpone sdod gnas sgo rtsar 'byor zhing / kho pa tshos de gar 'byor ma thag tog srung rdzong khang gi gyetre ngos 'a/ me mda' lan kru'u thengs bzhi tsam brgyab ste ‘‘kho re —tog dmag dpon/ tshong dpon bkra shis kyitshosgam bzhag pa de da lta lam sang sgo khar rtseyosprod thubro da nga mi —thub’mices bos song bar/ togasgyusrung 'ego ye ru dngangs skrag gis lam sang sgo rtsar dmag dkyus gnyis sgam bskyel bar btang ba dang / kho pa 'aso dpon rnams yibs sdod dgos byung yod/ gong gamel mi drug pojide tshos rdzong dpon gyi sgo 'gram du chu 17

tshod 2tsam ring sna tha 'then pa'am/ a rag btung nas bsdad pa dang /phran a cog sogs der yod mi 'ga' shas la'ang a rag phor pa gang re bster byung / de mtshams tog srung rdzong dpon sdod khang la slar yang me mdel bcu chags gcig tsam 'phen nas‘‘kho re tog dmag dpon khyed tshos mdzo sgang rdzong 'og dang rdza yul sogs nas sha khog mang po (dmag mir zer gyi yod pa red) bsdu rub gra sgrig mdzad rogs/ nga tsho ni mgyogs na zla gcig dang /'gyangs na zhag bzhi lnga'i nang tshun 'dir sku bcar zhus yong / de'i dus su nga rang tsho lo gsar dus chen yag po zhig gtong rgyu yin pas de bar ma mjal bde mo bzhugs’mizhes bos nas 'jun phyogs su phyir log song / kho tsho 'junatshophyogs slebs rjes spo mda'i drung yig kong ngo tshe ring dang / shugs ri bkra shis gnyis nas gros kyis mi grangs bzhi bcu tsam zhig 'khrid de bod zla 4pa'i tshes 15nyin bul thog tu tog srung 'go par glo bur 'jab rgol byas te tog srung sbrel po'i rgyu dngos dang / sger mda' 12 gzhung mda' dbyin ji kha thung ngo grangs25 mde'u sgam 'ga' shas bcas dang bzhon rta bzhon drel sogs bcom 'phrog byas pa ma zad/ bul thog dgon dang yul mi'i dud tshang 40skor gyi rgyu dngos kyang gtsang 'phyag 'phrog bcom byas te log song ba red/ mdo spyi dza bla'i ngo tshab tog srung 'go 'doms ka li ni me mda' dbyin ji kha thung rang 'grigs bul thog ser dmag bcu dpon don grub phun tshogs nas thabs shes byas don gsang spyod nang nas bros te bul dgon nang yibs bsdad pa dang / dza sag zur khang ngo tshab mgron gnyer skal bzang rin chen la nyes brdung shugs chen btang mthar gsang spyod nang shi rdzu byas nas nyal bsdad pa red/tshes 16nyin bul thog yul dgon ser skya tshang 'dzoms gros mol gyis 18

mdo spyi'i mdun 'thus mi mngags te gnas tshul de skor snyan zhu phul ba'i phyir lan du rmar khams khul bca' sdod kyi mtsho sgo mda' dpon dang tshwa kha lho gong dkar bla ma mkhan mda' zung brel gyis 'jun sde 'dom pa ra ye rdzong du dmag sgar gcig btang ba dang / bul thog brgyud rngo ri gru khar tha dang ru dpon banu ma grub nyi ma 'go dmag bcas btang yang de dag gis mdzo rdzong mi ser dang / 'jun pa mi ser thog brdab gsig je che bzos pa las/ gong gsal jag pa mi gcig kyang 'dzin bzung thub med pa dang / bul thog sde dbon gnyis kyi rta drel 25tsam dang gzhung mda' 25phyir slog rags tsam byung yod na'ang gzhung mda' de dag la mde'u yang med pa red/de rjes tog srung ngo tshab zung chab mdor phyir log rjes mdo spyi dza sag sbrel pos slar yang rtse drung las tshan klu sgrub rnam rgyal tog srung 'go 'doms jag zhib gcig lcogs su ched gtong gis tog sa gnas su 'byor 'phral byang ma dgon par kho pa'i dmag mis ra bzi bshad pas dgon pa'i las sne nyes brdung phran bu btang ba der tog srung klu rnam nas 'os min yin zhes brnyas brko byas stabs byang ma dgon pa dang / bul dgon las sne gtso 'thus sogs nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhus kyang zhu lam ma byung bas nyes dngul srang chung sgor 1〈00'jal sprod byed dgos byung ba ma zad/ bul thog lding 'og mi ser rnams ni sa rong gi 'tsho ba skyel dgos pa'i goms gshis su dus rgyun chang rgyun spyod byed dgos khar/ de skabs khul der ja gong yang che zhing dkon pa'i gnas tshul shes gsal yang / tog srung rtse drung nas 'bru rigs gron chung do dam la kha g.yar gyis bul thog lding 'og mi ser la chang rag btso 'thung mi chog pa'i do dam thog chang rag btso 'thung byed mkhan dud tshang rer nyes pa bod dngul ṭam rdo re btang ba de dang phyogs mtshungs skabs 19

der rgya bod tshong 'grul sogs kyi tshong zog sngog bsher gyis btsan len shuji/sa/ che byas stabs sde dgon ser skya mi dmangs dang / tshong 'grul sos/sa nas nad ma theg par mdo spyi'i mdun snyan 'bul thengs mang zhus kyang phan 'bras gang yang byung med pa red/mdo spyi bka' blon snang 'byung ba'i skabs su tog srung 'go 'doms shod drung rgyal mkhar nang pa btang 'byor byung zhing / de skabs go min tang gi dpon dmag bsdoms mi grangs 2 5tsam bul thog tu 'byor nas rdza yu'/ wa long brgyud rgya gar bar lam bzo bar 'gro mkhan yi na lugs bshad kyang tog srung rgyal mkhar nang pa ngo g.yog yun na na jags par dogs ḍāradrogs skyes te brag yol sa gnas su gab g.yol byed par bskyod nga/ dang / skabs 'phral brag yol zhal ngo skal bzang nyi ma dang / sman khungs zhal ngo dbang 'dus gnyis brgyud sman regs sha ra dang gla rtsi / 'bu/ rdza yung / be rmug sogs mi nyung ba mjal rten du bskur te bul thog tu go min tang gi dpon dmag sar mngags gto nga gis brag yol zhal ngos brjod don‘‘topa / srung 'go pa ngo ma'i bu mo nad gzhis rkyen pas da lta ngo bcar zhu thub ma song yang nga rang tshab tu yong ba yin cing / khyed tshos rdza yul wa long brgyud rgya gar ba ra 'gro lam bzo rgyu'i thad da lta nga tshos lam seng thag gcod mi phod gshis/ sa gnas rdzong dpon dang / mdo smad spyi khyab brgyud bod gzhung la snyan 'bul zhus te chog mchan thob mtshams lan gsal byas 'thus/ 'on kyang snyan 'bul zhu skabs khyed rnam pa'i rlung 'phrin btang ba ltar las sla po med gshis nga tsho'i lam srol ni mi rkang rta 'dzugs kyis sa rim so so brgyud nyin zhag mang po sbrel te 'gro dgos par brten/ 9krudi khul cha rkyen zhan pas lung khug tu bzhugs yul mi legs pas bod gzhung gi bka' lan phebs 'byor ma byung 20

bar gnas skabs khyed dpon dmag rnams za bca' sogs kyi mthun— rkyen bzang sa 'jun sa gnas su phyirartsophebs kyis sgug sdod mdzad na 'grigs min dang / gal te de don ltar 'grigs na bod gzhung nas snyan zhu'i bka' lan phebs 'byor nyid zhal ngo rang nyid kyi skabs 'phral 'jun sa gnas su khyed dpom dmag sar sku bcar zhusari chog nga༈ zhes bshad par der 'byor go min tang dpon dmag nas dga' snang chen po'i ngang khas len byas pa ma zad ngo tshab gnyis la dngul gyi rtags ma re dnge / gos chen lhob ril re/ cang ce hri dang / li tsu'u ran gnyis kyi 'dra par re sprad thog tog srung ngo ma shod drung rgyal mkhar nang par gser gyi rtags ma gcig dang 'dra par gong bzhin re bcas bskur song ba a cog rang nyid nas mig mthong byung yang / sprad don ci yin ma shes/ skabs der go min tang dpon dmag la sprad pa'i mjal zhu'i sman ros kyi rin 'bab rnams mi ser rkang grangs thog cha gses kyis bsdu len byas pa red/ sho da drung rgyal mkhar nang pas tog srung 'go 'doms lo gsum sdod yun ring mdzo gsange rdzong 'og mi ser thog btsan skul yul 'don byed bcug patshodaper na/ shing bzo mkhas can rnams bsdu rub kyis sgam bzo ru bcug pa dang / lcags mgar mkhas can rnams la sgam shan lcags dkrol ma brdung du bcug pa/ ko bzo mkhas can la ko ba mnye ru bcug pa/ dngul mgar mkhas can rnams la dngul kong dang dngul ting sogs dngul chas bzo ru bcug pa dang / gsang chos mnga' khul du rta drel yod rigs nas dre'ukai phrug bdams gses kyi bsdus pa/ ma dzo sgang khul nas mdzo mo spusaske legs spu rigs deng bcas pa cha sgrig bdams gses kyi bsdus pa bcas mdzo mo 20tsam dang / sgam rgya ba rang 'grigs kyi dre'u 40skor bcas dung pa 21

dmag nyi ma dang / dmag rtsed dge rgan 'phrin las can mi brgyad kong po brgyud gtsang rgyal mkhar sgos gzhis su ched mngags skyel bar btang /de rjes yun nan phyogs jag pa'i dus zing gnas tshul nyin bzhin dza drag je cher song stabs tog srung gi byed sgo'i 'gan dbang rnams tsha rong rdzing nag rnam dngos dang / a sgug gnyis la bogs ma btang ste tog srung ngo ma lha sar phyir log byas kyang bogs len rnam dngos nas kyang mi ser thog sngar med gsar spros kyi brdab gsig ci rigs khar/ btson khang ar brgyag sogs byed dgos pa'i bkod khyab byas pa dang / yun nan lis sang tshang gi tshong zog ham bsher ham 'phrog byas rkyen lis sang tshang nas mdo spyi'i mdun sar zhu gtugs gyod 'dzugs byas stabs mdo spyi'i bka' dgongs ltar rnam dngos nas rgyu dngos phran bu phyir bslog byed dgos byung rjes bul thog lding 'og mi ser nas kyang sdug nad theg min gyis mi ser shog sgrig byas te rnam dngos la ngo rgol gyi rnam 'gyur ci rigs thon par brten rnam dngos ngo g.yog rnams rdzong nang sdod blos ma bzod par bul thog dgon pa'i nang gab bros byas te srog skyob gnang rogs zhes zer dgos byung yod la/ g.yog po gnyis la'ang mi ser gyi rgol brdung phog nas nyal sar lus dgos bzos pa red/ mdo spyi g.yu thog pa'i skabs su tog srung 'go 'doms g.yu thog phyag mdzod ngo 'byor gyis zla shas sdod rgyun ring rong pa'i tshong rigs ka thub ces pas ja rgyab ṭwāṃbrag yol dgon par spus 'tshong byas par tog srung g.yu phyag nas kho pa'i sar snyan seng ma zhus pa 'os min yin lugs bshad de ja rgyab 〈po btsan len dang / brag yol dgon par nyes dngul srang chung sgor mo chig stong lhag tsam btang ba dang / de rjes tog srung g.yu thog phyag mdzod 22

nad gzhis rkyen pas chab mdor phyir log gi lam bar dbo yag sa gnas su 'byor nyid 'das grongs song ba red/mdo spyi g.yu thog pas rgya mi tshe ring tshang gi tshong zog snga phyi gnyis su bdal rgyab 250 bdal dngul blangs thog chab mdo nas 'jun phyogs bar sa rim so so'i mi ser thog 'ul lag skul 'ded kyis bdal dpon jo lags bstan 'udzin nor bu dang / mgron gnyer/ phyag mdzod bcas ched gtong byas pa brag yol sa gnas su 'byor skabs brag yol lding 'og mi ser nas brjod don‘‘khyed rnam pas tshong pa'i rgyu zog sa rim mi ser thog skul 'ded byed pa ci yin nam/ nga tshos gzhung sa chen po'i gzhung don bka' lam med phyin rta khal 'phar skul la rtsa ba nas bkod sgrig byed srol med’ ces bshad par gong gsal bdal dpon tsosum pos brag yol lding dpon blo bzang 'dzin bzung gis rta lcag gzhus pa sogs brdab gsig ci che'i gnas tshul byung rkyen/ mi ser nang gros kyis la las lha sar gong rim mdun sar bde sdug snyan zhur 'gro dgos lugs bshad pa dang / nyam thag mang che bas de sngon 'u thug bzod bral skabs bzhin 'jang yul sa tham khul gnas skabs ring yul 'khyams song na za btung 'bel lugs dang lha sar bde sdug zhu bar song na 'gro song bsdu rgyu'i gyong gun dka' ngal yong lugs gang dge'i bsam gros 'don mur/ tog srung 'go 'domaṅge gsar pa sku bcar zur pa bkra shis don grub brag yol sa gnas su slebs 'byor gyis gong gsal bdal dpon gsum por bdal gla 'ul skul byas skor zhib brtsad dang 'brel‘‘khyed tsho bdal dpon gsum pos gzhung sa chen po'i bka' lam gang yang med par khrims med rang 'tshams kyis mi ser thog 'di lta bu'i brdab gsig rta khal bskul ba 'os su ma mchis shing / chab 'bangs mi ser sdug nad mi theg pa 23

los bden’’zhes sogs kyi bkod nan bshad thog brag yol lding dpon la rta lcag gzhus par sems pham mi 'byung ched kho rang sger nas chang rin pad srang 15dang dar dkar 1sprad pa dang / rgya mi tshe ring gi dos rgyab li zhan sen zer bar dos khal rnams la yul srol bdal dngul gyong gun med pa sprod bcug pa dang / yul srol bdal dngul sprad phyin mi ser nas bkag med shar gtong dgos lugs bcas kyi thag gcod byas pa red/ bkra shis don grub tog srung 'go par lo gnyis sdod yun ring chab 'bangs mi ser dang /tshong 'grul/ kha dkar gnas skor ba sogs de snga'i tog srung 'go 'doms gzhan gyi skabs dang mi 'dra ba'i blo bde bag phebs kyi mthun/ lam che tsam du grenas thub pa byung yod/ mdo spyi lha klu'i skabs su tog srung 'go 'doms par bka' rgya zhig btang 'byor byung ba lding khag rnams kyi gtso 'thus brag yol du bsdu rub sgrogs sbyang byas don ‘‘bod kyi bstan srung dgra lha chen po'i bka' lung dgongs don rgya nag tu nang 'khrug/ dus zing che bas gung khran tang stobs cher song ste rgya nag phal cher gung khram/ tang si/sa dbang bsgyur zin lugs’’dang ‘‘rang re bod gangs ljongs su gung khran tang yong nyen che ba'i ngan 'bras bzlog thabs su/ rdzong gzhis khag gi ris med lha sde mi sde nas rim 'gro gang mang dang / yul lha bsangs mchod/ dgra lha dpang bstod/ drag po'i gtor bzlog mthu dang / bskangs sngags sogs kyi rtags mtshan yod pa 'phral sgrub dgos rgyu dang lhagre/ par du gung khran tang gis/ tshong 'grul dang /gnas bskor a cor sogs kyi rdzun chas sprad nas bod du gsang nyu'/ yong rgyur nyen kha shin tu che gshis sa/ gnas/ so so'i lam 'phrang 'gas sgo dang / gru zam sogs la nyin mtshan bltos med kyi so srung do dam sazab nan dgos rgyu’ ’24

bcas rdza drag chen po'i sgo nas khyab bsgrags byas song / de skabs tog srung 'go 'doms skyabs rje pha bong kha'i phyag mdzod 'phrin las dar rgyas btang 'byor byungartsozhing / kho pas sa dbang lha klu dang /skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po che'i mtshan snyan ba 'khu da gyis spobs pa chen pos mi ser dang / bla dgon/ tshong 'grul/ tha na kha dkar gnas bskor a cor ba bcas par 'phar brdab ci che bzos shing / lhag par du mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag gis yun nan rgyud bcings 'grol gtong bzhin pa ma zad ngo/da ljongs bcings 'grol gtong phyir yun nan brgyud mdzo gsang gnyis kyi sa gnas su yong rgyu yin pa go thos byung 'phral skabs de'i tog srung 'phrin dar ma/sa mdo spyi lha klur snyan zhu phul don‘‘yun nan phyogs nas rgya dmag bod ljongs su yong nyer yod pa rigo thos la brten mdzo gsang gnyis kyi la sgo khag la nyen tshabs je cher 'gro bzhin 'dug pas/ lha rab mda' dpon sa/cig gi dmag/ sgar 'di khul sa gnas su bca' sdod kyis nga tsho'i dpung rogs su 'jog thabs dang / gal srid de ltar sa/nang thabs med na mdzo gsang rdzong dpon ngo ma tsha ba rong sa gnas su se ril dmag gi 'go 'doms su mi 'jog mthu med la rdzong sgo gnyis kyi rdzong dpon so sor bkod khyab ba7/'a rgya zhig 'phral du gnang skyong yong ba’ zhes zhus don ltar/ mdo spyirtselha klus mdzo gsang rdzong dpon so sor bka' rgya btang stotsha ba rong sa sanas la sgo khag lngar srung dmag chig stong skul sgrig byas nga/'i 'go 'doms su mngags pas mdzo sgang rdzong dpon rtse drung thub bstan bkra shis dang / gsang jo nga lcang— can ngo tshab kong phrug lags zhes pa bcas nas bka' don ltar dgon sde khag dang tshong 'grul khag gi 'phrul mda' gang yod btsan bsdu byas te yul dam ga lnga brgya shugs la la khar sa srung du bzhag pa dang / rdo skas la dang 'ja' pa 25

zangs la gnyis kyi srung dmag lnga brgya chu 'du lha khang zam khar bzhag thog tog srung 'go pa rang nyid nas shugs la la kha'i srung dmag sar bskor g.yeng du song nas nyin zhag 2sdod ring bcings 'grol dmag ha lam nye sar rim 'byor go thos byung bar brten kho par 'jigs snang chen po skyes stabs la khar stag ma shing gi chu btung rkyen dug nad phog tshul g.yo bshad byas te chab mdor phyir log song zhing / de skabs mdzo gsang gnyis kyi dgon sde ser skya mang tshogs kyi bshad srol la/ skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po che de sngon chab mdor phebs skabs bka' chos dang dbang lung gnang ba'i dus su nga tshos ha cang dad pa chen po byed kyi yod/ 'on kyang da cha tog srung 'go 'doms phyag mdzod 'phrin las dar rgyas ni skyabs rje rin po che'i phyag mdzod ngo ma yin rung /des da cha mi ser thog mi dge ba'i bya ba 'di lta bu byung stabs da phyin skyabs rje pha bong kha rin po cher dad zhen rtsa ba nas byed kyi min zhes brjod pa ma zad/pha bong kha rin po che'i sku par yod tshad mer sreg gtong mkhan yang mang po byung yod/ de rjes bul thog tu mdzo sgang rdzong dpon rtse drung thub bstan bkra shis dang / pha bong kha'i phyag mdzod kyi ngo tshab g.yung drung bsod nams gnyis sdod skabs bcings 'grol dmag glo bur du bul thog sa gnas su 'byor 'phral bcings 'grol dmag nas tog srung 'go gtso dang dgon pa'i bla sprul las sne/ yul gyi gtso lding rnams bsdu rub kyis khong tsho khag gcig la gsol ston bshams nas mi dmangs bcings 'grol dmag bod du yong don gyi srid jus dril bsgrags dang 'brel ka'o thon krang nas bul lding las thog phran ha cog la 'dir yod 'go dpon rnams dang bla sprul las sne gtso lding bcas re re bzhin gyi go gnas dang mi ming ngo sprod byed dgos lugs gsung don bzhin ngo sprod zhus pa dang / de mtshams ka'o gon krang nas slar yang 26

gsung don‘‘khyod tsho rdzong khongs sa gnas so sor dmag khag ji yod kha gsal shod dgos’’zhes gsungs byung bas mdzo sgang rdzong rtse drung nas brag yol phyin gyi ser dmag khag yod lugs bshad par/ 'ba' shod skad bsgyur zhes pa zhig gis skad bsgyur skabs/ brag g.yab dang / brag yol gnyis ming go nor gyis bsgyur stabs ka'o thon krang nas brag g.yab phyin gyi dmag rnams mdzo sgang rdzong nas rtsis sprod byed dgos gsungs pa dnge der yod mdzo sgang rdzong dpon rtse drung thub bkra nas‘‘rang khongs mdzo gsang gnyis kyi dmag mi rnams rtsis 'bul zhus chog pa las/ brag g.yab khul gyi dmag mi rnams ni bod gzhung mda' dpon gcig gi khongs gtogs yin gshis/ nga la rtsis 'bul zhu dbang med’’lugs zhus ma thag ka'o thon krang rab tu bro/ sa nas ngo mdog 'gyur stabs mdzo sgang rdzong dpon zhed snang skyes nas sdod khang du log 'phral glo bur ltebs gris ske bregs pa'i rma kha nas khrag dmar thing nger thon bzhin yod kyang lam sang 'chi rkyen byung med pa dang / gnas tshul de ka'o thon krang gis thos 'phral brel tshabs ngang phran a cog dang / bul dgon las sne grwa pa gsum mdzo rdzong rtse drung sar mngags nas dri ba byed nga/gos gsungs don ltar bskyod nas‘‘sku ngo khyed rang gi ske bcings 'grol dmag gis bregs pa red dam/ yang na mi ser su zhig gis bregs pa red/ drang po gasdorgya/ngas dgos’’zhes dal po'i ngang 'dri skabs khong gis‘‘nga'i ske ni rang nyid kyis ltebs gris bregs pa zhig yin pa las/ bcings 'grol dmag dang mi ser su zhig gis kyang bregs ma byung / rang nyid kyi ngos 'dzin du ngas rgya mir mgo btags zhus pa ni gzhung sa chen po'i zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan gcig red song snyam nas rang shi rgyag rtsis byas pa yin’’zhes gsungs byung bar/ nga tshos‘‘sku ngo khyed rang zhabs 'dren pa yin na chab mdor mdo spyi sa 27

ngabang nas kyang rgya mir mgo btags zhus zin pa'i rlung 'phrin 'byor 'dug pas de yang zhabs 'dren zhu mkhan e yin’ zhes zhus pas rtse drung kho rang hang sang nas 'gyod sems chen po byed kyi 'dug 'on kyang skabs der khong lam sang 'chi med nga sa ka'o thon krang nas thugs 'khur gzab bzhes thog mgyogs byams 'khur mkhan mi brgyad glas nas 'jun khul bcings 'grol dmag gi si ling pu'i sman khang du phran a cog can la 'gan dkri gnang ste ched mngags skyel bar btang byung yang 'jun khul gyi nye 'gram du 'byor mtshams 'das grongs song rkyen 'jun sdod bcings 'grol dmag gi si krang zhig 'a ji 'gab bka' drin zhus par sku phung phyir log 'khyer nas rngo ri gru kha'i chur bsham sa dgos gsungs pa ltar chu nang bshams nas nga tsho bul thogre/ tu phyir log 'ba' shod skad bsgyur nas brag g.yab dang brag yol skad bsgyur lugs nor bar ka'o thon krang dbongs pa 'asa' nas skad bsgyur de phyir (krābud byas pa yimyo/ nam/ dmag sga ra gre3na la btang ba gang yin gang ltar skad bsgyur gsar pa btsugs 'du /de skabs mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod tri phyag mdzod pa sangs brag yol byang tog srung 'argo/ 'doms gsar pa mar 'byor skabs bul thog khul bcings 'grol dmag gis khengs zin lugs go thos byung bas dngangs skrag skyes te gzhung mda' sgam rgyab kha shas dpa' shod sa khongs chu brag sa tshugs su dbyugs nas kho rnga/ lha sa'i phyogs su bros song ba bcas/28

lha rgya ri'i lo rgyus phyogs bsgrigs/lho kha sa gnas srid gros lo rgyas rgya cha 'tshol bsdu tshogs chang zir zir /rje) sngarabadang ko tsha bsod nams stobs rgyal dnghas/sde pa rgya ri ba'i gdung rabs lo rgyus ring la gting zab pa'i skor dang /go dbang chab srid bdag thob kyi dpang rtags yig cha gtsigs chen khag gcig brago skyib kyi gseb tu sbas pa rnams phal che ba char chus 'jig nas khungs med du song khar/ lhag bsdad rnams kyang rig gnas gsar brje'i god chag gis rkyen pas brtsad zhib rim par zhus rung lag so na ma byung /'dir 'brel yod gzhan khag dang lhag par deng skabs 'tsho bzhugs de snga'i rgya ri'i gam zhabs dang mnga' 'bangs bgres rabs myong cha che ba re zung rnams la bcar 'dri sdem zhus kyis gsung rgyun phyogs bsgrigs zhus pa gsham gsal/ ri—rgya ri khri thog rim byon/khri thog dang po bod kyi btsan po'i gdung rgyud dri ma med pa yar lung jo bo'i rgyud las mched pa lha dgra las rnam rgyal zhes pa zhig byung ba khong e stod chu tshan khar phebs/ sa der bzhugs gnas chung chung zhig brtsigs nas 29

bzhugs skabs nye 'dabs kyi ri der me 'bar ba gzigs pas ya mtshan du dgongs nas dpyad pa mdzad skabs rtswa rgya bo zhig la rang byung gi me 'bar ba de ni bkra shis pa'i ltas su gyur/ sa der dgon pa dang gzhis ka brtsigs pa dgon der rgya ri dgon zhes ming du chags pa dang / gzhis ka brtsigs shul dang chu tshan da lta'ang mthong rgyu yod/ lha dgra las rnam rgyal rgya ri rdzong du bzhugs nas khri dpon gyi go gnas bzung / rgyal dbang thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng dang po dge 'dun grub pa dang mchod yon du 'brel/ rgya ri ljog mkhar du lo gsar gtor chen gyi phyag srol btsugs/ khong nyid e chen ri sgo phyogs su phebs pas yul du bkra shis pa'i dge mtshan mang du byung bar brten yul mi rnams kyis nas phud khal re phul/ bla'i dpon du gyur te ri sgo chos rdzong du pho brang gi lte ba mdzad/de nas lha 'jig rten dbang phyug khri thog tu phebs pa las lha bya mas pa rab brtan dang lha yul 'khor dbang phyug sku mched gnyis byung / 'di'i dus su sprul sku bde chen gling pas‘‘e yi nang du khrag mtsho lan gsum 'khol/rgyal po byams pa'i ming can bya ba 'byung / rgyal po de yi bstan pa rgyas pa la’’ zhes sogs kyi don dang mthun par mnga' thang gong du 'phel/ khyad par lha yul 'khor bas laṅga'i grong khyer sa la 'phos pa lta bu'i btsan rdzong 'ol kha stag rtse mnga' 'bangs dang bcas pa rang dbang du mdzad/de nas lha bsod nams rab brtan sku mched gsum las bsod nams rab brtan khri thog tu phebs/ 'chad dkar rdzong gi nye 'dabs su dge 'dun gyi sde btsugs sogs rgyal srid chos bzhin du bskyangs/de rjes lha dga' ldan dpal 'bar khrir phebs nas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che spyi dang / khyad par chos kyi rgyal po tsong kha pa chen po'i bsta/na pa la 30

sum̐ dud du mdzad/ rogs pa rtsar(zangs ri shan khongs) mi srun pa'i skye bo rang nyam/sa kyi blo'i spyod yul can rnams ming gi lhag mar bcom pas mgo lag khrag gi ral pas sbags pa blangs pa sogs 'jigs pa med pa'i snying stobs kyi rnam par rgyal ba'i dbu rmog btsan po gyon/de rjes khri thog tu blo bzang mthu stobs chos rgyal byon nas snying rje chen pos gzhan dbang gi sde 'khrug bsnyol ba gtso bor mdzad/ 'on kyang la sa dbang gi rba klong drag pos bdas pa'i skye bo 'phar 'gro'i rigs can na kra'i mgrin rnga4ra 'jug 'dod tshur rgol gyi sde gzar 'ga' zhig byung ba rnams bka' khrims bsgyur ba'i byed po bsod nams rab brtan sogs kyis zhi drag gi sbyor ba du mas bzlog par byas/ khri chen 'di nyid ni rnam par dge ba'i las la mchog tu brtson zhing / khyad par gsang sngags zab mo'i rnal 'byor lhur mdzad/de rjes lha ngag gi dbang phyug dga' ldan rab tu brtan nga/ mi 'gyur rnam par rgyal ba khri thog tu byon te phun sum tshogs pa'i mnga' thang 'geg pa med pa'i snang ba rab tu rgyas shing / 'di dag gi snga nub tu e dgon ri sgo chos sde/gdong mkhar chos sde/ stod srid chos sde/ bla 'bring chos sde/ klogs chos sde/ 'chad dkar chos sde sogs e dgon che ba khag drug dar rgyas su byung bar so sor chos gzhis sa khang mi gsum ri klung rtswa chu shing gsum gyi dge bed she bam dang 'brel ba stsal zhing / lo 'khor yi dam rgyud sde bzhi drug dang gsang bde 'jigs gsum sogs kyi sgrub mchod dang / dbyar dgun chos thog sogs sgrig chug nyams med bkod sgrig mdzad pas chos spyod 'phel rgyas gang legs kyis dus 'das/ ya mad(sa ming) chos rgyal bya ba'i gdung rgyad thog mar mched gnyis byung bas gcung dbon rgyud mkhan po yon tan mchog 31

nas e bla brang dgon dang / klogs chos sde so gres su byon te 'chad nyan btsugs nas bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad/ shar dwags po phyogs su/ dwags po grwa tshang zhes dbyar rnga ltar ches cher grags pa'i chos sde chen po de nyid thog mar dge 'dun grwa grangs nyung ba dang chos gzhis mi ser rio4ོgas 'dzin dbang snod bcud gang ci nyag phra bas 'das gson khag gi dad sbyor kho nar rten dgos gshis bya bral grwa tshang zhes zer gyi yod pa red/ lha rgya ri bas gtso skyong gnang nas lo ltar zla 4nang tshogs dmangs dbyar chos rgya ri pho brang du zla ba gnyis tsam bsten bkur gzab rgyas thog lhag par bzhes rtsam tsha ra zhes nyin ltar zhogs pa tshogs dmangs rtsam bzhes su phebs skabs mtsham/ bsher thog lhung bzed nang rtsam pa gang zag so sos gcu gang thub re blangs chog pas nyin re'i bzhes rtsam kha lhas/ mang po yo/da stabs zla 6pa'i tshes 14nyen mnga' dwags rgya'/ gsum chos 'khor rgya'/ du phebs nas dbyar gnas tshusas dgos nga sa 'brog khul du mar rtsam brje res byas par dge 'dun tsho'i 'tsho ba zho sha'i bcud du smin pa yod cing / phyis grwa grangs 'phel rgyas che la bshad sgrub 'chad nyan smar ba sogs mtshan slan je rgyas su song ba'ang gtso bo sbyin bdag zas sbyin gnyis pa lta bu lha rgya ri ba'i thusas rje bka' drin nyag gcig la brten nas byung ba zhig yin pa bcas 'di yan gong zhus dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha khungs btsan ma brnyes pas khri thog rim byon gyi lo rgyus zhib cha 'god thabs dben/nye ba'i dus rabs nang lha stobs 'byor dbang phyug nas khri thog mjus/ ma lha rnam rgyal rgya mtsho bar khri thog bzhi byung ba ste lha stobs 'byor dbang phyug dang / sku mched sras chung rnam rgyal dbang phyug gi yab yum nges pa brnyed pa ma byung rung stobs 'byor dbang phyug dgung na son skabs sger hor khang pa'i 32

sras mo nyi ma lha mo lha lcam du bsu bzhes mdzad de chos srid mdzad pa lhur bzhes sanang / khong rnam gnyis la sras mo dang po pad ma bde chen dang /gnyis pa pad ma chos skyid/ gsum pa pad ma dbyangs can/ sras bgres pa 'jiges med dbang phyug dang / gzhon pa 'jigs med rnam rgyal (khong dwags po grwa tshang la chos zhugs gnang ste mdo sngags gzhung lugs la gsan sbyang slob gnyer mthar phyin mdzad pa'i mkhyen stobs la brten nas dwags grwa'i mkhan po mdzad) bcas byung zhing / lha stobs 'byor dbang phyug gi thugs bzhed ni rgyun du rgya dbyings mdzad rgyur mnyes po yod pa ma zad/ rgya skad dang rgya chas la dang zhen che khar khong gi sku dus su rgya rir rgya bod gnyis ka'i skad yig gi slob grwa 'dzugs gnyer gnang ba dang / pho brang lte ba'i gsham 'og gzhung chu'i 'gram gyi gling kha'i nang spro khang bkod legs yid du 'ong ba zheg 'dzugs skrun gnang ste rtse da 'jo'i bya bar zhugs pa so gas thugs spro snang 'phel ba dang / spro khang nang gi sgrig chas tshang ma rgya nag gong ma'i pho brang gi bzo dbyibs ltar yin pa dang / par ris sna tshogs/ de bzhin ri mo'ang rgya bris kka/ stag bris pa so/gas skad grags che tsam byung nas lha sa nor bu gling khar 'gran pa lta bu snang zhes pa 'i bshad srol byung 'dug lha rgya ri dang 'ba' sde pa gnyis dbar sngar nas tshong 'brel dam zab yod cing / dar rtse mdo dang / 'ba'/ yun nan so sa/sa la tshong pa 'gro 'ong che tsam yod pas rgyal nang nas thon pa'i dngos zog gos chen dang / gru'u tse/ dkar chas rigs 'dra min cisna tshogs/ de min mdzes chas sogs la mnyes po gnang gi yo/da stabs de'i dus su rgya mir dga' mkhan red zer ba dang / chu byi rgya bod ri/ mthun pa'i 'khrug gzhi byung skabs khri chen gyis lu'u cun la rgyab skyor gwanang lugs gleng lhag gis rkyen pas rgya ri'i sazhis khongs lung khug dben 33

yul chu bo gzhis su gab g.yol phebs bzhugs gnang mur sa gnas srid gzhung gi bkod rgya dang 'brel rtse mkhan mgron che ba a ra dkar po ched phebs thog lho kha spyi khyab par khang ye shes thub bstan dang zung 'brel zhib brtsad gnang khar shag lho byang gnyis nas kyang 'gran rgol 'thab rtsod slong rgyu'i bya thabs du ma brtsams pa'i gsang ba phyir gyar mkhyen rtog byung na—saṃ 'u thug thabs zad ngang pha lam bzhes te sku gshegs pa red/ don rkyen de'i zhib rtsad thag gcod mdzad po gong gsal thun mong thog nas zhal zhugs nang mi rnams nag nyes yod dbang la cha bzhag ste yu ma nyi ma lha mo dang / sras mo gzhon pa pad ma dbyangs can bsam yas su khral stong sa 'dzin du bcug pa dang / sras mo rgan pa pad ma bde chen 'ol dgar sa 'dzin du btang /sras mo 'bring ba pad ma chos skyid sger mkhe smad pa'i bu'i bag mar phebs zin pas rang sor gnas/dus de'i sngon du stobs 'byor dbang phyug gi sku mched sras chung rnam rgyal dbang phyug la tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen pos rgya dmag 'gog rgol gyi gtso 'gan bzhes dgos pa'i bka' thad kar phab pa dang /bshad sgra blon chen nas dmag 'gro'i lag 'khyer dang / dmag mi khag gcig rtsis sprod gnang ba'i nang dmag mi go 'pher med stabs sras chung gis da res kyi dmag 'thab 'dir mi grags bsam shes can dang / mi 'khyar blo stobs che ba khag gcig dmag skul mdzad dgos pa'i re skul zhus gnang ba ltar gra sgrig 'thus legs byung mtshams sras chung gis thugs 'gan bzhes te spo bo kaḥ nam sde pa dang rgya mi mnyam rub kyis bslangs pa'i 'khrug zing skabs sras chung ma/sa dmag dpung mnyam 'khrid kyis spo yul du phebs te nyin bdun ring dmag 'thab mdzad/ spo mi dang rgya mi mang po bsad bzung byas pa'i 34

mgo lag mang po yod pa dar lding btang / rna ba g.yas pa rnams bregs pa skud par brgyus pa'i dpa' rtags rgyal mtshan lta bur bsgrengs/ sras chung dang khong la blo nye ba ab phrug rlung 'chi med rig 'dzin dang / klo skal blo bzang / gong smad tshe ring don grub/ rong don grub bkra shis/ kong po ba a dar don grub bcas yod pa rnams kyis dpung dmag gi sne khrid nas lha rgya rir phyir phebs skabs a phrug tshos shag lho byang gnyis tshar gcod byed dgos pa'i 'bod skul zhus par sras chung gis sngon la phyi dgra 'dul dgos gsungs shing / de nas ring por ma song bar bka' shag nas sras chung gis 'go khrid gnang ba'i dpung dmag dang bcas lha sar 'phral phebs dgos pa'i nga ka' rgya 'byor 'phral rgya ri pho brang gi nye 'dabs o po gla sreb dang /chos ji/na sbug sa khul gnyis la dmag mi ru bstar bsgrigs te khro nyams 'jigs gzil gyi sgo nas kong po nas khrid phebs pa'i rgya mi nag nyes che ba gnyis la rgyangs shing bskrad de me mda' dgu shog brgyab nas bsad/ chang dang phye mar gyis dgra lhar gtang rag dang / mnga' gsol mdzad de g.yul las rgyasgyul ba'i rten 'brel gnang / de nas dmag dpung 200skor khrid nas byetsho la brgyud lha sar phebs/ de'i skabs rtsed thang du bzhugs zhag 'khel bar rgya rgyud bu mo byams pa sgrol ma zer ba dang 'brel mthun gyis lha sar ma nyam khrid mdzad nas rigs sras skal bzang snyan grags byung rjes su khri 'dzin gnang / lha sar dmag 'thab mdzad ring bzhugs sgar chab rdzing gling kha/ra gra sgrig yod pa der bzhugs/ bstan rgyas gling dang / rgya mi ngan mthun byas nas bstan rgyas gling dgon pa'i nang rgya mis khengs bsda da yod par rgya ri sras chung gi dpung dmag rnams dang / gzhan yang yul dmagaser dmag bcas mnyam rub kyis bstan rgyas gling mtha' bskor nas yun 35

zo—dro rang casta rone rgya khra sdushaṃ 0 / da rī snye dzo ༄na spu sa gle/shā lha bi ra 'asto ba'iri datsho /kau' ngal bzod brlagyo re da pa byung ste/ rta ༅ bong da0 sogarusku gang byung za dpe— /sa byung bar ngarten lha sa khul du ngar/ngas gzhas 'di 'dra zhis/ yo/da pa ste/ ‘ mi byed rgu byed byed mkhan/ bstan rgyas gling gi grwa nga / rta sha bong sha za dgos/khyod tshas byas pa'i las red’ ces btang 'dus de nas bstan rgyas gling la me skyogs dang sa me brgyab nas rtsa gtor btang ba dang / de min ‘lha nu/ grong khyer du rgya dmag lhag 'phro yod nga rnams ser dmag dang / yul dmag rnams sras chung gis ru sne drangs nas mnyam rub thol/ lha gdong shan/ khar bkar 'ded byas pas rgya dmag mang stadro/ ze ga snang ma bzod par skyid chur mchong zhing / de'i skabs su sras chung gi ab phrug gtso bo snya/ dar don grub dgra bo'i mtshon cha'i 'og shor rkyen sras chung mchog nas de ring nga'i dpung pa g.yas pa shor song zhes spyan chab bsil skad/ skabs de'i dmag 'thab kyi brgyud rim nang dgra phyogs kyi mthong snang byung ba'i ba༅/da srol la mgo nas du ba thon pa'i mi de yod na bros rgyu ma gtogs ya lam/ slog thabs mi 'dug ces sras chung gi dgra 'thab nus rtsal la mi rnams/ ha las dgos pa byung 'dugasras chung nyid dmag 'thab rgyal ba'i spobs nyams lta bus bud med la gang byung 'brel ba mdzad stabs sku'i mtshon srung nyams nas dgra bo'i mtshon 'og tu sku gshegs pa red/ lha stobs 'byor dbang phyug gi sras bgres pa 'jigs med dbang phyug 'char 'bul phyag rta gas dgongs don khri 'dzin mdzad rgyur thugs gtan 'khel ba bzhin/ lo rgyus kyi mdzad lam ltar khri 'don gzab rgyas gnang zhing /lha rgya ri'i ngo 'bangs ser skya yo/ngas nas khri chen rin po che 'di nyid chos srid blang jor gyi gnas kun la gong myosko 'i bzhed srol ltar khri 'gan gzab bzhes 36

thog ya rabs kyi rnam thar bskyang ste bde ldan dge bcu'i dpal la longs su spyod pa zhig yong rgyu'i re bcol zhus/ 'on kyang khri chen rin po ches rgya ri ba'i mtshan snyan dang / mnga' 'bangs kyi re ba 'a/sa ldog ste che tshugs ma zin nga dang thugs gshes tsub cing/ / gtum drag che bas gam bcar zhabs 'bring rnams dang / mang(re ( rebangs mi ser thog gdug rtsub che ba'i phyag 'bebaskyusdo gnang ba dang / rgya ri'i pho brang dang / khri chen/ rgyun gtan bzhugaskyuṭa yul gyi rgyal sgo'i g.yakusmu g.yon du 'dogs khyi mthu la rngam ba zil can kha sprod du btags pa'i bar la mnga' 'bangs mi ser bde sdug zhu bar mi 'gro mthu med kyang khyi srung mkhan med stabs dngangs 'tshab shin tu che bas zhu don yang mi dran pa'i gnas su gyar gyi yod pa red/ de'i dus su khri chen gyi gam zhabs bsod nams tshe ring (ming ngan la rna g.yag zer) gi bza' zla btsan gshed kyi sgo nas khri chen gyi zur bsten chung ma gam/nga stabs bsod nams tshe ring la cung zad bstun mkhas mdzad dgos kyi yod cing / kho pas 'bas khongs nang khul dang / mi ser khyer 'khos drag gras la bca' dngos rnying ma'am/ dpe gsar gang yod khri chen la snyan seng zhus te btsan 'phrog gam/nga gi yod pa/ da per na/ zhabs khongs phun tshogs dbang 'dus kyi bza' zla'i pha rgya nag tu tshong gnyer ched gtong mdzad pa phyir log skabs kho rang sger gyi dngos po dpe gsar khag gcig bsod nams tshe ring gis mthong ste 'di dang 'di 'dug ces khri chen la snyan seng zhus 'phral rtsad zhib mdzad pas dngos po rnams spyan bstar mi zhu ka med byung ba de dag rin thang brtsi 'gro med par bzhes rkyang mdzad pa sogs bag chags ngan pa'i shugs rkyen la mi tshang mas yi ma rangs pa'i blo pham byed cing / de'i dus sger gzhung 'bangs bcas thun mong gis e chu mdo gyang du yar shod drung yig rgan bdag 37

zer ba dkar rtsis la mkhas pa zhig yod pa khong gdan zhus kyis khri chen gyi 'khrungs skar brtsi ru bcug pa'i rtsis 'bras su dbul po lag stong dang /'phrod me chu nang 'phrad/ dus tshod ngan pa sogs 'khel bas khri 'dzin gnang 'os ma mchis zhes brjod skad/ de bzhin khri chen nas lha lcam la skyong 'os thugs brtse'i spyod bzang dang sto dzo—la su bral ba'i tsub spyod kho na mdzad rkyen lha lcam nyid thugs pham yi chad ngang rang gzim du go log phyir phebs mdzad dgos byung zhing / de rjes rgya ri'i ngo bzhugs rnams dang / mnga' 'bangs mgrin gcig nas khri chen gyi tshul min mdzad spyod skor sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan zhu phul ba dang / rgya ri lha lcam nas kyang yab tshang khri smon sa dbang brgyud khri chen gyi tshul min mdzad spyod zhib phra bka' shag la snyan 'bul gnang ba'i phyir phebs dgongs don khri chen 'jigs med dbang phyug 'phral du lha sar phebs dgos pa'i bka' dgongs ltar lha sar bcar skabs bka' shag nas khri 'dzin mdzad stangs skor zhu ba blangs par rgya ri ngo 'bangs lha lcam dang bcas pa'i zhu don dngos ra gsal 'phrod la brten khri chen 'jigs med dbang phyug khri las bshol rgyu'i thag gcod byas te rgya ri bas gong smad bkra shis khang gsar du bzhugs gnas gsar rgyag zur skal dang bcas phul ba der lo bcu tsam bzhugs rjes chu bo gzhis su bzhugs rgyu'i thugs mos ltar rgya ri gzhis bzhugs dang nang mol zhal bzhes byung ste khri zur gyi dgongs 'dun ltar chu bo gzhis su spo bzhugs gnang / sa de'i ri klung gang sar rtsa chu shing gsum gyi cha rkyen phun sum tshogs la bzhugs gnas shin tu dben pas zhal 'do na dge sbyor 'phel ba'i sgrub gnas lta bu yod rung / khri zur nyid gtum spyod kyi thugs gshis 'gyur ldog ma thub stabs mi ser rnams rim bzhin yul gyar thog thon skyed kyang lo re bzhin je zhan je sdug tu song bar brten 'a 'ub 38 tsho

ma 'dus pa'i gnas su gyar te 'on chos sde bla brang nas 'bru bun chu blangs pa ltar lemyo/ dgos byung zhing / skabs der khong gi gzhis g.yog dang gam zhabs mang che ba yul byol du song rjes bran g.yog gsum las lhag med kyang da dung mnar gcod mdzad rgyu mtshams 'jog ma gnang stabs zhal ta ma bu mo gcig gtsang chur mchongs nas shi dgos byung 'dug mthar mdun g.yog gnyis 94sa lhag med pa'i gnas su gyar/ khong gi sku tshe'i lhag ma chu bo gzhis su bzhugs pas mtshan la'ang (chu bo khri zur zer) khong la rigs sras gcig las byung med pa de khri tshab mdzad rgyu'i thugs 'dun che yang yab kyi mdzad spyod zhan pa'i dbang ges khri tshab mdzad rgyu ma byung ba'i mus su glo bur glen lkugs su gyur pa'i ya mtshan can gyi sanas tshul byung rjes gzhon nu'i dus nas sku gshegs pas khri 'dzin rgya ri sras chung rnam rgyal dbang phyug gi rigs sras skal bzang snyan grags la gtan 'khel mdzad/ chu bo khri zur 1959lo dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur skabs btson du bcug nas 1960lor kong po rtse la sgang btson bang du sku gshegs/khri 'dzin skal bzang snyan grags dgung lo 16thog khri phebs mdzad sgo sngar lam ltar gzab rgyas bskyangs pa dang chabs cig lho kha gong dkar 'o sbug rgya mtsho'i rigs sras rig 'dzin zhu ba lha bla'i lung brtag dang rtsis 'bras gang ci dbe mtshan phun sum tshogs par brten lha lcam du bsu bzhes mdzad de khrung sa'i ma dzad sgo yang stabs gcig dus gnyis su mdzad/ de'i rjes su lha lcam gong gsal la rigs sras rnam rgyal rgya mtsho dang / sras mo skal bzang chos 'dzoms sras chung snyan grags ( 1959lor phyi rgyal du phebs) de 'og sras chung blo gros byis pa'i dus nas sku 'das/ de 'og sras chung nor bu( 195khalor lha sa nas do dam khongs tshud rjes las mir bsgyur te rta 'then 33

rirekhor lo 'gan (rakhre rngakanang bas stabs mi legs par phyag g.yon pa skyon can du gyur nanu/ deng skabs ‘sta sar las mi ru khag lnga pa'i khongs su bzhugs yod)de 'orngasha sras 'bri gung chung tshang sprul sku (da lta lha sar bzhugs mus) yab lha ska9ro bzang snyan grags nas khri 'gren rnam spyod bzang po'i lugs bzhin mi skyong ba ra rnam kun chibs 7ོ 'gros ma dang me mda'i tsha kha gzigs rgyur ha cang mnyes shing rta rtsal 'gran pa dang lhag par me mda'i tsha kha gzigs dus (reben la bod dngul ṭam dkar mi ser gyi phru gu gzhon nu zhig gi lag rkyang 'dzin du bcug gnang bas skabs shig na phru gu gcig la me mdel phog nas srog shor ba dang / gzhan yang rnam kun pho brang du bzhugs te chos srid kyi bya ba lhur bzhes mi mdzad par grong khul 'khyams nyul chang 'thung dang / bud med gang byung la tshul min 'dod sred kho nas dus 'da' ba dper na/ lha lcam gam du yo da bzhin par zhal ta ma dang / bal ma/ zhabs gras kyi bza' zla/nang bzan bud med bcas la gang byung gi btsan g.yem mdzad kyi yod pa ma zad/ lha lcam sku ngo mar jo/na med phyag 'bebs mdzad pas gab sa ma rnyed pas skabs 'gar cha sgam nang 'dzul yib gnang dgos pa sogs tha shal gyi mdzad spyod kho na bskyangs mthar rgya ri'i mi ser rong sba lu'i bu mo bsod nams g.yang 'dzoms zer ba zur bsten gtan nyar rgyan gos gang gzab g.yogs te pha na tshun phebs skabs kyang rta rags bsgrigs nas mnyam 'khrid mdzad kyi yod pas dmangs khrod nas khri/ chen smyon pa zer gyi yod la yi ma rangs pa'i bshad tshusnyel sna tshogs yod/ yin na'ang skyabs mgon sku phreng bcu gsum pa zhe dgu'i dgung skeg skabs sngar lam rgya ri khri chen brtan bzhugs 'bul bcar skabs khri chen ltos bcas tshang mas gra 'grig 'thus tshang zhig e yong snyam nas thugs khral chen po byung yang dngos su brtan 'bul skabs maṇḍal 40

rjags ba༅/da sogs tshig rdo/ma tso// ro ci nem nur zhum med rnga ra ku tho gyi daḍa— nga 'dren pa'i 'thus tshang sang legre/sasdo byung bas skabs der lha sa khul du khri chen smyon pa rtsa ba nas ma red zer ba'i bshad srol yang byung 'dug/ khong rnam kun mdzad tshul mi legs pa yod nges las/ mi ser thogre 'phar ma'i brdab mnar che rigs byung me da/ yin na'ang khri chen gyi 'khur bzhes 'os pa'i mdzad 'phrin ji bzhin skyong ma thub pas rgya ri'i mnga' 'bangs mgrin gcig nas sa gnas srid gzhung la snyan phul zhus pa'i phyir phebs su rigs sras rnam rgyal rgya mtsho dgung na ma son bar du sku mched rje btsun ye shes dbang mos rgya ri'i thugs 'gan bzhes dgos pa dang / khri skal bzang snyan grags khri las phab nas zur bzhugs gnang dgos phebs pa ltar rong klu khang du bzhugs gnas sku skal phul te rong sba lu'i bu mo bsod nams g.yang 'dzoms dang lhan du bzhugs nas dgung lo bzhi/ bcur phebs skabs sku 'das/ gong dkar 'o sbug nas bsu bzhes lha lcam ngo ma rgya ri pho brang du gtan bzhugs mdzad pa khong 1kha59lor dmangs/ gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs pho brang nas phyir phud de shag lho'i mi ser ri sgo zhol khang zer ba'i rdo skas 'og tu yod nga 'i ra ba zhig sprad pa de'i nang bzhugs skabs phyag rogs la rigs sras rnam rgyal rgya mtsho'i sras mo zhal lkugs ma zhig yod pa de thugs nyar gnang / slabs der lha yum gyi dang po'i zhal ta ma nor bu sgrol mas lha yum dang bral 'dod rtsa ba nas med pa'i ga(nung bzang bcos min gus bkur gyis dus yun gang 'tsham ring mnyam bzhugs rjes lha yum shag lho chus su bkag nyar 'thab rtso da dra ga po byas pa dang chabs cig nor bu sgrol ma mnyam du bsdad mi chog palī bka' phab ste rang khyim rong rta dpon du phyir log mi 'gro dka' med byung / de nas lha yum la ri zhol bkras skyabs dgon gyi a ne'i shag gog cig sprad pa der 41

bzhugs/ lha yum sku na bgres tsam yin pa dang phyag rogs sras mo bde chen g.yang 'dzoms zhal lkugs ma rnam gnyis lhan bzhugs mdzad de cha rkyen ha cang zhan pa'i 'tsho thabs gnang skabs khul de'i gzur gnas can gyis gzigs dus ya nga ba'i gnas su gyar/ phyag rogs sras mor zas gos kyi gces skyong gnang re bral rung phyag brda mdzad nas rmo bo'i sar sdod gsungs te 'khris su thugs nyar gyis dbu la byil byil gnang ba dang zhal sbyar ba sogs shin tu gces par mdzad kyi yod/ de nas mi ring bar lha yum 'das nas sku phung bdag med du lus skabs mu tig tshom bu'i snyan rgyan zhig yod pa der bltas nas bkras skyabs blo bzang chos rgyal zer bas sku phung la thag pa brgyab ste rta bong gi ro ltar drud nas rgya ri'i lho ngos grog rong du dbyugs/ bkras skyabs dgon gyi a ne dbang mos byams dang snying rje'i bsam pa zol med kyis sras mo zhal lkugs ma gso nyar mtha' 'khyongs byas mthar khong gi yab khri rnam rgyal rgya mtsho gu yang btson grol byung rjes sras mo gong gsal lha sar bskongs 'gugs mdzad de deng skabs lha sar bzhugs mus red/ rje btsun sku gzhon ye shes dbang mos khri tshab lo bcu tsam mdzad ring rgya ri'i phyi nang gang sar tshags tshud byung ba dang / lhag par da gon sde khag gi chos rgyun nyams med rgyun 'khyongs mdzad/ mnga' 'bangs mi ser thog la byams sdang 'bring tsam byung 'dug khong gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad spyod zhig ni rgya ri'i zhabs gras gzhis khag 'dzin skyong byed par 'gro skabs bza' zla mnyam khrid mi chog pa dang khong nyid nye 'gyangs gang du phebs kyang zhabs gras mang zhing chibs rags rgyas spros gnang gi yod pa red/ rje btsun ye shes dbang mo 1kha5khalor dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs dgung grangs re lngar phebs nas sku gshegs/42

lha rgya ri khri thog bzhi pa rnam rgyal rgya mtsho sa 'brug 1rdzo2rdolor 'khrungs/sku na son rjes rgya ri pho brang rang du rig gnas rang sbyong lo shas gnang rjes lha sa bka' ༅/ba/ drung yig sar phebs nas skyar sbyong gnang ba dang sbrags tshad ldan bla spru9ri khag nas gsang sngags rnying ma'i chos sgo gsan bzhes thog sngon 'gro bsags sbyang gi nyams len tshul bzhin mdzad/ 1946lor khri 'dzin che 'don gyi mdzad sgo dang chabs cig rim bzhi rin sgang pa'i sras mo pad ma dbyang sa can khri chen mchog gi sku bag tu bsu bzhes mdzad rgyu thugs gtan 'khe'/ nas phebs skyel zhu mi rin sgang pa'i sku tshab 'phyongs rgyas 'bum thang drung yig gis mdzad pa'i sku 'khor rnams lha sa nas rgod la brgyud phebs bzhugs zhag shas thog e mdzes stod du phebs/ rgya ri'i phyag mdzod gong po khang gsar rnam rgyal dbang phyug gis rgya ri'i sku tshab mdzad de chibs zhabs rta pa bcu phrag phebs bsur 'byor/ de'i sang nyin gza' skar 'byung 'phrod dge nga'i nyin thog mar lha lcam mchog la na bza' gzab legs dang / rin chen du ma las grub pa'i sku rgyan phun sum tshogs pa sgron 'bul zhus zin 'phral bdud rtsi mthun mtshams dang bstun rgya ri pho brang du gdan zhu'i phebs bsu skyel gyi chibs zhabs rta pa sum cu skor yod pa'i bkod legs gral bstar chibs bskyod phebs lam g.yas g.yon du mnga' 'bangs skye bo pho mo du mas phebs bsu'i sku bsangs phul ba'i du sprin gyis re zhig nyi ma'i 'od kyang 'phrog pa dang dus mtshungs lha lcam gyi 'dzum zhal la longs su spyod par 'dod pas mi tshogs kyi khrod nas shugs skyed de mgrin pa gzengs su bstod pa dang / byis pa phrag steng 'khur nas lta bar byed pa sogs dga' spro'i nyams 'gyur ci rigs bstan/ pho brang gi yang steng du bkras shis phreng ring dang dar gyi lda ldis brgyan pa dang / lha bsangs/ dung rgya rol mo sogs kyi bsu ba zhus te 4 sdo

rngu ri pho hrorsha rduprekra shir/chos jo nga /sdolor rngarsā'akhwa/ malnga5 / gyi chi bas stegre/sa baྈ ri ngalnga/ ci/nga brjid nyams ldan pa'i ngarka na/sa chibarngage bskyod/ de nas 'bab stegs thog chibs las bshol zin rma thag 'bebs bshad dang // bar sgor sgo bshad/ phebs skas kyi bshad pa sogs rim bzhin bkra shis pa'i tshig gi sngocha/ bsus nas zhal te ma sogs kyis phyag 'dren/ zhu bzhin tshoms chen du pheng/sa/ khri chen rin po che chos rgyal gong ma'i na bza' dang / mgul rgyan snyan rgyan sogs rin chen du mas yongs su klubs te bzhugs khrir 'dzum bzhin dgyes bzhugs yod pa dang lhan cig tu lha lcam mchog bzhugs khrir 'khod/ de nas rten 'brel mdzad sgo dbu tshugs te gsol ja dang /bzhes spro/ bzhes 'bras/ gro gso phye mar/ khrung phud sogs rim bzhin 'degs 'bul zhus rjes rgya ri gzhung 'bangs dang / yab tshang rin sgang bcas kyi rten 'brel 'bul mtshon bsta ra 'bul dang 'brel phebs bsu skyel dang bcas pas rang rang go bab kyi mjal dar phul nas gral gnas su 'khod/mtshams der phebs bsu bas lha lcam mchog la rten 'brel gyi gtsug g.yu sgron 'bul dang 'brel bkra shis pa'i g.yu bshad phul/ de 'phral gzhas chen 'bul ba dang / khrung zhu mas bdud rtsis khengs pa'i dngul rkyan dngul phor btegs te phud stor zhus/ skabs der sngar lam bod gzhung gi sku tshab rtsis dpen zhig phebs ngagos pa ltar de lo rtsis dpon rnam gling pa phebs mdun gi sbug dam phyag rtsa stsal bzhes sanang / tshoms chen gyi mdzad sgo grub 'phral pho brang yang steng du thog gso la lha ngo sprod par chibs bsgyur skabs phebs skyel zhu mi'i sku tshab kyis dar barshad phul ba dang lha lcam mchog gi dpal bskyed 'khel sar dar 'dzugs dang 'brel mgon po bas lha bsangs phul te 'phrin bcol gzab rgyas mdzad nga dang chabs cig phebs bsu dang phebs skyel zhu mkhan 44

thun mong gis bkris pa'i lha rgyal 'then te thog gso la mdzad sgo legs par grub rjes ga zim chung so sor phebs/ te sku ngal mdzad/ khrung sa'i mdzad sgo dngo sa gzhi'i skabs thugs snang dge /yul dang mnga' 'bangs sogs kyi rten 'brel zhu bcar rigs dgyes spro'i ngang 'bu‘ra bzhes gnang zhing thugs spro'i dus pun bdun phrag gcig ring sku rtsed sna tshog/sa dang bro gzhas/ glu gar la sogs pas dgyes ston gzab rgyas thog bkra shis grol ston mdzad/tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pas chos srid thugs 'gan bzhes pa'i mdzad sgo'i ska bas khri chen gyis sngar lam brtan bzhugs zhabs brtan 'bul rgyu dang / maṇḍal ljags bshad zhu rgyu sogs 'phyugs med gzengs thon byung ba'i mtshan snyan grags shing / 1956lo bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang dbu brnyes rjes lho kha sa gnas spyi khyab don gcod las khungs tshuganu/ skabs khri chen rnam rgyal rgya mtsho spyi khyab don gcod 'a/sa khungs kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa dang / lha lcam pad ma dbyangs can bud med kyi kru'u ren gzhon pa/ khri chen gyi sku mched gcung po sras chung snyan grags gzhon nu sde tshogs kyi u yon bcas chab srid kyi dbu gnas phul ba ltar thugs 'ab/na che bzhes kyis rgya ri'i mnga' khongs la mes rgyal nang khul dang / sa gnas khag la slob grwa ba gtong rgyu'i 'bod skul shugs chen gnang ba dang 'brel slob grwa ba khyon che ka kor med par gtong rkyang mdzad pa dang / gzhan yang 1956lo lha rgya ri khri chen rnam rgyal rgya mtshos thugs 'khur chen pos rgya rir rdzong don gcod las khungs kyi sgrig gzhi cha tshang rgya ri pho brang 'og la gsar 'dzugs gnang ba dang 'brel gzhon nu tshogs pa dang / bud med tshogs pa/ zlos gar chogs pa/ slob grwa ba sogs gsar 'dzugs gnang yang 1kha5rdolo ngo log zing 'khrug dngos su langs nye'i mtshams gong gsal sgrig gzhi rnams 45

'thor zhig tu song ba red/1kha57lo rgya ri'i zhabs khongs gong po khang gsar phyag mdzod kyi bu 'jigs med la rtsis dpon rnam gling dpal 'byor 'jigs med kyis rgyab skyor 'og gzhung zhabs shod drung gi go gnas zhus stsal byung bar brten skabs der khri chen gyi dgongs par gong po khang gsar rgya ri'i zhabs khongs yim/ bzhin du gzhung zhabs zhu 'os rtsa ba nas ma mchis pas phyir 'then gnang rgyu'i snyan zhu 'bul gnang mdzad gtan 'khel te sa dbang zur khang dbang chen dge legs dang / rtsis dpon rnam glingarmo rnam gnyis dang nang ma'i bka' gros gnang skabs khong gnyis kyis gong po khang gsar rgya ri'i zhabs khongs sngayin na'ang dga' ldan pho brang gi zhabs 'degs zhu ma bcug par phyir 'then mdzad 'os ma mchis/ de bas khri chen rin po che dbu gnas mtho yang lho kha spyi khyab mkhan chung zhig gi 'og tu rdzong gzhis spyi mtshungs kyi gnas babs su bzhugs ma dgos par khri chen dbu gnas rang 'jags thog dza sag gi dbu gnas shig zhu gnang mdzad na legs gnas nang ma'i bka' gros byung ba ltar mdzad rgyu'i thugs 'dun byung ste mi ring snyan 'bul gnang bas 'gro phyogs kyi cha rkyen la brten bzhed dgongs ji bzhin byung ste 195rdolo'i bod zla 2pa'i nang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog 'bras spungs dgon gyi tshogs dbus su chibs bsgyur skabs dza sag gi gsar mjal zhu gnang mdzad/skabs der nang don ji bzhin ma rtogs pa'i dmangs khrod du lha rgya ri khri chen ni chos rgyal gyi gdung rgyud la brten bod ljongs bla sprul che khag dang 'dra bar skye bo kun gyi phyag byar 'os pa zhig kyang gzhung zhabs dza sag gi go ming zhu gnang mdzad stabs khri chen mchog la sku ngo chen po zhes zhus te gnas bab go ldog rta bab bong bzhon gyi rnam pa lta bur mngon zhing / de rjes rgya rir phyir 46

phebs pho brang du bzhugs mus thog 195〈lo'i bod zla 5pa'i nang lha rgya riྈ glo bur du chu bzhi sgang drug gi dmag mi 50skor 'byor ba kha cig gis pho brang yang steng du 'dzegs te gang byung me mda' brgyab nas 'jigs snang skul ba dang / kho tsho'i 'go khrid skyabs mgon chos mdzad dang / klu sgrub phyag mdzod/ cha 'dren phyag mdzod zer ba bcas kyis khri chen bzhugs yul du shar kharidzul thog khri chen gyi phyag sa/nyis nas bzung ste lho khul rgya mir rogs ram rgyab skyor byed mkhan gras kyi byed gte gtso bo khyod rang yin 'dug pas de ring nga tshob/ srog thog tu gtong rgyu yin ces 'jigs skul byas sta bas lha lcam dang /zhabs gras rnams ci bya gtol bral du gyur zhing / stabs legs pa zhig la skabs der dwags po grwa tshang tshogs yongs chos 'khor rgyal du dbyar zhal bzhes su phebs dus sngar lam lha rgya rir bdun phrag gsum bzhugs kyi yod pa dang skabs 'khel dwags grwa'i mkhan rin po che dang / dbu mdzad las sne rnams nas khams jag la zhu 'bul gnang ngor cung zad gu yangs bzhag pa'i go skabs dang bstun nyin de'i mtshan mor khri chen stangs dpyal dang /zhabs gras bcu skor bcas garu/nga thabs kyis bre dgon du g.yol tsam mdzad pa de nas gang mgyogs lha sar gab g.yol du phebs/ 1959lo lha sar zing ḍarikhrug zhod 'jags skabs khri chen mchog kyang 'dzin bzung do dam khongs tshud de bod dmag khul khang gi btson khang du bkag nyar byas zhing /197b.lo btson grol thob nas mi ring bar bod ljongs chab gros u yon la bkod sgrig mdzad/47
