rgya ri pho prang chags yu' dang bzo bkod/gam/'a bo'i grong rda‘ra rtsed thang ma/sa spyi le lnga bcu sko ra gyi shar lho'i mtshams te rgya ri'i byang ngos gad pa rngams su gting zab tshad tho ga brtsegs nyi shu tsam yod pa'i steng du brjid nyams ldan pa'i thog brtseb/sa gsum ldan gyi pho brang zhig yod pa'i mdun ngos su‘‘dkar gzhal’ zhes pa 'khyams shin tu che ba mtha' skor du rdo tshos gzhi 'dra min sna tshogs bsgrigs pa'i mdzes ris bkra shis rtags brgyad dang / rgyal srid sna bdun/ 'dod yon sna lnga sogs kyis phyug pa de'i dbus su lo ltar zla ba dang po'i nang e dgon lnga yi 'cham rgyag dgos pa tshang ma sdebs gcig tu 'chud kyi yod/ e khul bzo rigs 'a ga shes mi sna mang po yod pas rgya ri'i pho brang de bzhin sra zhing mkhegs la brjid cing lhun chags di zhig bskrun 'dug pho brang gi byang ngos su spro khang chags yul gling kha'i rgya khyon (lha sa nor gling gi rgya khyon gsum tsam yod) ha cang che ba'i nang thog gcig ma'i spro khang bzo dbyibs legs la sge'u khung dang khra bcad sogs la shing brkos ri mo bya dang / me tog 'brug la sogs pa'i mdzes par brgyan pa'i khang bzang gi mtha' skor du spang ljongs dang /me tog stsa/ tshogs/ 'bras ldan shing sogs kyis yongs su bskor ba gzhan yang lta na sdug pa'i khrus kyi rdzing bu sogs yod/rgya ri'i sngar lam mdzad sgo chugs srol skor/lo ltar gnam lo gsar tshes kyi tshes 1nyin gyi zhos/sa pa'i tho rengs snga 48

4da ri 4 dreng bkrasheṭa/chos rkedirdzam sa yang lta'i ri du ji lnge/ che ma glu cho tsho ma yi sgaza' co —rizlo /batshe/sa kyis / 'basatshogras sku 'khoragrecas dpa'/ lda kai ha 3rngoḍire tshes gtor 'arul se dang sbragarsha/ 'phrin bcol ma dzad/ de nas tshoms chen du dpal lda rlo/ lha mo'i gtor kṣ-irebul grub rjes rang rang bzhugs gnas su phebanu/ te sku ngal she nga zad gsos/ de nas nyi ma drod mtshams choms chen du lo gsar dgyes/ swān mdzad sgo dngos gzhi rta) bu tshugs/ khri chen rin po che na bza' mdzod go/sa dang / zhabs lham 'ja' mtshal/ rgya gri phor shubs/ gre/ser gyi mu sogadabu zhwa wa gir sogs gzab bzhes gnang ste tshoms chen mdzad sgo'i khri thob/ tu phebs/ lha lcam gyi na bza' gos ser ma'i rgyab ldan sku tshags dang / bos ser ma'e phu med/ steng brtsegs/ gzan sna lnga/ mu tig dbu phrugagre/ser gyi mgul ga'u khra ldan/ gser gyi snyan skor/ rdzul gyi mgu'/ phreng gser gyi bcu bshad/ 'ba' khug la/ ba shubs/ mu tig thod rgyan sogs gzab bzhes gnang nas mdun gral gyi gral 'gor bzhugs/ mu tig thod rgyan zhal ta ma/sa bteg sa/ gzhan yang phyag mdzod/ gnyer pa/ mgrom/ drung / phyag g.yog rgyun zhabs sum cu skor/ de min nang bzan sogs mi grangs bdun cu skor yod pa so so'i gras gnas la 'khod cing / gsol zhu ba zhabs gras gnyis kyis gsol ja dang pyo btegs skabs mgron gnyer ma/sa pus mo/ g.yas pa btsugs am phrag nas phor pa bton te gsorṣapre jar dug se' gyi tshul du rang gis btung rjes khri chen rin po che'i zhal dkar yu ring myo /nga gsol ja btegs/ de nas rim bzhin bzhugs gral g.yas g.yon la gsol ja zhus zin pa dang / mgon gsol dbu mdzad rkyo gus 'dud dang bcas ja mchod 'dod rgu char 'bebs bskul 'don grub mtshams gsol bzhes /yang gsol ja gnyis pa'i thog bzhes gro bzhes 'bras 'degs 'bul zhus pa 49

mchod pa phul nas bzhes/ de nas gro gso phye mar dang dngul rkyan dngul phor btegs te bkra shis bde legs kyi phud stor mdzad rjes dkar gro bsgrigs gshom dang 'brel khrung bskol btegs bzhes grub 'phral phyag mdzod kyi gtsos zhabs gras nang bzan dang bcas pas go rim gyi rten 'brel mjal dar phul/ de nas dwags grwa dge bshes gnyis kyi mjal dar a she dang maṇḍal rten gsum ljags bshad 'degs 'bul thog rgya ri'i gdung rabs rim byon gyi lo rgyus rags tsam drangs te rgya ri dang / dwags po grwa tshang chos yon nyi zla zung 'brel ji srid du gnas pa'i thugs smon dang 'brel khri chen rin po cher dbu thug mdzad/ de nas dge bshes gnyis pos rtag rten gyi ched du mtshan nyid 'khrug tsam rtsod de bzhugs gral du 'khod par gsol 'bras dang /dkar gro btegs/ gsol ja gsum pa btegs rjes grol ja 'degs tsam byas nas tshoms chen gyi mdzad sgo grol/tshes 2nyin rgyug ring chen mo'i mdzad sgor lha rgya ri'i gzhung rta bzhi dang /de byings rgyug rta sum cu skor zhabs gras drung 'khor nasartsogatong dgos pa dang /rta chung zhes pa'i zhabs gras nas rgyug rta gtong mi dgos pa ni zhabs rten pha gzhis rgya khyon gyi khyad par dbye 'dug rgyug ring glod skabs byis pa lo 12tsam gyi rgyug rta bzhon nas rgyug gi yod cing/ skyong dkar thang du mi rta gra sgrig zin mtshams rgya ri pho brang dbu rtse nas ri chos dbu mdzad kyis bsangs dang ser skyems btang zin 'phral rgya ri'i chibs dpon gyis rta bzhon te lam phyed tsam slebs skabs pho brang du kha phyogs zhwa phud gus 'dud zhus te rgyug ma gra sgrig zin pa'i mtshon rtags bstan/ de 'phral me mda'i skad grags pa dang / rgyug ma rnams dus gcig tu glod de ka sbyong ri khrod mda'i mchod rten yod sar 'byor snga rting la drung yigo nas shing byang sprad zin bstun rta pa rnams 50

phyir log rgya ri'i pho brang tshomaṭwāṃ chen du bcar te gsol ja dang / dkar gro btegs/ de rjes rgyug rta'i ang rim ltar gyi mtshan grangs gnang srol yod/tshes 4nyin dngos gzhi'i rta rgyug skabs skyong dkar thang du dbu gur phub/ khri chen rin po che dang / lha lcam/ sras sros/ zhabs 'bring dang bcas pa chibs bsgyur zhabs 'khod mtshams gsol ja dang / gsol gro/ bzhes gro/ bzhes 'bras/ khrung phud/ dkar gro sogs 'degs 'bu'/ zhutsu/ rta rgyug rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum yod pa rgyas pa'i skabs rta pa 'i gyon pa gos tshos man dang / 'go snam rgya smug gi 'ja' lham/ sog zhwa/rgya gri phor shubs/ skra ga'u/ mda' zhu sag thag gos chen dang / spu ma/ 'go snam bcas kyi gog rtse dang brang 'jun sogs dang / 'bring bar 'go snam smyug se'i gyon pa/ lham spu shol/ skra ga'u sogs gong mtshungs/bsdus par gos snam rgya tshos/ lham ko shol/ de min gong mtshungs gyon srol// rta pa rnams 'dzoms 'phral mgron gnyer nas mi rta gnyis kyi gos rgyan rta chas sogs zhib bsher skabs cha tshang med na 'bog lcag gzhu srol/rgyug thengs dang po gtong rgyug skabs zhwa phud gus 'dud zhus/ mda' rkyang rgyug thengs gsum/ de rjes 'ben gnyis btsugs nas me mda' dang /mda' 'phen gyi rgyug thengs gnyis/ de rjes stong rgyug thengs gcig rgyug dus zhwa phud sogs gong bzhin dang / gnyer pas gos tshos man dang /'go mtshal kha gon/ rgya gri phur shubs/ gser gyi skra ga'u/ sog byil sogs gzab sbyor spras/ drung yig gis gos tshos man gyon pa dang se ril smyug krog btags te gdan du 'khod nas rta pa rnams la lta zhib kyis tshwa tho bkod de tshwa rer gnang cha zhes sngar srol bod dngul skar phyed brgyad re sprod srol ltar sprad rjes khrung zhu mas khri chen rin po che dang / lha lcam/ zhabs 51

gras sogs tshang mar mchod chang btegs nas rta rgyug gi mdzad sgo grub/tshes 5nyin/ pho brang bkra shis chos rdzong gi dar chen sku bzhengs zhu skabs sngar srol g.yag gcig skabs de rang la bsad pa'i pags pa dar chen la dkri zhing / sha dang / nang khrol rnams dum bur btubs nas zhabs gras rnams la bgos te za srol de ni lha rgya rir cizhabs 'degs lhag bsam rnam dag zhu rgyu'i mna' dam mtshon byed yin pa dang / de las ‘regal na rgya rir rnga chen 'ig yod pa de dag thengs 1 2brdungs na rong lha rgyal mtshan gyis bka' chad phog srid ces bshad srol yod pa red/tshes rdonyin pho brang gong gi yang steng du khri chen rin po che stangs dpyal sku 'khor dang bcas phebs te rong lha rgyal mtshan spyan sngar mchod sprin 'bul gshoms dang 'brel gtor sgam dam ldan zhal phye gtor gsos dang / rin po che'i rigs 'a‘ra bskongs gnang ste slar yang dam bca' grub 'phral gsol ja dang / dkar gro 'degs 'bul zim rjes mdzad sgo grol/zla 2tshes ṭwāṃnyin rdzong zur zhes lha gnas rong lha rgyal mtshan gyi mgon khang du khri chen rin/ po che dang 'bas 'bring bcas dgun gsol du phebs skabs sngar srol g.yag gcigyo bsad nas dmar mchod 'bul ba dang gtor gsos mdzad/ skabs der zhabs gras rnams nas mna' dam mtshon byed du sha khrag phran bu re za btung byed srol yod 'dugazla 5tshes rdonyin khri chen rin po che sku 'khor chibs zhabs rta pa 50skor lha gnas rdzong zur mgon khang du chibs bsgyur gnang nas dbyar gsol mdzad sgo sngar lam gnang /zla 5tshes 1ṭwāṃnyin ri chos su khri chen rin po che sku 'khor 2 0skor srung ma rgyal po zhes pa spyan 'dren zhu bar phebs srol yod 'dugakye/ 2

zla 6tshes 〈nyin sngar lam klog chos sder rgyal po sku lnga dang gnod sbyin gsol mchod gnang srol dang /zla 10tshes 2 5nyin sngar lam rje tsong kha pa chem/ po'i dgongs rdzogs lnga mchod mchod sprin 'bul skabs pho brang rtser dung rgya'i spyan 'dren dang ṭa ma ru rdung srol/zla 12tshes 27nyin lo gsar tshes 2rta rgyug gi gra sgrig nang sbyong yin zhing / de nyin rgyug rta 'khrid mkhan zhabs gras ngo ma rnams dus 'dzoms kyis sa shur nang rta rgyug nang sbyong byas te tshes 2〈nyin rang gnas su logazla 12nang rgya ri'i pho brang rnying par bkra shis chos rdzong ri chos grwa pa brgya da nas dpal yid dam rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi sgo nas gtor sgrub gnang ba dang / zla 12 tshes 29nyin gtor rgyab tu rdo rje slob dpon nas sngags chas bzhes shing / rnga rol dung rgya sogs dge 'dun nyi shu skor gyi na bza' gzab bzhes dang 'brel gzab sbreng mdzad/ go mo ba rnams nas ba/zab mchor dang ldan pa'i sgo nas gtor rgyab tu me mda' rgyag srol/ khri chen rin po che dang / lha lcam/ sras sros gzim 'khor rnams na bza' gzab bzhes kyis pho brang rab gsal nas gtor rgyab 'cham gzigs gnang srol/zla 12tshes 20nyin/ e dgon dgu nas phebs pa'i mgon po ba dge 'dun dgus sgrub chog sngon zin la 'bag rdzongs zhes gtor glud rdzongs ba dang chabs cig zhabs gras 2khyoskor nas glud rdzongs me mda' rgyag srol bcas/gzhis khag dang zhing ṭwāṃkkabrog thon 'bab/ mi ser/khral 'bab gtong yong sogs/gzhis khag gras su/ rong klu khang gzhis dang 'chad dkar/53

'khrums mda'/ ljang blun po/ 'phrin lo mo/ chu bo/ rong dogs ma/lte'u ra/ bya ngar/ khang gnyer/ rgya ma/ 'dam/ dmag phogs/rta ra/ rgyal gte/ klung / yar te/ 'bring mkhar/ cong rtsa/ spom mda'/ lhun rtse nga/ge rgyas bcas gzhis khag che chung nyi shu rtsa gcig spyir son bsdoms mkhar khal 2ṭwāṃ10'gro zhing lo re'i thon 'bab ji byung gzhis sdod so sos lhag bsam rnam dag gi sgo nas bum pa gsib blug gi 'bul srol ltar spyir btang thon 'bab bdun bskor rtsis pa'i lo re gzhis 'bab 'bru rigs bsdoms mkhar khal1kha7kyaskor 'bebs/mi ser lding khag che chung bsdoms grangs 27gyi sgrub 'don phyed brgyad cu gya gcig nas lo re bogs ma dang / khral 'bab bsdoms 'bru mkhar khal2515'bul dgos pa dang / sa gnas srid gzhung la sngar lam rgya shing brngod gsum gyi dngul khral dngul srang 1222lo ltar bka' shag dang /klu sgug shing gnyer/ rtsam bzhes las khungs so sor 'bul lam zhu dgos kyi 'dug rgya sbyong dmag 'don khongs dmag mi sum cu so gcig 'khri mus thog tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i sku dus su rgya sbyong dmag 'don gnyis re'i sar sku srung dmag re 'gel dkri gnang ba dmag 15dang /gong gsal sgrub 'don phyed rdo1la cha gses byas pa'i 'don dmag 20bcas 'khri 'duga'abrog khag dgu la spu nag pho mo rgan gzhon bsdoms grangs 1kha2rkyasko ra yod khongs nas mo chags 12〈0skor yod par skyes yar cha snyoms 'bri rer lo re she 'bab mar lha srang gi 'degs khal 2re rtsis bsdoms mar khal 12ṭwāṃ0skor dang phyur ba bsdoms mkhar khal 220skor/ spu rtsid lha srang 'degs khal 112tsam/ ra lug bsdoms grangs 1050skor yod par 'o 54

ma 'jo srol med/ gong 'bor nas lug ngo grangs 950skor la lo rer lug re nas ngal nyag do re brtsis bsdoms bal lha khal 2rdo0skor dang / ra ngo grangs lnga bcu skor yod pa ra re nas ra spu nyag re brtsis bsdoms ra spu lha srang gi khal 2tsam thob pa bcas bsdu srol 'dugagong gsal yong 'bab thog nas lo 'khor gcig gi thugs mkhor rong tshong nas mar 'degs khal 1200skor dang / g.yag sha khog 60sko ra/tshwa bul khal 2 50skor bcas lo ltar nyo sgrub byed pa las/ rgya ri rang khongs kyi sems can srog gcod mi byed pa'i srol rgyun de dmangs gtso bcos bsgyur bar lag bstar byas 'dug gong gsal 'bru dngul do dam sngar lam rgya ri'i zhabs gras drag 'dems gnyis re dang / ri sgo chos sde dang bla 'bring dgon so so nas dge 'dun re bcas ser skya bzhi sbrel gyis 'gan 'khur byed pas gong gsal thugs ma kho nyo grub bya rgyu phud/ de min 'bru rigs phyir tshong byas nas rgya ri gzhung rkyang gis sa gnas srid gzhung gi las khungs khag nas dngul bun bzhes nga 'i skyed dngul dus thog 'bul dgos pa'i 'gel dkri yod pa ltar 'gan len zhu dgos shing / gal te skyed dngul dus 'bul zhu 'gyangs mchis che do dam ser skya bzhi sbrel thun mong gis khungs skyel zhu dgos pa red/mchod rgyun khag dang rgya ri'i sku 'khor gyi lo 'khor 'gro gron khagalha dgra las rnam rgyal gyi sku dus su dgra las rnam rgyal gang nyid rgya ri pho brang bkra shis chos rdzong gi yang steng nas khul de'i ri klung mdzes ljongs la 55

gzigs zhib spro 'cham gnang skabs pho brang gi 'dabs rol gzhung lam thog dwags po bal srid bshad pa dang sgrub pa'i gling nas yin pa'i zhi zhing dul ba'i dbe sbyong bdun phrag gcig bshad gling dge 'dun 'dus pa rgya mtsho'i chos rgyun 'tsho ba'i slad du gzhung sar bde sdug snyan 'bul du phebs kyang re ba'i 'bras bu ma son par rang dgon du phyir log phebs pa gzigs nas dge 'dun de rnams pho brang du gdan drangs bkur bste mdzad/ dge 'dun pa de rnams kyis gong gi lo rgyus dgra las rnam rgyal gyi snyan du gsol bas dgra las rnam rgyal gyis da nas bzung ji srid bar lha rgya ri bas bshad sgrub gling dgon gyi yon bdag mdzad rgyu dang / dwags po bshad gling 'dus tshogs nas kyang rgya ri'i gdung rgyud srid thar gnas pa'i thugs smon rgyun bablung mdzad rgyu sogos chos yon nyi zla zung 'brel yun gnas mdzad rgyur phan tshun gnyis phyogs nas zhal bzhes mdzad/ dus de nas bzung dwags grwa tshogs yongs nas chos 'khor rgyal du dbyarari chos phebs skabs pu drang la brgyud rgya ri pho brang du dge 'du na 'dus tshogs zhal grangs tshad bkag med par lo ltar sa zla'i tshes 20nas zla 6tshes 4bar rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin dang 'brel ba'i 'dus tshogs su nyin re'i bsnyen bkur nyin 'khyongs dang / sku 'gyed/ dge 'dun rer nyin re gsol zhib bre re chag med khar/ dbyar gnas ring gi 'tsho ba'i mthun rkyen du dge 'dun rer gsol zhib lhung bzed bzhi re dge 'dun so sos gcu gang thub bzhes 'thus chog pa ma zad/ zla 6tshes 4nyin khri chen rin po che na bza' rgyal chas gzab bzhes kyis tshogs mgon/ du zhabs sor 'khod nyin dwags grwa tshogs yongs dang / mkhan rin po che nas maṇḍal rten gsum 'degs 'bul zhu ba'i srol bzang rgyun mthud dang / dbyar zhal bzhes grub nas bshad sgrub gling dgon gnas su phyir 56

phebs grub pa nas bzung dgon gnas rang gi pashad sgra'i chos rar sgrol ma rta dbyangs dang 'brel tshar lnga re nga — / sher snying tshar gsum re bcas rgyun chad med par 'don gnang ri dzad rgyu'i srol bzang de dag dmangs satso'i bcos bsgyur bar rgyun 'khyongs pū gnas 'dug lha rgya ri pho brang du tshe rte ge ri sgo smon lam zhes pa tshugs —skabs e dgon khag dgu'i dge 'dun nga phebs dgos pa'i khongs ri sgo chos sde dge 'dun zhal grangs 150 bla 'bring chos sde dge 'du4 / zhal grangs 60 gdong mkhar chos sde dge 'dun zhal grangs 50 rti'u ra dgon dge 'dun zhal grangs111 dga' ldan chos sdings dgon dge 'dun zhal grangs 10 rgya ri dgon dge 'dun zhal grangs 20 klog dbo/na dge 'dun zhal grangs 4kya stod gzigs dgon dge 'dun zhal grangs 25 (rong 'chad dkar dgon dge 'dun zhal grangs brgya skor smon lam zur tshogs gsham du gsal) bcas gong gsal dgon khas brgyad kyi dge 'dun zhal grangs bsdoms 267skor lo ltar zla 1tshes 5nyin rgya ri pho brang du phebs 'dzoms kyis dgon sde khag gi dge 'dun rnams gral 'dzin gnang / smon lam nyin bco lnga nge'i ring sngar lam khrims 'doms ri sgo chos sdes byed dgos/ de'i ring lha rgya/ ri nas rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin bstar 'bul dang / lhag par 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur gsol ja bzhes thug dang mchod pa'i yo chas sogs nyin 'khyongs gtong deb nang gsal 'bul dgos smos med khar/skye bo dad ldan khag nas kyang bsnyen bkur zhu mkhan mang po yod 'dug zla 1tshes 15dgong dro lha rgya ri'i pho brang dkar gzhal mthil du ri chos grwa tshang dang bla 'bring chos sde/ gdong mkhar chos sde so so nas rol mo khang gi lding gur kha dzrod du phub/ tshes 16zhogs par gza' skar 'phrod sbyor bdud rtsi 57

mthun mtshams dang bstun nas sku 'cham gnang rgyur grwa tshang so so'i dbu chos las sne dang / dge 'dun rnams 'dul ba'i cha byad gzab bzhes thog dung rgya rol dbyangs kyi khrod nas dge 'dun rnam pas mchod rdzas gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan/ 'phan/ gzhan yang 'dod yon lnga la sogs phreng brgyus ltar gyi ser sbreng mdzad de dkar gzhal mthil du rim bzhin phebs bskyod rol mo khang gi dbu gur nang bzhugs gnas so sor 'khod/ de nas thog mar sa 'dul gar 'cham gu ru rdo rje grod lod sku 'khor dang / de rjes rgyal chen rigs bzhe/ dur bdag yab yum/ chos rgyal yab yum/ zhwa nagarong lha rgyal mtshan sku 'khor/ ha shang 'khor bcas nas bal 'cham zhes pa'i 'cham rgyag pa dang / 'cham mjug bsgril mtshams gtor rgyag skabs rgya ri'i go mdzod gnyer pa nas me mda' ba zhabs gras sum cu la me mda' 'dzam grags re dang / me rdzas sbi ti sogs sprod pa/ de'i dgos don ni gor bod sde gzar skabs g.yul las rgyal ba'i rten 'brel mtshon byed red ces zer srol 'dug sku 'cham nyin pho brang rab gsal nas khri chen rin po che dang lha lcam sku 'khor rnams 'cham gzigs gnang srol yod/ skabs der rtsed thang sogs nas tshong rigs khag 'du 'dzoms kyis nyo tshong byed kyi yod la/ rgya ri'i mnga' khongs ser skya mang tshogs dang / de bzhin zangs ri sogs yul gru khag nas skye bo pho mo mang po 'cham dang / smon lam tshugs skabs tshogs mjal zhu ba dang sbrags dgos mkho nyo sgrub byed par yong gi yod pas 'khrug cha dod po yod/ tshes 16zhogs pa bka' 'gyur 'du khang nang dgon khag gsum gyi dge 'dun 'du tshogs kyi tshogs mgon du khri chen rin po che rgyal chas(chos rgyal srong btsan sgam po'i cha chas) bzhes te chibs bsgyur dang sbrags gnas gzigs mchod 'bul sku 'gyed sogs 'bul gnang mdzad/58

tshes 1ram̐cidagong dro gtor rgyag skabs e dgon brgyad kyi dge 'dun 'du tshogs kyi ser sbreng dang / ri chos dbu mdzad kyi sngags chas gzab bzhes kyis rdo rje slob dpon mdzad nas gtor rgyag la phebs/ gretor gzor 'phangs skabs me mda' ba zhabs gras sum cu skor nas me myo/da' 'dzam grags thengs re rgyag dgos pa de skabs kha bsu shor ba sogs kyi nyes skyon la mgron gnyer nas 'bog lcag re zhu gi yod/ me mda' ba ru g.yas g.yom/ so sos me mda' brgyab tshar rim bzhin g.yas rus gzhung sgo dang / go/na rus ltag sgo brgyud nas da' bu'i ngang bskyod de dkar gzhal mthil du gri 'khyer lja/gas rkyang skul ba dang / gtor rgyag dge 'dun rnams nas mnga' gsol ma/dzad de gtor gzor 'phangs pa'i mdzad sgo grub/rong 'chad dkar chos sder dge 'dun brgya skor yod pa de snga e dgon khag dgu'i khongs yin rung / ri sgo smon lam dus skabs shig la dgon yas mas thugs mthun ma byung stabs phyis rong 'chad dkar gzhis su zla 2tshes 1nas nyin bdun ring smon lam sger tshogs gnang dgos byung ba de'i ring rten mchog spyan sngar mchod sprin dang / 'dus tshogs su bsnyen bkur sogs rong gzhis rang nas nar 'bul zhu dgos/ tshes 2nyin snga dro rgyug ring glod pa dang / de rjes gzhis 'og zhabs gras nas rta pa bdun skor rta rgyug skabs 'ben gnyis btsugs par mda' dang / me mda' 'phen pa/'chad dkar gzhis nas rta pa rnams la tshwa dar sprod pa/ skabs der nye 'khor yu/la gru khag dang / rtsed thang sogs nas tshong rigs 'du 'dzoms kyis smomyo/ lam mjal ba dang sbrags dngos zog brje tshong gi 'khrug cha dod po yod/zla 2tshes 15nyin lo ltar byams pa'i dbang zhes ri sgo chos sde grwa tshang 5sdo)

tshogs yongs kyis rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan phebs byams thog bzhugs su gsol te ri chos grwa tshang tshogs yongs nas gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan/ba dan/ rdzas brgyad/ 'dod yon sna lnga sogs kyi —mchod rdzas dang /dung rgya rol mo sogs gzab rgyas kyis tshogs mchod ser sbreng mtshon byed gling bskor du gdan drangs/ de'i skabs khri chen rin po che na bza' mdzod gos ser po dang / dbu zhwa lcags mda'/ zhabs lham 'ja' mtshal/ rgya gri phor shubs sogs gzab bzhes gnang ste sku 'khor bsdus tsam gyis ser sbreng 'bas skor du lhan phebs mdzad kyi yod/ de'i snga nyin nor bu gling ga'i nang ri sgo chos sde dang / rgya ri phyogs gnyis kas tshogs gur dang / dbu gur/thab gur phub pa sogs gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas/ rgyal ba byams pa gling bskor gdan zhu'i thog ma ser sbreng dge 'dun dang bcas pa nor gling bzhugs sgrig sar chibs bsgyur gyis rgyal ba byams pa ri chos tshogs yongs kyi dbus su bzhugs su gsol ba'i mdun sar re chos/ grwa tshang nas ha shang gcig dang / ha phrug gnyis kyi gar 'chams dal bus bskyod de sku phyag lan gsum phul nas 'bas stegs thog bzhugs/ bye naṭashrī khri chen rin po ches sku phyas/ dang snyan shal 'bul gnang grub 'phral dbu gur du phebs/ de rjes ri sgo chos sde dge 'dun tshogs yo/ngas chu tshod gsum tsam ring gsol tshogs 'tshugs skabs gsol ja dang / dam thug 'bul bzhes/ de'i skabs khri chen rin po che sku 'khor rnams gsol tshigs grub rjes phyag mda' bi shu'i sku rtsed mdzad srol yod/ nor bu gling kha'i mdzad sgo mjug 'gril nas gling skor ser sbreng dang lhan du khri chen rin po che phebs dgos stabs zhabs gras shig gis shing gi zhabs stegs khra'u shing zhig dpung steng 'khur te sku ngal gnang yul rim par zhabs stegs thog bzhugs pa bcas de nyin gling skor 60

ser sbreng mdzad sgo grub/rgya ri'i zhabs gras dang / phogs thob/bya dga' chad gcod sogs/zhabs rten yod nga4 phyag mdzod 2dang mgron drung 2gnyer pa 2drung zhabs 10 rta chung 1 bcas dang / de byings phogs bzan gzim dpon ṭwāṃdang zhal ta ma 7 gad pa ṭwāṃ rum 'thag 2 'thag mkhan rngo’ 'tshem bzo 10 bal ma 11 chibs dpon 2 drel pa 2bong rjes/ 2 tshos rgyag thig mkhan 2 mdzo mo dang / ba phyugs g.yog mkhan 2 khyi g.yog 1 gling srung 2 khang gnyer 1 rgya zas ma byan 2dang / gsol bya'i ma byan 2 ma g.yog 2 chu len 2 'brog khag dgu'i rsha brdzi 52 ra lug brdzi bo mi 5bcas khyon bsdoms mi grangs 124la lo 'khor 'bru phogs mi rer snye'abru mkhar khal 2 0re dang nang bzan spyir gos rgyu ra lug khyu gnyis kyi spu bal/ nag she'i yong 'bab lhag thon che chung la gzhigs pa'i bya dga' gzengs bstod du 'bru rigs dang / gyon chas sna tshogs gsol ras gnang srol dang / dkar nag she 'bab chad rigs la phogs 'bru'i khongs nas cog cha byed pa ma zad chad lus khyon che byung rigs la dngos po'i nyes chad bcad de thag gcod byed srol/ rgya ri'i mnga' khongs yongs nas rkang 'gro lag 'don khral rigs rtsag rtsig gi yo nga 'bab ni/ kham star/ yom shun/ sa dkar/ shog bu/bzhu mar sdong ras 'ba' lan/ bsangs/ sgog btsong / sha mar/ sa dmar/ shing / bya sgong / jo cas/ gser/ mi bogs pho mo khyad med 61

lo re dngul srang gang re/ snga ra gyi khral lam lding nyi shu rtsa bdun nas lo rer mjal zhu khri chen rin po cher mjal dar zub phyi re dang / lugye/ sha mgo sbyar gcig phyag mdzod gnyis la lo rer lug sha khog phyed re/ 'bo kha dang drung yig gnyerari pa bcas la lug sha sdeb re / gong gsal gser khral bsdu yu/la bar klu lding dang / rdzong zhol gnyis nas mi rer gser se ba lnga re rtsis 'don rer gser zho gang re thob pa gser zho rer sngar srol rin dngul srang 1 2re yin yang bar skabs shig nas gser zho rer rin dngul srang 2 kyare rtsis 'bab 'bul dgos sogs kyi lag/ 'don dang / rtsam 'thag dang /snam 'thag snum btsag sogs dang gsol zhib ljags smin rgyu 'bru dang /snum/ rgyu pad kha/ gsham bu'i gong ga༅ma snam rgyu bal bcas kyi rgyu cha sprad de 'thag las byed dgos/rang khongs mi ser gser bzo ba dang / dngul bzo/ lha bris/ rdo shing / shing brkos/ 'tshem bzo/ phar chin rgyag mkhan/ rum dang /kam pā li/ btsugs phrug btsugs phrug mdzub bcad/ shad ma dang si shan pang gdan/ snam shad ma dang spu phrug sogs 'thag mkhan/ 'jim bzo ba/ lcags bzo/ ko chas bzo pa/ sbra 'thag mkhan bcas la las ka skul skabs 'bru phogs dang / gla cha sne sel sprad nas lag khral bskul rgyugs byed kyi yod/ rgya ri'i zhabs 'bring dang nang bzan/ mi ser tshe 'das skabs go bab kyi bsngo rten 'bul srol yod pa dper na/ rgya ri'i 'bas 'bring drung 'khor 'das skabs bsngo rten dar zub re dang / drung chas cha tshang re/ zhabs 'bring rta chung 'das skabs go bab kyi gyon chas cha tshang re dang / dar zub re/ de min mi ser dang / nang bzan 'das skabs so so nas dar zub re dang / dngul ṭam dkar re bcas 'bul 62

dgorngashrī/ rgya ri'i mnga' khongs mi rtsa gsar skyes pho mo ming 'god skabs dar zub re dang / dngul ṭam dkarari re bcas 'bul lam zhu dgos kyi 'dugasngar srol thon skor gral sgrig skor/lo ltar zla 1tshes 16nyin thon skor gral sgrig mdzad sgo'i skabs khri chen sto/ngas dpyal sku 'khor dang / phyag mdzod ngo ma gzim chung rab gsal dang byu/rmog mdzod khang gi zhal khra'i nang nas gzigs zhib gnang / dkar gzhal thil du thon skor gral sgrig sar drung yig ngo mas sngar srol rgya lcog steng gi goru/ bzang kha'i gdan thog tu 'dzegs nas rtsa tshig don tshan bco brgyad ces pa ( nang don ma nges) sgrog sbyang dang 'brel rgya ri gzhung rkyang la dus dang rnam pa kun tu lhag bsam rnam dag gis zhabs 'degs zhu dgos pa de las ldog na rgya ri gzhung rkyang gi sngar srol khrims lugs dang / rong lha rgyal mtshan sogs gzhung bsten mgon khang bcu gsum gyi srung mar gnyene du btang pa bzhin nyes chad 'phog rgyu gdon mi za ba des na khe nyen bsam shes 'dzol med dgos cizugs nan tan gyis dril bsgrags/ de nas gral ltar g.yas g.yon du zhabs gras rnams kyi gtsos khral rigs 'bul dgos pa'i sa gnas khag gi rgan po dang bcas pa re zhig langs nas bsdad/ drung yig gis thon 'bab rtsis tho ang grangs klog rim bzhin ang dang por 'bol gdan gsum brtseganu/ dang / khri lcog dkar yol yu ring / ang gnyis par 'bol gdan snyis brtsegs/ slangs lcog ja dkar stegs phebs rang 'grigs/ang gsu/ma par 'bol —gdan gcig dang / dkyus lcog ja dkar/ de byings 'o/ skyong gdan dang / bkum lcog ja dkar/ rjes lus par ko khyi /sta

gdan spu med dang mdun du ja ro sbang ro mnyam gses blugs pa'i ko sder bzhag de nas tshang ma gral du 'khod de phyag mdzod khang nas gzhis khag thon skor ang rim ltar gnang cha mtshan grangs dang / kha btags g.yogs/de rjes so so'i nye 'brel khag gis kha btags g.yosas te rten 'brel byas nas lo re'i thon skor gral sgrig gi byed sgo legs par grub/rgya ri'i khongs su sbas lung zhes pa'i dben gnas zhig yod pa/rgya ri'i pho brang gi byang shar du sbas lung zhes dben gnas khyad par can zhig yod cing / de ni gung thang bla ma zhang gis gnas sgo phye ba'i lo rgyus khungs ldan 'dug gnas der ngo mtshar che ba'i gangs ri zhig yod pa de dmag dpon go mtshon thogs pa lta bu rngam brjid can zhig yod pa'i rtser brag ri mi langs pa 'dra ba zhig yod cing / de'i 'dabs su spang ljongs dang rdza ri'i khor yug 'brel ba/ de'i nub byang du g.yu rags zhes pa brag ri g.yu yi hrūg pa 'dra ba der sgrub phug ngo mtshar can zhig yod/ byang du ding kha rong zhes pa 'bab chu ding ding du 'bab pa der brag sgo 'dra ba zhig yod pa der rin po che'i rigs kyi gter kha yod zer srol/ de'i byang ngos nye bar brag sho 'dra ba'i steng du lha khang thog brtsegs gnyis ldan/ shod du 'du khang /steng khang du sku rgyu rdo nag las grub pa'i mgon po phyag bzhi byin can gyi mgon khang yod pa rnam kun dam bcad kyis gang byung mjal sa med/ lo ltar zla 1tshes 12nyin khri chen sku 'khor hrag bsdus phebs te bdun phrag gcig ring bzhugs dgos pa der gzim shag dang / mgon po ba'i shag chung sogs 64

yod/ lha khang de'i nye 'dabs su spang ljongs yangs shing rgya che bar rin chen sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa 'dra ba'i me tog dang / dbyar rtsa dgun 'bu sogs sman rtsa'i rigs/ g.yas g.yon du dri ldan ba lu dang / shug pa/ dbo/na gsham du se ba dang / glang ma/ stag ma sogs nags gseb stug po'i khrod du gcan gzan sna tshogs yod/ gzhan yang bya rigs sna tshogs yod pa de dag gis skad snyan sgrogs shing / khro chu bla mtsho zhes dang / de min kha dog lnga ldan gyi mtshe'u'i nang kha mdog sna tshogs kyi nya rigs yod pa/ sdig bshag bla mcho zer ba'i mtsho zhig bcas yod pa der gnas skor la 'gro mkhan tshos sems can srog bcad pa'i nyes pa dag ched sdig bshag gi tshul du mda' gri dang / me mda'/ gser dngul sogs mtsho rdzas la btab pa'i dngos po khra chi' chil du mthong rgyu yod/ de min las dag min lta sa zhes brag 'og tu 'dzul gnas shig yod pa der sdig po che 'dzul mi thub pa'i shod srol yod/gnasade'i nye 'dabs su brag ri thog brtsegs bcu lhag tsam zhig yod pa der shing ske sa las 'dzegs bskyod dgos pa dang / de'i thog mkha' 'gro'i bro ra zhes rṣarikhod snyoms ngo mtshar can zhig yod/ der bskor bar bskyod par rdzong rgyab gan/sa skor zhes zer/ gnas skor thengs gcig phyin na gcong nad can gyi nad drag skyed dang / thengs gsum phyin na ngan song gi skye sgo 'gog thub ces/ shod srol yod/ gnas de'i lo rgyus la gung thang bla ma zha nga gis byin gyis rlabs pa'i chang rdza gcig yod pa de nas skor mi rnams la chang gi byim rlabs ster sa/sungs shing / chang 'dzad med du thon par sku gnyer ya mtshan nas bltes pa de nas bzung spyir btang las ma thon zhes pa'i shod srol 'dug de nas chang rgyu'i dmigs sgo dang po bsod snyoms brgyab pa'i thog nas chang btsos te gnas skor yong mi rnams la chang dkar yol che ba gang re 65

byin pa der 'bru bre rdo re sprod pa'i 'a/ma srol dar/ de bzhin rgya ri dang /e khul 'byor ldan khag la chang phud dkar yol gong gsal gang las ma phu'/ kyang byin rlabs che zhing / rten 'brel bzang ba'i mtshon tshul mdzad nas bzhes rkyang dang / tshur 'bru gong bzhin dad 'bul gnang mkhan byung ba'i 'bru bsdoms khal lnga bcu skor yong gi yod pa lo re'i chang rgyu'i dmigs sgor ma 'bru'i spyi gnyer zur 'dzugs kyis rtsis sprod rtsis len byed cing / 'phros rnams lo re zla 6pa'i nang mgon po'i sgrub mchod tshugs skabs 'gro song du gtong gi yod/ chang de ga'an dang mi 'dra'i khyad chos yod pa ste/ rgyun ldan chang 'thung mkhan yin na'ang dkar yo/la gang po de rang gis ra bzi ba'i bshad srol 'dug chang snyol skabs kyang drod srung gang yang ma dgos par brag phug nang ba'ag na chang spus legs dus throg tu langs kyi yod pa dang /bla ma zhang nas stsal ba'i chang rdza de dmangs gtso'i bcos bsgyur skabs bar bsdad yod/ ri khrod de'i chos lugs rnying ma yin/ gnas der dbon ser gzugs bcu skor yod pa rgyun ldan pho mo mnyam tshogs kyis snga dro gsol ja bzhes pa las/ nyin gung nas tshogs gzhung rang la mchod chang btegs bzhes mdzad rkyang yin pa bcas/khri chen khri thog skabs dmigs bsal khral 'bab dang shag sbo byang /rgya ri'i khyab khongs sa char gzhung sger chos gsum su zhig gi phyugs rigs dkar nag rtswa za chu 'thung byed mkhan mtha' dag nas khri phyugs bcu zur 'es 'bul dgos kyi yo/da pa de dag bsdu bzhes mdzad mkhan sngar lam rgya 66

ri'i 'tsho 'dzin gyis thugs 'ag na bzhes srol bzhin sku tshab do chod 'igre gtong gi yod pa red/ de min khri 'bru dang / sri dngul zhes rgya ri'i mnga' khongs 'don phyed gya gcig la cha sases kyis bsdoms 'bru khal 1 15dang dngul srang 50e dgon /bag dang / sger khag bcas kyi khri mjal rtem/ 'brel rdo che chung kha ba'i dpe ltar 'bul dgos kyi yod pa red/de snga lha rgya ri'i khri rgyud sras gsum byung ba'i dus skabs shig na khri 'gan bzhes phyogs sogs la thugs snang ma mthun tsam byung zhing / skabs nger khri 'dzin gdung sras sku 'bring gis thugs 'gan bzhes stabs rigs sras bgres gzhon gnyis pos thob thang 'then rtsod gnang bar brten gzim 'ag lho byang gnyis su zhal gyes te bzhugs/ rigs sras sku bgres shag lho dkon mchog dar rgyu7/ sa nas zur gyes thob skal du dkyil gsum ( sa zhing dkyil dang / na kha'i nga kyil/ khang pa'i dkyil) dgos lugs rtsod gleng mdzad pa bzhin brag dkar phu mda' bar gsum dang / chu mdo byang / bar smad/ rma ra sogs kyi sa khul la da lta'ang dkyil gsum zhes pa'i sa ming rgyun chags su gnas/ gong gsal sa khul khag rtsis bzhes skabs rgya ri'i mnga' khongs dang / shag lho byang mi ser 'brel yod rnams nas skabs der mjal zhu dang /sa gnas su phebs dus sne len gzab rgyas zhus pa re re bzhin tho bkod gnang nas ngazang po'i ja chang ngan pa'i khral 'jags su gyur te 195khalo'i bar de ltar la ga bstar byed bzhin yod pa red/zhar byung / rgya ri'i sa khongs gser gyi thon khungs dang khul den rig gnas kyi dar srol che tsam yod pa'i skor/rgya ri'i khongs gtogs e stod khul du gser gyi thon khungs legs pas 67

khul de'i mi ser phal che bas gsed sngog ngadon gyi 'tsho ba skyel gyi yo da kru rgya ri gzhung la gser khral phran tsam re 'bul dbos nga/ dang / rgya ri gzhung nas bskos pa'i gser dpon gyis sku rnam yong bzhes nga ra gser dod ces si dngul phran tsam re yang 'bul dgos kyi yo da nga/ red/ 1kha19lo'i ya ji ri/ mas su gser sgor rer rin dngul srang nyi shu skor byed pa dang // gser tshong yul bal po sogs nyo mkhan su byung la tshong rkyang byed nga/ las bkag rgya'i rigs med/ rgya ri bas bskos pa'i gser dpon ri mig pa zhes pa'i khyim tshang de bzhin dngos po'i cha rkyen gang legs 'dug pa bcas dang / de snga sa gnas srid gzhung gis e khul nas e phrug pa zhes yig 'bri khag gcig skong bsdu byed skabs yi ge gzab/ gshar/ lañdza/ wartu/ hor yig sngags yigayig gsar rigs bcas 'bri srol dar khyab che ba dang / shog bu tshos gzhi 'dra min dang / snag tsha 'dra min/ gsang yig 'bri byed‘‘sa chu me rlung nam mkha'’ bcas 'byung lnga 'dus pa'i dmigs bsal bzo rtsal gyi bya thabs ma spyad na yi ge gsal mi thub pa'i khyad chos ldan pa'i snag tsha bzo ba/ de bzhin bod snagarteng/nga mtshal snag gi sbyor ba sna tshogs/ lor shog dang /deb 'dra min bzo ba sogs 'phrul rtsal las byed pa brgya rtsa mang po rang rang gi go gnas bzung yod/ e phrug de dag phal che bar khral rkang re'i ri klung rtsa chu shing sogs kyi bdag thob dang / rkang 'gro lag 'don gyi khral rigs yongs rdzogs rtsa chag gi lag khyer sprod kyi yod pa bcas so cho68

ngas zhol 'dod darnguprel do dam pa byed ring dmigs bsal gyi las 'gan bananyis dang / gnad don gcig 'phrad pa'i skon/ye shes smon lam gyis/dmigs bsal las 'gan gnyis/dang po/ stag brag rgyal thog skabs kyi 1947bod me phag lo'i zla 2pa'i nang phran 'dod dpal do dam pa'i las 'gan 'khur skabs nyin gcig shod 'gag nas shod drung mkhar sna ba mkha' khyab bde chen nged gnyis shod 'gag tu 'phral bcar dgos pa'i brda tho 'byor don ltar bcar skabs sno mgron thub bstan legs smon nas‘‘'di nas rwa sgreng dgon par dmag dpung bskyod gtan 'khel bas khyod gnyis rta khal spyi khyab par bsko gzhag byas nga/ yin dmag mi rnams dus 'gyangs mi 'byung ba'i rta khal dus thog gtong dgos pa las ka kor nar 'gyangs shar tshe de lam du 'jog rgyu min’ ces bka' bsgyur/de nas nged gnyis rang khyim du log ste yud tsam las ma song bar grwa bzhi dmagami khag gcig nga'i nang du yong ste‘‘nga tsho de ring phan por 'byor ba 'gro dgos pas rta 'ul 'phral du 'khrid shog’ ces brjod 'dug kyang rang nyid la 69

rta 'ul skul sa'i dmigs yu/'a/ gtan nas med la rnam kun rta khal gtong mi lha sa rta gtong pa dang / zhol pa rta gtong pa gnyiskyug yin pa des kyang lha sa'i nye 'khor gzhis khag so sor sngon tshud cha gses brda sbyor byed dgos pa las lam seng btang chog med cing / da lagru ḍā lal spyi ñtsab ces pa ched du btsugs na'ang rta khal gang nas gtong da ge( ) dmigs sa med bzhin par dmag mi tshos dza drag gi 'ded rtser byas stabs thabs gzhan med par dmag mi rnams dang mnyam du zhol chibs rwa mdo sbug gnyis la bskyod de chibs g.yog tshor rta 'ul gtong rogs brjod ska bas nga tshor gong nas bka' phebs ma byung zhes ka kor byed cing phran nas dus bab gal che yin lugs gses grol dang 'brel rgyal ba rin po che'i chibs sga phog myong ba phud de byings kyi rta rnams gtong rogs brjod de rta'i grangs 'boratshol ga'igyo/sa pa'i dmag mi khag gcig ba'ag nas chibs g.yog gi gtam nyog ma/ nyan par dmag mi lhag ma dang mnyam du nor gling chibs rwar bskyo da nas dpon po chibs dpon lags dang 'phros mol byed skabs khong gis kyang ‘‘nga tshos gong gi bka' med par rta gang byung du btang na mi 'grig’’brjod 'dug par ngas dza drag gi gnas tshul 'di 'drar thug dus 'di nas rta ma btang na gzhan la re ltos bya yul med la rang nyid la ni rta phar zhog rta spu tsam yang med tsas bshad de chibs rwa'i nang bskyod nas rgyal ba'i chibs sga phog myong ba'i rta rnams phud de 'phros grangs ka brgyab ste dmag mi khag gcig la rtsis sprad/ de nas yar lam kun bde gling du bskyod skabs shod drung mkhar sna bas dmag mi khag gcig 'khrid yong ba dang thug pa nged gnyis mnyam du de ga'i bla brang gi rta rnams dmag mir rtsis sprad/ gong gsal chibs rwa gnyis dang / kun gling gi rtas ma ldeng bas 'phros bsdad dmag mis nged rta khal spyi khyab gnyis la tsha 'ded btang nas me 70

mda'i bya gzhug gzhu bar brtsams pa'i 'jigs snang gi khrod du nga dang mkhar sna gyonyis sa khu'/ khag bgos kyis lha sa'i grong khul sger pa khag dang / rta yod sgo rwa so so'i sgo 'gram du bskyod skabs tshang mas rta 'chag yong ba'i gas nga brda go nas sgo dam por mnan bsdad pa sha stag la brten wa pā gling grong dkyil du/ bskyod de gro 'thab gi bdag po so sor rwa sgreng bar rta 'ul satong dgos rnga/'i gnas lugs brjod pa nga/nga sbrags rta drel re zung yo/nga/ pa rnams kyi mthur thag nas bzung ste 'khrid rkyang byas pa la sto sga smos ci srab rmed tsam med kyang dam0 nitwe/ so so'i ske rags kyis srab byas te bzhon rtsis byed pa'i brel 'tshab dang bstun na/sa rang nyid tshong khang zhig tu gab g.yol gyis sbo seng nas bltas bsdad pa yin/ gro 'thag gi rta drel bkol spyod skabs sko ra ba kho na rgyag pa las thad kar bskyod rgyu'i goms gshis med stabs bzhon phan ma thogs pa 'i skabs der dmag mi tshos skad shugs chen pos rta khal spyi khyab greng du song ngam zhes gang sar 'tshol zhib byas rung rang nyid gab yib thub pas dmag mi rnams ci bya gtol bral ngang rta drel 'khrid de thon song ba bcas/de nyin dmag mi nyis brgyar rta 'ul gtong thub tsam byung rung phran mkhar sna ba'i shag tu bskyod skabs khong ni zhed snang gis hon thor ba lta bur 'dugade nasanyin brgyad dgu zhig song mtshams dmag mi rnams phyir log thub rjes nyin zhig gra bzhi dmag sgar nas rta drel tsis len par yong dgos pa'i lan brda 'byor 'phral rang nyid bskyod par rta rnams sgal rmas khengs shing sha shed rus sgrom/ lta bur gyur 'dug kyang grangs ka ma chad tsam 'dug pas khungs so sor rtsis 'phrod thub tsam byung /gnyis pa/ dmag mi rnams rwa sgreng dgon du bskyod nas phyir 'khor ma thung/ gong gi nyin gcig tshogs 'dus (bod ljongs/ tshogs 'du hrag bsdus 71

rgyas/ pa/ra zer) 'a ra chen lcogs su khang nga 7 bzhi ma zhig yod pa de'i sge'u khung (hwapre lcags hreng gtong rgyu dang / sgo'i myo/dzo rna lcags sgor 'phral du bzo dgos pa'i bka' phab pa bzhin de 'phral 'dod dpal nas lcags bzo ba khrid de mtshan mo de rang la las 'go btsugs kyang bzo skrun ma tshar gong rwa sgreng nas rgyal zur rwa sgreng rin po che phebs 'byor gyis khang pa de'i nang btson 'jug byas nas skabs de'i srung byar 'phral bde'i jo lags gnyis bzhag song /de rjes btson srung drung rigs skya ser gnyis bsko gzhag byas pa red/ rgyal zur rwa sgreng btson khang nas bkrongs pa dang / se ra'i zing 'khrug lhing 'jags zin mtshams rwa bla 'khor bcas dang / se ra'i grwa rigs byed gte rnams 'dzin ba zung byas rjes glo bur du tshogs 'dus nga rang bskongs 'gugs kyis‘‘rkang lcags dang ske sgo grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun re bzo dgos pa dang rkang lcags kyi ljid tshad rab 'bring gsum dgos pa ste/ che shos la ljid tshad khal gnyis dang / de 'og la khal gcig de 'og la nyag bco lnga re bcas bzos te gnangs nyin nam langs ma thag tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms sar spyan zhu bstar thub pa bya dgos’’kyi bka' phab/ de 'phral rang nyid 'dod dpal las khungs su bskyod de lag g.yog khag gcig dang mnyam du bla phyag las khungs nas rgyu cha lcags dang stag spang zhus stsal phyir log 'dod dpal du 'byor 'phral lcags bzo ba sgrigs 'dzugs byas te nyin mtshan ltos med bzo skrun gyis nyin zhag gsum ste gtan 'bebs dus bkag thog grangs tshad legs grub zin rung dus tshod dza drag dbang gis rkang lcags yang shos kho na'i gras las bzo thabs ma byung / lcags dang ske sgo rnams 'dod dpal lag g.yog la bskur te tshogs 'du'i sar spyan zhur bcar skabanu/ dza sag tsha rong pas‘‘kha nyin tshogs 'dus rkang lcags kyi ljid tshad rab 'bring gsum 72

dargos lugs bka' mngags gnang rung kho nga sa('dod dang/la do nga/ma nga/ dong nyid) yang po sha stag bzo ru bcug 'dug pa gzigs dang ’zhes lcags lag pas btegs te bshad song bar drung yig chen mo lcog steng gis‘‘sku 'bas 'dod dpal do dam pa dka' las khag po yong ba yod/ ngas shag nas lta dus khong dang bzo pa rnams la nyin zhag gsum ring gnyid sen mo ba/nga tsam nyal yas byung ma song’’zhes bshad song ba der rtsis dpon klu kha nga pas rgyab skyor byas te‘‘dus thung nang las 'gan legs grub zin pa red/ sngon du ljid tshad rab 'bring gsum bzo rgyu gtan 'bebs byas rung ma tshar ba yin gyi red’’ces bshad song bar dza sag tsha rong pa kha skyengs mig hu rer sdod pa las gzhan bya thabs brnyed ma song / de nas 'dod dpal lag g.yog la rkang lcags dang ske sgo rnams bskur te zhol pa las khungs su bskyod pa de 'phral las khungs de'i sgo mchor 'og tu tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms tshogs pa'i mdun sar rtse shar rgyud btson khang dang / zhol btson khang so so nas rwa sgreng dza sag 'jam dpal rgyal mtshan dang / mkhar rdo sprul sku/ rtse nya sprul sku/ nyang bran chos rje sogs mi grangs nyi shu lhag tsam yod pa rnams dam ga mi re dang /btson bzung ba res zhol las khungs kyi rdo gcal steng 'khrid yong ste mi rer thon zhu1ga brgya tham pa re gzhus zin rim bzhin nga la rtsis sprad ma thag ngas sne khrid de bzo pa tshos rkang lcags brgyab ste tsha la gtong ba dang / ske sgo g.yogs te lcags shan rgyag tu bcug cing de 'phral 'phral bde las khungs nas btson chas snam bu dkar po'i phyu pa re g.yogs nas dmag mir rtsis sprod kyis zhol gzhung sgo'i 'gram nas re re bzhin glang gog la bskyon te sa gre/nas so sor sa/ 'dzin rgyang 'bud btang song / mkhar rdo dang rtse nya de min grwa rigs bcas par rta lcag gzhu skabs ngas zhol pa'i nang bzan la ga ler gzhu rogs/73

kho ra tshas rku ma brkus pa ma red ze bshad nga/ zhol pa 'brang stod pas thos tshor phra 'a tshogs 'du'i sar slan seng zhus 'dug pa de'o skor tshogs 'du grol rjes nub zhol pa am kug ( rjes su drung yi/ga che mo) lags kyis nga la bshad byung / de rjes tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyi mi sna rnams zhol las khungs kyi tho—ka ༄ra phebs so nga / rang nyid nas rkang lcags lhag 'phro re zung 'dug pa 'dod dpal lag g.yog la bskur te bzo pa dang mnyam du log rtsis byed skabs zhol pa'i nang bzan zhig gis ‘‘khyed tshogs 'du'i sar phebs shog gsung gi 'dug’ ces brjod don bzhin thog khar 'tshog bzhin pa'i rgyas 'dzoms sar bcar ba yin/ der tsha rong dang 'brang stod pa sogs kyis kho bor rnyog dra rtso/da 'dod kyis mig 'bur tshugs su bltas 'dug pa de 'phral rtsis dpon klu khang bas‘6da lam ñtsid rang khag po byung song bzhugs gdan 'jagasami’zhes brjod don ltar tshogs 'du ba rnams dang mnyam du bsdad par ja dang / 'bras sil btang byung bas 'brang sto/da pa sogs kha skyengs te byed yas byung ma song /gnad don grecigang rang 'dod dpal do dam byed skabs bod chu lug 1kha4 2lo tsam zhig la rgyal yab nas bzo rigs skul 'ded mdzad phyogs de sngon yab gzhes la 'khyongs gzhis ma gnang gong dang 'dra ba'i gla lto med par gang dgos skul rkyang gnang stabs bzo rigs rnazu/sa sgal pas 'drongs kyang rtsib mas mi 'drongs pa'i dpe bzhin dka' tshegs shin tu che ba dngos mthong la brten las sbrel rnam sras gling rtse drung blo bzang 'phel rgyas nged gnyis gros mol byas 7‘kto

don/ da phyin bzo rigs nas yab gzhis kyi zhabs 'degs zhu sgo'i rigs la yul srol gla lto ma sprad na bzo rigs mi gtong rgyu'i thag gcod byas pa yi/na/'on kyang bong gsal las sbrel gyis zhal tog slo ma gang khyer te rgyal yab sar bcar na 5 8 bzo rigs bkag sdom byed mkhan las sbrel yin pa las phran la le khag med’ ces zhus 'dug de rjes nyin gcig zhogs pa rgyal yab kyis zhabs gras shig gtong gnang gis‘‘'dod dpal do dam pa gnyis drung ja grol rjeskyu shrī rgyal yab sar yong dgos’’pa'i lan bskyal byung / drung ja'i sar rang nyid nas las sbrel la phal cher bzo rigs gtong phyogs skor min nam brjod par las sprel gyis ‘‘don gnad de'i skor yin na gnas lugs rgyu mtshan ngas zhus chog khyed rang gi rgyun gshis kha ri kha thug song tsang rgyal yab kyi dgongs par mi ldan pa yong srid’ zer gyi 'dug de nas nged gnyis drung ja grol rjes rgyal yab sar bcar 'ing / skabs der rgyal yab kyis gsung bsgyur bya yul nas yin 3pa'i zhabs gras shig yod pa de brgyud nged gnyis la‘‘khyod gnyis kyis bzo rigos mi gtong ba'i rgyu mtshan gang yin nam’ zhes gshe gshe tshad med btang byung / nged gnyis nas dgongs dag thugs bden zhus pa dang sbrags kha dan sngon zin ltar las sbrel nas gses 'grol dang 'brel ba'i dgongs sel zhus mi yong ngam snyam rung kha tshig gcig ma grags par brten kho bos yab gzhis nas bzo rigs la yul srol gla lto spyi mtshungaru/ gnang ba yin na nges par du btang chog pa zhu rgyu las yab gzhis dang gzhung rngag dga' ldan pho brang pa thugs 'dod gcig gyur min la gzhung sa nas 'khyongatra/ thebs kyang phul zin pa'i skor la nged gnyis 'phros mol byung lugs gsung bsgyur brgyud zhus pa de 'phral rgyal yab rab tu khros te lcags gzer bkog byed a'u ne tso zhes pa'i lcags mgo bor thengs gsum gzhus byang bas ༄ 7 5

ma/ zusas che zhing bzi 'thom yang langs byung / skabs der bzod bsran dka' ba'i khong khro'i dbang gis lcags gzer bkog byed a'u ne tso 'phrog par brtsamari/sa pas gsung bsgyur dang / las sbrel gnyis bros song / gang 'tshams song rjes a'u ne tso 'phrog pa sogs 'dzing shar gyi skad cor nye 'brel yi ga tshang las khungs su thos par brten las bya rnams kyis bar mi byed par yong bas rang nyid phyir log thub tsam byung / de rjes yig tshang las khungs dang / bka' shag gis kho bo'i sa nas zhu ba blangs pa ma zad shod 'gag tu snya na seng yang zhus 'dug nyin zhig rang nyid shod 'gag tu bka' dpyad zhu bar yong dgos pa'i brda tho 'byor skabs bsam par kha nyin khong khro mnan ma thub pa'i thal cha che gyur la bka' dpyad nan po phog rgyu gdon mi za ba 'di ni ('phral phug gang la'ang mi phan pa'i bya bar blo 'gyod bzhin par shod 'gag tu bcar skabs yab gzhis kyi 'tsho 'dzin bla phyag tar khang thub bstan chos bzang dang / rtsis dpon 'bri yul ba/ phyag mdzod lha dga' tshe brtan phun tshogs/ mgron gnyer ka 'a/ rin chen grags pa bcas 'byor 'dugaskabs de'i srid skyong stag lung brag yin pas shod 'gag tu gong gsal yab gzhis kyi 'tsho 'dzin gnyis dang phyag mgron/ rang nyid bcas mnyam 'dzoms sar bka' dpyad sgrogs sbyangs gnang don du‘‘'dod dpal do dam pa rtse drung ye shes smon lam nas rgyal ba don gyi bdag po'i yab la kha lan slog pa ma zad brang zur nas 'ju ba sogs kyi nyes tshabs shin tu che bas mig lar 'doms pa'i nyes chad dang 'brel las zhabs chabs cig gnas dbyung gtong 'os las ma 'das kyang rnam kun gzhung sems dag pos las don bsgrubs pa dang / yab gzhis la 'khyongs gzhis dang 'khyongs snon phul zin pa dngos don la brten da lam thengs gcig ring yang pa yin’’zhes pa'i bka' dpyad 76
gyur nas rangang byung du spi rngos kyis dag9

chu sprel si bod dmag 'khrug gi la rgyus dum bu/sreg shing blo bzang don grub kyis/spyi lo 1la15lo tsam nas bzung mdo smad khul dkar mdzes be ri dgon dang / tre hor dar rgyas dbon gnyis dkor sa dge khungs sogs kyi slor nga che nga btsan lta bu'i 'khrug rtsod rim byung mi gso/da tha'/ cha je cher song mthar be ri dgon gyi rgyab rtsa si khron li'u tsi chan gyis byas pa dang / dar rgyas dgon gyi rgyab rtsa bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis byas pa'i me stag( 192 6 ) lo tsam la be dar g.yul 'khrug ces si bod dbar 'thab 'khrug byung rjes be ri phyogs gtogs dang rgyab rtsa si dmag pham nyes byung ste rta'u dang / sde nga/se brag 'go tre hor/ dkar mdzes// nyag rong bcas bod dmagre gis blangs thog si dmagre spyi khyab dmag dpon krang thon krang so/bas/ 'go dmag sum cu skor mgo len 'dzin bzung dang 'brel chab mdor btang 'byor byung ba ngos rang nas dngos mthong byung zhing / de rjes chab mdo bka' shag nas si khron dmag dkyus rmams pha yul du phyir log byed dam da nu/sa bod sar sdod rgyu kho tshor 'dems ka byed du bcug pa ltar khag gcis dza yu la du phyir log byas pa de dag gi lam bar 'gro song bza' nyal 'gel khal bcas babod sgrig dang 'bre'/ si bron gyi sa sne ma zin bar skyel sgrol byas tsho7sta

pa dang / bod sar sdod 'dod yod pa khag gcig smad phyogs rdzong sa'is/ so sor khag bgos kyis btang ste 'tsho ba'i lta skyong rdzong 'go so sor 'gan dkri byas/si dmag gi nyag spyi dmag dpon krang thon krang chab mdor sdod ring mdo spyi bka' blon sman stod pas‘‘dgra lag 'og tu tshud na bu las byams’’zer ba'i gtam rgyun ltar ‘pag len bstar dgos zhes tshang mar shod kyi yo/da la/krang thon krang bza' mi bu phrug dang bcas par sdod gnas dang phogs thob kyang ldeng nges sprad/ mdo spyi bka' blon sman stod pa mdo spyi'i las 'khur 'phos tshab gsar pa bka' blon nga phod sngon mar mdo spyi rtsis sprod skabs rgya dpon krang la 'tsho skyong rogs ram gnang 'os skor zhib cha'i bka' mngags zhus don ltar/ mdo spyi gsar pa nga phod nas kyang de don sngar bzhin byamasagazigaskyushrī gang legs kyis bskyangs/ de rjes rgya dpon krang lebyen krang bza' 'tsho bu phrug dang bcas thabs rnam gang drag gis phyir log chog pa zhus son byung ste phyir log byas/ de nas mi ring bar si khron tsung tu'u (li'u wun hu'e) dang rgya dpon krang thon krang thug phrad thog bod dmag gi stobs shugs ji yod shes rtogs byung lugs dang / slar yang bod du dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i re ba zhus don tsung tu'u li'u'i bka' khrol byung skad gang ltar kho pas si dmag khyon che bskong 'gugs kyis go lag rdzas mdel dmag phogs sogs gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas thog zi ling ma hphu hphang la'ang lho byang rgya dmag dpung sdeb bya rgyu'i nang mol byas don bzhin rgya dpon krang si khron nas thon te thog mar nyag rong sa gnas su dpung 'jug gis bod dmag pham nyes btang ste nyag spyi bde hrī/ na pa dang / tre hor brag 'go khul gyi spyi khyab gre/tsang mda' khyung ram pa/ sde dge spyi khyab dbus/ ma da' khe smad sras bsod nams dbang 'dus 7 9

dang / shel gling sras bcas 'artso/ dam/ga khyon che yod kyang / skabs der da mgre rma ra nang khu'/ 'cham mthun ra/tshobyung bas dgra rethab thog 'thus sho ra ci bye byung ste 'bri chu tshur kha bar bod da mag rnams phyir 'then bya dgos byung ba ma zad/ gong gsal mda' dpon tshos rang 'tsham gyis rgya bod sa mtshams thad (krābri chu phan chad rgya khongs dang / tshun chad bod khongs su gtogs pa bya rgyu'i chings yig kyang ba'ag pa red/chu sprel( 192 2 )lo'i zla 2pa'i nang 'dan khog sgrol ma lha khang rgyud si rgya'i rta dmag khyon che 'byor te bod dmag gi sa srung dmag la glo bur mtshan 'gebs dpung 'jug byas par bod kyi sa srung cha dang me sgyogs dmag sga ra gyi 'go dmag bzhi brgya skor dang / kha dang grwa bzhi dmag sgar gyi 'go dmag gang 'tsham gyis phar rgol dmag 'thab byas kyang si dmag stobs shugs che bas/ bod dmag pham nye'i skabs dpung snon tha dang mda' dpon mtsho sgo bas cha dang me skyogs dmag sgar sogs der yod dpung dmag rnams re zhig phyir 'then byed du bcug thog 'go byed grwa bzhi ru dpon gnyis pa nag ra 'gyur med tshe brtan dang cha dang me skyogs dmag gi ru dpon blo bzang yon tan gnyis la'ang re zhig dmag sa phyir 'then byas na ma gtogs dmag 'bras yag po yong bzo med lugs brjod par kho pa gnyis nas de las ldog ste nga tsho ni a phrug nyar te legs nyes ji ltar byung yang 'di gar sdod rgyu'i semyo/sa thag bcad pa yin lugs brjod pa ma zad/ mda' dpon mtsho sgo ba phyir log byas 'phral si rgya'i rta dmag khyon ches khul de'i mtha' bskor rgol rdung byed skabs gong gsal ru dpon gnyis dang / a phrug rnams nas phar rgol byas kyang mang sne nyung gis ma brten par mthar ru dpon gnyis dang a phrug rnams gson bzung byas pa dang / mda' dpon mtsho sgo bas dmag 80

dmangakusro phyir 'them/ sngon btang zimyo/ pa'i rgyab tu na/ sdi py-ikhasku la shas dang me mnga' sbaka sbag gnyis nyar te si rgya'i rta dam ga khyo na che'i rjes snye/ka/ sa pa rnams la dmag cherithab byas te dus tshod gang 'tsham ba ra bkag par brten phyir 'them/ byed bzhin pa'i dmag dmangs go lag dang bcas bde bgrod thub lugs skabs de'i g.yul 'gyed ma/nga zhugs myong ba'i mis nges gsal bshad byung /nge rjes bod sa gnari ra srid gzhung gis si rgya'i gdong len dpung snon du nga dang mda' tshab chab spel ba dang / ta dang mda' dpon shan kha ba/ ja dang mda' dpon zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan/ ga dang mda' dpon thang dpon pa sogs dpung snon du btang yang / dmag sa ga/la 'gangab/ che chung gis lam bar nas mdo smad khul gyi sa shor dza drag gi dpung snon du 'gro dgos byung ste g.yas 'thab g.yon lus kyis dmag khag gnyis ka nas sa shor gyong chag ci che byung yo da/ gnas tshul de dag gis rkyen byas te mdo spyi bka' blon nga phod pa sngon ma yang sku rlung gis chab mdor dgongs pa rdzogs pa sogs kyi skor chab mdo bka' shag nas lha sar snyan zhu 'byor bas gzhung nas byang spyi dang / mdo spyi gsar pa ma 'byor bar dngos gzhi mkhan chung thub bstan kun mkhyen la las khur gcig lcogs su bkod mngags dang 'brel las bya rtse shod drung rigs gzhon skyes khyon che 'dems bsgrugs dang /gdan sa gsum gyi ser dmag go ldan/ phyi rgyal nas nyo sgrub byas pa'i thon gsar me skyogs che chung / me mda' sbag sbag che chung / lag len dngos sbyong thon sa'i sku srung dmag mi bcas go sgrig byas thog chu sprel lo'i zla 6pa'i tshes 6nyin byang spyi ngo las dang / thon gsar go lag ldan pa'i dmag sgar khag lha sa nas rdog thon bya rgyu gtan 'khel gyis sngar lam dmag sgar 'degs 'grims skabs kyi srol ltar sa gnas so sos nam 'byor mtshams lam 'khel 81

mi ser narnga ga rta khal sdod sgrig sang ci ang gsar sne len da gos rgyu zhes pa'i mda' yig springs pa de dag sa gnas so sos ‘nyar blos ma bzod par rim btang gis mthar skye mdo'i zi ling stod rgya'i dmag sgar la sprad pa dang /mda' yig gi nang don bod yig nas rgya yig tu sgyur skabs byang spyi mkhan chung dngos gzhi ba zhetra/ par dung bzhi ba zhes bsgyur te go ba log sgrub tu 'phyan nam gang ltar si dmag nas bod pa'i dmag grangs phon che yod pa dang /thon gsar go lag kyang yod pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa sogs dgra tshod dgras ma lon pa ma zad/ de nas mi ring bar byang spyi mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan kun mkhyen ngo las khyung po steng chen du 'byor skabs mda' yig nang gsal ser dmag dang / me spyogs dmag sogs dmag mi khyon cher brten mi ser gyi rta khal sgrig min la ma ltos par nam nyin ltos me da sngon 'gro rting sdod rim 'byor bcas kyis rkyen pas dmag las 'ur che ba'i dpe bzhin skye mdo phyogs nas kyang sa mtshams so 'og nyul mas si dmag gi sgar sar brda 'byor byung bas zi ling thon krang ngo las blos 'gan ma bzod par kho pa tsho gros tshogs 'tshogs thog kho tsho'i dmag sde rnams 'thab thag ring la byang sa rgyab stong dang / zi ling nas mi rta'i dmag phogs go rdzas dus thog 'byor min sogs sgo gang sa nas bsam gzhigs byas te de 'phral krang thon krang gis si bod 'khrug zing ma dgos par zhi chings bya rgyu'i skor si phyogs nas nang chen rtse dga' mtshan 'gyur gling pa(snying brgyud bla ma) ched btang thog sa/ mtshams nas sngon tshud ri che zhabs bla'i mdzod zur tshe grags la'ang nang yig btang 'byo ra du‘‘si bod chings 'grig gnang rgyur thugs mos yod na gnas skabs phar dgra tshur shed mi bya rgyu'i bka' mol zhu rgyu’’zhes gsal bas byang spyi mkhan chung dngos gzhi'i sar phyag mdzod tshe grags ngo bcar snyan zhus la de don 82

chings 'grig bya rgyu'i bka' khrol ltar rtse dga' sprul skur yig lan btang nas phan tshun thug 'phrad zing bshig mi byed pa'i khas len bka' mol sne 'phrod byung bar brten byang spyi dngos gzhi ba ngo las hrag bsdus kyis khyung po steng chen nas ri bo cher chibs bskyod gnang ba dang chabs cig bod phyogs nas zhi chings sku tshab ja dang mda' dpon zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan dang /rtse drung 'phyongs rgyas rdo rje g.yul rgyal can mngags gtong ched bskyod kyis si rgya'i sku tshab thon krang ngo las dang rgya bod sa mtshams su thug 'phrad bya rgyu gtan ḍarikhel byas te sku tshab so so dus thog 'byor 'dzoms kyis zhib gros byas snying / si bod phan tshun zhi 'jags thog sa mtshams bdag 'dzin sngar mus gnas rgyu dang / gsom/ bzung byas pa'i kha dang ru dpon gnyis pa dang /cha dang ru dpon blo bzang yon tan 'go dmag gang yod go lag rang 'grigs tshang tshang rub rub bod gzhung la rtsis sprod bya rgyu sogs 'i ba'i chings sgrig 'thus tshang legs grub byung bas byang spyi mkhan chung dngos gzhi thub bstan kun mkhyen ngo las rnams si bod sa mtshams zhod 'jags bka' mol legs zin gyis ri bo che nas byang lam brgyud zla 5tshes 5nyin lha sar 'byor 'phral nor gling skal bzang pho brang du 'byor phyag dang / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa thub bstan rgya mtshor dmigs bsal mjal kha zhus thob sogs bdag rkyen yang gnang /chu bya lo'i( 192 2 ) zla 2pa'i tshes shar du mdo smad zhi drag spyi 'doms gsar pa bka' tshab bkras mthong pa 'gyur med rgya mtsho bsko gzhag gis chab mdor 'byor te gzhung gi bka' 'brel nyag khog spyi khyab khyung ram pa dang /bde tstsha na pa/ shel gling sras/ khe smad sras bcas spyi khyab mda' khag bzhis de snga rang sa rang srung ma thub khar/ sa mtshams skor rang 'tshams 83
radzol la myo

gro mo spyi khub rim byung dang gro spyi mi ro brgya pa'i lo rgyus rags rim/blo bzang byams pas/dzo/ mo ni de sngon phag ri rdzong gi do dam 'og tu gnas yod 'dug pas phag ri rdzong dpon gyi zhabs phyi'i nang nas mi gnyis drag 'dems kyis‘‘gro mo drag shos ’’zhes 'go 'dzin du bsko gtong byed srol dang de rjes phag ri dang gro mo'i mi drag nang nas mi gnyis 'os 'dems byed/ bar skabs shig nas gro mo stod du gong 'thus pad rgyal dang / de'i bu rin chen dbang rgyal nas 'go 'dzin zhus stsal gyis las 'gan 'khur ba dang / gro mo smad du gong 'thus dang tsho pa spyi pas bogs mar blangs te gong 'thus las thog pa so sos gcig lcogs byas pa red/ nye rabs su gro smad gong 'thus a phur zer mkhan zhig la phag rdzong nas gro smad khul gyi‘‘drag shos’’zhes pa bsko gzhag byas yod kyang ‘‘gro mo spyi khyab pa’’'byor ba'i rjes su gro mo‘‘drag shos’’ni gro mo stod smad du ming grags cung zad yod pa tsam las don dam gyi dbang cha gang yang med/sa byi ( 1rdoṭwāṃrdo) lo gro mo'i sna gdong (snya stong zhes kyang brjod) du dbyin 'gog dmag 'khrug byung rjes ching gong ma'i dmag dpon‘‘kra'o er hpheng ’’gis sne khrid pa'i dmag dpung dang bod gzhung gi dmag dpung zung sbrel gyis 'gag sgo srung bya bzhag yod kyang shing 'brug( 1904)lor dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa'i btsan 'dzul dmag gro mo brgyud rgyal rtse dang /85

lha sar 'byor rjes dbyin ji'i dmag dpon(twa()5sdi19 ji1(/co 6༷spro1(/) yo/'ong ho se sben kras bod gzhung gi sku tshab skabs de'i rgyal tshab dga' ldan khri pa‘‘la mo shar pa’’sogs la 'dra mnyam min pa'i chings yig 'jog tu bcug ste lha sa dang / sgar thog rgyal rtse/ gro mo bcas su tshong ra 'dzugs rgyu byas pa de'i nang sgar thog gi rgya nyi ma zhes par lo rer tshong dus thengs re 'tshogs pa'i skabs su 'bras spyi blon chen gyi drung yig chen mo dang / gro mor bca' sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don las tshab(2stu111cikha ktastu41)ṣṭa 4()rshasdusapyatwo)pa gnyis po res mos kyis 'gro ba las dmag dpung gtong srol mi 'dug skabs der bod gzhung gi sku tshab ni sgar dpon las thog pas gcig lcogs byed (tshong dus skabs rgya gar ba khri stong mang pos gangs rin po che mjal bar yong gi yod pa red/ dbyin ji bas lha sar tshong don spyi khyab las khungs btsugs pa dang / gro mo dang rgyal rtser tshong don las khungs btsugs shing / rgyal rtser dbyin dmag mi grangs 75dang gro mor dbyin dmag 2 5bca' sdod kyis shar gsing ma grong rdal gyi dbang cha yongs rdzogs dbyin jis bzung ste (smo2kho4pya5 ⑨()kho41mo7) meg sgro nel sgra zhes dang ( spo2 (sta4()1phyoshwa) sga 'ol sgra ( smo2 ṣāstu.a8()1snabhu) khem sba'o lo sogs dbyin dpon snga phyi rim 'byor gyis bsdad/ shing 'brug ( 19kya4) lo'i dbyin ji'i btsan 'dzul dmag 'khrug gi rjes su thog mar sna gdong du dbyin je'i tshong ra btsugs na yang mi ring bar shar gsing mar spos /de rjes bod gzhung nas gro mo sa khul du gro mo spyi khyab nga/ ngo g.yog bcu tsam zhig dang / sa srung bod darma ga lding dpon dang dmag dkyus mi grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga bcas btang ste dbang bsgyur byas thing / gro mo stod smad nas khral 'ul rgyug rgyur 'on seng ba‘‘gong 'thus’’zhes mi ser 'go dpon gnyis 86

dang / lag do zhes gong 'thus kyi las rogs mi gnyis bcas rgyun du gro spyi khang gi nye 'dabs su sdod dgos kyi yod/ mi ser nas kho tshor 'bud shing dang / gzan rtswa/ rtsam pa 'thag rgyu dang chang btso ba'i skabs su 'bru rigs phud de min gyi dgos cha nar gtong dang g.yog rgyug dgos pa/ de mtshungs rta khal bskul gtong skabs rta drel yod mkhan tshos rta drel dang med mkhan tshos mi hreng gtong dgos kyi yod pa red/ rta 'ul dang dos khal khag gcig la rgyas bcad kyi gla cha phran bu re yod rung / khag gcig la gla cha sprod srol med/ de 'brel chang ma nas chang khral dang / dmar khe ba nas sha khral/lag shes bzo pa nas bzo khral lam lag khral/ tshong pa nas tshong khral bcas bsdu zhing / lo rabs bzhi bcu pa'i nang gro mo spyi khyab khang bskyar 'dzugs skabs su/ spom mda' yar 'phel gyis rdo bzo ba dang shing bzo ba so sor nyin rer gla cha bod dngukha4 zho lnga re dang / dmangs rgyug tshor skar phyed brgyad re dang / rdo shing dmangs gsum la zla rer 'bru ru'i khal gsum re'i phogs sprad pa dang de rjes 'gro lam bzo bcos skabs su rdo bzo ba dang ar po bar gong mtshungs kyi gla phogs sprad pa las de min 'u lag bskul ba'i mi ser rnams la gla phogs gang yang sprad med/ phyitsho/ rgyal ba'i mi sna 'gro 'ong skabs rta khal bskul bar gla cha cung che ba sprod kyi yod kyang gla 'bab kyi dngul de dag gong 'thus kyi lag pa brgyud de gzhi nas mi ser la rag gi yod 'dug gzhung gi dpon rigs 'gro 'ong skabs sgrig chas gdan lcog dang / skol snod cha tshang skyel sgrig dgos thogartswa shing dang rta g.yog thab g.yog mi gnyis gtong dgos kyi yod/skabs der gro mo spyi khyab khang gi mdun nas 'grul bzhud byed skabs rta las babs te phyu pa'i phu thung gyon dgos pa dang / de ltar ma byas tshe dmag 87

mi tshos lam seng ko lcag gam 'gram lcag skabs rer khrims lcag gzhu ba dang / khral 'ul rgyug par dus thog tu ma— 'byor tshe khrims rgyug sogs nyes rdung sna tshogs dang / dngos po'i chad pa gcod pa dang / skabs re gong 'thus dang tsho par yang dngul chad dang / khrims lcag khrims rgyug btang ba sogs kyi gnas tshul byung yod/gro spyi dang po'am gro mo tshong ra'i do dam pa dang po sar rdar dar rgyas ni de sngon shing 'brug ( 1904) lo'i gong du rgya gar rdo rje gling du yod pa'i dbyin ji'i las mi (bu0()1phyo1stu)ku li'i 'go byed‘‘sar rdar dar rgyas’’zer ba yin zhing / khong gis dbyin jir ngo rgol mig dper 'os pa byas par brten twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gis khong la drung 'khor dkyus ma'i go gnas(gro spyi dang po nas lnga pa'i dus 'go'i bar drung 'khor dkyus ma yin pa) bstsal ba dang chabs cig mtha' srung dmag mi nyi shu rtsa lnga mngags gtong mdzad de ( 1905— 1kha11) bar lo lnga'i ring sar rdar dar rgyas nas gro spyi dang / tshong ra'i do dam pa gcig lcogs byas te sna gdong du yod pa'i gro spyi khang du sdod/ skabs der sna gdong du phyi rgyal ba'i‘‘ko khri’’zhes phyi dbyibs can gyi khang pa zhig kyang brgyab yod pa der dbyin ji'i sman pa bud med‘‘mi mi sa teb’’zer ba zhig yod pa dang / ching gong ma'i mtha' srung dmag gro stod mchod rten dkar por mi grangs lnga bcu tsam dang / sna gdong 'gag sgor mi grangs sum cu so lnga yas mas/ pad sbas thang du mi grangs sum cu tsam yod skad 'dugasar rdar dar rgyas bod la 'byor tshul skor rtso/da srol gnyis yod pa ste/gcig ni dbyin jis bod la btsan 'dzul gyi grabs gshoms byas par khong gis ngo rgol mtha' gcig tu byas pa dang / bod rigs las mi mang po zhig 88

sgrig 'dzugs byas te rgol 'dzing bya rtsis byas par nang rul pas dbyin jir gsang brda btang bas dbyin jis khong 'dzin bzung gis bod phyogs su rtsis par brten tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gis khong la gzigs bskyang bdag rkyen chen po grenang ba zhes dang / gcig shos ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng ngacu gsum pa rdor gying du byol phebs skabs sar rdar dar rgyas kyis thugs phan gsol po byung bar brten chu byi ( 1912 )lo'i dmag 'khrug rjes twa la'i bla ma bod du phyir phebs skabs bshad sgra blon che na gyis khrid phebs pa red ces shod srol yod/gro spyi gnyis pa sger spel bzhi ba ྾ ྾ ྾ ྾ gis ( 1912 —1916) bar lo lnga ring bzu nga zhing / skabs der gro spyi khang ni gro smad rin chen sgang gi gsang tar khyim bdag zhes pa'i dud tshang zhig tu byas/gro spyi gsum pa mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rjes ( 1917— 1kha2 1)bar lo lnga'i ring bzung ring bye ma grong sde'i byang shar ngos su yod pa'i pad sbas thang (pad sbas thang gi gro spyi khang ni 1940lo'i bar du gnas pa dang 194kyaror chu rud kyis 'jig 'dug) zhes par gro mo spyi khyab pa'i gzhung las gas ra skrun byas yod pa der bsdad/gro spyi bzhi pa sger lha sding ba mgon po snyan grags kyis ( 192 2 —1926) lo lnga'i ring bzung ba gong bzhin pad sbas thang du yod pa'i gro spyi khang du bsdad/gro spyi lnga pa/ slar yang sger mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rjes( 1927—1kha24) bar lo brgyad ring bzung skabs gong bzhin pad thang gro spyi khang du bsdad/ khong gi lo rgyus gsham du zur bkod byas yod/gro spyi drug pa/ sger tshes gsum phun khang pa skal bzang dbang phyug 89

gis ( 1kha25— 1kha40bar)lo drug ring bzung ba gong bzhin pad thang gi gro spyi khang du bsdad cing / 194kyalor khong gis dgongs pa zhus te lha sar phebs ring khams bu'i stod khongs go rwa zhes nga/'i lung pa'i chu rud thon te khams bu dang gro mo smad khul gyi grong sde mang po zhig dang chabs cig pad sbas thang du yod pa'i gro spyi khang yang gtsang ma 'jig par brten gro spyi khang gsar skrun ma zin bar gro smad bye ma grong tsho'i btsun rgyal du gan/sa tshang g.yar te gnas skabs kyi gro spyi khang zhig btsugs 'dugagro spyi bdun pa/ spom mda' yar 'phel gyis ( 1941— 1kha54)lo bcu bzhi ring bzung zhing / chu 'bi grong tsho'i shar ngos su gro spyi khang gsar rgyag byas pa dang / gro mo sto/da smad kyi 'gro lam nyams gso byas pa sogs khong gis gro spyi rim byon gyi nang nas 'dzugs skrun gyi byas rjes che tsam bzhag yod/ spom mdas gro spyi bzung ring spom mda' yar 'phel ngo ma ma bsdad par lho kha mtsho sna rdzong khongs (deng sang sbyor ra chus) smin mda'i bu stobs 'byor zer ba zhig ngo tshab tu ba'ag pa dang / 1952lor sto/bas 'byor 'das grongs song rjes spom mda'i gnyer pa bsod nams don grub zer ba'i smar khams pa zhig gis lo gnyis ring bzung /gro spyi brgyad pa/ sger mu bya ba tshe dbang nor bus ( 1kha55 —1kha56) bar lo gnyis ring ma gtogs bzung thub med cing / de ni khong gro mor 'byor rjes mi dmangs la brdab gsig ha cang chen po btang rkyen mang tshogs kyi ngo rgol shugs che 'phog ste mthar phyir 'then mi bya ka med byung 'dugagro spyi rjes shos mu bya ba phyir 'then byas pa'i rjes su krung gung gro mo tang ud kyi thad ka'i rogs ram 'og bod rang skyong ljongs gra sgrig u yon lhan khang khongs gro mo rdzong rim pa'i don sa/cod khang gi kru'u ren u yom/ khri smon dpal 'byor 9()

rdo rjes gcig lcogs byas pa dang / khri smon pa phyir 'o/ga rjes gro phag spyi khyab mkhan chung thub bstan sangs rgyas dang chab tshoms 'chi med rgyal po gnyis kyis zla drug ring gcig lcogs byas pa de nas bzung gro mo spyi khyab pa zhes pa mjug ljorigril ba red/gro spyi mi ro brgya pa'i lo rgyus rags rim/mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje ni gtsang khul pa rnam rdzong khongs lcogre/ ro zhes pa'i khyim tshang du skyes pa dang / lo na son rjes shangs mi ro brgya pa zhes par go mag tu slebs shing / chung ngu'i dus nas yig rtsis la sbyang brtson/ che la/ blo stobs ldan pa zhig kyang yod pas/ gzhung zhabs zhus bstsal rjes chu byi rgya bod dmag 'khrug skabs gzhis rtse grong khyer nang ming ngan du‘‘dpa' la kha chen’’zhes pa'i lu'u cun gyi dmag dpon des gtsos lu'u cun dmyo/ga khas/ gcig gis mi ser gyi dngos po gang byung gis 'phrog bcom sogs khrims med lugs med byed bzhin pa'i skabs der khong gis bod dmag khag gcig 'khrid de ‘‘dpa' la kha chen’’ zer ba'i byed gte bsad pa dang de 'phros rnams kha thor du btang ba dang / yang stod khul rdzong dpon zhig byed skabs khul der gyong dregs can gyi jag rkun mang po yod pa de dag la khong gis thog mar brtag zhib nan tan byas pa dang / de rjes byed gte 'dzin bzung gis mi ser tshang ma 'bod bkug byas te tshang mas mthong sar dmar gsod patang ba dang / de 'phros rnams la khrims gcod nan tan byas pa ra brten yul der khong la‘‘mi ro brgya pa mi yi spyang ki red’’ces pa'i shod srol chags yod skad 'dug91

rab byung bco lnga pa'i me sbrul( 1rdzo17)lo gro mo spyi khyab par bsko stsal gyis lo lnga'i ring gro spyi gsum pa'i las khur byas pa dang / de rjes rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos ( 1rdzo17)lo nas lo brgyad ring gro spyi lnga pa'i las khur byed myong zhing khong gis gro mo spyi khyab pa lo bcu gsum byed ring gro mo'i mi ser tshor rgyun gtan 'char can 'khri ba'i khral 'ul bskul ba las rang snang gang dran gyis brdab gsig 'phar ma'i rigs gtan nas mi gtong ba'i drang tshugs che la/ mi ngan yan por mi gtong ba'i blo stobs kyang che gshis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog nas khong la gdeng 'jog dang gzigs skyong chen po gnang ste spyan bsal gyi gras su tshud par brten khong gis twa la'i bla ma mchog la gal che'i las don gyi nang snyan zhu skabs snyan zhu'i 'go brjod du ‘‘bdag gi skyabs rje gong sa yid bzhin nor bu mchog gi (nabs drung du/gus gsol’’zhes sogs bris te bka' shag sogs las khungs gang zhig kyang brgyud ma dgos par thad kar 'bul gyi yod skad 'dugatho/ nga rgyun ldan zhogs pa langs skabs dang / dgong mo nyal skabs gzim brda dang bzhengs brda zhes srung dmag tshor gtan 'khel dus tshod du rol cha gtong du 'jug pa dang / gro spyi khang nas phyir bskyod skabs srung dmag bzhis btegs pa'i 'gyogs byams nang sdo da pa/ lo gsar sogs dus chen khag tu slo ma chen po'i nang dngul bsil ma rdag rdag blugs rnga/ de dag srung dmag dang g.yog po'i khrod du bshos te hab thob rgyag tu 'jug gi yod 'dugami ro brgya pa 'chi rmad rdo rjes khrims 'gal nyes can par khrims gcod byed skabs stag lpags shig bting ba'i steng khri'u shing brgyab nas sdod pa dang /mdun gyi lcog rtse'i steng du me mda'‘‘lan kru'u’mizhig bzhag a rag gis 92

bkang ba'i gser gyi phor pa bshams/ mdun phyogs g.yas g.yon gnyis su rol cha ba ru star bsgrigs shing de'i dkyil du nyes can pa pus mo btsugs te 'jog pa dang / nye 'dabs mi ser yongs rdzogs ltad mor bkug thog khong gis a rag 'thung bzhin du nyes can pa de'i nag nyes re re bzhin bgrangs nas bka' bkyon tsha nan btang 'phral‘‘dwo pha'o’’rgyag tu bcug pa'i sgra grags ma thag rol cha ba tshos rol cha gtong bzhin pa'i ngang du nyes can pa der khrims rgyug gam khrims lcag tsha nan zhig gtong gi yod skad 'dugani/ ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje ni mi rigs kyi la rgya brtan por srung thub mkhan zhig yin pas/ khong gis dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pa sogs phyi rgyal ba su 'dra zhig la'ang gus gus zhum zhum gtan nas byed kyi med pa/dper na/ khong gro spyi byed ring dbyin ji srid gzhung gis 'bras ljongs su mngags gtong byas pa'i srid 'dzin dpon po 'bras spyi blon chen sbe le(sbe le blon chen zhes brjod) sogs 'bras ljongs nas gro mor 'byor rgyu'i nyin der las drung phebs bsur mngags gtong dang 'brel 'bras spyi ngo 'khor rnarma yonyin dgung gi gsol tshigs gro spyi khang du gnang bar phebs dgos zhes mgron brda gtong ba dang 'bras spyi ngo 'khor gro spyi khang du 'byor mtshams khong gis gzhi nas gzim chung 'gag gi rdo skas kyi gsham bar bsu bar yong gi yod pa dang / khong tshor gsol tshigs gzab rgyas bshams rjes gong bzhin rdo skas kyi gsham bar skyel ma byed pa las/ de las brgal te mi 'gro zhing / phyi nyin khong gis shar gsing mar 'bras spyi blon chen la sngar srol 'tshams 'drir skyod skabs kyang 'gyogs byams nang bsdad de 'gro gi yod pa red/khong la6‘'ja' sa'i’’cho lo byung stangs ni/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu 93

gsum pa mchog gis 'bras spyi'i drung yig che mo ba dang gro mor bca' sdod dbyin ji'i tshong don las khungs kyi spyi khyab pa gcig lcogs yin pa'i rā ye bha ra dur nor bu don grub la‘‘'ja' sa'i cho lo bstsal rjes nor bu don grub gro mor 'byor ba dang gro mo nas phyir thon pa'i skabs su gro spyi mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje khong nyid skabs der drung 'khor dkyus ma zhig yin par brten sku zhabs rnor bu don grub 'a phebs bsu dang phebs skyel zhu bar mi bskyod thabs med byung ba der ma bzod par khong gis tā la'i bla ma mchog la‘‘gong nas phyi mir gang byung gis go gnas chen po bstsal ba des gus pa rang nyid go gnas dma' bar brten phyi mi bsu rgyu dang phyi mi skyel rgyur nyams dma' ba'i gnas tshul thabs rdugs can rang bzhim/ gyis 'byung 'gro ba des mtha' mtshams sa khul du rang nyid dma' zhan ngo tsha ba'i gnas su gyar zhing / na rgas 'chi khar nye ba bdas gis mtha' mtshams khul du thabs rdugs la dma' zhan po'i ngang du dka' las brgyab ste snying po gtan nas mi 'dug lags na/ da cha las zhabs chabs cig dgongs pa rtsa nga/nga gnang skyong yod pa’’ zhes 'khod pa'i 'u thug bzod bral gyi snyan zhu zhig thad snakar phul bar tā la'i bla ma mchog gi bka' lan dusnye de ring nas bzung mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje khyod rang la yang ri ma bzhi'i go gnas sprad pa yin pas bka' bsgyur mjal dar thad 'di ga grezhung sar ched bcar ma dgos par snya na zhu'i thog nas gsar mjal gyis shib/’’ ces pa'i sbug tham sbyar ba'i bkod rgya phebs pa ltar khong la‘‘'ja' sa'i’’cho lo tho/ba rjes khong gis phyi rgyal ba'i dpon rigs rnams dang sngar bas 'dra mnyam gyi ngang du gnas thub pa byung skad/ khong gis gro spyi'i dbang shugs spyod phyogs thad kyang / dper na rgyun ldan 'grul bzhud pa dpon chen phud phyi nang su yin la ma bltos par tshang mas gro spyi khang du 'byor nye'i 94

mtshams su rta las babs te gro spyi khang ma sgrol bar du rkang thang mar 'gro dgos nga 'i rgyun srol zhig bzos yod nga/ der phyi rgyal gyi mi 'ga' zhig nas brtsi bkur ma zhus par rta bzhon te thad kar bskyod pa'i gnas tshul byung tshe de 'phral rta las phab ste ko lcag gam rta lcag gtong gi yod 'dug de bzhin gro spyi'i sa khongs su khrims 'gal ba byung tshe phyi rgyal ba sogs su yin la ma bltos nga ra khricha/sa gcod gtong gi yod pa dper na/ thengs shig 'brug pa'i jag rkun zhige gis gro mo'i mi ser tsho'i sgo phyugs dang rgyu nor 'phrog bcom byas pa'i gnas tshul shes rto gas byung 'phral srung dmag mngags te 'brug jag bzung bkyig byas thog 'brug gzhung gi sku tshab cig gdan zhus kyis des mthong sar‘‘stib ci/ra’ zhes pa'i gro mo'i shing rgyug rlon pa bcad de rkub la tsha nan nyis brgya btang bas der 'brug pa'i sku tshab ha las hon thor gyis‘‘gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po 'di na 'dug’ ces dbang med du bshad yod skad de mtshungs skyes ma bod rigs yin pa'i phyi mi tshor khrims gcod byed skabs phyi rgyal ba'i 'thus/ tshab 'angod 'gugs kyis de tsho'e mthong sar‘‘nyes can pa 'di'i rus pa khyed tsho'i yin na'ang sha ni nga tsho'i red’’ces bsgrags nas khrims rgyug gam rta lcag tsha nan gtong gi yod pas phyi mi su 'dra zhig gis kyang gro mor khrims 'gal gyi bya ba byed mi nus pa'i rnam pa zhig chags yod 'dug 'on kyang bka' 'a/ga gnas yu la lha sar phyi rgyal bas khrims 'gal gyi bya ba spel na'ang phyi rgyal gzhung tshab las khungs la rtsis sprod pa las rang khongs nas khrims gcod byed nus kyi med pa red/ cigro spyi mi ro brgya pas mtha' mtshams kyi bde 'jags las don thog drag rtsub che tsam gyis srung sdom byed kyi yod cing / dper na de'i sngon bod du phyi rgyal nas rdo tha dang / tha mag 'dren rgyur bkag sdom shugs che byed bzhin 95

yod na 'ang nag tshong pa tshos lam yan brgyud de rdo tha dang / tha mag lkog 'dren byed pa de rigs gro spyi mi brgya'i dus 'dzin bzung byas nas do bdag gis mthong sar gris btsab tu bcug ste gtsang chur bskyur thog khrims gcod nges can zhig kyang gtong gi yod pa dang / de bzhin spyi tshogs thog ra bzi skyur 'gong bshad de 'phung dkrug slong mkhan dang rgyag res rgyag mkhan tshor yang dbye zhib dang 'brel khrims gcod 'os 'tshams byed kyi yod/ yang khong gis gro spyi lnga pa'i las khur skabs spom mda' tshang gi g.yog po byed myong ba'i khams pa bsod nams tshe ring zer ba zhig yod pa des 'go gco byas pa'i 'og phag rir jag tshang zhig chags yod pa de tshos phag ri dang phag ri'i yas mas sogs mtha' mtshams sa khul mi ser gyi srog dang rgyu nor la nyen 'jigs tshabs che sku la bzhin yod pa'i gnas tshul shes rto gas byung 'phral nan tan gyis brtag zhib mthil phyin byas rjes nyin zhig khong ngo mas glo bur du srung dmag nyi shu skor khrid de gro spyi khang nas rdog thon gyis phag rir 'byor 'phral jag dpon bsod nams tshe ring sogs jag rkun mi brgyadu (de'i nang jag mo zhig tshud yod) po tshang ma 'dzin bzung byas te phag ri dga' bzhi spa rwa'i(sgo ra'i don) nang du bsdams bkyig gis khrims rgyug tsha nan btang 'phral phag ri rdzong shar nub kyi rdzong dpon gnyis po'ang der 'bod bkug gis‘‘khyod gnyis gzhung sa nas mgo mi brlag ched mig bya rwar bskos te mngags gtong gnang na yang da cha mgo rul sna bas ma tshor ba'i dpe ltar gye gnas tshul chags su bcug pa 'os min red’ ces sogs kyi bka' bkyon tsha nan dang 'brel chu tshod gcig tsam ring bslangs te bkar ba dang de rjes jag pa de tsho'i lag pa g.yas pa'i mdzub mo bzhi dang lag pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong bcad/jag mo de'i rna cog ya gcig dang skra phyed ka bzhur ba de rnams phag ri'i khrom 96

ra'i khrod du 'grems ston byas pa dang / slar yang jag pa pho mo tshang mar khrims lca ga tsha na na brgya re btang ste phag rir ro las byed mkhan‘‘dgon pa ba’’zer ba de tshor lta rtogs do dam bya rgyur rtsis sprad/ jag tshang nang gi rgyu norngo yongs rdzogs gzhung len gyis gro spyi khang du dbor rjes bka' shag la zhib phra'i ga nas tshul 'khod pa'i las don snyan seng zhus 'dug gong gsal mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje'i byed stangs der skye bo mang pos skad gsang mthon pos bsnga/gas brjod byas 'dug kyang bka' shag nas‘‘da res mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rjes spel ba'i bya spyod de ni thal cha shin tu che drags pa dang /'os su ma mchis pa red’’ ces sogs skyon brjod byas pa'i bkod rgya ci/ga 'byor nga de'i lan du‘‘rgas po bdag la rim pa gong ma nas mtha' mtshams kyi bde 'jags nan tan gyis brtan por sru nga dargos rgyu'i las 'gan dkris te mngags gtong gnang byung ba'i dgongs don ltar da res ngas mjirwa' mtshams sa khul mi ser gyi srog dang rgyu nor srung skyob kyi ched du jag rngaprer drag gno na gyis jag tshang gtor ba de ni gzur gnas skye bo kun gyis bsngags par 'os pa'i lugs mthun gyi bya ba 'ba' zhig yin pa der ma 'grigs pa 'dug na/rgas po bdag la bka' dang nyes pa ba/ re yod na yang gnang rogs gnang ’’zhes sosas snyan zhu tsha nan zhig bris phul byas yod skad 'dugade snga bkras lhun bla brang snyesmu gzhung nas gnon shugs chen po sprad par brten kun gzigs paṇa chen thams cad mkhyen pa sku phreng dgu pa chos kyi nyi ma dpal bzang po mchog chu phag ( 192 2) lor glo bur gsang ba'i sgo nas rang gi gdan sa nas zhal bral te mtsho sngon khul du nyen g.yol gnang ba ra phebs ngagos byung ba'i rjes su gzhung nas bkras lhun gyi phyi nang 'dzin dbang yongs rdzogs do dam byas pa ma zad‘‘bkra shis lhun po'i grwa rgyun gcig kyang sa 97

mtshams brgal te btang mi chog’’ces bod kyi mtha' khul rdzong gzhis yongs su bka' rgya btang ste bkag sdom byas dang byed bzhicha/ pa'i skabs der bkras lhun bla brang nas zhabs 'bring ba'i gras yin pa (bka' chen tshogs gnyis phyis su lo rabs bdun cu pa dang brgyad cu par gzhis rtse sa gnas srid gros kyi kru'u zhi gzhon pa gnang myong ba) sogs pho nya ba khag gcig gsang ba'i sgo nas rgya gar brgyud paṇa chen rin po che'i sku drung du mngags gtong byas pa khong rnams gro spyi khang gnas yul‘‘pad sbas thang nya’zer ba'i lung shur gyi 'gro lam brgyud de skyod skabs gro spyi mi ro brgya pa 'cham 'cham byed bzhin pa dang kha thug 'khel te‘‘sku zhabs dge 'dun pa khyod tsho grwa pa gang nas yin nam’’zhes dris par khong tshos‘‘bdag tsho shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor nas yin’mi ces zhus par mitshoro brgya pas‘‘khyod tsho dga' ldan chos 'khor ba min par bkra shis lhun po ba zhig yin rnga/ ngas shes kyi 'dub/ khyod tsho the tshom dogs pa gang yang gnang mi dgos shar bskyod chog cing / khyod tsho rgya gar gyi tsha khul du phebs skabs zas spyod sogs gang cir gzab nan gyi sgo nas bla brang nas dkris pa'i las don rnams 'thus shor med par legs sgrub kyis skyabs mgon rin po che'i thugs bzhed yongs su skong thub pa zhig gnang dgos’ zhes skul lcag kyang byas yod pa sogs rgyal mchog yab sras rnam gnyis lhan 'dzoms thub pa zhig yong re'i ched du khong gis dngos shugs gang thad nas rang gi nus shugs legs skyes su phul myong yod 'dug spyan gsal kun 'phel lags kyi pha spyan bsal pā lags zhes pa zhig gro mo brgyud rgya gar du gnas mjal skyod skabs mi ro brgya pas khong la dga' bsu dga' skyel dang lam 'khel rta 'u'/ sgrig cha bya rgyu sogs gang cir sne len gzab rgyas byas yod na yang nyin zhig gsol ston zhig bshams te phan tshun ci gros 98
