mol gros byas pa'i zhor du mi ro brgya pas‘‘pa pha khyed rang gi bu kun 'phel nged gnyis ka rgyal dbang yid bzhin nor bu'i spyan bsal gcig pa yin pa ma zad/ spyan bsal 'dra 'dra'i nang nas nga rang lo na rgan shos shig yin na yang khyod rang gi bus nga la yi ge tsam yang btang yong gi mi 'dug’’ces phan tshun 'dra mnyam yin tshul gleng ba der spyan bsal kun 'phel pha bur dma' 'bebs btang ba'i rang bzhin du gyur par brten spyan bsal kun 'phel la phog thug ci che byung bas mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rjer snying dbus nas dga' min zhe 'dzin gyis ring por ma thogs par spyan bsal kun 'phel gyis bka' shag la mi ro brgya pa'i gro spyi'i las 'gan gnas dbyung gtong rgyur ngan bskul byas don bka' shag nas glo bur du mi ro brgya par dza drag gi bka' rgya zhig btang 'byor du‘‘mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje'i gro spyi'i las khur 'khyur tshab tshes gsum phun khang ba ska'/ bzang dbang phyug la bsko gzhag song bas/ gro spyi gas ra rnying gi rtsis sprod rtsis/ len byed sgo gang myur legs grub dgos pa dang / mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje khyod rang gang myur phyir log gis 'di ga bka' shag tu ched bcar gyis’’zhes gsal ba ltar mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rjes rang nyid kyis 'khur bzhin pa'i gro spyi'i las khur rnams gro spyi gsar pa tshes gsum phun khang ba skal bzang dbang phyug la nan tan gyis rtsis sprod byas pa dang dus mtshungs bka' shag la‘‘gus mi ro brgya pa 'chi med rdo rje rang nyid lo na ha cang myo4tho yang gong rim gyi bka' bzang ldog tu med par da bar mi lo bcu gsum ring mtha' mtshams sa khul du lus sems gnyis ka'i dka' ngal khyad bsad kyis rang srog 'ben la btsugs te zhabs phyi hur thag zhus shing /da cha na rgas 'chi khar nye ba bdag gis da dung mu mthud de gzhung sa chen po'i zhabs phyi zhu thub re bral 'dug lags na slad gus pa'i las zhabs chabs cig 99
rnya ’zhesacipa'i snyan zhu zhi/‘ /zhis mi ro brgya par po

stse yig tshang rdonerngasri lhangs tshugre/sa dus dang /de'i 'gan 'bab las rdan/ khya ba khongs/ 'gan 'khur mi sna sogs kyi skor/ye shes kun dgas/rab byung 12pa chu sprel ( 1752 )lor/ twa la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skasnyel bzang rgya mtshos gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i rtse yig tshang las khungs zhes pa ni/ sbug dam bka' yig zhabs zhu dang / ser mo ba yongs kyi spyi khyab las khungs che shos shig red/de'i gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur mi sna ni rim pa gsum pa'i twa bla ma gcig dang / rim pa bzhi pa'i mkhan drung gsum/ gsham 'og las don mi sna gtso bo yeg tshang gnyer pa zhes rim pa lnga pa'i rtse drung sa/cig dang / rim pa drug pa'i dbu ri las tshan (dbu mdzad ri mo ba) zhes ser gzugs gcig('dzugs khungs 'bras spungs spyi so yin pa las 'gan 'char can gtan 'bebs/ sbug dam bka' rgya dang / dpyad phra khag gi 'go shog sa stong du zla gzugs ri mo bkod rgyu dang / yig tshags bcas) yig las zhes rim pa bdun pa'i rtse drung dkyus ma na gzhon mi grangs bcu nas bco lnga'i bar/drung yig che mo ba bzhi la gsol zhu zhabs 'degs pa lta bu yig tshang slob phrug zhes na gzhon phru gu bzhi(yig gzugs sbyang brtson gyis lo na son mtshams rtse 101

drung zhu dmigs ) bcas —ri las mi gra nga 'i nyi shu ca nge/ smo ra la rshag grub pa zhib/ red/drung yig che mo bsko ga/sgag/ dang / de min las bya gsar zhugs kyi sko na/drung yig che mo bsko gzhag byed skabs thog mar twa la'i bla ma'i phyag rtags dgongs don rtse 'gag nas mkhan mgron che bas bka' bsgyur rjes shag tshang sger gyis tshes cha gtan 'kheya mtshams rtse 'gag tu gzhes brda snya/na seng dang 'brel sngon la bka' bsgyur mjal dar zhes twa la'i bla mar mjal phyag zhu dgos pa dang / slar yang gza' sta/ra legs bdams tshes cha gtan 'khel gyis gsar mjal dngos gzhi'i che 'don nyin snga dro rtsetsho'agag tu gsar mjal la ma bcar gong yig tshang du sngar srol rten 'brel byed sgo'i thad thog mar drung che rnying pa rnams la go babs ma/tshams zhu'i gzan phab zin 'phral drung che'i gdan thob thog 'khod chog cing / de nas ngo las yongs la rten 'brel gyi gso la ja bzhes 'bras btang rjes gsar zhug/sa drung che nas sngar srol ltar rten 'brel yig tshad tshigs bcad bzhi tsam 'bri dgos pa bcas don snying drung che snga rjes tshang ma'i gsar zhugs lam srol de ltar yin 'dugade 'og gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur gras yig tshang gnyer pa ni de snga yig tshang las bya byed myo nga ba'i gras nas yig rtsis nges can yod la mkhan drung tsho'i blos 'gel chog pa zhig 'dems bsgrug gis dmigs bsal yig tshad gtong ma dgos par gsar zhugs skabs drung che rnams 'a/ rten 'brel mtshon byed mjal dar re phul na chog cing / gsol ja bzhes 'bras sogs gtong srol spyi mtshungs red/ yig tshang las byar rtse drung na gzhon khag gcig bsdu rgyu dang / gsar zhugs dgos min thad rgyun ldan 'a sa bya'i grangs 'bor gyi 102

dgos gal dang yig gzugs legs gras dmigs bsal gyis bsdu yi yo/da kyang / 'ga' zhig drung che rnams la nang bcar skyabs bcol gyis zhu 'tshang yang byed dgos pa sogs rgyu mtshan sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas gsar zhugs kyang dgos min sna tshogs shig las nges gtan 'khel ba rang mi 'dug spyir yig tshang las byar zhugs na shag tshang sger la gyong gun yod pa'i rtswa rtsam shing gsum(rtswa gnyer dang / rtsam bzhes/ shing gnyer) gyi las tshan byed ma dgos pa'i thog yig rtsis sbyong brdar dang gzhung srol 'gro lugs shes rtogs yong thabs phyin chad rdzong gzhis sam/ nang ma'i las tshan sogs 'gro khungs legs gras kyi 'os khongs su tshud rgyu'i dmigs yul ldam/ yod stabs shag tshang dang / khyim tshang drag gras kyi na gzhon rtse drung ma gtogs phal cher zhugs thub rgyu dka' tsam yod pa red/rtse yig tshang gi gtso bo'i 'gan babs las ka'i skon/twa la'i bla ma'i bka' 'brel phyag rtags dgongs don/ gtan 'jags las khungs khag dang / rgya khyab yongs la bsgrags rgyu'i rtsa tshig sogs bzo rgyu dang / lhag par du ser mo ba yongs kyi spyi khyab ces se 'bras dga' gsum gyis mtshon grub mtha' ris med bla dgon yongs kyi spyi 'doms yin pabasdo/ dgon khag so sor 'dul khrims kyi bca' yig dgos rigs dang dmigs bsal zhu tho snyan 'byor dang bstun pa'i bla khag so jo tsho'i gdan thob gnas spar/ chos gzhis khag gi bdag dbang gtan tshigs/ dgon khag gi phyi nang nyams gso'i mthun rkyen/ dge bshes gartang sgo'i dge skul slong yig sogs kyi skor skabs bstun babs 'os mchis min zhib gros 'char 103

ram̐bul phyas/ rta gas gzhir bzung gtan 'khe ra bya ngagos rigs dang / de mirlo se skubras dga' gsu /ma gyi3sri ma/tshon dbon khas rnam sa la 'char 'phar /zhabakug rim sgrub tho'i mang 'gyeod dgos thob kyi dpyad khag 'bri rgyu ma zad/gnas dga'(gnas chung dang dgaljori gdong ) gnyis kyis mtshon bsam yas dang ‘ra mo sogs la lha zhu'i lung yig sna tshogs/ shod skor ya sor khri pa'i lag rtsa/ bkras lhun lo gsar rten 'bul khag gi lag lam (lag rtsa dang lam yig) sku tshab gzims 'gag bcas pa'i lag lam/ rgya khyab rdzong gzhis lha klu gnas yul so sor sa bcud bum skyel a drung dang / bum pa sba rgyu'i 'gan 'khur chog grwa'i lag lam/ mdo spyi bka' shag gis mtshon phyogs mtha'i spyi khyab khag dang / rdzong gzhis mi 'gro ser skya 'phos len dbar gsar rnying sprod dpang bcas kyi co 'dzin sprod rgya lam yig snyan zhu khag gi bka9re lan 'go mchan sna tshogs/ ri klung rtsa tshig sogs sbug dam dam zhu'i thad lo zla so so'i nang 'gyangs med 'phral sa/tong dgos pa 'i yig rigs rnams tshugs thung gtsang bris kyis btang chog gra sgrig 'thus tshang byas rjes twa la'i bla mar dam zhu'i gnas brda 'am gzhes brda snyan se nga zhus te dngos gzhi'i nyin drung che bzhi dang / yig gnyer las bya gnyis tsam bcas dam mtshal dang yig khag rnams ma‘nyam 'khyer gyis gzims chung 'gag tu bcar nas bka' lan thon mtshams yig gnyer dang las bya gzims chung mdor sdod dgos pa dang / mkhan drung twa bla mas gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur gyi thog nas dam zhu'i yig khag so so'i nang don rnams snyan zhus zhu dag chabs sbrags kyis go rim bsgrig dgos pa/ drung che gzhon pas sbug dam phab rgyag zhabs 'degs kyi 'gan 'khur byed srol yod pa/ drung che gnyis nas gcig gis sgor gzugs rtags tham phab rgyu dang / gcig gis dam zhu thon rim bzhin 104

ne zo ) ra tshoyib/ gnyer dang / las byar sprad de lteb sgril rtse bkug ji snekri/ sheg zi ri myo5 tshams slar yang dkris tham zhu rgyur phul te dam zhu yong sa rdzopa—/sa zin rjes yib/ tshang nas phyi lkogs brgyab ste khungs sprod dang yig gnyer gyis tshes grang sa bkod de snyan zhu'i bka' lan 'go mchan dang / 'char can dpyad khag sigs sbug dam rigs rnams dam song zhes tho bkod byed srol 'dugasbug dam bdag tshags byed sgo'i thad/ sbug dam 'jug snod dam sgam de nyid tā la'i bla ma po ta lar bzhugs skabs su gzim chung lha mo khang du 'jog nga/ dang / nor gling du mgon po khang gnyis su 'jog gi yod cing /dam sgacha/ phyir sgo lcags 'breng lhad thog twa la'i bla ma sku sger gyi phyag tham phab ste lde mib/ de dag yig tshang du nyar tshags byed srol dang / tā la'i bla ma po ta 'a/ dang / nor gling / lha sa gtsug lag khang sogs la chibs bsgyur skabs sbug dam rnams drung che so sos sngon tshud nas phyi bsgril gos 'bog nang bsgril te 'khur rgyu'i las 'gan yod par/ de'i nang ljid tshad gser srang bzhi brgya tsam yod pa'i dam sgam de nyid drung che gzhon pas ga'on khral lta bur 'khyer dgos kyi 'dug yig tshang du de min 'gyed 'dzin nam/ las khungs khag nas gtong sgo zhu len sogs la bed spyod gtong byed dmar tham sgor gzugs gcig yig tshang rang gi dgos mkho snag shog sogs kyi ngos sbyor ram/ yig chung brda tho sogs la phab rgyag bed spyod gtong byed sgo tham gcig bcas 'dugartse skor zhabs dmigs kyi yongs khungs kyi skor/pyi lo 1762lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa skal bzang rgya mtshos gsar 'dzugs gnang ba'i rtse rig gnas slob grwa zhes se 'bras dga' gsum 105

gyi grwa tshang che khag re nas btsun chung gsum re dang / grwa tshang chung khag re nas gnyiskyuske re/ rme ru/ bzhi sde/ 'phyongs rgyas ri bo bde chen/ ri bo chos gling / rtsed thang rtse tshogs pa bcas so so nas btsun chung re bcas grwa 'phyags bsdu bskong bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs yod pa ltar yig tshang nas skabs mtshams so sor bkod rgya gtong lam bzhin bsdu thengs rer grwa grangs nyi shu rtsa bdun re zin pa de rnams mi rer 'os 'dra re go sgrig gi thog nas yig tshang du mi babs spyan zhur yong ste gtan 'khel ba rnams slob grwa dus gcig tu rngakasar zhugs byed dgos pa ma zad/ zla rer yig tshang du yig tshad thengs gnyis re spyan zhur yong dgos nga/ dang / dbyar mjal yig tshad ces lo re thengs re'i yig tshad che mo 'ig yod pas yig tshang brgyud tā la'i bla mar spya na zhu bstar dgos pa dang / twa la'i bla mas yig gzugs legs zhan la gzhigs pa'i ang bkod phyag rtags dgongs don rnams drung ja'i sar drung che gcig gis slob phrug so so'i ming jang ang grangs bsgrags mjal phyag skabs rtse phyag ma/sa gyon snam gnang cha bcas sprod srol mchis/ slob grwa der rgyun gtan yig gzugs dge rgan rtse drung gcig dang / rig gnas dpe khrid dge rgan lho kha smin gling dgon nas drag 'dems kyis ming shog yig tshang ges gtan 'khel 'bul phyag rtags dgongs don ltar bsko gzhag byed cing / slob phrug rnams slob grwar lo shas song rjes sbyangs 'bras phran bu thon rimatshams zhabs sdod snyan dar zhes kha btags nang mdzod legs pa gcig dang / a she legs/ pa gcig zub phyi legs pa gnyis/ rang nyid kyi lag bris yig tshad bcas yig tshang du 'bul dgos shing / yig tshang nas yig rtsis sbyangs 'bras dang lo na son tshad la gzhigs te rim bzhin rtse drung gi go ming gnas spar bya rgyu'i skor tā la'i bla mar zhabs dmigs 'os khongs su btang nas phyag 106

rtags thon mtshams yig tshang du bka' bsgyur gan 'jog zhu bar yong dgos pa'i brda tho btang 'byor skabs gan rgya'i 'bru keon du gtso bo gzhung sa'i bkrin snying la bcangs te 'gan babs las don mtha' dag btang 'gro bzhag sdod 'pher ba'i lhag bsam zhu sgo rnam dag dgos skor bka' bsgyur dang 'brel shag tshang dge rgan dang / do bdag khag theg 'gan len bcas pas gan 'jog rtags 'dzugs byed dgos/zhabs dmigs rtse drung gi yong khungs gzhan zhig ni/ sa rten gzhis khag ming 'dzin yod pa'i rtse drung dper na/ bar zhi rje drung / gung thang /tshang khyim dngos gzhi/ bkras gling / gtam snyan/ snang dkar/ bsam mkhar nang 'khor/ dga' brang / pha lha/ rong rnam sras/ rong dpal lhun sogs yod pa de dag gi gras la sger pa zhes 'bod srol yod/ de min rtse drung gi shag tshang khungs ldan ming 'khur gyi thog nas spun mched dam dge phrug shag shul rjes 'jug gi dmigs sgo bcas kyi skor rtso/nga mtshungs zhabs zhu'i snyan dar dang / yig tshang sogs phul te mi babs spyan zhu'i 'os khongs su tshud thabs byed rgyus mtshon rtse drung ngo ma'i phyag rtags ma thon bar thabs shes sna tshogs kyis zhu 'tshang byed dgos kyi yod/ mdor na/ yig tshang las khungs nas rtse skor thog ma'i zhabs sdod 'os khongs su gtong rgyus mtshon rtse drung gi go ming thob tshun 'gro khungs phyi nang las tshan mtho dma' legs nyes che phra mtha' dag gi bsko 'then yongs rdzogs gros bsdur thog 'char 'bul byed pa'i 'gan dbang yod/smon tshogs gnyis kyi skabs yig tshang gi dmigs bsal 'gan dbang thad/ sngar lam gzhung nas mang thug nar sa/tong bya rgyu'i dngul skyed ma rtsa phran yod kyi rmang gzhi'i thog ser skya 'byor ldan khag nas smon tshogs sa/nyis su 10 7

rim 'dzuka/ sa thebs sbyar ma skyed da cho / skapas bstun lag 'don/ dod 'bul khab/ bcas snyan 'byor mang 'gyed ri ma gtong gi go rim tshes cha dang /nyin re'i tshogs dus so sor go rim gyi 'char 'bukhapre mang gzhung/ 'gyed gtong rtsa tshig se 'bras dga' gsum ba caṭashrī kyi khongs nas smon tshogs ring dgon par mtshams sdod dang / nad pa/ shag srung bcas 'a/ dmigs bsal skal ba blangs 'thus dang // de bzhin nye 'khor dgon khag 'ga' shas kyang tshogs zhugs su med rung / se 'bras dga' gsum spyi mtshungs ltar skal ba blangs chog pa sogs kyi yig khag rnams sngon tshud nas 'char 'bul go sgrig byed dgos pa dang / gzhan yang se 'bras dga' gsum gyi bla sprul grwa dmangs dang bcas pa smon tshogs gnyis su phebs rgyu'i skor phebs tshes bka' rgya zhes 'bras spungs su bla spyi dang / se rar gzim khang sde pa/ dga' ldan khri thog khang bcas khungs so sor sbug dam bka'arū re gtong srol/'bras spungs tshogs chen dge skos las sne rnamyo/sa rtse 'gag tu 'byor tshes su bcar ba dang chabs cig yig tshang du'ang 'byor tshes su yong dgos pas de skabs drung che tshos smon tshogs ring lha sa khusnyel ser skya yongs la khrims gnon 'thus tshang dgos pa dang / tshogres dus so so'i las 'gan rnams legs grub dgos rgyu'i bka' bsgyur gtong dgos pa lhag par smon tshogs gnyis kyi skabs su 'gro dgos pa'i mi sna ni bla phyag tu dngul rtsis pa zhes nyin re'i tshogs dus gsum so so'i thog mang gzhung phyag rtagasacadagongs don gzhir bzung 'gyed dngul rtsis bsher dang / bsher khag so sor spom sprod 'gyed dngul gyi khug tho dang 'brel skabs so sor 'gyed gtong rtse drung dang / bla phyag zha li so sor khungs sprod kyis bsdad song rtsis gzhung 'god mkhan sku tshab tu yig tshang las bya ba/cigadang / 'gyed sprod sa gnas so sor rtse drung bdun 108

bcas gtong dgos/ smon lam skabs zla 1po'i tshes rdonyi na re cha ra can dgung tshigs su gzhung nas spyan bsal sku 'gyed ces mang thug gzab rgyas dang / 'gyed dngul ṭam dkar re sprod lam yo da pa de'i 'gan 'khur yongs rdzob/sa yig tshang rang nas byed srol yod/ dngul 'bab thad rtse rnam sras gan mdzod dam mdzod sbug nas zhu len dang 'brel bsher khag bdun so sor 'gyedathob cha bgos thog bsher khag so so'i spyi khyab tu drung che ngo ma so so bskyod dgos pa dang / 'gyed sprod du'ang las bya'i kha snon du rtse drung ming gsal sngon tshud brda tho btang ste byed sgo rnams khyab bsgrags kyis bsdad song rtsis phra de nyin rang 'god dgos/zla 1po'i tshes 15nub mo bco lnga mchod par gtso bo gzhung gi mchod pa dang / de 'og bka' blon nas las tshan yan rim par gzhigs pa'i kher rkyang ngam/ gnyis gsum gcig 'thus kyi mchod pa re dang / se 'bras dga' gsum gyi grwa tshang khag dang / rgyud stod smad/ rnam grwa/ gnas chung sde dpon che khag sogs kyis mchod sgrig byed srol yod pas der tā la'i bla ma chibs bsgyur yod na sgrig gshoms byed po su yin mchod pa'i go rim gzhung khra de drung che ngo mas snyan sgron zhu rgyu dang / mchod pa'i spus tshad legs zhan thugs zhi ba grub bstun ang grangs dang gnyis ji 'god bka' gsal thon 'phral tho 'god byed rgyu'i 'gan dbang yongs rdzogs yig tshang du yod stabs drung che thun mong gi 'gan 'khur byed dgos khar de'i nang nas twa bla mas gtso bo'i 'gan 'khur byed/ de min yig tshang zhor gtogs las 'gan ni/ grwa bzhi dngul par khang dang / bde zhib/ zhib khang / zhabs 'phar khang / mdzod sbugadamag spyi khang / 'du 'god las khungs/ legs bcos las khungs 109

bcas su drung che so sos rtsa ba'i yis tshang gi las brel dang bstun gong gali kwari/ 9shwes khungs khag la'ang bskyod 'a/ma 'dug lo ltar rtse rnam sras gan mdzod sgo 'byed bkar 'jug skabs gcoo 'gan bka' shag dang / spyi khyab mkhan po/drung yig che mo bzhi/ rtsis dpon bzhi/ rtse'i sku tshab ces rtse mgron gcig bcas yod pa dang / rtse rnam gan dngul skyed khang dang / smon 'gyed thebs sbyar gnyis kyi lo 'khor ma skyed bsdu gtong dus skabs so sor drung che re res mos kyis bskyod dgos pa dang / gzhang yang / po ta la'i nang twa la'i bla ma rim byon gyi gser sdong khag gi dkon gnyer rtse drung gsar rnying rtsis sprod skabs dang / 'bras spungs spyi sor grwa tshang bzhi'i grwa grangs yongs la 'bru phogs rgyag skabs kyang drung che ngo ma re bskyod dgos/ tshogs 'du rgyas bsdus nam 'tshogs skabs tshogs 'du'i snying don dang ma jug/ bsdoms bcas kyi skor drung rtsis rnams kyis las 'gan 'khur dgos shing / drung ches tshogs 'du'i bsam gros lam rob gtan 'khel ba'i tshig tho'i zin bris sam ṭa'i thog bkod rjes ba7/'a shag la snyan seng dang legs cha go bsdur gyis bka' ji phebs tshogs 'dur sgrogs sbyang bya rgyu bcas kyi las 'gan yod pa red/ lo ltar zla 1po'i tshes 1nyin gyi zhogs pa drung che bzhi tshang 'dzoms kyis gzim chung lha mo khang du lo ltar gser gzhong zhes pa'i nang twa la'i bla ma'i sku 'phya dang rtse skor yongs kyi mtshan tho bstan srid/ yul gru yongs la nad yams mu ge sogs legs nyes blang dor skor gzan brtag zhu srol yod pa de'i legs nyes gzhir bzung dgon sde dang ri khrod khag la zhabs rim sgrub sgo'i skor yig tshang nas gtan krābebs bya dgos/ gong gsal rtse skor gyi mtshan tho gcig spyi khyab mkhan por 'bul dgos pa dang / mtshan tho gcig yig tshang rang du nyar dgos pa de'i nang mchan gsal du dang po lo dang /110

rngi nga / grwa sa zhabs sdod zhus nas li ji tsam phyin/ la/sa garlo/sa 'pho 'gyung da lta ga 'dra yin bcas pa las bya gcis gis 'bri 'a be/nga byeng dgos pa yi be sniche ba tshugaṭaṭa thung 'bri rgyu de dag yig tshang khongs e pa yon padag zer bas drung gtogs gnyis yod pas su rung gcig gis 'bri dgos kyi 'dug tā la'i bla ma rtse po ta la dang / gtsug lag khang / gdan sa se 'bras dga' gsum bcas par gan sa gzigs su phebs skabs rten gtso khag la sgron 'bul zhu rgyu'i thugs smon snyan shal zhes rtse shod las khungs nas kha btags blangs te drung che rnams kyis tā la'i bla mar thugs smon zhus te rten gtsor sgron 'bul zhu dgos/po ta la'i nang du twa la'i bla ma sku phreng rim pa'i sku mched nam shar skabs rtse mchod pa khang du sku tshab tu yig tshang las bya res mos kyis 'gro srol dang / se 'bras dga' gsum du tā la'i bla ma sku thog rim pa'i sku mched du rtse drung re gtong srol yod pa dang / phyi'i lha khang khag ste/ zhol bka' 'gyur par khang dang / lha sa rje 'bum sgang / bstan rgyas gling sogs kyi dkon gnyer gsar rnying rtsis sprod skabs dang / 'bras spu ngas su gling se rgyan bskyur/ 'bras ram rgyan bskyur/ 'bras tshogs chen dge skos ('al ngo) gsar pa'i ko ja zhes tshogs chen tshogs gzhung du bca' yig snyan sgron sogs la yig tshang sku tshab las bya res 'kho/ ra gyis 'gro dgos pa ma zad/tshogs mchod skabs mchod rdzas ngo las zur bkod thog gser sbreng tho gzhung stod smad klog mkhan las bya gnyis res mos kyis 'gro dgos/ gzhan yang phyogs mtha'i rdzong gzhis khag dang / sger chos khag gcig gis sngar lam deb gsal dngul 'bab phran bu re bsdu 'bul dgos pa'i ming gsal khag gsum yod pa ste/ dgon khag bla bogs dang / zhabs sdod ngo dod ༵lton

bla gzhung mchod kyi bsam dkar ma rtsa'i skyed 'bab bcas kyi dngul 'bab bsdu len bya sgo 'i thad yig tshang rba/nyer nga/droge las bya'i khongs nas rgyun ldan latrari/ bcar rtag skyod byed mkhan zhig la 'bab bsdu'i las ka byed du 'jug gi yod/lo re'i skyed bsdu'i dngul 'bab de rnams yig tshang gnyer par rtsis rgyag dgos/drung che'i phogs thob thad sngar srol gtan 'jags phogs yig lag 'dzin yod nges la dngos grangs nges gsal zhu 'pher med mod/ lag 'bab che ba rang e yod snyam/ bar 'a/ma ra stag gnyis kyi srid skyong dus skabs su drung che rnams lha sar gtan sdo da las don zhu sgor brten ngo g.yog bzhon rta'i zas song che khar/ yig tshang spro chen gtong res skabs rgyas spros che la nyo thang je 'phar bcas kyi dka' ngal gnas tshul snyan zhu phyag rtags dgongs 'brel zhes rdzong gzhis sam tsha sho sogs legs gras shig yod nges la rang gis go thos su rta dbang bla gnyer dang / 'brong pa lho byang spyi khyab/yan steng tshwa sho/ phan po lhun grub rdzong 'dam bla ma bcas drung che'i thab rten du lo dus tshad bkag med par bdag 'dzin chog pa byung zhing / bod shing rta( 1kha54) lor rdzong gzhis khag gi mi 'gro ser skya mos snyoms dang 'brel 'bab yong tshang ma gzhung 'dzin bum pa gsib blug bya rgyu'i gtan 'bebs zin pa nas bzung drung che'i thab rten rnams kyang phyir slog gzhung 'bul mi bya mthu med chags pa de nas bzung dus thung lo shas ring spyi 'gro'i las yod go thob la gzhigs pa'i phogs thob 'bru dngul sprod len byed kyi yod pa bcas so/ /112

mgar na bla mjig luzhu cun dmag khams khul 'apyor skabs mnyam 'brel dang go mi na tang skabs pod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon sogs byas skor/skal bzang bkra shis kyis/ma gar ra bla ma bsod nams rab brtan ni ri bo che rdzong khongs lung gsar khu/la gyi ches grags pa che ba'i mgar ra tshang du 'khrungs shing / rab byung bco lnga pa'i me byi(1ṭwāṃ76)lor mgar ra bsod nams rab brtan de nyid tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gnyis pa 'phrin las rgya mtsho'i yang srid yin par ngotra/ 'dzin gyis bka' shag nas/ khong la maṇḍal rten gsum dang chos gos sogs phu'/ yod/ 'on kyang de rjes rgyal ba'i yang srid du dngos gtan 'khel med rung / khong gi mdzad spyod mtshon tshul thog nas gang ltar sprul pa'i sku zhig yin par ngos 'dzin dang bcarngasi ri bo che dgo na rnying ma grwa tshang gi bla ma myo/dzad/ rje drung 'phri na las byams pa 'byung gnas slob dpon du bsten ceng / chos lugs kyi thad dang lhag par gso rigs sman bcos kyi thad la khyad du 'phags pa'i thulha/sa yon mchis gshis ser skya mang tshogs kun gyis dad gus yid rten bya yul du gyur/ri bo che rje drung byams pa 'byung gnas nas bdag mo bzhes rjes mgar 113

ra bla ma dang thugs gros mdzad don rje drung rin po ches ri bo che dgon pa'i chos don gtso skyong dang / mgar ra bla mas dgon lag bla brang gi srid 'gan bzhes rgyu gnang ba red/mgar ra bla mas lu'u cun dang mnyam 'brel byas pa/sa sprel(1kha0ṭwāṃ)lor kra'o er hphung gi dmag dpung chab mdo brgyud lha sar skyod skabs chab dgon byams pa gling dang / dpa' shod dgon pa/brag greji5 ba ma dgon/ bu dgon bcas kyis khong tsho ra sne len bsu ba legs po ma byas rkyen kra'o er hphung dmag gis gong gsal dgon pa bzhi po tshang ma mer sreg btang / gnas tshul de dag ri bo che dgon pas thos 'phral dgon pa'i drung yig la ra lug chig stong dang dngul dkar bcas bskur te chab mdor kra'o dmag la bsu ba sne len zhu bar btang skabs kra'o er hphung gis byed stangs der gzengs bstod byas pa ma zad ri bo che dgon pa'i sprul sku rje drung ni mes rgyal la dga' zhen byed mkhan gyi sprul sku bzang po zhig red ces bsngags brjod kyang phul bas ri bo che dgon par srung skyob thub pa byung ba red/sa bya(1kha09)lor phing ri hreng(phing ta ran zhes kyang zer sdol mchis)gis sne khrid byas pa'i lu'u cun dmag ri bo che rdzong du 'byor skabs sprul sku rje drung dang / zhabs drung blo bzang tshul khrims gnyis kyis phing dmag la sne len bya rgyu'i gsang gros byas pa ma zad/ dka' tshegs kyi gnas tshul gang 'dra zhig 'phrad kyang blo brtan 'gyur med kyi sgo nas krung dbyang srid gzhung gi phyogs su langs rgyu'i dam bca' yang bzhag pa red/ 'on kyang zhabs drung sprul sku gzim khang du phebs rjes khyim mi dang rnam kun yid ches bya yul sku 'khor 11‘1

rnams dang nang gros byas snying mna' skyel dam bca' bzhag pa la rgyab 'gal bya rgyu byas thog 'bas drung blo bzang tshul khrims lam seng lha sar gsang bskyod kyis‘‘ri bo che rje drung gis rgya mir rgyab rten bcol te gzhung la ngo rgol byed kyi gda'’’zhes bka' shag la zhus pa dang bka' shag srid gzhung gis khong la gnas skabs 'tsho rten 'phan po khul nas gzhis lag cig sprad pa ma zad/rgya bod dbar gyi 'khrug rtsod thag gcod byung rjes bya dga' sprod rgyu'i khas len yang byas yod pa red/ gong lo'i nang rje drung dang mgar ra bla mas phing dam/ga la 'bru rigs dang / snum sha sogs rgyab skyor mkho 'don bya rgyu'i mna' tshig bzhag skad 'dugachu glang(1912)lor bod sa gnas srid gzhung nas bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar mdo smad(chab mdo sa khul)gyi don rkyen thag gcod byed par mngags gtong byas shing bka' bla byams bstan dpon dmag lho rong rdzong du 'byor rjes ri bo che rje drung la 'phrin yig btang 'byor nang rgya bod kyi 'khrug rtsod thag gcod byed ched mgar ra bla ma ngo ma gros mol byed par yong dgos zhes 'khod yod pa red/ phing ri hreng gis mgar ra bla ma bka' bla byams pa bstan dar sar yong dgos zer ba de ni lkog g.yo'i jus gzhi zhig red snyams te mos mthun byas med/ 'on kyang mgar ra bla mas nyen khar ma 'dzems par shing stag(1914)lor g.yog gro rdo dge legs khrid de lho rdzong du bskyod cing / de gar khong la thog mar dga' bsu'i gsol ston bshams rjes bkag nyar byas pa ma zad/ mda' dpon mdo mkhar ba ched btang gis mgar ra bla ma'i gzhis ka'i rgyu nor rnams bsdu len byas pa dang / zhor du 14ma 'khel mang tshogs kyi rgyu nor yang 'phrog pa red/ gnas tshul de 'dra byung rkyem mgar ra bla ma'i sems la zhabs drung bla brang gi mis lkog tu ngan 115

jus bzos rkyen rang nyid kyi srog la'ang nyen kha yod skabs da cha bros thabs byas na legs gnas snyams te khong gis g.yog gro rdo dge legs la nye 'gram zhig tu rta gnyis la sga chas gtad nas gra sgrib/ byo sa zhes bka' bsgos thog de'i nub mo khong gis ja gar po zhig btungs rjes rang gi chab gcin la ra'i gcin pa mnyam bsres byas pa sogs kyi gra sgrig cha tshang zin rjes mgar ra bla ma bsnyun tshul g.yog gro rdo dge legatra/ nas bka' bla byams pa bstan dar la snyan seng zhus par bka' bla byams pa bstan dar nas khong sger gyi sman pa mgar ra bla ma'i bsnyun gzhir blta bar btang zhing / sman pas mgar ra bla ma'i chab gcin sogs la dpyad rjes tshabs che'i dbang rtsa'i tshor ba nyams pa'i nad du ngos 'dzin gyis bka' bla byams pa bstan dar spyol de—ltar snyan seng zhus par brten khong snyung shag byas te bkag nyar la dogs zon cher mi byed pa'i 'og mgar ra bla mas go skabs de dang bstun nas gra sgrig byas zin pa'i bzhon rta la bcibs te bros byol gyis rgyal mo rngul chu brga‘ra nas ri bo che'i sa mtshams kyi pad gdags grong du yib bsdad pa red/ khong rjes 'ded mkhan gyi dmag mi slebs kyang / mi ser rnams bod dmag gi bya spyod ngan par mi dga' gshis/ mi ser tshos bod dmag la rgya dmag gi myul zhib pho lha'i ri bor slebs 'dug ces dang ri bo che nas btang ba'i rgya dmag 'di ra slebs grabs 'dug ces pa sogs mgo skor rdzun tshig bshad skabs bod dmag de dag dngangs te phyir bros byas pa dang / mgar ra bla mas bod dmag phyir bros song ba'i gnas tshul rtogs rjes sa cha de ga'i mi rnams kyis srung skyel 'og shing yos(1kha15)lor ri bo che ru phyir log thub pa byung ba red/ bka' bla byams pa bstan dar gyis mgar ra bla ma lho rdzong du bkag nyar byed ring phing ri hreng gis ri che rje drung nas skog g.yo ngan jus kyis bka' shag la bshad pa 116

red snyams te rje drung la gnon shugs sprad pa ma zad/ gal srid mgar ra bla ma phyir log ma thub na ri che dgon pa mer sreg gtong rgyu yin zhes nyen brda btang ba ma zad/ gra sgrig kyang byas zin pa red/ mgar ra bla ma ri bo cher phyir log rjes phing ri hreng gis khong la brtsi bkur chen po byas shing / khong chab mdo'i byang phyogs kyi bkod 'doms par bskos pa ma zad/ 'byung 'gyur chab mdo'i spyi khyab tu bsko gzhag bya rgyur krung dbyang la snyan zhu 'bul rgyu'i khas len yang byas pa dang / nang don de skor gyi yig cha zhig bzos thog phing gis thel tse brgyab ste mgar ra bla ma la sprad yod pa red/ mgar ra bla ma ri bo cher phyir log rjes rang nyid kyi stobs shugs la shugs snon bya ched bod gzhung la ngo rgol byed mkhan steng chen dkar stod tshang gi stobs shugs skong 'then dang phing ri hreng gi ching dmag dang mnyam 'brel gyis steng chen du bca' sdod byed mkhan byings pa mda' dpon gyi dmag dpung dang 'thab ste byings pa mda' dpon bsad pa dang / de min dpon dmag 'ga' bsad rmas btang ba red/bka' shag srid gzhung nas ga dang mda' dpon bkras mthong 'jigs med rgya mtsho dmag chig stong dang / mda' dpon thang dpon rnam rgyal dbang 'dud da mag lnga brgya bcas lcags zam brtan srung byed par btang /steng chen rme ru dgon(dkyil mkhar dgon)du bca' sdod byed mkhan phu lung mda' dpon gyi dmag dpung dang ri che zhabs drung bla brang gi mi sna phan tshun 'brel ba byung rjes ri bo che'i stod(dbu rtse)bzung ba dang / mgar ra bla mas ching dmag dang malham 'brel byas thog bla brang gi ser skya mi grangs brgya lhag tsam bskongs te mda' dpon phu lung dang 'thab par phu lung mda' zhabs kyi dpon dmag 'ga' zhig bsad rmas song bas de min rnams rtse 117

bzang zam pa bar phyir babyo/la byas/ mgar ra bla mas so so'i dmag stobs kyi skabs dang bstun nas phar rgol dpung 'jug byas te mda' dpon phu lung pa bsad/ phu lung mda' zhabs 'go dmag gis mda' dpon gyi ro zam 'og nas yar 'then te phyir bshol byas pa red/ mda' dpon mtsho sgo bas brag sayab skyid thang du bca' srung byed mkhan ching dmag la dpung 'jug byas te ching dmag chig stong tsam bod dmag la mgo btags zhus/ mkhan chung zla bas sho rja lho(lho rdzong / tho pa mdo/ dpal 'bar bcas)gsum nas bsdus pa'i dmag sum brgya khrid de nus shugs yod rgus ri bo cher dpung 'jug byas nas phing ri hrong gi ching dmag gtor pham btang / mgar ra bla mas rang gi yid ches 'os pa'i mi nyi shu tsam dang lhan du dkar stod rgya tshang gi mi bcu bcas khrid de mgyogs lam brgyud chab mdor bros/ de min mgar bla'i phyogs gtogs kyi mi rnams nyen 'jigs kyi gnas su gyar/ bka' bla byams pa bstan dar ri bo che'i don rkyen thag gcod byed par ched bskyod kyis‘‘rje drung dang mgar ra bla mas rgya mir rgyab rten bcol nas gzhung la ngo rgol byas pa’’zhes pa'i nyes 'gel byas te rje drung sprul sku sogs dgon pa'i khrir bzhugs mi chog nga dang / gtam bshad kyi khe dbang yang med pa bzo rgyu/slad sprul sku ngos 'dzin mi chog pa/ rje drung lho rdzong du log dgos rgyu sogs khyab bsgrags kyang byas/ de rjes stag lung dgon pa'i rtse sprul ngag dbang dpal ldan gyis rje drung stag lung dgon du bzhugs rgyu'i chog mchan gnang rogs zhes bka' shag la re zhus don son gyis stag lung dgon du bzhugs rjes chu phag(192 2)lor de gar sku gshegs/me sbrul( 1kha17)lor mgar ra bla ma sku 'khor mi bzhi bcu tsam chab mdo dgon du 'byor skabs chab mdor yod pa'i ching dmag rnams bod 118

dmag gis pham nyes btang ste phing ri hreng 'dzin bzung byas zin pas mgar ra bla ma so gas kyis shing gru ba zes nas rdza chu brgal te dar mdo ngos su bros rtsis byed bzhin yod pa nye 'dabs bod dmag gis tshor te phan tshum dmag 'thab byas mthar mgar bla'i phyogs la rgyab skyor byed mkhan med rkyen mgar bla ngo 'khor tshang ma 'dzi5 bzung byas shing / bud med dang phru gu phud de byings mi rer 'byor lcag brgya tham pa re bzhus thog de na sa khrims gcod byas pa ste ra/gar ra bla ma'i gcung rga na pa'i pus mo'i lha nga bkog gcung po gnyis pa bsam yas dang tsha bo tshe ring lha rgyas/ mgon po bcas gsum gyi sna breg ste sho pa mdo rdzong du btson nyar byed du bcug dkar stod rgya tshang phyogs kyi a rgya dpal ldan sogs mi nyer brgyad yod pa sna breg ste dpal 'bar rdzong la btson nyar byed du bcug zla gcig tsam song rjes mgar ra bla ma lha sar brja ngas/ btson ra'i 'tsho ba lo 'ga' dpyad rjes rgyal ba sku phreng bcu gsum ji/'i dgung keg tu nyes can glod 'gro' gtong ba'i dus dang 'khel zhing / mgar ra bla ma'i ske la sgo bkog thog nyes yig sbyar te zhol gyi lam zur du bslang / de nas nyin bdun rjes bya yul du spyugs/ de nas dus ring tsam song rjes do dam byed mkhan gzhis sdod sogs dang kho tsho'i bar mchod yon sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba chags stabs mgar ra bla mas kho rang la dogs zo na cher mi byed pa'i go skabs dang bstun te dar rtse mdor bros pa red/de rjes mgar bla pe cin du 'byor te chos lugs kyi byed sgo spel ba dang gso rigs kyi 'gro don sogs mdzad/ de rjes pe cin du bca' sdod byed pa'i le'u shang gi 'thus mi li kung tu'u dang mgar ra bla ma'i bar mchod yon sbyin bdag gi 'brel ba chags/ li kung tu'u mgar bla'i mdzad spyod dang rgyal gces kyi sems par shin tu mos par gyur te le'u shang la ngo sprod kyis mgar 119

bla khrung ching du phebs par le'u shang phyogs kyis dga' bsu chen po byas pa red/mgar ra bla mas bod sog u lhan gyi u yon sogs byas skor/rab byung bcu drug pa'i me yos(1927)lor li'u shang gis mgar ra bla ma nan cin rgyal dmangs srid gzhung la ngo sprod byas te mab/ra ra bla ma nan cin du bskyod par rgyal dmangs srid gzhung dang cang ce hris dga' bsu dang do snang chen po byas te khong bod sog u yon lhan khang gi u yon du bskos pa ma zad/ nor bla ho thog thu zhes pa'i mtshan gsol ba de nas bzung mgar ra bla mar nor bla sprul sku zhes mtshan chags skabs der cang ce hris nor bla ho thog thu pe cin du bca' sdod byed pa'i don gcod khang 'dzugs rgyu'i chog mchan yang sprad pa red/ tshode rjes(192 2)lo tsam du nan cin du mgar ra bla ma dang spom mda' stobs rgyas gnyis ma gros 'du 'ardzams byung nas bod bka' shag srid gzhung la gang 'dra byas nas ya lan slog thabs kyi gnad don skor nga/na tshun gros mol byas pa ma zad/ mnyam du go min tang krung dbyang srid gzhung la/ re ba zhus te mes rgyal gcig gyur srung skyob byed ched btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs bod nas phyir 'bud gtong rgyu dang rgyu dngos dang dmag don gyi thog nas shugs che'i rgyab skyor gnang rogs zhes zhus thog bod du dpung 'jug bya rgyu'i 'char gzhi zhig kyang phul yod pa der go min tang cang ce hri'i phyogs nas ha cang gis mthong chen byas pa red/ spyi lo 1kha25lor ngo/ min tang gis nor bla mgar ra bla mar dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri ba'i 'gan dbang sprad 120

thog shis khams la dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri kung hru'u btsugs pa dang /drung yig dang / dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri/ spyi gnyer/ sa gnas drag chas bcas yan lag gi tshogs chung bzhi btsugs te spom mda' stobs rgyas kyis dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri'i tsu'u krang dang / sa khul drag chas kyi tsu'u krang zhor lcogs kyang byas nas chab srid dril bsgrags dang / sa gnas khag gi stobs shugs 'brel ba byed pa dang ram 'degs dam tshags byas pa brgyud sa gnas drag chas stobs shugs dang spyi tshogs rmang gzhi gzhi rgya che ru btang ba red/cho/ra bla sogs dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri ba nan cin nas khams phyogs su rdog thon byed skabs khreng tur go min tang dmag don u yon lhan khang khrung ching du bca' sdod gsang nyul spyi khyab༈ru khag gis gsang nyul ru 'bring zhig mngags/ pa dang slob ston pa cang 6ṭan shis thad kar bkod 'doms byas 'og yan lag ru khag zhig nor bla dang mnyam du khams su bskyod/ yan lag ru khag gnyis dar rtse mdor bsdad nas sa gnas drag chas gso skyong byas pa red/le'u shang dang nor bla gnyis de sngon nas mchod yon 'brel ba yod thog chab srid 'thab rtsod kyi dgos mkhor brten kho gnyis dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri ba'i kung hru'u dang myul ma ru chen khag so sor gtong len sgrig sbyor byas pa dang ching wa'i ching ru dpon rgan pa de sngon le'u shang gi lu'e krang red/ nor blas dar rtse mdor dril bsgrags 'tshams 'dri tshogs chen bskong tshogs byas pa dang shis khams lho byang yul dpon gyi 'go pa khag dang dbo/na pa khag gi gtso skyong pa bcas dang gsang tshogs kyang 'tshogs pa red/ cang ce hris jus skul byed thabs 'og gi mdung rtse gtad phyogs li'u wun hu'e yi cun 24paྈ ni dmag don 'thab rtsod spe‘ra ba red/ cang ce hris li'u wun hu'e la 121

dgra 'dzin ngan jus de ltar byed don ni( 1kha20)lor li'u wun hu'e yis cang ce hrir‘‘srid dbang sger gcod pa’’zhes pa'i tar btang ste ngo rgol byas pa sogs kyi 'khon 'gras yod gshis cang ce hris li'u la sdang sems yod pa'i rkyen gyis red/ 'on kyang nor blas don 'di ni gri g.yar nas mi bsad pa ltar yin pa shes rtogs byung yang / krung dbyang gsang nyul ru khag gi gnon shugs 'og bsam yul las 'das pa'i bya ba de ma sgrub rang sgrub byung nas khams kyi byang dang / rta'u/ brag 'go/ dkar mdzes bcas kyi phyogs na snga rting du cun 2 4yi thon gcig lhag tsam gyi drag chas bsdu rub byas pa red/de rjes li'u wun hu'e yis nor lha'i don rkyen de cang ce hris bzos pa zhig las khong rang nyid kyis bzos pa'i don rkyen zhig min pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa red/ 1kha26lor nor bla dkar mdzes su sku gshegs pas srid 'dzin kung hru'u yang rang shugs kyis mi dgos pa bzos pa red/

trīyab gzhis stag 'cher ba'i lo rgyus dang rang nyid kyis yab gzhis de'i zhabs zhu'i brgyud rim cung zad gleng ba/dkon mchog lha skyabs kyis/ya ba gzhis nor gling du bzhugs ring dang 'khrungs lha dbyar gso' skor/ptags 'brug ( 1kha40 )lo'i zla 1tshes 14gza' skar 'byung 'phrod mchog tu dge ba'i nyin tā la 'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog pho brang chen po po ta la'i tshoms chen srid 'i'i phun tshogs kyi mi 'jig gdong lngas btegs pa'i gser khrir mnga' gsol mdzad sgo grub rjes rgyal yab chos skyong tshe ring dang / rgyal yum bsod nams mtshos dbus sras sros rnams nor gling las shag tu bzhugs shing / skabs der yab gzhis kyi 'tsho 'dzin sa gnas srid gzhung gi drung yig chen mo ba lcog steng thub bstan nor bzang dang / rtsis dpon 'bri yul ba rnam gnyis bsko gzhag dang / yageyum sku 'khor la trethugs myo/kho che phra rtse phyag dang / bla phyag zhol gnyer/ rtswa gnyer/ rshang gnyer/ rtsam len/ nor gling mdzod sbug bcas las ktasangs khag nas nar gtong nga nga 'brel gtong sgo'i do dam rtse shod phyag ma tsho dang / zhol gnyer 123

bcas kyi ngo tshab dang / skad sgyur dang gam sdod zhabs gras nor gling chibs zhabs khongs 'dzugs gnang thog yab gzhis sku tshad 'khrungs yul du yod rigs la 'tshams rtags dang / tshong pa gtong gnang gi tshong rtsa dgos rigs kyang gong gsal las khungs khag nas 'bul gyi 'dug chide rjes rgyal yab la gung gi mtshan gnas 'bul bzhes dang / yab gzhis la 'khyongs gzhis 'khyongs snon bcas 'bul rgyur thugs gtan rim 'khel khongs 'khyongs snon gzhung gzhis 'brong rtse bstsal bar brten nga rang 'brong rtse'i 'don khongs mi ser yin stabs chu rta ( 1kha42)lor yab gzhis nang bskongs 'gugs gnang zhing skabs der phyag mdzod dang / mgron gnyer/zhabs zhal sogs 'khyongs gzhis 'khyongs snon khongs nas 'gugs bcar 'dug pa ma zad/ de min skad sgyur dang ma chen sogs zhabs khongs su a mdo ba yang 'dug de skabs phyag mdzod 'brong rtse lha dga' tshe brtan phun tshogs dang / mgron gnyer ka la rin chen grags pa/ nga rang bcas nas rgyal yab gung mchog gi gang gsung de sgrub kyi zhabs 'degs zhus rgyu las dmigs bsal las 'gan che rigs mi 'dugargyal yab gung mchog kyang nyin re drung jar rtag bcar dang / tā la'i bla ma'i chibs bsgyur sogs mdzad sgo khag la phebs dgos pa las sa gnas srid gzhung gi chab srid 'dzin skyong sogre/sa kyi thugs 'gan med cing /'khyongs gzhis 'khyongs snon gtan 'khel zin pas srid gzhung las khungs khag nas thugs mkho nar gtong gnang lam de dag med pa bzos kyang gzhis khag nas thugs mkho btang 'byor gyis zhabs zhal tshang mar lto chas nar gtong yin la gzhis khag tshang ma gzhung 'dzin song tsang thugs mkho 'byor rib/sa brdzangs sho nang gsal rtsis len byed pa las 'des/sa shor gang yang 124

byed lam mi 'dug nor gling nye 'khor rgya mtsho smad gzhis kyi nang bzan dang / rta pa/ drel pa bcas par yang lto phogs nar gtong gis rgya mtshor sku tsha yi/ mdo can can zer ba zhig dang / de 'og gnyer pa gcig nas do dam byed kyi 'dugasras mo tshe ring sgrol ma stangs dpyal dang / sras rgya lo don grub/sras blo bzang bsam gtan sku 'khor lha sa zas zhim shag tu bzhugs thog sras bgres gzhon gnyis tar khang slob grwar phebs kyi 'dug lcog steng yab gzhis 'tsho 'dzin dgongs zhus kyis tshab bla phyag tar khang thub bstan bsam 'phel bsko gzhag gnang 'dug kyang 'tsho 'dzin gnyis yab gzhis la rtag phebs dang 'brel phyag las gnang lam de tsam mi 'dugagezhis khag rnams gzhung 'dzin gyis bya yul gzhis sdod sku tsha a mdo blo dar dang / phyag mdzod sgro gzhis/ drung yig chibs zhabs ngag dbang rgyal mtshan shyor ra gzhis sdod phyag mdzod chibs 'bas bkra shis dpal ldan/drung yig bya yul tshe ring / 'brong rtse gzhis sdod phyag mdzod chibs zhabs skal dgra dang / phyag mdzod 'brong rtse shing spe/ bde gling / sne'u gzhis sdod gam zhabs byams pa bstan dar/ zas zhim gzhis sdod sku tsha a marda phun tshosas/ drung yig zas zhim rnam rgyal bcas bsko gzhag sngon bstsal rnams nas sa/zhis khag so so'i las 'gan 'khur zhing / lo re'i gzhis 'bab tsis zhu'i thad lo ltar 'khrungs lha dbyar gsol thugs mkho 'bul ba dang sbrags gzhis sdod so so ngo bcar zhu skabs dngul rkyang yod rigs rgyal yab mchog la thad kar 'bul ba dang sbrags gzhis ka'i bsdad song skor snyan seng zhu tsam byed pa las rtsis khra zhib cha de tsam 'bul lam mi 'dugalo ltar 'khrungs lha dbyar gsol la srung bskang pa rnam rgyal grwa tshang chog 125

grwa dang / yab ga'is sku 'khor rnams la nyin sanyis ring rtse phyag las khungs kyi ngo las phebs nas lha mi'i mchod bsten nga/nga sku 'khor rnams la gsol sto/na gnang ba bcas kyi mdzad sgo dang / de mur ya ba gzhis sku sger nas nyin gsum ring srung bskang gi chog grwa'i mchod bsnyen dang / nyin dang gnyis gnyis la srid zur dang bka' shag sku bcar spyi mkhan/ rtse shod las tshan yan 'khrungs lha'i mdzad sgor gdan zhus gsol ston gzab rgyas sogs mdor na/ rtse shod las khungs khag gi sgo ra nang bzan yan tshang mar ston mo gang gzab dang nyin gsum par lha lcam khag dang thugs snang dge yul/ chong rigs/ rgya gar dang / bal po'i sku tshab bcas mgron 'bod thog nye 'khor gzhis khag gi rta thab lag g.yogye dang 'go byed gzhis rgan sogs la'ang sto/na mo gtong ba dang / 'ul mi'i za rtsam sprod dgos pa sogs yab gzhis kyi lo 9rekhor las 'gan che shos shig yin zhing der yab tshang thabs gsar gzhis gsar lta bus mdzad sgo'i gdan chas sogs bla brang che khag dang /mi drag sger khag sogs gang sa nas g.yar len gra sgrig zhu dgos 'dug cing / bod zla 5 tshes 5snga dro ya/ba yu ma sras sros sku 'khor rnams nor gling du tā la'i bla ma mchog bi mjal kha zhu gnang dang 'brel 'khrungs lhar phebs dgos kyi 'dug bod 'i bas bcings 'grol btang rjes bka' shag ‘stan rgyas gnad zhu mdzad nyin krung dbyang sku tshab zhi drag dpon rigs rnams kyang lo ltar gsol ston la gdan zhu mdzad lam chags song /'khrongs gzhis 'khrongs snon byung rjes kyi brgyud rim dang rgyal yab dgongs rdzogs zhu sgo/chu lug( 194 2)lor nyin zhig 'tsho 'dzin dang / bka' shag yig 126

sgyur ngo phebs brgyud bod ljongs tshogs 'du rgyas 'dzoms kyi tham sbyar tshig tho zhig/ rgyal ya ba gung mchog la phul ba dang / lha zhol gnyis su bka' shag dam sbyar gyi rtsa tshig sbyar 'grems/ rgya khyab rdzong gzhis khag la'ang bka' rgya 'grems ṣṭṛ/la byas pa'i nang‘ yab gzhis ming 'khur gyis mi ser thog brdab gsig myo/ neor sacod byung na skabs sbyar bka' shag dang / sa gnas rdzong gzhis/ khag la snyan seng zhu dgos’’shes 'khod 'dug de dag gi yong rkyen(1)rgyal yab nas 'khrungs yul du sku tsha khag la 'tshams rtags dang / tshong pa zi ling du satong gnang skabs rta khal byang rigs lam 'khel mi ser thog 'khyongs gzhis ma gnang gong dang 'dra mtshungs sger gyi lam yig btang nas skul gtong gnang ba( 2)gzhis khag phan tshun nas thugs mkho skyel 'dren dang / bya yul nas lha sa'i zas zhim khang pa gsar rgyag gi shing cha dang /sne'u khul gro thag chu 'khor gyi shing cha skyel 'dren gyi khal ma dgos rigs sger gyi lam yig btang bas 'gro lam 'khel yul gyi mi ser la brdab gaṣpedro/ga 'khel ba(2)'brong rtser rta drel tshong pa btang nas gzhis rtse khul tshong bsgyur byed skabs dang / rgyal yab rang nas lha sa khul rta drel tshong sgyur gnang skabs lugs mthun rang ma byung pha(4)sger chos gzhan gyi mi rtsa kha shas mgo btags/ zhu len gnang ba(5)yab gzhis la phogs yig lag 'dzin nang gsal rtse shod phyag mdzod dang / zhol gnyer/ rtsa gnyer sogs las khungs nas phug dkar(nde mo phug nas thon pa'i 'bru dkar)dang / bzhes sha/ gzan dod sngar lam dbus gtsang rdzong gzhis khag bcu tsam gyi yong bsdus steng nas bka' shag 'dzin tham dang / lam yig 'brel ba'i ga sbrags gnang bas thog mar bsdu lenatsho'agro mi nas dngos mdogs dang / rin sgyur skor la brdab gsig 'khel ba/ gzhis sdod khag nas skabs der yab gzhis kyi 127

thugs mkho dmigs bsal thon khungs khag la 'phar ma'i brdab gsig 'khel ba(6)nag tshang khul dang / gtsang khul rdzong gzhis kha shas la bal tshong rgyab 'thus skor bdams ra sogs kyi tshong pas yab gzhis la nang bogs phul bar rgyal yab kyis lag 'khyer stsal ba'i gnas tshul byung ba bcas kyis rkyen pas gzhung sa mchog nas bkag sdom mi gnang ka med byung ba der rgyal yab nas nor skyon yo bsrangs mdzad rgyu'i dgongs gzhi med par ‘‘rtsa tshig dang /bka' rgya 'grems spel gnang ba de ha cang thabs rdugs red’’ces thugs yid ma rangs pa'i rnam pa byung song yang de nas bzung yab gzhis kha 'khyer gyi bya spyod rtsa ba'i cha nas med par gyur pa red/ 'khyongs gzhis 'khyongs snon ma stsal gong yab gzhis la bzo rigs gang dgos lto chas nar gtong gzhung srol gla cha sprad de yong lam yang / rjes su krab gzhis ngo khang gzhung gnas nas do dam gsar rgyag mjug sgril rtsis sprod gnang nye'i mtshams bzo rigs tshos dus thog tu ma bcar bar brten yab gzhis nas 'tsho 'dzin brgyud rgyal ba'i gzim chung dang / ngo ma bzhugs yul bcas pa'i nang gi 'dzin chas gzhung gnas nas gsar bzo yong ba zhes bka' shag brgyud snyan seng zhus pa'i phyir phebs su‘‘rgyal ba'i gzim chung dang / tshoms chen gyi sku rten/ bzhugs khri bskor bcas/ mchod rdzas bcas gzhung gnas nas gsol ras bstsal rgyu dang / de min 'dzin chas yab gzhis/ rang nas gsar bzo gnang dgos’’zhes gsungs te spang leb gang 'tshams shig gnang / yang bka' shag gis rdo shing 'go 'doms dang gtan 'jags ar po'i do dam pa/ bzo rigs khag gzhan dag gi do dam pa bcas la 'tsho 'dzin brgyud las grwa'i bzo rigs gang dgos sger gla spyi mtshungs kyi gla lto sprad de bskul gtong dgos lugyus ba ka' bsgyur bstsal ba de nas bzung bzo rigs skul 'thus byung ste 'dzin tre 128

chas gsar bzo grub 'phral yab gzhis gsar pa'i ngo khang ma lag rtsis sprod kyis yab yum sras sros spo shugs skabs rgyal ba'i na bza' gdan zhu dang 'brel rten 'brel zhal gro'i mdzad sgo 'tsho 'dzin dang / gzhung zhabs thugs snang dge yul khag nas rogs ram zhus te thugs gra legs 'grigs byung song ba ma zad/ bka' shag gis mtshon rten 'brel mjal dar 'bul mi khag la'ang gsol ston gzab rgyas gnang song / skabs der skyabs mgon rtse shod la thugs rje legs 'bul dang sbrags brtan bzhugs 'degs 'bul dang drung jar ngo phebs gzhung zhabs che phra tshang mar sku skal 'bul gnang bcas kyi mdzad sgo gang legs byung song / nang gi 'dzin chas gsar bzo mjug skyong dgos rigs dang / lcang shar gling kha'i gyangs rtsigs nyams gso gsar bskongaṭage/ gzhis khag nas 'bab rigs thugs mkho gang 'byor la 'degs shor 'jal gsum gyis slad yab gzhis spyi mtshungs sgrigs lam chags thub rgyur ngo 'khor tshang mar re 'dun yod par borten lha sa'i gnyer phyag mdzod dang gzim chung / mgon khang / tshoms chen bcas kyi dkon gnyer dang / zhabs zhal/ rta pa/ drel pa/ sgo ra ba/ khang gnyer bcas kyi lto phogs yab gzhis glang mdun dang / lha klu sogs kyi lam srol gang yod dpyad gzhi bzhes song yang lam seng gtan 'khel ma thub pas slad zhabs zhal sogs kyi phogs thob gtan 'khel ma zin par yab yum/ gnyis kyis gsol ras bstsal te gnyer phyag mdzod dang mgron drung so sor lo re 'bru khal bzhi bcu tham pa re nas sgo ra bar 'bru khal bco brgyad yan las 'gan la gzhigs pa'i sprod srol dang / ja phogs mar phogs zla drug re'i mtshams mar khal gsum re dang / ja ril rdog drug re bcas sprod lam byung ba red/129

sdeyab gzhis rgyal sgo nang ma'i ga'i/sa g.yon la ma ṇi dang gdugs dkar 'khor chen gsar bzhengs srog shing 'bul skabs skyon cha phran bu byung bar rgyal yab sku rlung bzhengs nas phyag mdzod 'brong rtse lha dga' tshe brtan phun tshogs la phyag 'bebs dang / mgron gnyer ka la rin chen grags pa nged gnyis la bka' bkyon chen rpā ga—nad bar brten stag 'tsher sprul sku ngo chen brgyud de dgongs pa dwangs thabase rnyemi.oṃ yang gsan dgongs med khar skabs der 'khrungs gsol thugs mkho 'bul bar mgron gnyer ka la ba'i khal drel skam bu lung du rtsa gsor ba'ag pa rnams kyang ya ba gzhis su bskongs ded gnang bar brten nga tsha gsum gyi bsam blor de sngon bya yul sgro gzhis phyag mdzod 'das grongs rjes rgyu dngos 'dzin dbang yab gzhis nas bzhes te bu tshab bu mo de dag kyang rang khyim du phyir log byed dgos byung ba sogs kyi yong rkyen gang la rgezhigs kyang slad sku dbang btsan ba/yogs ji yong ma nges pas 'u thug thabs zad kyis shod 'gag tu srid skyong stag brag sar zhu 'bod bcar dgos ba sogs bkra ma shis pa'i gnas tshul phran tsam byung yang skabs dedze'i skug bcar spyi khyab mkhan ngo ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nas rgyal yab ne dgongs pa dwangs thabs dang / nga tsho gsum gyi bde sdug yar zhu masno gnanee — ne mthar nga tsho gsum zhabs zhur rtag sdod ma dgos/ pa sogs kyi bsgyur bcos gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gtsang thob byung / de rjes sne'u gzhis byams bstan dang / dze nang khral mi ser dbar ma 'grigs pa'i gnas tshul byung nas byams baṃstan gyi tshab tu nga rang sne'u bzhis sdodasnal gtong gnang gis 'khrungs srol gyi mtshon mdzad sgo khag gi zhabs zhur bcar ba las rgyun gtan sne'u ga'is kyi las 'gan 'khur te bsdad/ yab ga'is sku 'khor nor gling nas lcang shar du spo shugs ma gnang gong sras rgya lo don grub kyi gnyen sgrig 'khrungs sa'i 130

mdzad sgo rgya mtsho smad gzhis su gnang song bar skabs der rtse'i sku tshab dang 'brel ba'e rtse phyag las khungs nas gnang cha dang mjal dar gnang srol 'dug la thugs dge khag nas kyang rten 'brel mjal dar phul bar bka' shag lhan rgyas dang sku bcar spyi mkhan drung rigs skya ser sogs la gso ston gzab rgyas 'bul gnang mdzad song / stag 'tsher sprul sku 'bras sbo mang grwa tshang du chos zhugs kyis gzhung chen bka' pod lngar gsan bsam slob gnyer mdzad 'bras rim thon skabs kyi gtong sgo nor gling mdzod sbugre nas/ gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes 'go mchan yod pa ltar sgo mang grwa tshang gi phar phyi na 'dzin grwa'i tshogs mang dang / tshogs chen grwa tshang bcas la tshogs lang gtong sgo gtong gnang dang chabs cig mtshan gnas rjes 'brel phar phyin gling kha'i 'dzin grwa'i mkhan po yang gnang dgos byung bar brten sngar lam phar phyin 'dzin grwa'i tshogs mang dang / 'bras spungs bla spyi/ sgo mang grwa tshang gi dbu chos las sne bcas la nyin gsum tsam gtong sgo gzab 'bul thog phar phyin mkhan 4ོra thugs dge khag nas rten 'brel mjal dar 'bul srol yod pa bzhin phar phyin mkhan po stag 'tsher sprul sku mchog la rten 'brel zhu bar yab yum sras bcas dang gzhung zhabs ser skya khag sogs nas mjal cidar 'bu' phebs la gsol ston rgya che 'bul gshoms gnang song /rgyal tshab srid zur rwa sgreng rin po che dang / rgyal yab gung rnam gnyis chibs pa chibs drel la mnyes po song tsang nor gling du bzhugs skabs sam/ lcang shar yab gzhis su spo shugs grub rjes zi ling tshong pa ston dus rwa sgreng brgyud yong dus rta drel spus gzigs dang sbrags rwa sgreng du rgyal yab thengs kha mo shas phebs me dang rgyal zur rwa sgreng lha sar phebs skabs shig la yab gzhis gsar par rab gnas mdzad rgyur gdan zhu dang 'brel nyin gnyis gsum 131

ring lhod bzhugs ba/nang song /sras rgya lo don grub da nga / blo bzang bas ma gtan lags slo lo grwar phebs skabs rtse slob grwa'i smin grol gling gi dge rga na sar rig gnas slob sbyong gnang bar rtser phebs pa dang skabs re dge rgan lcang shar yab gzhis su phebs kyi yod/ de mjug sras rgya lo don grub lags dang / sras mo'i sku bag phun tshogs bkra—shis lags mes rgyal nang sar slob grwar phebs rjes sras mo tshe ring sgrol ma lags kyang 'khrungs yul du gnyen 'phrad la phebs zhar mes rgyal du rgya lo don grub lags dang sku bag gnyis mjal 'phrad gnang ste khong tsho lhan rgyas sgron pa'i par ris kyang 'byor song /me khyi(1946)lo'i dgun thog rgyal yab gung snyun mnar la rnam kun bsten gnang mdzad pa'i rgya rigs em rje shan san zer ba zhig yod pa des sman bcos byas pa dang gzhan yang kyon sel zhabs rim rgya che bsgrubs kyang phan nus ma thon par de'i phyi lo me phag zla 1tshes 1nub mo sku gshegs shing skabs der snyun g.yog zhabs zhu dang sbrags stag 'tsher sprul sku yang yab gzhis su bzhugarngashrī mus thog tshes 2nyin rtse'i lo gsar mdzad sgo grub rjes mkhan drung tā bla ma lcog steng thub bstan nor bzang nas yig tshang las bya dang sbrags 'das rjes zhu sgor phebs te rtse shod dang bla spru la khag la 'bul rgyu'i bsngo rten gra sgrig dang sku tshigs zhe dgu bar gyi bdun tshig so/ so'i 'das rjes zhu sgo'i re'u mig 'god gnang mdzad song / skabs der rtse mkhan mgron che ba byams pa chos bzang phebs nas rgya la yum/ la rgyal ba mchog nas thugs gsos 'tshams 'dri dang phyag mdzod khang du phyag mgron gnyis dang / nga rang bcas la bka' bsgyur phebs dgongs su‘6da phan yab gzhis phyi nang 'gan 'khur rgyal yab nas gnang ba ma zad a mdo ba sogs ba/nga byung nas the jus 132

byed kyi yong tshod 'dug pas da cha rgyal nga/ba mchog sku tshe ma zin pas da phyi na yab gzhisakyi phyi nang byed sgo gang ci khyod tshos/ 'gan 'khur dgos pa 'di skor rgyal yum cha/chog la'ang snyan sgron zin pas de lugs 'thus shor med pa dgos rgyu'i bka' phebs 'dug’’ces bka' nan/ che phebs pa dang bcas sku rjes zhu sgo rnams kyang phyag mgron gnyis nas gtso bo byas pa'i gzhis byes tshang ma/sa dbus gca/tsho nga dgon sde che chung khag la bsnyen bkur mang ljorigyed rgya greng che zhus pa ma zad/ sras rgya lo lags dang / sras mo tshe ring sgrol ma stangs da pyal nas kyang 'khrungs yul rje sku 'bum khul gyis mtshon dgon sde khag la mchod 'bul rgya gang che gnang 'dug lo de'i nang sas mo tshe ring sgrol ma lags nas rgyal yum gyi a ma lags 'khrungs yul nas gdan zhus kyi lha sar phebs 'byor byung song /'tsho 'dzin gsar bsko dang / nga rang nas phyag mjod 'gan 'khur byas pa'i brgyud rim/sa/ byi ( 1kha4ṭwāṃ) lor nga rang lha sa'i phyag mdzod 'gan 'khur dang /ngag dbang rgyal mtshan la drung yig rnam rgyal la gnyer pa bcas gsar bsko gamyo nga don skabs der 'tsho 'dzin bla phyag tar khang rngapre dang / rtsis dpon ḍaribri yul rnam gnyis las gnas gzhan 'phos kyi yab gzhis 'tsho 'dzin gyi mtshan 'khur med stabs las don che chung rgyal yum mchog la dgongs bskor bka' slob zhu ba dang sbrags las 'gan gang ci 'khur len zhu dgos byung bar brten de sngon rgyal yab 'das mjug zhu sgo dang / yum sras bgres gzhon snun mnar zhabs rim/ sras sros bgres pa rgya gar brgyud 133

mes rgyal la phebs skabs phyag gron sogs kye rkyen pas gzhung sger khag la dngul rkyang phyag bun che tsam chags pa/ sras blo bzang bsam gtan la sku bcar mkhan che'i go gnas stsal bas che 'don zhu sgo zin yang sku na ma son pas gzhung gi phyag las med thog yab gzhis phyi nang zhu sgo la'ang thugs 'gan ma bzhes pa bcas gang spyi'i gamad zo sna/ thag gcod ma thub pa sogs 'thus shor yong gzhir dpon g.yog tshang mas gros bsdur gyis bka' shag la 'tsho 'dzin bsko gzhag yong ba'i mgron brgyud snyan seng zhu dgos byung bar brten skabs der 'tsho 'dzin du sku bcar mkhan che bkras gling mkhyen rab dbang phyug dang / tha'i ji shan kha ba 'gyur med rdo rje rnam gnyis bsko gzhag gnang zhing / 'tsho 'dzin rnam gnyis yab gzhis su lhan phebs thog phyin chad yab gzhis kyi phyi nang byed sgo'i skor sogs gang ci'i gnas lugs zhib rtsad gnang zhing / skabs der gzhung sger chags bun sprod mjal byed stangs dang /gzhis khag rnams nas 'bab bzo bya rgyu sogs gang ci'i thad rgyal yum mchog la dgongs bskor dang / nga tsho phyag drung zhabs zhu rgan gras dang bcas gros bsdur byas pa'i mdo don 'tsho 'dzin rnam gnyis nas yab gzhis phyi nang 'dzin skyong spel gsum thugs 'gan gtsang bzhes yong ba dang / nga tshos 'tsho 'dzin rnam gnyis kyi bkaljori dgongs ltar zhabs zhu 'bad 'bungs zhu rgyu'i khas len zhus don 'tsho 'dzin gnyis nas bka' shag sogs la snyan seng thog gtso bo phyi'i dngul bun sprod 'jal byed thabs nor gling mdzod sbug dang /grwa bzhi glog 'phrul dngul khang bcas nas gzhung dngul skyed yang g.yar zhus —kyis sger chos skyed lci'i bun dngul sprod 'jal thog gzhung bun 'bul phyogs thad bya yul ka la rin chen grags pa lha sa'i phyag mdzod las sbrel du bsko bzhag thog skabs de'i nag tshang shan rtsa 'go pa yang gcig shod skor rtswa gnyer 134

cha pa sras skal bzang dbang 'dus dang mnyam sbrel gyis tshong sar bskyod nas nag tshang khul gnyis mos bal tshong lo gnyis rgyag skabs bal gong che 'phar lam 'gro rgyugs pa lta bus bskyed lci'i phyi bun 'jal sprod thub khar gzhung dngul 'jal dmigs kyang byung yod pa ni/ 'tsho 'dzin rnams gnyis kyi thugs 'asan che bzhes 'og 'brel yod 'gan 'khur mi sna tshang mas 'phyar ba gru 'degs/ zhus pa'i 'bras bu zhig yin/ de dang dus mtshungs gzhis khag 'bab bzo'i tshod lta stod lung zas zhim gzhis su 'tsho 'dzin ngo tshab bsko/ 'dzugs dang / yab gzhis kyi rgyun gtan phyi nang gtong yong las byed 'tsho 'dzin bkwas gling zhabs sdod thub bstan dang bshad zur zhabs sdod phun tshe gnyis nyin ltar ngo phebs dang / phyag mdzod khang du 'bab bzo byed phyogs skor gzhis khag gi sngon phul rtsis khrar rtog zhib gnang mi rtsis pa chab tshoms phebs par rgyus bab zhu mi drung yig ngag dbang rgyal mtshan dang / gnyer pa rnam rgyal gnyis yod cing / skabs der sku'i gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan lags su sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan tshab bsko gzhag stsal stabs nga rang mkhan po'e phyag mdzod khang gi las khur zhu dgos byung bas yab gzhis su rgyun gtan rtag bcar zhu khom med/'byongs gzhis 'khyongs snon gzhis khag bya yul/ mnyal 'byor ra/'brong rtse/ stod lung sne'u gzhis dang / zas zhim/ nor gling gsham rgya mtsho smang bcas kyi 'dzin dbang bdag thob sa tho 'byed khra sogs gtsang chod ma byung ba ma zad gzhis khag la 'bab bzo gtan 'bebs ma thub pas 'bab rigs che phra kha gsal zhu ma thub kyang bya yul gzhis sdod dang / sbyor ra gzhis sdod so sor yab gzhis su ma byung sngon rtse shod skya ser gnyis re 'gro khungs yin pa dang / sne'u gzhis rtse skor mi 'gro gcig 'brong rtse gzhis 135

pha ptas kha 'dzim/ byed pa'i ga'is sdo/da ngo tshab rngusnye/ gnyis/ zas zhim gzhis sger pa 'bring gras kyi rnga4 grezhis bcas yin 'dug par brte na gzhis khag rnams kyi gzhung 'bru bkar 'jug sogs rtsa chu ga gis yab gzhis la gnang bas 'bab rigre/sa gang cir yong 'bab che tsam yod/sras rgya lo don grub lags dang / sku bag phun tshogs bkra shis gnyis krung hwa mi dmangs spyi mthun rgyal khab dbu brnyes khar nang sa nas rgya gar du byi ra phebs kyis rgya lo lags lha sar ma phebs kyang phun tshogs bkra shis lags lha sar phebs 'byor byung ba'i rjes sa gnas srid gzhung nas sras rnam pa'i go ming bstsal te mes rgyal nang sar bod sa gan/sa srid gzhung gi don gcod sku tshab tshogs pa'i las byar phebs dgos byung song zhing / de mjug tā la'i bla ma mes rgyal du gzigs bskor la phebs skabs sku srung mda' dpon gyi go ming yang stsal song /sku bcar mkhan tshab sku'e gcen po blo bzang bsam gtan lags su tā la'i bla ma gro mo nas phyir phebs ska/bas sku bcar dza sag gi go ming dang / de rjes rtse mkhan drung las 'phar/ sku bcar spyi mkhan las tshab bcas bsko gzhag gnang ba'i che 'don gsar mjal rem par gnang thog las 'gan khag 'khur bzhes thog tā la'i bla ma mchog mes rgyal du phebs skabs chibs zhabs su'ang phebs dgos byung zhing / sngar lam tā la'i bla ma mchog yab gzhis su gdan zhus rab gnas mdzad sgo de yang mes rgyal du phebs khar zhabs 'khod nyin shas lhod bzhugs kyis gnang song /chu 'brug ( 1kha52 )lor rgyal yum dang lhan du sras rgya lo don grub lags lha sar phebs (sprubyor byung zhing / rgya lo don grub lags zla shas bzhugs ring 'khyongs gzhis 'khyongs snon gzhis khag khongs thog mar sne'u 136

shā—deng / zas zhim gnyis dang / de rjes bya yul da nga spyo/ra ra gzhis khag la ngo phebs rtog zhib kyis mi ser rnams nas yab gzhis la 'bru bun 'apul dgos rnams rtsa chag btang ste khong nyid mtsho sna brgyud rgya gar du gsang bskyo da gnang bar brten 'tsho 'dzin gnyis dang / rgyal yum bcas nas krung dbyang sku tshab krang cin u'u la skabs 'phral snyan seng gnang dgos byung song /stag 'tsher sprul sku lcags stag(1kha50)lor mtsho sngon zhing chen gyi sku 'bum nas lha sar bod zhi bas bcings 'grol 'byung thabs kyi don gcod du sku 'bum/ bla ma ༅/ra skal ldan rgya mtsho dang lhan du lha sar phebs 'byor byung zhing / de skabs khong nyid kyi las 'gan legs grub ma byung ba lta bus tā la'i bla ca4 mchog gro mor phebs skabs rgyal yum dang lhan du gro mor phebs rjes rgya gar brgyud a rir phebs bskyod gnang pa red/nga rang ni yab gzhis stag 'tsher ba'i las 'gan lhag bsam rnam dag gi 'khur mkhan zhig yin par brten tā la'i bla ma mchog gro mor phebs skabs rgyal yum gyi zhabs zhur mnyam bcar zhu dgos byung ba dang / de rjes gro mo nas phyir 'byor rjes nad mnar lci bas phyag mdzod las 'khur dgongs zhu mi byed thu med skabs yab gzhis sku ngo lhan rgyas dang / 'tsho 'dzin rnam gnyis nas rnam kun gzhis byes zhabs 'degs zhu sgo gang ci lhag bsam zol me da zhus par dgongs bzhes kyis 'khrungs lha dbyar gsol sogs yab gzhis kyi mdzad sgo gal che'i skabs su ma gtogs phyag mdzod las 'khur gyis mtshon pas rnam kun zhu myo/ gang sar rtag bcar ma dgos pa'i dgongs khrol thog nam 'cho'i ring lo ltar 'bru ru'i khal brgya re stsal rgyu'i snyan zhur chu sbrul(1rdzo52)lor 'go mchan stsal thon byung ba bcas so/137

lcang gseb shar du yab gzhis stag 'tsher ma khang 'dzags skrun dang zhol par 'jug 1/nges 1/pe/༷ gas nyamasamag san rgyag byas kar/ṣāze rastsenghrurno—be— ra spomed dalja ga/sa ljil rapy-i ༷tt+waṃṭwāṃ ḍi ༵bye rshapy-iṭwāṃ ༵ ༵ga phoḍis sra rdzung ngadhise dīb rno~X bye ༵༵ gzhis stag 'tsher ma khang gsar tsāka wa da/ma par bsko rshazhag song bas ar po sra brtan phags 'pher 'phral du4 rgyag dbos bka' bsnyar phebs byang zhing /nga phod ngerno gnyis gros bsdur si gling co/nga sa rdo gang ༵nga med paṭā son la ar po'i rgya cha gsog dgos padzā las ༵ tshe drung gnyis dang / shosdo drung gnyis/ ༄rdo shing che mo lag thes dag byo/sa re bcas bsko gzhag yong ba'i snyan seng zhu rgya byas pa ltar rtse yig tshangasgo las/ /dzeengs la lang shar ar po'i las bya rtse drung gadhos bsko gzhag yong ba zhus par rtse drung darsha 'dun rgya mtsho dang / rtse drung blo bzang mkhas grub gnyis bsko gtong gnang / do dam pa so so'i sger gyi gnyer pa re dgos pa nga phod kyis a ngar skal bzang dang / nga rang gis ba chang dga' ldan phan tshogs nang bskos byas/ rdo bshags gnam pa ba mi rnyi hūṃ skor bskongs dīgugs kyis dog sde'i nong rdo chen bshags las byed du 38

bcug rgya gar nas shing rta 'khor lo bcu nyo 'dren gyis 'khor 'dren kong po khu' nas mdzo nyi shu tham pa nyos te sa dang / bye ma/ dral rdo legs pa sogs zo/rme sgusnyel byed yul med rigs gsog 'dren byed du bcug snga 'phros ar 'u(3 lnge sa khul nas mi bco lnga skor gla nyar byas khongs kha dang grwa bzhi dmag dbang 'dus mdzo 'then 'khor lo'i bdag gnyer bskos/rdo shing spyi par shing bzo che mo dang / rdo bzo che mo lag shes dras gras 'os chotho 'bul dgos bkod khyab kyis 'os 'char bka' shag la phul bas shing bzo che mo 'chi med stobs rgyal dang / rdo bzo che mo rta nag nor bu tshe ring bsko gzhag gnang song / rdo shing che mo gnyis nas ar po'i rgyu cha rdo chen dang / ka gdung lcam shing / bad g.yam/ ar ka sogs spom tshad grangs 'bor bshad pa ltar de lo dang / chu rta(1kha42)lor lo gnyis ring gsoge 'jog byas/ yab gzhis stag 'tsher ma khang gal cher brten spyi khyab mkhamyo pos shing cha nor gling skal bzang pho brang sku rgyab kyi sbyar pa gang yod gnang byung bas gcod bregs byed mi lha klu skor nas mi bcu tsam bskongs 'gugs kyis gcod bregs skabs 'bras bu can gyi shing snar chag skyon mi chog pa'i bka' nan che bas la sa bya rtse drung dge 'dun rgya mtsho can zhol las khungs su om thag(rtsid skud kyi thag pa sbom po)g.yar po zhu btang la thag pa g.yar yang / skyel mi gtong srol med ze ma btang bas las bya rtse drung dase 'dun rgya mtsho dang / blo bzang mkhas grub gnyis kyis sgal par 'khur te nor bu gling khar 'byor byung ba nga phod nas las bya shod drung bka' shag la zhu rgyu ma byung yang / shod drung nas thag pa sgal 'khur sogs de tsam hur brtson mi byed pas rtse drung shod drung khyad med la las kar rtag 'byor gtam 'dod mi byed pa'i rtse drung gnyis sla ra yang zhu grogs gsungs don rtse yig tshang 'a/sa 139

khukhudrob / su snyan seng zhus/ par rtse durnga— ṭul ma tshan 'jigasaṭa med dang / blo pazang 'byor ldan ba/nyis bskoru/ btang gnang byung / ka gdu nga lcam shing sbyar rag stod smad dang / lcang gseb shar nas sbyar pa gcod bregs byas/yab gzhis stag 'tsher ma khang rgya khyon dang / bzo dbyibs sogs rgyal yab gung gi dgongs pa dang mthun pa dgos nges stabs rgyal yab gung tsha rong dang /spo mda' rnying pa/ glang mdun/ bon shod bcas par gdan zhus kyis bka' slob zhus par/ rgya khyon glang mdun las che tsam dang / khang par rtsig zur mang po med pa/ gsum thog steng mtho dma' med pa rgyag dgos bka' phebs byung / shing bzo che mo 'chi med stobs rgyal gyis sa bkra bkod rjes 'chi med stobs rgyal 'das tshab rdo shing spyi pas 'os tho phul ba bka' shag tu 'char phul shing bzo lha sa dko na mchog la bzo rtsal gyis slar yang sa bkra bkod pa rgyal yab gung la spyan bstar zhus kyang / rgyal ya ba gung la bod kyi 'dzugs skrun byed stangs thugs rgyus med pas zi ling dang bod kyi khang chen rgyag stangs dang mi mthun pa mang po 'jam rtsub sna tshogs gsungs par nga phod nged gnyis kyis sha zhen tshig rtsub 'ga' shas zhu thal la dgongs pa 'gal te bka' bkyon tsha phebs sogs kyis re zhig sa bkra nges gtan 'khel ba byung ma song / ar po'i rgyu cha rdo chen zhol las khungs nas zhol 'og rdzong gzhis bco brgyad khal 'khyags khal yod gzhung khra nang gsal cha gses snga phyi kha shas btang ba skyel 'dren byas pa rdo chen 'bum bzhi dang brgyad khri lhag tsam dang /bka' shag gi lag 'dzin nang gsal lho kha khul nas phogs 'bru ru'i khal chig khri skor/ dgos dngul grwa bzhi las khungs nas bod dngul rdo tshad chig khri lnga stong skor/ nye skor gzhis khag lho mos dang / glang ru/ 'bras bu gling /grwa bzhi gzhis bcas mi ser nas bad g.yam dang / sa dmar/ ar ka 140

sogs sprudon 'dren/ rdo bcal g.yam pa ma༄/ ra rab shan kha bas bsha ba/sa las kyi ko thog skyel 'dren/ phra ma'i she'/ ko/ 'bi larari sa/ shag (rekhor steng rshad kyi khro khra/ sgo dang phra ma'i a shing / kab car/ lcags kyu/bkrag rtsi sogs rgya gar nas nyos 'dren byas te ar po'i rgyu cha gang 'tshams bsags thub mtshams shing bzo dbu chen dbu chung dkyus bcas mi lnga bcu nga lnga tsamyo/ dang / rdo bzo dbu chen dbu chung dkyus bcas mi bzhi bcu skor/pa rnamyo// 'dus byung / dbang ldan sogs gtsang khul rdzong gzhis res 'khor gyis lo re ar 'ul mi nyis brgya skor bka' shag nas bka' rgya btang ste bskongs 'gugs byas/ chu lug (1942)lo ma khang 'og thog glang mdun las che tsam dang /bzo dbyibs tsha rong sogs kyi legs cha bsdus te rdo brtsigs grong khyer nang dper 'os phun khang la bltas te 'og thog brgyab zin pa byas/ yab gzhis stag 'tsher nas bon shod ar ston tho lam nas spar cha mdzad de 'dzugs ston gzab rgyas nyin gcig gtong gnang rgyal yab gung dang / sras rgya lotshodon grub sogs phebs te ar po'i do dam ngo las dang / gnyer pa/ rdo shing lha bris chen mo ba sogs la gsol ras gos chen dang / gru'u tsi/ ja sbag rdo shing lha bris sogs byings dang / ar 'ul tshang mar ja chang thug pa gzab rgyas thog dngul rkyang gsol ras gnang ste rgyal yab gung rnam 'gyur ha cang bzang pos sku ra bzi ba gnang song / khang chen gal che'i rigs dgun thog zla nga phyed gsum tsam ring rgyag srol med pas rdo shing / ar 'ul phyir slog gis rgyu cha kha snon slar yang gsog 'jog dang / ka gdung lcam shing lho kha khul gzhung gling yod rigs nas gcod bregs dang / sger khag khongs nas ka gdung lcam shing la gzhung sger gnyis gun med pa'i rin 'bab gnang rgyur 141

shing cha dang / shing rin bkod de lcang shar ar po'e las grar skyel radren dgos pa'i bka' shag nas bka' rgya gnang bas skyel 'byor byung / spang leb dang / tshon sna tshogs/ dral ma/ spos dkar/ snum sogs bka' shag nas bka' 'dzin grangs 'bor mang po 'khod pa zhus te rtse shod phyag mdzod dang lha zhol gnyer tshang sogs la zhu mi gtong skabs dus thog mi gnang ba dang / 'os 'tshams sprad de bka' shag bka' 'dzin gsham du sprod 'os sprad ces mchan bkod kha yod lag med la brten ar po 'phral 'phral lag len ma thub par nar lus song tshe rgyal yab gung nas bka' bkyon che phebs yong rgyur brten dgos dngul thog nas nyo sgrub dang / las khungs khag nas zhus pa rtsa ba gzhung gron gcig gyur la ar po'i dgos mkho khrom nyos zhus na ar po mgyogs khyad dang / rgyal yab gung gi dgongs mthun yong nges bka' shag la snyan seng zhib phra zhus pas dgos mkho rtsag rtsig khrom nyos byas mthus bka' 'khrol bas ar po'i las khungs gzhan dag dang mi 'dra ba'i dmigs bsal khyad chos shig tu gyur song /shing sprel ( 1kha44)lo bar thog dang / shing bya( 1945)lo steng thog tā la'i bla ma bcu bzhi pa'i gzim chung dang / nyi 'od(nyi 'od zer ba mdzad sgo tshugs sa'i tshoms chen)sogs 'dzugs skrun tshon rtsi gtong ran la bzo khang do dam par bkod khyab kyi lha bris dbu drung bsod nams rin chen dang / tshon gnyer drung gtogs/ lha bris dbu chen/ dbu drung dkyus bcas mi grangs bzhi bcu skor bskongs 'gugs kyis tshon rtsi btang / (yab gzhis ma khang nub rta g.yab gzugs ka ba brgyad cu'i sa dang / rta bres nang ar bcag khron pa drus pa/ rta chu gter sa'i rdo gzhongs sogs spus dag gsar rgyag bcas byas/ dgun thog las rma tshams sngar rgyun bzhag ste rgyu cha 142

rdzogs pa'i rigs gsog 'jog byas/gla phogs sprod stangs/las bya rtse drung dang / gnyer pa gnyis/ rdo shing / lha bris che mo dbu chen dbu chung dkyus byings gnam pa che mo lha klu bskor shing bshag bcas so songari zla re 'bru phogs ru'i khal gnyis re dang / chang nas ru'i khal sa/cig re/ phogs dngul gzhung srol ltar che mo bar nyin re dngul srang do tsam dang /de 'og la dngul zho bzhi lnga re las the'u gzhir bzung dgos dngul thog nas sprod pa/ bka' shag phogs yig lag 'dzin nang gsal ja mar rgyar chung phog sdor lug mgo/ tshwa bul sogs gsal ba rtse shod las khungs sogs nas gang sprad sde tshan so sos zhus te bgo bsha' rgyag gi yod pa red/ ar 'ul rdzong gzhis khag gi 'ul mi rer zla re phogs 'bru ru'i khal gnyis re rgyag sprod dang / lha sa khul nas glas rigs mi rer zla phogs 'bru ru'i khal gnyis re dang / nyin gla skabs de'i yul srol dngul srang lnga tsam sprod len byed kyi yod pa red/ lcang gseb shar ar rgyag ring yab gzhis nye ltos zi ling pa kha shas ar po rgyag sar yong ste khungs lung med pa'i jus bkod byas par nyan mkhan ma byung stabs rgyal yab gung la snyan phra zhus pa'i sang nyin rgyal yab gung lcang gseb shar du phebs te las bya dang gnyer pa/ rdo shing che mo bcas la bka' bkyon phyag 'bebs dang 'brel ba'i sku rlung gnang skabs las gnyer tsho lcang ma'i gseb bros yibs thengs kha shas byas 'dug pa dang / rgyal yum phebs skabs las bya dang / gnyer pa/ rdo shing ar 'ul sogs la dngul rkyang gsol ras gnang ste 'di 'dra dang de 'dra byed rogs gsungs pa khas 143

blakṣiṃngs lag len bsta ra ba red / (nga phod nge ‘ na spo /nyis lhokru yarngapre gung sar sarari po'i ba zo dbyibs dang / rgya khyon sogs skor ba car bar ska bas re don med bka' bkyon tsha na5/ phebs par lan 'debs ma zhus khar ja dang zhal stob btang ba yang ma 'thung ma zas pa ra don med bka' bkyon 'di 'dra nyan te sdod long med ces phyir log byas par rgyal yab gung bzhugs gdan nas bzhengs te rgya skad kyis bka' bkyon gnang ba dang de'i dgong dro sang nyin yong dgos lan 'byor bcar bar zhi 'jam 'dzum dmul gyi gso' tshig gtong ba dang / tshig 'jam gsung bar gus lan zhus te ar po rgyag phyogs gang zhus gsan 'dra'i rnam 'gyur bton gnang sogs 'khrug cha de dang de 'dra thengs mang byung song / tā la'i bla ma'i gzim chung nyi 'od la bzhugs khri dang / cha sgam/ mchod gshoms/ bzhugs sgrom spus dag gsar bzhengs zhus pa dang / yab gzhis kyi gzim chung khag drug tsam nang cha sgam cha bcu gnyis tsam gsar bzos tshon rtsi rgya bris bzo bkod gnyis ldan gsar bzo byas/ rgyal yab gung thug/sa gtum drag che zhing sku dbang che la zhu sa byed sa med pa'i sku rlung ldang po yin tsang las khungs khag dang / sku drag ser skya sogs mi su 'dra yin rung / rgyal yab gung gi bka' la brtsi bkur dang len mi zhu mkhan med pas lcang gseb shar yab gzhis ma khang le lag dang bcas pa sra brtan phugs 'pher da lta dngos su mthong rgyu yod pa 'di bzhin 'dzugs skrun mgyogs po'i sgo nas las 'gan sgrub thub pa rgyal yab gung gi sku bsod dbang grags kyi byung ba zhig las/ ar po'i do dam nged gnyis kyi hur brtson 'jon thang gis byung ba zhig min pa skabs de'i mi rgan rabs bgres song tshos shes gsal red/ lcang gseb shar du yab gzhis ma khang le lag sra brtan phugs 'pher mgyogs po zin pas rdo shing lha bris sogs byas rjes yod 144

mkhan rṣa/ balke/'a shag brgyu/—) srid skyong stag brag la 'char phul chog mchan thob ste shing bzo che mo lha sa dasnokon mchog la rim pa drug pa'i las tshan pa dang /rdo bzo che mo rta na ga nor bu tshe ring la rim pa bdun pa'i drung gtogs /ar po'i las rgyab mdzo dpon kha dang da mag dbang 'dus 9ro lding dpon go gnas bsko gzhag sogs shod gzim 'gag nas bka' bsgyur bstsa' / rdo shing lha bris lag rtsa'/ nukusu shugs 'don mir dbu chen dbu chung sogs rang khungs so sos gnas spar gzengs bstod byed du bcugartsis khra'i skor/lcang gseb shar yab gzhis ar po'i dgos dngul dang dgos 'bru sogs bka' shag lag 'dzin nang gsal gzhung rtsiru/ zhib khang du rtsis zhu'i skabs rdo shing / lha bris/ zhal dpon/ gnam pa/ ar 'ul bcas kyis nyin re'i las deb lag the'u zhib bsher gyi rtsis khra mnyam 'bul zhu dgos la brten rtsis zhu gra sgrig byed 'go tshugs te lag the'u khag rtsis bsher byed mus nga rang byang spyi mkhan chung du 'phos pas rtsis dpon nga phod sras mchog la rtsis khra 'jug skyong bzo gnang yod pa dang / ngo tshab shag tshang rtse drung bstan 'dzin rgyal rya tshan skad 'bod gnang grogs zhus pa ltar rtsis dpon nga phod sras nas rtsis khang gi phyag las zhor du rtsis khra bzo gnang mur mdo spyi bka' blon du mtshan gnas 'phar bas chab mdor 'phral phebs gnang dgos byung bas rtsis khra bzo 'phror lus pa dang‘‘rig gnas gsar brje'i’’ring yig cha mer bsregs btang nas lta yul ma mchis pas 'bru dngul grangs 'bor dang /rdo shing sogs grangs 'bor ma nges pas lam tsam las gsal po 'bri stangs mi 145

shes pa der thug song /zhol par khang shar nyams gso gsan rgyag skor/lcang gseb shar yab gzhis ma khang lam tsam 'dzugs skrun zin nyer shod gzim 'gag nas zhol par khang shar lo mang gog gcong che bas nyams gso gsar rgyag byed dgos bka' bsgyur phebs 'phral zhol par khang shar gyi shing par rnams gzhan du spo shugs kyis par khang shar bshig ral gyi phyi'i rgya khyon rnying pa rang sor ba'ag ste nang gi bzo dbyibs legs bcos ar rgyag skabs par shing 'jog yul shing sgrom 'bu skyon yod rigs 'bud rshang byas na du ba gar khyab kyi shing char 'bu mched gnod skyon yong rgyur brten spyi khyab mkhan por gnad don snyan seng gi skyid chu'i chu rags rags shing gtong byed du phul bar byung 'dzin zhus te shing sgrom gsar rkyang ba zos pa yin/ mi ngan g.yo khram can zhig gis srid skyong stag brag la zhol par khang shar par shing 'jug snod shing sgrom 'bu yod rang 'jags btang lugs snyan khra zhus par brten srid skyong stag brag dgongs 'gal gyis zhol bka' 'gyur par khang gi do dam sku bcar dar han phun rab thub bstan tshangs dbyangs dang / rtse gzim 'gag byang chub yon tan/ ar po'i do dam nga phod dang / nga rang bcas sang nyin shod gzim 'gag tu bcar dgos brda tho btang 'byor thog sne mgron mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon zhol par khang du bskor g.yeng byed par btang bas ar po'i las bya dang / gnyer pa/ rdo shing che mo bcas la shing cha 'bu skyon yod pa btang min dri rtsad byed skabs shing sgrom 'bu yod tshang ma mkhan po tshang la 'bul gnang mdzad lugs zhus pa dang / steng 146

shod tshang ma'i shing cha spyan bstar zhus 'dug par 'bu yod shing cha gcig kyang mthong ya sa med pas sne mgron mkhan chung thub bstan legs smon nas de don srid skyong stag brag la drang bden snyan seng zhus tsang shing sgom 'bu skyon yod tshul sa/yo khram brdzun zhu yin pa mkhyen te srid skyong stag brag dgongs pa dwangs yod 'dug de'i sang nyin brda tho nang gsal nga tsho bzhi shod gzim 'gag tu bcar skabs sne mgron mkhan chung nas bka' 'gyur par khang do dam pa gnyis la par shing khag bdag gces lhod med byed dgos bshad song / nga phod nged gnyis la dri ba dang / 'di byas 'di min tshig gcig mi shod pas phyir 'o/tshog bya rgyu red/ shing char 'bu skyon yod pa thon tshe nyes pa nan po gtong rtsis yod 'dug kyang dāngos yod bden dpang gi ra 'phrod bden pa bden thog tu 'khyo ca tswastong tsho ོ sta sa gsung chog ra ba'i shar ka ba brgyad nub gesar rgyag skon/bka' shag nas lha ldan smon lam chen mo dang / tshogs mchod ring dge 'dun par gso'/ ja zhu 'dren 'bras spungs bde yangs grwa pa ja 'ded pa sdod khang dang / dngul rkyan/ zangs rkyan 'jug yul/ tshogs dbar o lo ngal gso bya yul ma byung mthu med la ka brgyad nub gsar rgyag dgos rgyu bka' phab byung / lcang gseb shar ar po'i khongs nas rdo bzo ba dgos nges dang / ar 'ul btang ste ka brgyad nub bshig ral gyis rdo brtsigs rgyas tu bcug pa dang / shing brdo bas lcang gseb shar du ka sgrigs gdung sgris/ byed du bcug ste thog so gcig long mtshams ka gdung dang lcam shing rdzo 147

btang / thog sa gnyis pa'i rdo brtsigs mu mthud brgyab ste thog sa gnyis pa zin 'phral lcang gses shar du shing sgrigs gong ltar byas te lha bris pas shing tshon btang / yang steng ar ka bcag pa sogs 'dzugs skrun zla ba gcig nang tshar ba byas pas bka' blon tshos nub mdun ngos mthong bar yid ma ches nga/sa bka' blon bla ma bstan pa 'jam dbyangs kyis mgron gnyer rgya mtsho nang du lta bar btang 'dug ka brgyad nub nang 'bras spungs bde yangs ja 'ded grwa pa sdod yul sogs ka ba bcu tsam gyi sa dang / 'og khang du dngul rkyan zangs rkyan 'jog yul ka ba brgyad/ o lo ngal gso rgyag yul ka ba brgyad bcas gsar rgyag zin pas bka' shag nas maghogs po byung song gsungs ba dang / grong khyer mang tshogs bar bskor 'gro mis khang pa'i phyi nang la bltas te ar po mgyogs po 'di 'dra gur phug pa las kyang las sla ba 'dug ces rdo shing ar 'ul las ka byed mir bshad 'dugargyab bshad 'chal gtam la dgag sgrub cung zad/gzhan sbyor phun tshogs la dug sbrul ltar gyi phrag dog pa nyung shas nas brtag dpyad gnad don shes rtogs ma byas par yab gzhis ma khang yag po rgyab 'dug rung / yab gzhis ma khang la phru gu gnyis skyes pa red ces 'chal gtam rgyab bshad lkog lab byas yod 'dug phru gu gnyis skyes pa zer ba gang red zer na/ gcig ni dgun thog ar po las mtshams ring nga phod nas nga phod rnying pa gsar rgyag gnang rgyur dgun thog sger las kyi rdo shing dkon pas zhu 'then byed dgos pas lcang gseb /nar ar po'i ring rdo shing ar po'i do dam par 'tsho rten re ltos bca' dgos la rdo shing che mo gnyis la 148

ar las phongs nas rdo shing lcogs min 'phros mol gnang bar rdo shing dgos nges bskong 'gugs kyis dgun thog ring ar ngo/ mjug 'khyongs las 'gan nga rang gnyis nas 'khur chog pa khas len ltar rdo shing dgos nges la skabs de'i yul srol gla lto sprad de dgun thog gcig ring nga phod rnying pa gsar rgyag gnang skabs lcang gseb shar ar po'i khongs nas shing cha sogs sne gcig gzhung rgyu sger spyod gnang med pa nga rang dang / skabs de'i las bya rtse drung dge 'dun rgya mtsho gnyis nas gsal shes bden dpang bya rgyu yin/ dgun thog ar po bskyon pa rdo shing dang / lha bris par zhu ba 'then ma dgos pa dang /ar po'i las 'jug 'phro can du mi lus pa'i khyad par las/ gzhan gyi re 'dod gnang yod pa ma red/ phru gu gcig ni khrom gzigs khang byang brgyud thub ngastan bstan dar(nga rang)sdod shag dang / 'og tu tshogs mchod ring gong nga kar chos sde ba grwa pa brgya skor zur tshogs glud 'gong rjes su gtor rgyag rgyag dgos pa'i sgrub zhag zla gcig ring tshugs yul 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis sa yod pa'i ka ba babs zhod dang / lcam rtsa shor ba sogs gog skyon che tsam yod pa 1946— 194〈bar lo gsum ring tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa dgung lo bcu gsum dgung keg ar khrims kyi ar rgyag mi chog par brten nga rang sdod shag dngaspya/ rgong dkar chos sde'i 'du khang la skyon cha yod rigs tho bkod kyi sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan po ngag dbang bstan 'dzin la phul te gtan 'jags ar po'i do dam pa'i khongs nas ar khrims ma bsdams gong nyams gso yong ba zhus pas khrom gzigs khang gi khang gnyer che ba rtse mgron dang /khang gnyer chung ba rtse drung / mkhan po'i drung yig bcas bskyar du bskor zhib tu gtong gnang khang gnyer drung yig gsum gyis bskor tho phul te nyams gso/ ma gnang mthu med red ces zhus 'dug nga rang spyi khyab mkhan po'i 149
