sar zhabs skul la bcar bas spyi mkhan ngag dbang bstan 'dzin nas66khyed rang gi shes gsal da cha mkhan khongs nas shing cha gtong yas med pas ar khrims gong nyams gso thub mdog ma kha ba’rizhes sogs gsung byung / nga rang nas gzhung khang khrom gzigs khang khang gla ha cang chung ba dang / byang rgyud khang pa ka thag gdung thag ring bas lha sa'i spyir btang khang pa'i lcam shing gis mi bsnyabs pas kong po khul nas lcam shing brgyad brgya lhag tsam nyos nyar gyis nyams gso bya rtsis yod kyang / bcu gsum dgung keg ar khrims ring rdib zhig byung na blos kyis mi bzod pas lcam shing nga rang la 'gel dkri gnang ste lcang shar yab gzhis ar po'i khongs nas brgyab 'thus bka' 'khrol yong ba zhus pa ltar gong gsal sku bcar spyi khyab mkhan pos gong dkar chos sde ba tshogs mchod ring zur tshogs 'du khang dang steng thog rtse mgron thub bstan bstan dar gyi sdod shag nyams gso ma gnang mthu med la da phan khang sdod rtse mgron nas khang par bdag gces chung bas lcam shing rtse mgron rang nas gtong dgos pa dang de byings sa rdo sogs lcang shar ar po'i do dam sras mgron sbrel po'i khongs narngaske btang ste 'phral la nyams gso dgos rgyu sogs 'khod srid skyong stag brag la 'char phul chog mchan thob pa ltar lcang gseb shar ar po'i khongs nas nyams gso byas pa yin garshas/ ar po lam tsam zin mtshams nga rang nas rdo shing / lha bris/ (zhal dpon/ ar 'ul bcas par ston mo nyin gcig btang / ci lcam shing tshang ma rgya shing yin yang /tshon rtsi btang rjes shing gang yin mi shes pas rdo stegs 'gor lcam gling gnyis kyi sa'i lcam shing la chon ma btang ba tshang mas mthong rgyu yod pa rgya shing dmar thing nger bzhag yod pa de ni ra 'phrod cig yin/ nga rang gi sdod shag la spyi 'gre'i khang gla phul phyin lha'u rta ra mi mus rgyud bcas la kha 'dzin gtan 150

(rejags sbug dam lag khyer sngon yod thog ar po nyams gsor lcam shing gtong bcug pa'i rin gnad dang / ar ston 'gro song sogs 'khod pa'i slar yang kha 'dzin gtan 'jags sbug dam rtags ma lag 'dzin gcig gnang byung ba khrom gzigs khang sdod khang lha'u rta ra'i mi mus brgyud bcas la spyod dbang yod pa las bdag dbang ster tshong gi dbang cha med pas gzhung khang gzhung gnas nas ar rgyag gnang ba zhig la don dngos ma rtogs pas dga' mim/ zhe 'dzin gyi rgyab bshad de 'dra shod srol yod pa bcas/

shing phag ( 1kha 2 5 ) lor rang nyid nas zhol gnyer las 'khur byed skabs kyi gnas chul skor/ram pa ma rgya95 wa bang phya bod shing phag(spyi lo 1kha25 )lor rang nyid zhol gnyer du bsko gzhag gnang ba ltar las 'khur byas pa yin/ zhol gnyer tshang las khungs de bzhin tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtshos 'bab 'os 'bru rig sogs bsdu gtong dang / khrims gcod las khungs gcig 'thus su rtse po ta la'i 'dabs zhol du zhol pa las khungs zhes pa ched 'dzugs gnang lugs ngag rgyun nas brjod pa ltar las khungs de'i bde skyid gling zer ba'i khang pa'i bar 'khyams nang sde srid mchog gzigs zhib tu phebs skabs bzhugs yul red ces sa khri zhig kyang 'dugalas khungs der las byed nub zhol pa zer ba rtse drung gcig dang /zhol gnyer shod drung gnyis kyi thog shod skor nas las 'phar gcig kyang bsko srol 'dug zhol pa'i drung yis rtsa 'bor mi grangs nyi shu tsam yod khongs nas rgan gras gsu ma la gnyer chung rgan pa dang / gzhon pa gnyis zer/de min gnyer chung las 'phar gcig kyang bsko srol 'dug gnyer chung zer bar drung gtogs kyi go thob yod pa dang / zhol nang bzan mi grangs nyi shu rtsa lnga skor bcas yod pa red/152

las/ khungs de'i dbang cha'i khyab kho/ ngas thad/ zhol 'og rdzong gzhis bco brgyad zer ba'i khongs su rdzong gnyis yod pa gdong dkar rdzong dang tshal bde chen rdzong / nye 'khor gzhis khag bzhi zer ba grwa bzhi gzhis dang / lho mos gzhis/ glang ru gzhis/ 'bras gling gzhis bcas dang / de min sku 'bum thang gzhis dang / 'brom thod gzhis/ tshal gzhis/ chos lung gzhis/ sbrags gzhis/ phreng sgo gzhis/ mnyes thang nor sgang gzhis/ljang gzhis/ gnam skyid tshal gzhis/ sne'u gzhis/ rnam rgyal sgang gzhis/ lum pa gzhis bcas khyon bsdoms rdzong gzhis bco brgyad yod cing / gong gsal rdzong gzhis sa khul so so'i krig car yong 'bab phud/da dung yul bab thon rdzas skabs bstun mkho gal rigs yig skyel zhol bskor gzim zer ba'i gdong bskul tham btang ste bsdu len byed kyi yod pa red/lha zhol gnyis kyi khrims gcod sa mtshams thad/ grong khyer nang g.yu thog zam pa'i zam mig dkyi'/ ma'i gdung mar lcags kyi a long zhig yod pa de'i lho jotsho sa nas klu sbug rgyal sgo dang / seng ge shar lam rgyud/ shar phyogs su kha che'i lha khang 'gram rgyud dang / sbra nag zhol sogs gling skor lam nang tshud pa rnams lha sa mi dpon gyi khongs su po/togs pa dang / de byings klu sbug tsha'/ zhing rnams dang / lcang shar/ zhol/ rdzong rgyab klu khang rgyud bcas kyitsho khor yug dang / gling skor phyi rol gyi shar lho nub byang sa kho/ ngas rnams 'ol las khungs su gtogs kyi yod pa red/bal po dang / kha tshar bas zhol las khungs dang / snang shag las khungs kyi sa khongs su bod rigs dang gyod gzhi byung skabs las khungs gnyis kyi bkong dpyang/ la brtsi 'jog mi byed pa'i rigs bka' shag la snyan seng dang 'brel bo/ra zhib las khungs nas lha sar bca' sdod gorsha kab tan dang 'phros 153

mol thag gcod byed dgos pa red/zhol pa las khungs kyi las 'gan gtso bo rtse gso' thab(tā la'i bla ma'i gso/la thab) tu mal gro gzi sbug sogs kyi gsol ru khag nas nyin re gsol mar‘‘a'o’’zer ba'i gdong tā la'i bla ma'i gsol mar dkar rti phyi snod shing sgam ras ser bsgril 'bog byas pa zhig 'bul 'byor yong ba rtsisaspyalen gyis gsol mar zhal ngo zhes zhol drung gi go thob yod pa brgyud rtse gsol thab tu 'bul dgos pa ma zad/ rgyun gtan drung ja'i gsol mar dang / tā la'i bla ma'i gsol zhib rgyu 'bru phug dkar/ gzhan yang lo gsar dang / zho ston/ chab zhugs sogs mdzad sgo 'char 'phar gyi thugs mkho gsol mar dang / gsol zhib / phyur zhib sogs ji dgos rtse gsol thab nas gsol zhal brgyud bka' lan 'byor 'phral le thogs med par 'bul lam zhu dgos/mdzad sgo 'char 'phar gyi gro zhib rgyu 'gror lngags gro zhes nga/ lo re gro khal/ chig stong lnga brgya lhag tsam sa rdo'i bsres lhad med par 'bul dgos pa de dag zhol nas khang steng du gad bsgrug byed dgos pa'i las mi zhol lcags ri phyi nang nas du ba gnam gtong (me 'bud mkhan yod do cog) zer ba khyim tshang re nas mi re res skor gyi yong dgos de'i 'a/sa rgyun nyin kha shas 'bor gyi 'duga'adzin bsgyur nang gsal shod gzims 'asag tu sne shan/ rtse drung brgyud gsol mar dang / gsol zhib/ lha ldan smon lam che mo dang tshogs mchod kyi tshwa bul dang bzhes thug gi rgyu 'gro rtsam pa/ bka' blon rnams kyi gsol phogs /gzhan yang mchod phogs khag dang / bzo rigs 'dra min gyi phogs thob 'bru dang / rtsam pa/ tshwa bul/ zhol 'dod dpal a po zer bar bzo grwa'i dgos mkho sol ba/ zho ston skabs rgyal mkhar chos rdzong pa dang /shangs ri ri bo che pa/ cung ri bo che pa/ skyor mo lung pa bcas kyi lha mo ba 154

ma/sa nor gling du nyin 'khyongs 'khrab ston skabs gnang spyin zhes gsol ras khongs suzhol las khungs nas nyin re sgrig gtong dgos pa mar ltang re dang /gro nas/ rtsam pa bcas do grangs bcu skor re sprod dngo/ sa pa sogs da nga de min/ rtsag rtsig gtong sgo sne grangs ha cang mang po yod pa red/zhol las khungs kyis btson pa'i 'tsho ba'i thad nyin drug bdun re'i mtshams btson srung zhol nang gis btson rtsam zhu len skabs rtsam snyigs 'bo gang do cam sprod pa las/ de min 'tsho ba'i lta rtog gang kyapreng med pas lha zhol mang tshogs sogs nas dge rtsa'i ched du rtsam pa dang / ja thug ster mkhan kho nar re bcol dgos pas rtag tu bkres skom gyi sdug/ bsngal myong dgos kyi yod pa red/zho'1 dpa' lding zer ba btson pa nag nyes che rigs 'jug yul gnam sgo babs bskyod dgos pa'i khang pa mun nag zhig yod pa dang / zhol las khungs kyi rab gsal lho ma'i sgo mchor gyang ldebs su khrims gcod yo chas rta lcag dang / ko lcag rdo zhwa/ rgyug btsir/ 'ching thag rkang lcags lag lcagaskyu// ske sgo sogs yod pa rnams lo rgyus su bkod pa de ltar lags so/

nang nyid nas de snga byang 'brog khul du bskyod de bal tshong byed stangs skor/bsam zur chos 'phel gyis/rang nyid de sngom rang lo 1shā1 ( nga lta/ 1ke〈khalo rang lo 7kya ) nas byadzo 'brogre khul du bskyod de gtso bo bal tshong rgyag skabs byang khul nas bal sogs/ sgrub byed du lha rtse dang lha smon khongs so/ gas nas 'bru rtsam nyo sgrub byas te khyer dgos shing / skabs der lha smon khul nas 'bru nyo spi ba byed skabs khri ru zhes gyotam/ tshigs ma/krar ru dang che chung 'i tshungs nga re la dngu' / srang do zho lnga tsam byed pa dang / byang 'brog khu'/ du phar gco bo 'bru rtsam/ bag phye(gro zhib)de bzhin ras cha sna tshogs dang / bu ram // shel ka ra sogres kyang khye/ ra gyi rngo/da/ tshur byang nas gtso bo ba'/ dang spu pags nga// 'u/gre bcas yi/na/ la/ ga'/na yang / mar phyur dang / rnga ma/ de min skabs re bal so0sa kyis rgya ba cha ma long na tshwa nyo sgru ba kyis tshur gtsang khul du 'dren gyi yod/'brog pa tsho dang tshong las thogre ma/ne byed skabs66 mna' ༅ga mdzub rngo/ bkug’’ ces nga/'i shagre po ( grogs po) sgres spo' 'dug cing / kha rgyun du6 gshardore mi tshigyes phud na nye ru dang / sa‘nye 3/ mi tshigs phud na 'khyang du (regro’’zhes/ zer ba dang / mdzub mo bapesdugyo res byed pa der‘6sro0 rtsa dmyoge ra ngo/ bkusanyi’ces brjod de pham tshun blos ling 'gel byed pa / dper rlo/ da lo dngos zog gang yod kyang phar bkram ste phio lo bal sogs bsdu rgyu byed pa der156

6rjes 'dzog’’ces zer zhing der phan tshun ga/nyis kas bzang po blos 'gel byed pa 9ra/sa/ gan rgya dang khag theg sogs kyi dpang ngo gang jiji/nga mi dgos pa dang / kha rgyun du‘‘dus da lo ma red rting phyi ma red’’ces brjod cing / de ldo/na lta/ra mi rabs na/sa mitshorabs kyi bsam blo gtong ba'i bzang po blos 'gel byed kyi yo da pa red/byang du bal nyo byed 'bru do ngo/ re la gtan tshigs mkhar ru'i khal gnyinu/ re yod cing /'bru do re la ba'/ mchod khal drug re sprod pa(mchod khal brgyad la lho khanu/ bcu gnyis yod pa dang / deng sang gi rgya ma brgyad cu re la rdo don cho /ma do reri yin)dang / de yang / tshong pa mang ba'i skabaru/ 'bru do po rer bal mchod khal lnga dang phyed tsam mam/ lnga tsam re sna tshogs byed/ nga/byi da dus su bskyod tshe tshong pa 'gro mkhan nyung tsam las med pas/ 'bru sogs nga tsho'i tshong zog la gong thang che tsam rag gi 'dug kyang / dbyar kha zla lnga pa'i nang chong pa mang tsam 'gro gi yo datshopas gong thang phram/ bu dma' tsam las mi rag cing / 9rebru do rer bal khal lnga tsam las 'khug gi med/ ras cha dang ja sogs la spyir btang gi gong thang ni/ dper na nga tshos gtsang twa/ la sogs ma/sa ras cha tshur nyo skabs bying kha rer dngul srang bzhi tsam ‘yakuske mi gnas pa dang / byang 'brog khul phar tshong skabs bying tshos mdog sna tshogs gang rung tsā re la bal nya ga bcu'am brgyad tsam byed pa dang / nga chos tshur (redi nas(gzhis rtse so/gas gtsang khul nas)ja nyo dus ja ril la dngul srang do (ོzho lnga tsamyo/ dang / sbag chung 'khor lo rtse brgyad dang nor bu me 'bar/ 'brug tshang 'khor sogs ja rtags sna tshogs can yod par gong tshad che skabs kyang sbag chung rer dngul srang bdun dang zho lnga tsam las mi gnas pa/ phar byang 'brog khul du tshong skabs ja sbag chung rer bal mchod khal re tsam ma ma/15 7

nyag bcu drug tsam dang / ja ril rer bal nya ga bcu'am brgyad tsam rag pa/bu ram 'di nas tshur nyo dus do po rer(sher bzhi bcu yod pa)ṭam rdo lnga tsam/ lakushrī mi gnas shing / phar byang 'brog khul tshong skabs bu ram dang mar brje po rgyag par bu mar mgo thug ces mar mchod khal gcig la bu ram yang de bzhin byed/gong gsari/ da ngos zog gi rin gong tshad gzhi de dag ni 1khe20so grangs nang gi rgong tshad yin pa dang / de rjes 1rdzo40zhe grangs nang du 'di nas rgya zog(rgya gar nas thon pa'i tshong zog)nyo rgyur rin gong phran bu mtho ru song yod /kyang / 'brog pa dang brje tshong byed skabs de snga ltar gcig pa yin cing / der 'brob/ pas6 mtho na gram mtho chu mnyam dang / dma' na gram dam 'a chu ma‘nyam’rizhes zer zhing / de'i rgo don ni rin gong mtho na gnyis ka mtho dgos pa dang / dma' na gnyis ka dma' ba byed dgos zhes pa'i don red/bal nyo sgrub bya yul gyi mang nas brwa —sna li 7 le gas shos sger rtse khul yin pa dang / de 'og a ma ma do sto da smad red/ nag tshang khul du bal nag mang banu/ spus ka phran bu zhan par brtsi gi red/ bal snyo sgrub kyis byang 'brog khul nas dbor 'dren byed skabs bal do'i nang nas lam bar rku ma shor gyi yod rung / bal la gzha' rlan gyis ljid du 'gro gi yo da stabs bdal skyel bas brkus kyang rgya mar bkyag ste rtsis sprod len skabs bal do yang du mi 'gro ba dang / de skabs skyel 'dren khal g.yag la brten dgos shing / nga tshos bdal gla gla yul ni mthong smon gyi phu'i sa ma 'brog rnams yin/ khong tshos khal g.yabaka la brten nas ched mngags bdal skyel byed kyi yod pas/bdal gla gla yul 'bel po yod/ g.yag nyi shu rtsa lnga rer lag re rtsis te lag 158

rer rjes 'gro mi re sgrigs dgos pa dang / bdal bdag gis g.yag gi rjes 'gror phar lam tshur lam lto chas ster dgos pa ma zad/ lam bar lham mthil krad pa brgyab na g.yag gi rjes 'gro des bdal bdag gi spu sogs sgrim yog gi lag las byed pa dang / de bzhin bdal bdag gis g.yag par lham krad ma sprad na g.yag pas bdal bdag gi lag las kyang mi byed/ nga rang nas rtag par g.yag par lham krad sprod rkyang byed kyi yod/1ba20lo'i nang tsam la khal ga ya/ga rer yar mar bsdoms bdal gla dngul sra nga bdun dang zho lnga re tsam byed cing / yar mar bsdoms zla ba bzhi tsam 'gor gyi yod pa de'i nang lam bar la zla ba grenyis tsam dang / 'brog pa dang tshong rgyag pa'i dus tshod zla ba gnyis tsam 'bor gyi yod pa red/ de skabs nga rang la g.yag lag drug tsam gyi tshong zog 'gel rgyu yod cing / lag rer tshad gzhi g.yag nyi shu rtsa lnga re'i khar g.yag pa mi res sger g.yag ces g.yag pa'i zhor tshong 'ge'/ byed khal g.yag bzhi lnga tsam re ded yong gi yod pas/ g.yag pa mi gnyis re la khyon khal g.yag drug cu lhag tsam re ded yong gi red g.yag pa lag gnyis re zla bsgril gyis ma phyin na khal 'gel mi shes pas lag gnyis re zla bsgril nas 'gro gi red/lam bar 'gro dus byang stong zhe gcig la brten gur dang / thab chas cha tshang khyer dgos pa dang / ‘‘mar rgan’’zhes mi gcig gis snga dro bkod sgrig gis lam lci sgrug pa zhes mi so sos phad chung nang lci ba sgrug gin 'gro ba'am/ yang na/ zhag sa'i tshugs bab yu la la slebs 'phral gur phub zin rjes‘‘mar rgan’’zhes pa de ja skol mkhan gcig sdod pa las/ de min rnams lci ba sgrug par 'gro ba/ lam bar thab rdo'i rdo sgrug chog med pas lcags kyed(me btang nas lto snod 'dzugs bya lcags rkang gsum zhig yod par zer)kyi 159

rkang gsum lhu phral rgyu yod rngapre 'is mod cing / de dag btsugs nas de'i mthar spang bkog ste thab bzos nas ja skol ba dang / nyin dgung tsha phog rgyag srol med kyang snga/ dro deng sang shyas na chu tshod bcu gnyis tsam ‘la thon nas phyi dro chu tshod lnga dang phyed ka tsam 'a tshusas 'ag sdo da kyi red/ phyi dro tshugs babs 'phral kha'/ spabs te g.yagye rnams sga bshus nas ri la rtswa zar gretong 'ing / skabs der rkun ma de tsam med nga/sa ga yag dgong mo ri la brgyab ste bakhyo/ga kyang bor brlag 'gro bi med/ de ltar byas te lam bar yar 'a/ma zla gcis/ tsam dang mar lam zla gcig tsam 'gro dgos/ spyir btang rta pa'i nyin (lam/ gcig la g.yag tshugs lnga lhas tsam 'a/sa mi 'bo/ra ya nga / 'gro yu/la thang chen yin pas snga/ dro thon sa de dbong dro sdod pa nas mi gre gis mthong gi red/ lo ltar bod zla gnyis pa gsum pa'i nang tsamyo4 ra phyin nas 'brogre par tshong zog rnams bkram ba'as ste/ baṇashwe ma breg bar sgus sdod bya rgyu ma gtob/sa meng nga/sa/ nga rang skabs re rta bzhon te zla ba zeri tsam nang la log yong gi yo/da/ 'brogre pa tsho sdod lgenas/ skya/ spo byed da'o/sa khas / zlang pa med kyang86spungs’’sam/ ga'i ma’’zhes pa sbya tsho spyi la mar phyune rngadang rtsam pa so gas rgyu dngos 'jog yu/'a/ yod pa der 6spungs srung’lhazheru/ nga 'i rgad po rgan rngo re zung thun mong du glas te srung char 'jog srol 'dug ska bas re jag nga nga yang g.yagre gnyis gsum re ma gtogs rgyu dngos za bca' 'phrog si/ med lugs zer skad/'brog pa'i lag nas tshong zog bsgrub bya'i gras da dung lug shi ba'i rngapregaṣpe/ pa'ang sgrub kyi yod/ shi lpags legs nga/ bcu gnyis la 'a bru do po re —/6()

sprod dgos pa/ (bsad lpags la bal meed pa sa nyo sgrub byed kyi med nga/)dang / tsha ru le sas pa rer ja nya ga lnga tsa ma ma ma / 'an par nya ga do gakrusnyumyo4 cam re'ang byed/tshur hā ma ba'/ gyis rgyab cha ma long na tshwa 'bru brje dgos pa/ de yang /'bya hra der tshwa do bzhi'am lnga sgyu tswam byed nga/ der‘‘bzhi de lnga de’rizhes zer/ tshwa nge dag byang 'brog khul nas gzhis rtse sogs gtsang khul du drangs nas tshwa 'bru brje ska ngas‘8dgu drug’’('bru khal drug la tshwa khal dgu)'am‘‘lnga bzhi’’('bru kharṣa/ bci la tshwa khal lnga)pyas te brje gi red/ (skabs der 'bras dang 'apru'i gong tshang ldab kyi khyad par yod ci nga / 'bras phag ri nas nyo skabs phas bre der dngu/la swa nga bzhi rnge tsam sprod dgos/)nga rang de sngon skabs re 'brog zog gis rgyab cha ma long bar tshwa le na par tshwa kha /bab/ gsum/ tsam la 'gro myo nga yod cing / tshwa khar tshong rgyas sa med kyang /tshwa la ri na dang dpya khral sosas gang yang sprod mi dargos pas/ ‘byang gi tshwa kha chen mo la/ snyobs pa 'a/ga pa su ring dang/ brdzong bar ngapung pa su bzang yi na’’zhes brjod sro' ltar su rung gis len chog gi red/ dpyid ka tshwa len/ skabs rkarijor gis 'gog rgyu las gzhan gyi dka' ngal med par las sla po yod kyang dbyi/tshod tshwa de dbyar tshwa las sbus ka (nan pa yod pa dang / dbyar kha cha ra nga/ bta nga skabs chu'i dkyil nas tshwa (krājon dgos pa sogs kyis dala' nga' che ba yod rung tshwa'i spus ka ngabyar kha legs pa yod patshored/ skabs der tshwa pādo na /skabs mi gsum dgos rshang / mi sa/nyis kyis tshwa phad bzed nas/ gcig ji /sa bton te tshwa phad nang plugs kyi red/ tshwa kha bag la g.yas g.yom/ gang sa nas tshwa len mkhan rngo/nga gi yod pas/ khal g.yag stong tsho mang po 'dus kyi yod gathis so so'i khal gang/ga sems can 'tsho mkhan satong dbos 161

pa las/ phar tshur 'dres tshe ngo shes yas med pas bor brlag 'gro ba'i nyen kha yod pa red/byang tshwa dbor 'dren gyis tshur zhing khul du tshong skabs tshwa dkon dus tshwa 'bru mgo gtug ste tshwa do po rer 'bru do re byed pa dang / gal srid tshwa gong gtan nas med rung / 'bras khang ste wa lung khul sogs la yod pa'i gzhung gi tshwa 'bras brje mkhan 'bras sgrub par bskyal na‘‘do ma’’zhes tshwa do gnyis rer 'bru do re brje gi yod/ spyir btang byas na gzhung gi 'bras sgrub par tshong mi dgos par‘‘dgu drug’’'am‘ lnga bzhi’’rje thub kyi yod cing / des na sa khad la gzhigs pa'i bdal gla ma gtogs tshwa la ma rtsa med pas tshwa tshong de'ang khe bzang yag po yod pa red/byang 'brog pa tsho'ang tshwa kha nas tshwa len par 'gro gi yod cing / khong tshos kyang thag nye sar 'tshong thub na gong zhus ltar tshwa 'bru brje yang / dpyid tshwa ni spus ka zhan pas nyo mkhan de tsam med stabs dbus gtsang khul thag ring tsam la 'tshong bar 'gro gi yod pa dang / 'brog pa tsho ston kha stod khul gyi zhing khul du bskyod skabs tshwa dang / bal/ pags pa/ khu lu/ lug‘‘yum ske’’'am‘‘yum bu’’(lu gu'i bal rgyab la zer)sogs kyi 'brog zog khyer yong ste phar bsgrub rgyu gtso bo 'bru yin la/ nge min la phug dang nyung ma skam po sogs kyang bsgrub cing / brje tshong byed phyos/sa thad tshwa mang che ba gzhung gi tshwa sgrub pas nyo ba dang / tshwa sgrub par dgongs pa zhus te tshwa phran bu mi ser sogs la brje 'tshong byed skabs tshwa dkon/ po yod na ma go thug dang / 'bel po yod na dgu drug gam lnga bzhi byed kyi yod pa/ de yang 'brog pa'i tshwa dbor 'dren ni lug la brten nas byed kyi yod pas/ 'bru lug sgye dgu 'a/ tshwa lug sgye drug yang na 'bru lug sgye lnga la tshwa lug sgye bzhi re byed/ (lug sgye lnga 162

tsam la gtan tshigs mkhar ru do tsam yod pa) de min lug dang pags pa sogs 'a bru dang brje tshong byed skabs zhing pa tshos 'asbru‘‘gla 'bo’’zhes gtan tshigs myo/khar ru gang la gla 'bo bcu drug re 'gro ba'i 'bo chung zhig yod pa der 'jal gshor gyis sprod pa dang / 'brog pa nyung skabs lug rer 'bru gla 'bo nyi shu tsam dang bcu drug tsam re byed/ lug lpags rer gla 'bo do 'am gsum tsam byed la lug lpags legs par lnga re tsam yang byed/ bal ni bal 'bru mgo thug yin pa/ dper na/ lug phad nang bal gang 'gro zhing pas brdzong brgyab ste phar 'bru dkar yol kha zhes lug phad kyi kha dang mnyam pa'i 'bru'i tshad gzhi gzhir bzung sprod len byed/ 'brog pa nyung skabs rdig gsum ngakar yol kha zhes lus/ sgye'i nang 'bru blugs nas rdig rdig lan gsum byas pa'iri dkar yol kha re byed pa/ khu lur rdig gsum dang kha mtho tsam byed/la phug dang / nyung ma skam po/ zhog khog bcas bal dang brje skabs lug sgyer tshad byas nas brje ba dang / yum ske zhes lu gu'i bal rgya ba rer gong thang che skabs gla 'bo re byed la/ 'brog pa mang skabs gla 'bo rer yum ske gnyis re'ang byed/ 'brog pas bsha' lug lnga drug tsam re dngul la 'tshong ba las/ bal rnams dngul la mi 'tshong ba dang / bul 'bru brje skabs 'bru do gcig la 'brog pa mang nyung gis bul do gnyis sam gsum tsam re byed kyang / zhing pas bul tog la 'bru spus zhan tsam las mi sprod/skabs der nga tshos byang nas bal sgrub pa rnams mang che ba gzhung tshong 'khri ska'/ spom mang/'a tshang du 'tshong gi yod cing / gzhung tshong spom tshang tshong pas 'jad(bzhad)khul bsdad de nga tsho'i lag nas bal nyo zhing / gzhung tshong bas skabs der bal mon dor dngul srang 50—60tsam sprod pa der khe bzang phran bu las med rung dngu la rkyang sprod kyi yod/163

gong gsal dngul gyi thog nas 'brog tshong dang batta)la gla/ gzhung tshong bar bal btsong pa'i rin thang sogs ni 192kyanang gi dus skabs su yin pa dang / de rjes dngul gyis nyo tshong pyed pa'i dngos zob/ gi rin gong je 'phar la parten 1950nang byang du 'gro dus yar mar bsdoms bdal gla rgyab rer dngul srang 25— 20byed pa dang —da nas(gzhis rtse)nga tshos tshur rgya zog nyo dus ja ril rer dngul srang 75re 'am dngul srang brgyad re tsam dang /sbag chung la dngul srang 16— 17tsam/ de bzhin ras cha dang / bu ram sogs la'am gong tshad 'phar yod rung / byang du brje tshong byed skabs 'bro ga zog la'ang de bzhin 'phar yod pas/ sngon ma dang gcig mtshungs red/ tshong zog gi rin gong 'phar tshul gong ltar yin pa ma zad/ zhing khul du sha mar dang g.yag lug nyo tshong gi rin bong la mtshon na/ 1kha20nang du mar khal rer(deng sang gi rgya ma bcu)dngul srang 40 — 50tsam byed pa dang / 1kha50nang mar khal rer dngul srang brgyad cu tsam mam dngul srang brgya byas na song chen rags par brtsi gi red/ 1920nang g.yag rer dngul srang 25—20byed pa dang / lug rer dngul srang 5——6byed pa dang / 1950nang g.yag rer rdo tshad gsum re tsam dang / lug rer dngul srang 25tsam re byed/ngas 1kha42lo nas bzung byang 'brog khul nas bal sgrub pa de dag phag rir 'tshong du bskyod cing / de skabs gzhis rle khul nas phag ri bar rgyab rer bdal gla dngul sra nga 15— 16tsam re sprod dgos pa dang / phag rir bal mon do rer rdo tshad gsum re tsam bya sa te btsong thog de gar dngul brjes brgyab nas rgya gar du tshong zog skrub rngaprer 'gro gi yo/da/ de 167/

ska/bas rgyutsho gar sgor mo rer 'dza' thang bod dngu9ro srang do srang gsum ma/ na //lnga drug tsam re byed cing / de dus ngos rang la ma rtsa rgya gar sgor mo bdu 5/ stong tsam las med rung dngos zog sna tshogs mang tsam sgrub thub kyi yod/ngos rang la thog mar ma rtsa bod dngul rdo tshad brgya tsam las med kyang / de rjes rgya gar du lo ltar bskyod par brten 195ṭwāṃ — 195rdzobar ma rtsa dod dngul rdo tshad bzhi stong tsam bar 'phar thub nga/ byung /dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur rjes nga tsho gzhis rtse grong khyer khur sdo/nga/ ye snga'i tshong rigs gras them grangs brgyad sgrig 'dzugs kyis mnyam 'a/sa btsu3kas pa dang / them pa bzhi rer tshong khang re btsugs te bsdoms ma rtsa dngul sgor brgyad stong tsam las med/ de rjes 1kha62lo slob gso chen po gsu ma gyi skabs ma rtsa ring lugs red ces skabs shig ring nor 'khrul du brtsis rung /1kha6khrilo nas bzung sngon yod ma rtsa can gyi mnyam las bskyar gso dang 'brel ngos rang tsu'u krang dang rtsis pa'i 'gan khur bdams bskos kyis lo bco brgyad tsam las khur byas/de snga ma rtsa can gyis mnyam las btsugs pa'i thog ma'i 'char byas na lo re bskyed kha brgya cha drug sprod rgyu byas pa dang / de rjes khe bzang gang 'tshams byung bas lo re ma rtsa khri gnyis bzhag 'phros dngul khang du bcol dgos si red/ de rjes6‘rig gnas gsar brje’’tshugs te dngos zog ji bzhin len sa med pa sogs kyis mthar las ka byed mkhan la gla cha'ang sprod mi thub pa'i mtshams su slebs pa dang / gong rim nas las ka byed mir gla cha ma sprad na mi 'grig pa'i bka' ga nang stabs mthar nga tsho'i ma rtsa nas khe bzang med nga ra sgor bzhi stong tsam brlags pa re da/ de rjes tang gi skabs bcu gcig pa'i krung u tshang 'dzoms gros tshogs thengs gsum pa 'tshogs rjes nga 165

chor lta stangs drag tu tretre rtedro na/sa tshong zo la ca 5/ peni 'u4nga tsam sprad pa dang 7spo sasum tsam ring chong brgyab par khe bzang che ca ma byung bas / 1kha 〈5lor ma/ rtsa bgo bsha' rgyag skabs sngon ma'i ma rtsa dang / bar la ma zla re'i bya dala' sprad nga/ rnams phud khe bzang sgor khri gnyis tsa ma byung 'dugre/ pas/ nga tshor de snga'i skyed kha'ang rtsis brgyab byung /de snga'i them dud brgyad kyi mnyam gnyer las ka byed mkhan tshong khang rer ma rtsa can bzhi dang / lta ltogs byed ma khan 'bring po gcig dbul po gcig bcas tshong khang gnyis la khyon mi bcu gnyis yod(de snga tshong rgyag skabs mi rer zla re gla mtho shos gras la sgo ra 40 ge 45dang / dma' bar sgor 2ṭwāṃre yod)kyang khe bzang khri gnyis nge/'ang thog mar byas na ma rtsa can tshor bgos na 'grig lugs gsungs kyi 'dug 'on kyang tshang ma ma rtsa can tshor bgos na las ka byed mkhan gzhan tshos sems pham byed pa'i bsam 'char yod stabs ngos nas cha shas shig las ska/ byed mkhan gzhan tshor bgos na legs gnas zhes bsam 'char zhus ma thar khe bzang khri gnyis nas brgya cha drug cu re lnga ma rtsa can tshor bgos pa dang / brgya cha sum cu so lnga las ka byed mkhan gzhan tshor bgos pa bcas 1kha〈5lo ma rtsa bgos te de nas bzung da bar kher rkyang gi tshong gnyer byed bzhin yod pa bcas/166

de snga bod nas bal nyo sgrub byas te ka len sbyag tu bal tshong bskyod skon/ra bya0nang satshe nga sarang nyid ni de snga rang lo 1ṭwāṃ(da lta shā1rdzordokharang lo 65)naru/ tshong las byas shing / de sngon tshong las byed phyogs ni/ rnam gling dang / shangs//rgya mtsho/ mthong smon/ ngam ring / mud/ sger rtse/ nag tshang khurṣa4 sogs nas bal nyo sgrub kyis ka lon sbug tu 'tshong bar 'gro bi/ yod/1940nang gzhis rtse dang shangs khul sogs nas bal nyo sgrub byed skabs bal legs nyes kyis gzhis rtse khul nas nyo skabs bal mon do rer dngul srang 70—75tsam re dang / shangs khul nas nyo skabs mon do rer dngul srang :80—60tsam re byed/ skabs der ngos rang 'a/ bal mon do sum stong bzhi stong tsam re nyo tshong bya rgyu'i ma rtsa yod cing / gzhis rtse khul nas phapa na ri bar bdal gla ni khal g.yag yin na g.yag rgyab rer dngul srang 15— 2 0tsamyo/ re dang / bong bu yin na bong rgyab rer bdal gla dngul srang 14— 15tsam re byed/ rnam gling dang shangs/ rgya mtsho sogs gong gsal sa khul nas/ phag ri bar g.yag tshugs nyi shu tsam dang bong tshugs bcu gsum bcu bzhi tsam 'gogru gyi yod/ spyir btang byas na tshugs chen bco brgyad yin pa de'i nang bcag zhag gnyis tshud yod/phag ri nas ka lon sbug bar ched mngags bdal skyel byed ma/ban ni gro 167

mo ba'i dud chang che 0'i dre'/ trīri byon che 'o tshi na ne// dgun duṭashrī su dgon sde che ḍaba'i grwa sgrurngong dang bla brang kha0// dang zlams khul tshoro rib /sa che kha'i drel pa/ de mi na dzha/ra khag ljorigazeri /0sa so/sas kyis ched mngasas bdal skyel du btang ba'i drel pa phom/ che yo/nga gi yo/da pa der‘8mon sko ra’’zhes zer zhing / lo ltar da gun dus phag ri nas 7/ sbug bar ya/ra mar thengs bcu gnyis bcu gsum tsam re bdal skyel 'gro bskyod byed pa dang / dbyar dus tshong rigs mang po kyed la bdal skyel drel pa'ang mang che ba log 'gro gi red/ 1kha45 —1946nang phag ri nas ka sbug bar tshong rigs nyung dus rgyab rer bdal gla rgya gar sgor mo 15da 20tsam / byed/ bal rnams ka sbug tu 'byor rjes rgya gar ka yan zhes sngar nas tshong ༅ga yod pa khong tshor 'chong zhing / bal mon do rer rgya ga/ra sgor mo 55 — shā 5tsam (rgya gar sgor mo rer 'dza' thang dngul sra/nga do zho lnga tsam mam sra/nga gsu pya tsamari/ re)re byed/tshur bsgrub bya'i dngos zog mi// bod du ma/kho ma'i rgya zog dper na/thong gshol dang rkom/ zor ba/ sbyag ma sogs so nam yo chas bzo byed kyi lcags leb dang lcags gug so/gas ñtsa gres risas sna tshogs dang / gzhan yang rams dang rgya gsar/ chos sas ra/ 'gugs tshwa sogs kyi tshos rigs sna tshogs/ ras cha sna tshogres/ bu/ ram dang bye ma ka ra sogs mngar cha'i rigs / ba/ zhis rtse khul gyi dakho bzo bas rta'i srab dang smed sogre/sa bzo byed 'u/ ga lpags skrudros gzhi sna tshogs/ rgya ko(glang ko)dang stung kris/ phomyo/ sogs nyo sgrub byed pa ma zad rgya gser dang pan jab nas thon pa'i byu ru/'bom spel gyi g.yu dang / mu tig sogs bod du dgos mkho 'gro khungs yod rngapre ci rigs gre/nga thub kyis nyo sgrub byed cing / lcags i si pā mon do po gcig(sher 40rgya ma rdo0)la rgya gar sgor mo 12tsam re sprod dgos pa da nga /168

ras cha ni ga ce 40la tha na re yin cing / tha na rer dpya khral bsnan pa'i a na/ rdo — 12tsam re spus ka legs nyes kyis sprod kyi yod/ ras do po gcig la tha na 6yin cing / ras srab pa yin na do po rer tha na 6las mang ba yod/de skabs rgya gar nas ras cha sogs nyo sgrub byed skabs rgya gar gzhung nas bod mi tshong rigs kyi 'go 'don byed po‘‘e so'o si shan’’zhes pa'i mi sna ched 'dzugs byas yod pa dang nga tshos de dag brgyud dngos zog gi rnamyo/ grangs dang 'bor grangs ji dgos tho sprad rjes khong tshos tshong rigs 'di la 'di sprod zer ba'i chog mchan gyi tho zhig sprod kyi yod pa de gzhir bzung nyo chog cing /ras cha ni 1947tsam gyi skabs su rgya gar gzhung nas6‘par mi tra’’zhes pa'i gtan 'bebs spra se zhig sprod kyi 'dug pa de gzhir bzung len dgos kyi yod pa dang / dper na tshong pa gcig la ras do po bcu'i ming thon na spra se de rang la rgya gar sgor mo nyis stong re sprod dgos/ de skabs bod kyi smad phyogs khul rgya rmeg nas ras cha mkho 'don ma thub par bar mtshams chad stabs smad phyogs kyi tshong pa mang pos rgya gar nas ras cha nyo sgrub byed par yong gi yod pas/ nga tsho ras cha sgug sdod byed mkhan la spra se thon tshe smad phyogs chong pas nga tsho'i lag khres spra se nyo gi yod pa dang / spra se rer rgya gar sgo ra mo nyis sto nga lnga brgya tsam re sprod kyi yod/ rgya gar gzhung nas‘‘e so'o si shan’’la spra se gzhir bzung ras cha sprod kyi yod pa red/nga tshos skabs der rgya gar nas gser nyo sgrub byed skabs rgya gser spus dag yin na to lā rer rgya gar sgor mo drug cu tsam re byed kyi yod pas bod dngul rdo tshad gsum re tsam gnas pa dang / gzhan yang bod kyi tshong rigs tshos ngod du mkho ba'i dngos zog ci rigs sgrub rgyu'i bsam blo btang ste thabs shes gang yod kyis nang 'dren byed kyi yod pa sogs mdor na bal phyir gtong 169

byas pa rnams la gang ltar bod mkho'i rgya zog nang 'dren byed cing / de skabs bod nas rgya gar du lo re tshod rtsis byas na ha lam bal mon do khri gsum bzhi tsam 'gro gi red/1kha50lo bar rgya gar du bal mon do rer rgya gar sgor mo 2〈0 —200bar tsam byed kyi yod kyang / chab mdo bcings 'grol btang ste〈gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun〉bzhag rjes a ri dang dbyin jis bod kyi bal rgya gar gyi lag nas ma nyos par brten rgya gar nas bod kyi tshong rigs khag gi bal nyo sgrub ma byas stabs de skabs dgun dus ka lon sbug tu 'byor ba'i bal phon che rnams de gar luru/ shing / mthar krung dbyang sku tshab nas rwa spom sa gsum(rwa sgreng bla brang dang spom mda' tshang / sa 'du tshang)dang gros mol gyis tshong ‘ros don gcod cig btsugs te ka sbug tu 'byor zin pa'i bal rnams krung dbyang gzhung(skabs de'i brjod srol ltar bkod)nas nyo sgrub gnang bar bal mon do rer rgya gar sgor mo ṭwāṃ6re byas te spus 'tshong zhu dgos byung bas tshong rigs rnams la bal mon do re nas rgya gar sgor mo 200lhag tsam re gyong gun 'khel stabs lo der tshong pa tshang ma skad shor ba red/1kha52lo nas bod du tshong don kung si dang dngul khang sogs btsugs yod kyang / de dus nang sa nas ca lag 'don yas mang po med stabs krung dbyang gzhung nas bod kyi tshong rigs kha shas la rda yang khri gnyis tsam dang stong phrag kha shas tsam ma rtsa bskur te rgya gar nas lcags shog dang / 'bi lā sa/so phag tan shin/ tha mag rkub stegs/ a ru nag chung zer ba'i sman rgyu sogs dngos rdzas kyi rnam grangs dang grangs 'bor 'di dang 'di khyer yong dgos zhes kha khrun bzos te 'don 'dren bya rgyu mngags kyi yod cing /'don 'dren gyi dus tshod gtan 'khel bzos pa ltar ca lag dus thog 'don 170

ma thub na rkub brdibs pa'i gyong rgun 'khel ba'ang byung yod/ dper na/tshong rigs 'ga' shas nas rkub stegs nyis stong tsam dang / a ru nag chung mon do chig stong tsam/ lcags shog sogs dus thog ma 'byor stabs krung dbyang gi kung si nas da dgos pa byung ma song zhes rtsis ma blangs pas rkub brdibs/ pa'i gnas tshul yang byung yod/sprasnakha56lo kung si nas bod kyi tshong pas bal tshong rgyur skul slong dang 'brel bal rnams ka sbug tu krung dbyang gi tshong don sku tshab khru'u zhes pa ched 'dzugs gnang yod pa der tshong dgos pa'i gan rgya 'jog dgos gsung skabs bkras lhun bla brang nas gan rgya dang po bzhag 'dug pa de'i nang bkras bla gcig pu'i bal mon do drug stong 'dug pas tshong khag che rigs gcig la de tsam yod stabs skabs der bod nas bal tshong rgyag mkhan rwa spom sa gsum tsam du ma zad/ a 'brug tshang / gzis/sa rgyab tshang / dar rgyas dgon pa sogs mdo smad khul nas tshong khag mang po dang / lha sa khul nas tsha rong /ka shong/ gling khag se 'bras dga' gsum(dgon khag gi tshong pa de rnams ni bla grwa so so'i mchod rgyun gtong rtsa'i ched du red) gzhis rtse khul nas bkras bla/ shangs dga' ldan chos 'khor nga tsho(shar chen) ri 'gas/dar rgyusna/ sa spa ra/ grong gsar spa ra sogs/ rgyas rtse khul nas dzar pa sogs/lha rtse khul nas bye ma gang / rda dbang / de min bzhad thong smon khul dang /mus khul sogs khyon bal tshong rgyag mkhan tshong rigs ha cang mang po yod pa red/1956lo tsam nas a me ri ka dang dbyin ji nas rgya gar brgyud bod kyi bal nyos stabs/ bal gong 'phar nas ba' mon dor 'di nas ṭam rdo bcu gnyiṭa/ re sprad par ka sbug tu rgya gar sgor mo 28 khyebyung yod(de skabs rgya gar 171

sgor mar bod dngul srang 5re yi5 pa)de nas 1kha5khalor bal phyir gtong mi chog pa'i khyapa bsgrags gnang skabs nga rang la bal mon do nyis stonganyis barya lhag tsam yod pa de dag mon shido rer mi dmangs shog sgor 42re byas te gzhung la spus 'bul zhus/1961lo mjug nas bal tshong rgyag mtshams chod pa bawas/
༄nga nga tsung

bla ma rani dkrugre shing ngan sku la gyis bod chen po zer ba zhib/ bzos nas/ rin / bablu/na mes rgyal sa khongs khyur mi da gtong rgyu'i ham sems dang bod du btsan 'a dzul bya rgyu'i re ngan gyi thabs jus da nga 'brel ba dam po yod pa zhig yin 'a//go mi ma/ tang srid dbang gis bod du bya ba spel ba'i lhu tshigs gnad chen zhig kyang yin stabs 'dir ngas gnad don 'di skor 1kha2 2lor khren tu cun nyer bzhi pa'i cun pu'u ru sdod skabs dang 1kha2 2lor bod sog u yon lhan khang (bod don khru'u) du las ka byed skabs 'phrad pa'i gnad don dang /yig rigs/ zin bris tha thor/ gzhan yang dran gsos pa'i gnas tshul bcas kyi thog nas de'i skor gyi gnad don gsal po yong phyir gyod gzhi 'di'i mgo mjug brgyud rim zhig brjod rgyu yin/dang po/ dar rgyas dgon pa dang be ri grong cho gnyis 'khrug rtsod 'byung rkyen/dar rgyas dgon pa dang be ri grong tsho gnyis ni dkar mdzes rdzong gi sa khongs yin kyang rtsa med du phyin med pa'i stobs shugs te sde dpon(thu'u si) gyis bdag gir bzung yod/ be ri grong tsho ni be ri sde dpon la bdag pa dang / dar rgyas dgon pa ni kru'u o'o sde dpon gyi khongs gtogs red/be ri grong tsho'i yar lha dgon pa ni be ri sde dpon(yon bdag sde dpon)gyi khyim tshang yin zhing / de'i gtso gnyer sprul sku'i yang srid ni dar rgyas dgon nga/'i mnga' khongs mi ser sangs rdo'i khyim du skyes pas be ri sde dpon gyis mnga' khongs mi ser khyim/ dud bco lnga mi tshab khral par gtong rgyu byas shing /sprul sku des dgon pa'i gtso gnyer byed pa dang dar rgyas dgon pa dang 'gro 174

'ongo jitrī /tro byed kyi yod/ dkar mdzes dang sde da treri/shāre dbar baninas pa'i dpa ri rgyas dgom pa ni nub ngos kham sa bod mtha' srung ba/ ga tsanyis sa mtshams te rong nga tshang dang bar thag le dbar bcu tsam las med cing // ༅ra du be ri dang le dbar sum cus chod pa'i dgon der grwa pa nyis stong lhag tsam yod pa'i gzhi rgya che ba'i dgon pa zhig yin pa de'i chags yul khams phyogs nas bod du tshong rgyag par 'gro sa'i byang lam gyi sne mo 'khel bas kha rgyun du sa phyug po zhes zer srol 'dug sa derisde dger bca' sdod bod dmag dang khad nyer brten nga/ra rgyas dgon pas bod dmag rgyab brten yod par rlom ste khul der gtum spyod ci rigs byed pa ma zad/ 191ṭwāṃlor rong pa tsha'i dmag 'khrug skabs dar dgon grwa yongasku kyis bod skyor khams rgol byas na'ang de skor lab gleng gang yang byed mkhan ma byung bar de las ldog ste 'ching yig gi 'geb srung byas rkyen ngan rlom je cher song ste khams khul dpon 'bangs khas la mthong chung dang / lhag par nye 'khor khag la brnyas bcos mgo gnon kho na byed kyi yod /1kṣ-ipe27lor be ri dpon 'das rjes khong gi bu mos rjes shul bzung zhing / yar lha sprul sku dang be ri dpon gyi shul 'dzin bu mo gnyis kyis sa gnas dbang cha mnyam spyod skabs phan tshun khe dbang skor skabs 'gar 'gal rtsod kyi bsam 'char je mang du song bar brtem/ yar lha sprul skus be ri dang mnyam gnas bya rgyu blos btang gis 1920lor dar rgyas dgon du phyin spos thog de sngon be ris mi tshab tu sprad pa'i khral pa them dud bco lnga de dag be ris phyir sprod ma byas par dar rgyas dgon par 'bul rten du phul bas dar dgon pas kyang dang len byas shing / don der be ri'i mi ser mnyam langs kyis ngo rgol byas gshis be dar dbar gyi 'khrug rtsod yong rkyen du gyur zhing /175

dar rgya sa dgon pas da kar ma dzes dzo nga 9sha sa krā dzistso/ nya na ru/'u chi'i snga/ gsa' / bshad byas kyang han gyis thag paṃ/cod ma byas/ stabs da ra dgon drag shugs phyogs /bag gis 1920lo'i zla 6tshes 1〈nyin gyi mtsham/ gung khwapre be ri grong tsho glo bur btsan bzung dang 'brel rang snang gang shar gyis mer sreg 'phrog bcoms byas/ be ris dar rgyas dngo/na la rgol lan slog kyang glags ma 'khel bar dkar mdzes rdzong la zhu gtugs byas pa ltar las 'dzin han gyis zhu don gzhir bzung gong la snyan seng zhus/ dar rgyas dgon pa'i zhi mthun phyogs khag gis phyob/sa gcig nas las 'dzin han gdan drangs nas gzhung drang thag gcod yong re byas pa dang / gcig shos nas rdzong de'i khongs kyi mi drag dang tshong pa rnams bar 'dum byed par gdan zhus kyis zhi mthun yong re byas kyang las 'dzin han gyis snga sa nas gnas tshul je sdug tu song ba mthong nas las 'gan dgongs zhu byas pa dang chabs cig dkar mdzes su 'bo/ga srung dmag dmag dpung gtong dgos pa'i re ba bton nas mgyogs myur 'gan 'khri dor rgyu'i 'dod tshul bzung ste gyod gzhir kha ya ma byas pa red/skabs de'i shis khams dmigs bsal sa khul de bzhin zi khron zhing chen gyi kru'u zhi li'u wun hu'e yis khron khams mtha' srung spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa'i ming thog nas zhor gtogs byed pa'i sa khongs la brten li'u yis khron khams mtha' srung lu'i yi lu'i krang ma su'u dar mdo grong rdal rgyun sdod sa srung du mngags/ ma yis dkar mjes/ kyi don rkyen nyin bzhin dza drag tu song bar gzhigs te khron dar mtha' srung thon zhe gnyis pa'i dkar lo ying la drag shugs spyod rgyu'i gra sgrig dgos pa'i 'phren yig btang nas bkod mngags byas pa dang / khron dar sa srung thon zhe gnyis pa'i thon/ krang ma khreng lung dkar mdzes su dpung skyod byed mkha na gdong len dmag gi si ling du bskos/176

ma khyeng lung dkar ma/dzes su ma slebs gong tsam du lu'u khreng(da ra mdo)srid 'dzin nas tshan yi kru'u zhon wun be dar dbar bar 'dum byed par btang ba de ni ktar snang tsam las don dam gnad don thag gcod thub re med par dras shugs spyod rgyu'i rang bzhin snga sa nas chags zin zhing / lu'u khreng gi tshong pas nga ra mdor ma su'u yi khrims 'og tu bkag nyar 'og gnas pa'iri dar dargom/ gyi tshong pa mi bdun la bu lon tsha 'ded byed dgos pa'i re ba bton pa'i gnas tshul de dar rgyas dgon pas thos rjes khong khro je cher song nas bar 'dum bya rgyu khas ma blangs pa red/ ma khreng lung dkar mdzes su slebs 'phral skul slong bka' 'bebs kyis gong lo'i zla 7tshes 〈nyin yar lha dgon bdag bzung byas pa dang / dar rgyas dgon pas ma yi tshur rgol la dus tshod nges med kyi 'gog rgol byas pas phan tshun gdong gtugs chung chung rgyun mi chad par byung ste gyod gzhi gzhi rgya je cher song ba red/gnyis pa/ bod dmag gis dar rgyas dgon par rgyab skyon byas rkyen khron dar mtha' srung dmag dang gdong gtugs byung ba'i skon/dar rgyas dgon pas bod la rgyab brten bcol ba ma zad/ rgyal phyi'i gnas tshul zhig kyang yod pa ste/ 1rdzo1ṭwāṃlo chapa mdo dgrar shor skabs dbyin ji'i ling hri gzhon pa the khe man gyi bar du 'dum sgrig byas te khron dar mtha' srung dang bod dmag dmag mtshams 'jog rgyu'i 'ching yig don tshan gsum rngapre'i zur snon nang‘‘rgya dmag gis dar rgyas dgon par brnyas rtsod byed mi chogari ces bkod yod pa dang / da res kyi 'khrug rtsod skabs tā la'i bla 177

mas dar rgyas dgon pa ni rgyun du‘‘gus zhabs ldan pa'i lcags ri’’yin lugs brjod pa de'i thog nas bod dar dang / bod dbyin dbar gyi 'brel ba yun ring zhing dam zab yin pa mthong thub/ dar rgyas dgon pas dmag rgyag 'go tshugs 'phral bod du gser dngul gyi 'bul rten dang sbrags mi mngags te rgyab skyor gnang rogs zhu bar btang zhing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis dar dgon la me mda' spus legs sum brgya sprad thog mda' dpon bde smon pa dmag dang bcas dpung rogs su btang ba sde dger slebs 'phral dar rgyas dgon pas be dar bar 'dum bya rgyu khas ma blangs pa'i gsar 'gyur thob 'phral tā lar snyan seng zhu bar btang zhing / tā las bod kyi sa gnas khag la dmag bsdu dgos pa'i bka' rgya btang ba dang chabs cig mda' dpon khe smad sras dang phyung ram pa 'go dmag dang bcas dpung snon du mngags gtong byas/ dar rgyas dgon par sngar yod mtshon cha'i thog bod nas sprad pa'i me mda' sum brgya bsnan na me mda' chig stong lhag tsam yod pa de dag gis khams dmag(rgya dmag)'gog pa'i grabs gshom byas pa dang /dkar mdzes khul du bsdus pa'i khams dmag(rgya dmag)nang thon bzhi bcu pa dang thon nyi shu rtsa dgu'i khongs kyi ying gcig yod pa phud/ da dung me skyos/sa len dang myul zhib len bcas khyon bsdoms dmag mi nyis stong yas mas zhig yod pa de dag gis gong lo'i zla 〈tshes 21nyin dar rgyas dgon dang dngos su gdong gtug byed 'go tshugs nas zla 9tshes 2nyin be ri dgon pa tshur blangs pa dang seng ris yod pa'i dar cha ser po(bod dmag gi dar cha)zhig/ kyang thob nas rgyal kha chung chung zhig blangs/ de rjes kro/ mas dmag gis nan cin srid gzhung la 'dum 'grig dgos pa'i glog 'phrin btang bar brten bod dmag gis the jus byed mi srid snyam nas kha gtad du bsdad pa'i 178

dgra bor snang chung du btang ba red/go min tang nan cin srid gzhung gis dkon mchog 'byung gnas dang /shad go le'ang bod du tā la dang 'brel ba byed par btang nas lo mang 'brel ba chad pari rgya bod kyi dus bab la 'gyur ba yong re byas kyang phan 'bras ma thon pa'i mus su dkar mdzes khul gyi dar be'i don rkyen langs ba dang /bod sog u yon lhan khang la be ri dargo/na dang grong mi dmangs tsho gas pa'i snyan zhu gcis mjug gnyis mthud du 'byor stabs bod sog u yon lhan khang gis khron dar mtha' srung spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa li'u wun hu'e la‘‘gang thub kyis bar 'dum yong thabs byas nas rkyen ngan med pa bzo rgyu'i’’glog 'phrin btang khing / tā la'i bla mas bod sog u yon lhan khang la‘‘paṇa chen gyis be dar dbon gnyis kyi rtsod gzhi'i skor bla ma bzang po zhes pa btang nas dkar mdzes sa srung rgya dpon gyi khog tu gzhug pas be rir phyogs pa dang dar dgon la rgol ba de ni rgya bod phyogs yongs kyi zhi mthun la 'gog rkyen bzos pa zhig yin pas/ de dbang du ma song bar gang mgyogs dmag mi phyir 'then gnang dgos’’zhes pa'i glog 'phrin btang 'dug kyang li'u yi btang 'byor glog 'phrin mang‘‘gyod gzhi 'di skor dar mdo srid ud dang bca' sdod dmag dpung bi snyan zhu gzhir bzung rdzong der(dkar mdzes)'phral du gzhung drang gi sgo nas thag gcod byed dgos pa'i bka' btang zin pa ma zad kru'u zhon win ched mngags bar 'dum byed par btang yang / dar dgon nas rloms sems cher skyed kyis snyan 'jog ma byas par zla 6tshes 1ṭwāṃnyin mngon gsal du drag dpung spyad de be ri yongs rdzogs btsan bzung byas pa ma zad/gal te be ri nas phyir 'then byed dgos na bod phyogs la snyan seng dgongs skor zhu dgos lugs sogs brjod 'dug’’ces 'khod/ 'di'i thad dngos 179

don ni bod dmagye gi snga sa nas dmag rgyag rtsis yod pa ste/ dar rgyas dargo na par mtshon cha'i rob/sa ram byas pa dang / dmyo/ga dpung btang ba/ sde dger dmag mi stong phrag la nye ba grabs gsog byas pa/ dar rgyas dgon pas be ri nas phyir 'then byed dgos na bod phyogs la snyan seng dgongs skor zhu dgos lugs brjod pa sogs la gzhigs na bod sa gnas srid gzhung sis be dar gnyis kyi don rkyen nang the jus byas pa'i ra 'phrod gsal po byung yod/dar rgyas dgon nga/ra bod phyogs kyi mi shugs rgyab skyor thob rjes zi'/ shugs slar gso thub pas zla 1kyatshes 2 2nyi na slar yang rgya dmag da nga gdong gretug byas/ rgya dmag gis sngar yo da 'gog srung bya yu‘ra gyi sa cha khag yang bskya ra tshur blangs naru/ bar 'dum bya rgyu'i bka' sgug nas bsdad/ zla 11nang tā las bod sog u yon lhan khang la tar btang ba'i nang‘‘be dar gnad don/ skor srid gzhung nas spyi khyab bkod 'doms pa 'i 'u la bar 'dum byed dgos pa'i bka' khyab gnang zin rung / zla 10tshes 24nyin rgya dmag sto/nga phragre tsam zhig gis glo bur rgol rdung byas pa rdoredi skor su zhig gis brtse srung ma zhus par gang byung byas yin nam de'i thad tar lan 'phral du yo da pa’’es dang /li'u yis zla 12par bod sog u lhan la tar btang don/‘8dmag dpung rnams bka(re bzhin mdu na bskyod byed mtshams ba(nag kyang / dar rgyas dgon la bod phyogs nas rgya ba snon byung bas zla 'angi/'e tshas shar la glo bur 'jab rgo‘la byas byung’’zhes 'khod/ dus der tā las bod sog u lhan la tar btang don‘‘li'u wun hu'e yis bod dmag sis rgya dmag la bskyar rgol byas byung zer ba 'di ni mig mang rtsed pa lta bu zhig yi na rngachi/sa kyod gzhi (re di 'dum 'grig byed par sring/ gzhung nas rgya bod dbar mthun lam byed shes pa'i mi sna 'igre shang mgyogs gros mol byed par ma btang na 'gri/ga thabatra4 med pa zhig red’’ces 180

'khod cing / mdor na dus bab ni de lta bu'i phyogs su 'phel nas phyogs gnyis kas kha gtad du dmag bshams te rang rang 'dod tshig mkhrigs bzung gis phan tshun skyon 'dzugs byed pa'i gnas tshul je sdug tu song zhing /nan cin srid gzhung gis gnas tshul dngos thes rtog byed par khams phyogs su mi sna zhig btang nas sngar bzhin bar 'dum bya rgyu'i byed phyogs rgyun krākhyongs kyis nyen kha'i dus bab skyob rgyu'i 'dod tshul 'dzin gyi yo/da/gsum pa/ nan cen srid gzhung gis thang kho'o san dar be'i gyod gzhi bar 'dum byed par btang ba'i brgyud rim/1ky-itsā2 1lo'i zla 2tshes 2 5nyin nan cin srid gzhung bis bod sog u yo na lhan khang gi u rngo/na thang kho'o san dang / ched gnyer u yon li'u tsan thing gnyis dar mdor btang nas dar be'i rtsod gzhi 'dum 'grig byed pa'i 'gan 'khur du ma ngags pa da nga bod sog u/ yon lhan khang gis kyang li'u wun hu'e la 'a/sa rogs su phebs dgos pa'i gdan zhu'i glog 'phrin zhig btang zhing / tā lar yang dmigs bkar mi sna gtan ljorikhel ched gtong gis dar rgyas dpo/na du ngo thug thag gcod dgos pa'i glog 9rephrin btang ba red/thang dang li'u gnyis rdog thon ma byas gong gi zla 2tshes 14nyin li'u wun hu'e yis bod sog u yon lhan khang la glog 'phrin btang 'byor nang‘‘bod phyogs ga dang cha/da' dpon gyis dmag mi bzhi stong tsam khrid de dkar mdzes dang yan ho khul gyi gal che'i 'gag gho khag la rgol rdung shugs drag byas nas jo mo dgon pa'ang btsan bzung byas 'dugari’ces dang / ji5nga li'u yis tshes 181

2 1nyin zhing kreng yon la glog 'phrin btang ba'i nang‘‘nga tshos bka' ltar dmag mtshams bzhag kyang / bod phyogs kyis go skabs 'dug snyam nas tshur rgol shugs drag byed kyi 'dug nga tsho'i mdun sar dmag shugs nyung bas zla 2tshes 9nyin be ri nas dkar mdzes kyi srung byar phyir 'then mi byed thabs med byung’’zhes dang / ‘‘yang bod da mag gis tshod bzung med par nye sar gtugs te dkar mdzes grong btsan bzung byas shing / rang dmag lu'u ho ru phyir 'then pas lam byang ngos kyi rdzong khag srung ma thub pa'i mus su bod dmag gis dmag khag bgos te pa yam/ dang da/ra lho sogs kyi sa khur la dpung 'jug byed pa'i nyen kha gnas bathin pa'i skabs su dpung snon btang na krung dbyang gi bka' dang 'gal rgyu ma zad/ tā las kyang bron der kha g.yar sa zhig byed nges yin cing / rgyal srung ma byas par rang sar bsdad na nyen kha nyin bzhin che ru 'gro rgyur brten ji 'gab bka' sasal yong ba’’zhes gsal/ de'i skor bod sog u yon lhan khang gis tā la ra zab nan gyis glog 'phrin btang bar zla 2tshes ’tswa 4nyin 'phrin lan 'byor gsal‘‘gnad don de'i 'byung rkyen gtso bo rgya phyogs nas dus zing gi 'go bslang ste dar rgyas dgon la bskyar rgol byas pas red/ nga tshos dmag mtshams bsgag nas bar 'dum bya rgyur sgug bsdad yod’’ces 'khod/ don dngos thog rgya dmag gis dmag mtshams bzhag kyang bod phyogs kyis dmag shugs 'phar bsnon byed cing / tā las dmag mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' btang yang bod dmag gi mdun sar rgyal kha thob pa des btsan bzung rgya skyed byed pa'i ham sems che ru song zhing / bod sog u yon lhan khang gis thang ho san dang li'u tsan thing la dus bkag gi sngon la thon dgos pa'i bka' btang ba ma zad/ li'u wun hu'e yis kyang glog 'phrin thog nas 'phral thon dgos pa'i 182

skul 'ded byas/ thang ho sa na zla 5tshes 2nyin khren tur 'byor 'phral glog 'phrin thog nas‘‘tā las da ñtsa 'ang ched bskos mi sna gtong rgyur gtan 'khel byas mi 'dug yan hwa'i sa shor nas lu ho'i nye mtshams su bcar zin pa'i snyan seng 'byor byung’’zhes pa'i snyan zhu phul nas bod dmag dkar yan nas phyir 'then dgos pa dang tsu dmag sngar yod sa srung khul du bskyod dgos pa las zhi gros bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul med pa red/ 'dir zhor du dar rgyas dgon dang be ri dgon gnyis thog ma'i 'khrug rtsod langs pa'i rgyud rim skor la 1kha22lor thang ho san khams su skyod skabs bris pa'i nyin tho'i khrod nas mdo tsamyo/ gleng rgyur 1920lo'i ston kar si ling ma khreng lung gis khams dmag(rgya dmag)khrid de dkar mdzes khul du rub 'dzom gis dkar mdzes krung kha grong tshor bca' sdod kyis dgra/ bo'i nyen zon med pa'i skabs dang bstun cha/sa rab brtan dza 'e/sa pa'i sa cha tshur 'phrog ste rim bzhin dar rgyaskyushrī dgon rṣa4 dmag rgyag rgyu'i sgo phye nas rgyal kha chung chung zhig thob kyang de 'phral lhod g.yeng snang med du bzhag stabs zla 12par bod phyogs nas dmag snon rim 'byor dar rgyas dgon dang mnyam 'brel gyis 1kha21lo'i zla 2tshes 9nyin drag shugs che ba'i dpung 'jug byed skabs ma si ling gis khams dmag la bkod 'doms byas nas rgol lan slog kyang bkod 'doms byed stangs mi 'dra ba dang / mdun sa'i dmag mi rnams yun ring gangs 'khyags/ khrod du sdod dgos pa'i zas bcud kyi mi ldang pas dmag rgyag rgyu'i sems shugs nyams pa'i dbang gis dmag rgyag thengs gcig la pham nyes byung ste dmag sar dmag mi drug brgya bdun brgya tsam zhig shi ba dang /dmag me brgya tsam zhig gson bzung byas shing / dmag 'phros rnams dkar ma dzes khul du bros kyang rgyab bsnon dpung dmag ma 'byor stabs rang 183

bzhin sdod blos ma bzod par 'thus mi cang yu'u wun gyis bod byo gas dang 'brel gtugs byas nas dkar mdzes de pazhin bar chod sa cha zhig tu brtsis rlos phyogs gre/nyis kyi dmag mi bca' sdod mi byed nga/'i gros mol byas pa nga/nga /kru'u o'o sde dpo'o de yang bod kyi nye phyogs yi na par dogs nas kru'u o'o ru bca' srung sdod ma phod par thengs gcig rang la le dbar nyis brgya phyir bshol gyis lu'u ho(brag 'go)bar du 9rethen nga ra brten bod dmag gis rgyal /ba thob mur dkar mdzes btsan bzung byas shing / ma si ling la yan hwa rdzong dpon gyi dza drag gi snyan zhu 'byor gsal 6‘li 'u dang lo'i ying gnyis thob/ ma'i bka' ltar dpung snon du yong nas nga/ma hwa mkhar 'dabs su (rebyor zin song’’zhes 'khod par brten grangs nyung be bod dachari/ga de dag phyi ra ldos mi thub pa med na'ang / lu'u khreng lu'i yi lu'i krang ma su 'u( rje sa su ngo log dam/ga gis gresad pa)yis dpung sno na du yong myopu khan dmag dpung rnams mgyogre/sa mūo ra lu'u ho 'a/ phyir log dgos pa'i ba7'ari btang nas yan hwa ma khar la do 'khu ra ma byas par brten yan hwa mkhar de rim/ bzhi na shub/sa zad rogres med du gyur pas dmag sa shor te rdzong gi las 'dzin krang da nga 'a sa bya sum cu tsam zhig /be smad mda' dpon gyis ba/son bzung byas nas chab mdor bskya'/ zhing /bod dmag gis phyogres gcig mas kru'u o/'o btsan bzung byas nga dang /cig shos nas li hwa rdzo nga la nyul 'ib/ byas naru/ dmag mi med nga shes 'api 'a/ rdzong de'i khongs kyi chung pa dang ༅ pa ba/nyis dang / li hwa dang lu'u ho rdzong so/ so'i sa khongs phyed tsam bcas btsan bzung byali shing / cod dmaka gis/ rgyal kha thob nu/ra mdun bskyod byed zhu/sarusmi ni 'u/nga sto/nga du rta rgyugres pa lta bu'i ngang tshul (ro brten lho byang lamyo/ khul dang / lu 'u khreng (dar ma do)mkhar gyi mi sems nyi ma 'khyol dka'i gyenas su gyar ba sogs mngo/ra na shis/ kham/sa yongs 184

la g.yo 'gul thebs pa red’’ces 'khod 'dugaskabs der pe cin du sdod pa'i bod kyi sku tshab dkon mchog 'byung ba/nas nas bod sog u yon lhan khang la‘‘tā la'i bla mas mda' dpon khyung ram pa cheribrel ba byed mkhan sku tshab tu gtan 'khel gnang tshar bas dar rgyas sa khul du u yon thang dang gros mol bya rgyur phebs sgugs zhus bsdad yod’’ces snyamyo seng zhus/ yang zla 6par li'u wun hu'e yis bod sog u yon lhan khang la btang ba'i glog 'phrin nang‘‘mda' dpon khe smad sras kyi yi ge btang ljobyor nang yan ho sa/ khul ni sngar nas tā la'i sa khongs su gtogs pa 'ig yin paskyushrī ngas gong gi bka' ltar dpung da mag khrid nas yan hor yong ba yin/li thang da nga / chung shag rnga pa bcas kyang bod khongs yin gshis bod kyi do dam bya rgyur nges par phyir sprod bya dgos’’zhes 'khod 'dug par brten ‘‘ngas(li'u wun hu'e)yan ho dang / chung shag rnga pa bcas la srung byar dmag me btong rtsis yod’’ces 'khod 'dug khams kyi gyod don rni be dar rtsod gzhi nas mthar khron bod dmag 'khrug cig tu gyur zhing / 'on kyang bod phyogs kyi da/migs yul ni khams bod sa mtshams kyi phyogs su 'gyur ba gsal por mngon thub pa zhig red/thang ho san zla 7tshes 〈nyin lu'u hor 'byor 'phral li'u tsan thing dkar mjetshos su khyung rim pa dang 'brel gtugs gros mol byed par btang ste‘‘nga tsho'i ḍāredod tshul mtha' 'khyongs byed dgos pa las snang chung mthun thabs byed ni/ rung / dmag mi phyir 'then dgos pa de sngon 'gro'i cha rkyen du 'jos rgyur brtson len byed dgos’’zhes gdams shing li'u dkar matres su slebs nas khyung rim dang gros mol skabs khyung ram pas khams kyi‘‘don rkyen 'di ni gal (ragangs che bar brten rang nyid gcis/ pus 'gan len thub thabs bral 185

bas chab mdor bka' blon nga phod dang bka' gros gnang bar phebs nga/gos’’zhes brjod pa las dkar yan nas dmag mi phyir 'then bya rgyu dang krang sogs glod bkrol gtong rgyu'i gros gzhe gnyis la lan 'debs ma byas pa red/ zla 7tshes 2〈nyin bod sog u yon lhan khang la tā las btang ba'i glog 'phrin nang‘ dkar yan khul ni sngar nas bod khongs yin gshis bod dmag gis bdag bzung byed dgos nges yin zhing / ched mngags pa thang gis bod dmag phyir 'then dgos pa'i gros 'go thengs mang 'don pa de ni bden don min pa'i brjod tshul zhig red’’ces 'khod pa ma zad/ nga phod pas li'u tsan thing la btang ba'i yi se/'i nang du'ang‘‘dkar yan bod dmag gi bzung ba ni sngar gyi sa khongs tshur blangs pa zhig yin’’zhes 'khod pa sogs kyi brjod bab ni tā la'i glog 'phri na dang gre/cig mtshungs yin zhing / gong gsal tshul phyogs bsdus byas na bod phyogs kyis shis khams khul du nang 'dzul byed pa de ni sa mtshams rgya skyed sa/tong rgyu'i 'dod tshul sngar nas yod pa mthong thub/dar be'i rtsod gzhir kha g.yar ba de ni gyod gzhi rgya cher gtong rgyu'i me stag lta bur brtsis nas dkar yan btsan bzung nyag rkyang byed pa las dmag mi phyir 'then bya rtsis rtsa ba nas med khar/ gros mol bya yul dkar mdzes su gtan 'khel byas pa de yang rjes su chab mdor bsgyur pa sogs khag dkri sna tshogs kyis nar 'gyangs byas shing / zla 〈pa'i zla mjug la tā las glo bur du bod sog u yon lhan khang la‘‘dmag mi phyir 'then byed phyogs skor brgyud zhu bya rgyu dka' tshegs che bas u yon thang lags sngar bzhin chab mdor nges phebs gnang rogs’rizhes glog 'phrin btang nas gros mol bya rgyu'i rnam pa zhig bstan cing / dkar mjes kyi gyod gzhi nar 'gyangs song ba dang / tā la'i blo 'gyur bas zhi bde yong re me da par brten li'u wun hu'e yis zla 9tshes 186

29shin bod sog u lhan la glog 'phrin btang don‘‘gal te tā las mu mthud mkhregs bzung byas na krung dbyang nas bka' phab ste mtsho sngon dang yun nan phyogs gnyis nas mnyam rub kyis bod la kha gtad cag na gtor pham gtong dka' ba zhig min’’zhes 'khod pa dang / thang ho san gyi glog 'phrin btang yong ba'i 'dod tshul yang de dang mtshungs shing / bod sog u lhan gyis snga phyi'i glog 'phrin khag gnyis khren brgyud zhing kreng yon la brgyud zhu byas pa'i bka' 'a na du‘‘da lta byang shar khul du phyi phyogs kyi gnod 'tshe tshabs che yod pa'i skabs 'dir lho nub mtha' khul du zhi ba'i thabs lam spyad na legs/dmag pho/gas dang rdzas mdel kha gsab bya rgyur gnas skabs brel ba med’’ces 'khod cing / bod phyogs kyi byang shar khul du dus 'gyur byung ba dang /nan cin nas bzod sgom byed pa'i rnam pa mthong bas sngar las mkhregs su phyin pa red/ zla 10nang khyung rim pas thang ho san la yi ge zhig btang ba'i nang‘‘dar be'i ser skya rnams tā la'i bla ma'i khongs su gtogs pa dang /khams /zul 'di yang bod khongs yin pas sa mtshams dbye rgyur dgos pa med/dar be'i 'khrug rtsod ni khron dmag gi phung dkrug bslangs nas byung ba zhig yin’’zhes smyo ham chen pos bshad pa der da dung bar 'dum bya rgyu'i bsam blo gtong thabs ga la yod/ bod sog u lhan gyis khams bod sa mtshams kyi gnad don ni gal 'gangs che zhing rtsod gzhi je mang du 'gro bzhin par brten thang lha san gyi dbang tshad kho nas thag gcod thub pa zhig min stabs gzhi nas dkon mchog 'byung gnas brgyud tā lar glog 'phrin thog nas dmigs 'dzusas mi sna btang nas snga 'phros thang ho san dang mnyam du dar be'i rtsod gzhi thag gcod dgos pa dang / gnad don gzhan rnams gros gzhi gzhan zhig gi thog nas thag gcod bya rgyu'i gros mol byas pa de ni bod dmag gi 187

gnas skabs dkar yan sa khul btsan bzung chog pa'i khas blangs pa lta bu zhig yin/ tā las gros gzhir mos mthun yod pa'i glog 'phrin btang thog 'brel 'thus khyung ram pa btang ba dang / thang ho san nas kyang de don 'brel gtugs byas nas thag chod yong re byas/thang ho san gyis bod sog u yon lhan khang la 1921lo'i zla 11tshes 2 0nyin btang ba'i glog 'phrin nang‘‘li'u tsan thing lu'u ho ru phyir log gis brjod gsal khyung ram pas thang la 'brel bshad bya rgyu'i mngag cha byas byung ba ma zad 'dod blor bab pa'i rnam 'gyur dang bcas gnad don gzhan rnams thag gcod bde po yin lugs brjod 'dug gong tshes nyin li'u dkar mdzes su skyod song bar 'gan babs gros mol bya rgyur sngon la dmag mtshams bzhag nas phyir 'then dgos pa dang / de rjes skobs bstun dar be'i don gnad gros mol byas te gyod gzhi gang mgyogs khrun thag chod pa dgos rgyu'i mngags gdams byas pa yin’’zhes gsal/ thang gis yan hwa nas zla 11pa'i nang glog 'phrin thog nas ngar rte ma/tshams 'jog rgyu'i cha rkyen snyan seng zhus pa'i gtso bo'i nang don du‘8'dir khyung ram pa dang gros mthun gyi cha rkyen don tshan brgyad gtan 'bebs byas pa gsham gsal/ 1 dkar yan khul du gnas skabs bod dmag gis bca' srung bya rgyu dang / rjes su gros gzhi gzhan gyi thog nas thag gcod bya rgyu/ 2 dar be'i don rkyen khyung ram pas bden don gzhir bzung thag gcod byed du 'jug rgyu/ 2 phyogs gnyis so so'i mdun sar dmag mi nyis brgya re bca' sdod bya rgyu/ 4 chung shag da/nga / rnga pa/ kru'u o'o bcas kyi sa cha phyir sprod bya rgyu/ 5 dar rgyas dgon pas rgya rigs tshong par chad pa'i dngul bun rnams gang mgyogs phyir slog dgos pa/ 6 gson bzung byas pa'i khron dmag rnams glod 188

'grol gtong dgos pa/ 7 ma su'u dang khyung ram pas so so'i mi btang nas phan tshun thugs rje che zhu dgos pa/ 〈 tshong las dang 'grim 'grul skyar gso byed dgos pa bcas so’’yang de dang chabasacig〈be ri mi dmangs la bkod sgrig bya thabs〉zhes pa'i don tshan drug 'khod pa'i yig cha zhig bzhag pa rjes su nus pa ma thon stabs phyir bsdu byas/thang ho san gyis dar rgyas dgon dang be ri ni sngar nas dkar mdzes rdzong gi khengs su gtogs shing / dkar mdzes ni nga tsho'i sa khongs la brten de ga'i pyod gzhi 'dum sgrig byed par gnad don lhag mi srid/ 'on kyang deng skangs rdzong de bod phyogs kyi bzung nas 'dum sgrig kho na bshad de sa gnas kyi bdag dbang skyur na mi 'grig pa'i ngos 'dzin byas par brten thang gis dalar mdzes nas dmag mi phyir 'then ma byas na 'dum sgrig yong thabs med paḍiri 'dod tshul mtha' 'khyongs byas shing / dkar yan bod dmag gis babyung thub phyin bod phyogs rang na/sa do dam bya rgyur sprod rgyu yang / gal te ma thub na 191rdolor shor ba'i sa cha rnams bod phyogs la cha rkyen med par mi sprod thag gcod byas mthar cha rkyen don tshan khag gtan 'khel rjes thang gis glog 'phrin btang ba'i nang‘‘rgyal khab kyi gnas tshul rnyog 'dzings 'di lta bu'i 'og rang rang lta ba mkhregs 'dzin zhu ga 'a/ phod/ stabs legs pa zhig la thang ho san gyis gyong po byas pa dang li'u tsan thing gi bar 'dum byed bzhin par khyung ram par kha gtad cag pas chung shag dang / kru'u o'o phyir len thub byung’’zhes 'khod/ der nan cin zhing kreng yon nas‘‘thang u yon dang bod kyi 'thus mi khyung ram pa gnyis gros mthun byas pa'i shis khams kyi don rkyen thag gcod byed thabs don tshan brgyad de da lta'i gnas tshul(dus 189

bab)la gzhigs na 'tsham pa zhig yin pas de ltar lag len byed dgos’’zhes bka' btang ba red/ 'on kyang thang ho san dang khyung ram pa gnyis kyis sa yig 'god rgyu'i gros mol byed bzhin pa'i skabs mtsho sngon phyogs nas yus hru'u(skye mdo)la dmag snon btang bas khyung ram pa rong pa tshar dmag bsdu dmag grabs byed par myur bskyod byas rkyen sa yig 'god pa'i 'gro lugs ma grub par lus pa dang dus mtshungs nang khul dang phyir skyod shis khams kyi mi tshos dkar mdzes dang yan hwa dus thog tshur len ma thub par yi ma rangs pa byed kyi yod/ skabs der bod phyogs nas mtsho sngon gyis yus hru'u la dmag snon byed lugs thos pa so gas kyi skor li'u wun hu'e yis zla 12tshes 12nyin bod sog u yon lhan khang la btang ba'i glog 'phrin nang‘‘myul zhib pa'i snyan zhur gzhigs na yus hru'u khul du rta dmag stong phrag lhag tsam yod pa dang /ka tang dang gdugs rtse dgon pa gnyis bzung 'dug de nas chab mdo bar nyin lam gsum las med rkyen bod phyogs dngangs skrag bskyed nas sde dge dang be ri sa mtshams kyi mda' shog gnyis 'gog srung du btang 'dug’’ces 'khod/ mtsho sngon gyis yus hru'u la dpung rogs byas nas bod phyogs la dmag rub rgyag pa'i dogs gzhi chags nga/ra brten zhi mthun gyi rnam pa thor zhig tu song ba dang / bod dmag gis su meng dang nang lan khul la dpung rgol byed rtsis yod pa de'i thog nas tā las mtsho sngon gyi mtha' mtshams btsan bzung byas nas bod chen po zhes pa grub rgyu'i re stong 'chang ba mthong thub/1kha2 1lo'i zla 1tshes 1nyin thang ho san gyi bod sog u yon lhan khang la btang ba'i glog 'phrin nang‘‘khyung ram pas chung shag dang kru'u o'o rdzong gnyis phyer sprod gtan nas mi byed par de ni tā la'i bka' 'brel yin zhes brjod de rang phyogs nas bod la 'brel gtugs byas pa phan med du gyur song’dizhes 190

dang / gong zla'i tshes 6nyin li'u wun hu'e yi glog 'phrin nang‘‘khyung ram pas thang u yon la yi ge btang ste rgya bod sa mtshams ni lu'u ting zam nga bar yin dgos/ gal te phyir 'then byas na'ang ching nying nas sa mtshams dbye dgos zhes klad mkhregs kyi rnam 'gyur ston par brten da lta dmag 'khrug langs grabs yod’’ces dang / thang ho san gyi glog 'phrin nang‘‘zla 2tshes 10nas phyoges gnyis pos 'brel gtugs kyi 'gan dbang 'khur mi dgos pa'i khyab bsgrags zin song bas zla phyi mar khren tur phyir log bya rgyu yin’’zhes 'khod 'dug de sngon thang dang khyung ram pas gtan 'bebs byas pa'i gros mthun gyi cha rkyen la ritā las 'gyur ldog yang yang btang bas zhi mthun gyi rnam pa thor zhig tu song ba de'i thog nas sa gnas srid gzhung gis dar rgyas dgon la rgyab skyor bya rgyur kha g.yar nas shis khams sa khul btsan bzung bya rgyu'i dmigs yul ngo ma ni bod chen po zhes pa zhig rim bzhin grub re byed kyi yod pa'i ra'aphrod gsal po byung ba red/bzhi pa khron khams mtha' srung spyi khyab li'u wun hra'e la shis khams don rkyen thag gcod bya rgyu'i 'gan dbang spra da rjes zhi ba'i cha rkyen gsar du bzos pa/1kha2 2lo'i zla 2par bod sog u lhan gyis thang dang li'u gnyis kyi glog 'phrin gzhir bzung gong la snyan seng zhus pas nan cin zhing kren yon nas‘‘shis khams don rkyen skor khron khams mtha' srung spyi khyab pa li'u wun hu'e la 'gan 'khur du bcug nas thang ho san rgyal sar snyan zhu 'bul bar 191

yong dgos’’pa'i bka' phab/ gnas tshul de tā las shes rjes phyogs gcig nas bod sog u yon lhan khang la glog 'phrin btang nas‘‘be ri'i gyod gzhi'i rkyen rtsa si khron phyogs nas bslangs pa yin bzhin du da lam srid gzhung nas gyod don thag gcod byed po li'u wun hu'e bskos mngag gnang ba der bod 'bangs rnams hang sangs kyi 'dug gal te gyod gzhi 'di khron khams mtha' srung spyi khyab li'u wun hu'e la thag gcod byed du bcug na rgya bod mthun lam bar mtshams chadatshonges red’’ces ngo rgol byed pa'i rnam pa ston pa dang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas bod dmag la mtsho sngon du dpung 'jug byed dgos pa'i bka' phab/ mtsho sngon gyis ma kru'u zhis nan cin dmag don u lhan la glog 'phrin btang bar bod dmag gis zla 2tshes 24nyin rkang btsugs rnyog dra btsal nas sha'o su'u mang la dpung 'jug btsan bzung byas pa dang / zla 4tshes 4nyin yang bskyar nang lan la dpung 'jug btsan bzung byas shing /nga tsho'i dmag dpung tshang ma yus hru'u la phyir 'then byas kyang yus hru'u yi nye 'khor phyogs bzhir bod dmag rub bsdus byas 'dug’’ces 'khod/ nan cin srid 'dzin gyis sngar bzhin mtsho sngon dang bod so sor glog 'phrin btang ste zhi ba'i thag gcod dgos pa'i gnas bshad rnying pa de bskyar zlos byas kyang phan 'bras thon ga la srid/ bod dmag gis mtsho sngon lho rgyud du nang 'dzul byas pa dang dus mtshungs yang bskyar shis khams khul la dpung 'jug byas te dmag 'khrug bskyar du bslangs shing / zla 4pa'i nang dang / zla 5tshes 2yang de rjes thengs gcig bcas so sor li'u wun hu'e kyis bod sog u yon lhan khang la glog 'phrin btang 'byor gyi rdo don‘‘bod dmag gi dmag shugs mang che ba dkar mdzes dang yan ho khul du gcig sdud kyis nga tshor dpung rgol byed rtsis 'dug na khyod tshos glog 'phrin thog nas mtsho sngon gyi ma hre krang la 192

yus hru'u nas dpung 'jug mnyam rub byed dgos pa'i bka' phab dgos’’zhes dang / ‘‘rang dmag gi ta ke ri bor bod dmag dang dza drag gi dmag 'thab byas rjes kru'u o'o blangs pa dang / tshes 1nyin yan hā yang tshur blangs/ tshes khanyin dkar mdzes rdzong mkhar la dpung 'jug byas pa yin/da lta stobs shugarnga 5 gcig sgril gyis dar be'i khul la skor rdung byed bzhin yod ces 'khod 'dug zla 7tshes 2 0nyin yang bskyar li'u wun hu'e yis glog 'phrin 'byor gsal/ tshes 9nyin bod dmag gis rgyab skyor yod rlom byed pa'i dar rgyas dgon par zang zing bzos nas btsan 'phrog byas pa dang /rgyal kha'i ngang rong pa tsho khul du dpung bskyod byas te/ spyi lo 1kha20zla 7par dar be'i gyod gzhi ma byung gong gi rnam pa bskyar gso thub song’’zhes dang / ya nga‘‘bod dmag pham nas sde dger bros byol byas kyang / nyin gnyis kyi sngon du phyi phyogs kyi go mtshon dpe gsar can mang po nyos te mu mthud dmyo/ga rgyag rgyu'i gra sgrig byed bzhin 'dug’’ces 'khod/ tshes 2 2nyin rtsi‘ 'brel pu'u yis bod sog u lhan la gsang yig btang don dbyin ji'i hin sdod spyi khyab kyi snyan zhu ltar na tā las hin sdod dbyin ji'i srid gzhung la yi ge zhig btang ste dmas/ spyod rdzas mdel 'tshong rogs zhes brjod don ltar dbyin jis spom mda' tshang rgyud dus bkag gong me skyogs kyi mdel sgam lnga ngacu tham pa dang / me mda'i mde'u sogs lha sar dbor rgyu byas 'dug’’ces dang / da dung‘‘bod dbyin gnyis kyi gsang ba'i chings yig bzhag nas dbyin jis dmag spyod mtshon cha 'bor chen rogs 'don byed rgyu dang / bod kyi yig zam dang / mkha' 'grul/ gter kha sogs kyi dbang cha dbyin jir sprod rgyu byas 'dug par brten don rkyen 'dir rgyal phyi'i 'brel nga/'i gnas tshul yod pa don dngos thos/ nas dmar rjen du thon pa 193

redari’ khron khams dmag gis dar be rong bcas su dmag gi rgyal kha thob khar/zla 7tshes 27nyin sde dge yang tshur blangs shing / zla ṭwāṃpa'i zla stod la cin sdod bod kyi 'thus mi dkon mchog 'byung gnas sogs kyis bod sog u lhan la tā las btang ba'i yi ge'i nang don gsel 'grol byas par/ khams bod don rkyen thad bod phyogs kyi krung bod mthun lam dang rgyab 'gal byed kyi med/'on kyang gyod don thag gcod byed par li'u wun hu'e mngags na 'dum sgrig yong re med la/ de las ldog ste phyogs 'gal je cher 'gro srid pa de'i thad bod phyogs nas 'gan len bya rgyu min zhes dang / bod la nye phyogs byed mkhan u ming yon gyis tshes 6nyin bod sog u lhan la‘‘khyed tshos bod mi'i blo dogs sel phyir parṇa/ chen mtsho sngon du bskyod rgyur bkag 'gog byed dgos pa ma zad/ bod la ched bskos mi sna mngags nas tā la paṇa chen gyi go gnas dang / dbyin mi'i gnas tshul yod med rtog zhib gnang rgyu/ gdan sa gsum gyi brtse dung dang 'brel ba/ mdza' bshes mthun lam sogs yag po yong ba gnang rogs’’zhes pa'i glog 'phrin 'byor zhing / paṇa chen ni de snga gtsang khul du 'u thug nas spyi 192 4lor mes rgyal nang sar bros phebs pa zhig yin cing / khong gis mes rgyal la lhag bsam byed pa de tā la'i phyogs kyi dbyin jir nye 'brel byed pa dang 'gal zlar gyur par brten phan tshun phyogs zhen byed kyi yod/nan cin srid dbang gis 1kha2 2lor paṇa chen la cho lo dang / go gnas 'bul rgyu'i bka' btang / zla 12pa'i tshes 24nyin paṇa chen gyis nan cin du las 'gan 'khur ba'i mdzad sgo spel ba red/ khong gi go gnas dang las 'gan la der yod sa gnas srid grezhung gi mi snas phrag dogs byed pa 194

dang / khong gi skabs de'i gsol dpon mkhan po blo bzang rgyal mtshan gyis kyang bod sog u lhan gyi bod don khru'u yi khru'u krang gi 'gan (rekhur nas bod don gtso gnyer byed kyi yod/ bod sa/ gnas srid gzhung gi cin sdod sku tshab dko na ma chorngaka/ 'byung gnas sogs kyis khru'u de'i mnga' 'og tu sdod 'dod mi byed cing / bod don gros mol thad phyogs gnyis kyi 'gal zla nyin bzhin che ru song rkyen dar be'i don rkyen thog mar langs skabs tā las paṇa chen gyis khams phyogs ngo sru/nga byed kyi 'dus ces glog 'phrin thog nas skyon 'dzugs byas yod snyer dar rgyas dgon par rgyab skyor byed dgos pa'i rgyu mtshan yang der brtsis pa zerid/ lo de'i zla ba gsum pa bzhi pa'i nang khams bod kyi dmag don glo bur dza drag tu phyin pa dang / bod dmag nas mtsho sngon mtha' mtshams la nang 'dzul byanu/ pa'i gnas tshul khag la'ang dkon mchog 'byung gnas sogs kyis kha g.yar sna tshogs byas te paṇa chen gyi go ming dang / bod sog khru'u krang gi las tshan la tshig mtshon 'debs rnga4/ ngo rgol mtha' 'khyongs byas pa ma zad/gdan sa gsum gyi ming g.yar nas gsal bsgrags spel gsal‘‘paṇa chen la gnang ba'i cho lo dang / go gnas/ sku srung ru khag go mtshon bcas dang cin khams so sor bca' sdod don gcod khang sogs srid gzhung nas 'phral du phyir 'then gnang ste krung bod mthun lam la 'gal cha mi yong ba'i re ba zhu rgyu yin’’zhes dang / bod phyogs kyi mgrin tshab pa u ming yon gyis kyang de dang chos mtshungs kyi tā la'i bsam 'char rnams sba gsang med par bton pa de'i thog nas dar be'i don rkyen de khams bod kyi rtsod gzhir 'khel ba ma zad/tā la dang paṇa chen da bar gyi de snga'i 'gal zla bskyar du langs pa'i gnad don sngar las rnyog 'dzing che ru song ba mthong thub/ 'on kyang khron dmag la rgyal 195

kha rim bzhin thob nga/'i /// bod dmas/ sde dger pham bros rjes teng ho dang /khri chos/ dpal yu/la sogs rdzong khag na/sa rim bzhin phyir 'then byas nas 'bri chu'i nub phyogs su sa sru/nga byas te bsdad/ khron bod dmag gnyis kha gtad du gnas pa'i gnas tshul 'og mu mthud phar rgol byed khag par brten nan cin tshan mu'u pu'u yis mtsho sngon dang si khron gnyis kyi dmag dpung la dmag mtshams 'jog dgos pa'i bka' btang ba dang / bod sog u lhan brgyud tā lar sngon du hang kha 'bri chu'i ngogs kyi gru kha khag gi dmag mi phyir 'then thog phyogs gnyis phan tshun gdong gtugs mi yong phyir dung pho dang /'u khreng / cang kha rdzong sogs bar chod kyi rsā khul byas nas gnas skabs ri mag mi bca' sdod ma byas na zhi ba'i thag gcod bya rgyur phan thogs yod pa'i gros 'go bton cing zla 10tshes 1nyin mtsho sngon gyi ma kru'u zhis bod sog u lhan la glog 'phrin btang 'byor nang‘‘bod phyos/sa kyis de sngon btsan bzung byas pa'i mtsho sngon lho khul gyi ta dang / sho'o su/'u mang / nang len sogs kyi sa cha khag zla khatshes 2dang tshes 2nyin snga rting du tshur blangs zin zhes 'khod/dus bab de lta bus bod dmag gi gal che'i rgyab phyogs dmag don brten gzhi chab mdor tshabs che'i 'jigs snang bskul zhing / bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis bod kyi gnas tshul ha cang tshabs cher gyur pas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi rgyab rten yong re ma byas na mi 'grig pa'i ngos 'dzin byas pa dang /zla 10tshes 7nyin nan cin bod sog u lhan la nan cin phyi 'brel pu'u'i yi ge zhig 'byor gsal‘‘krung gor bca' sdod dbyin ji'i phyi 'brel las tshab pa dbyin ke len gyis khams bod rtsod gzhi rgya cher phyin yod pa dang / khron dmag chab mdo'i nye phyogs su bcar yod pas nges par du khyed tshos bya thabs spel nas dmag mtshams 'jog tu 'jug dgos zer 'dug der nga 196

tshos dbyin ji'i las sdob par khams kyi do na rkyen skor la dmag ud kyis mtsho dzon dang si khron/ tā la bcas la dmag mtshams bzhag nas krung dbyang gis thag gcod bya rgyu'i bka' sgug dgos pa'i glog 'phrin btang tshar ba red ces 'di ga pu'u nas dbyin ji'i phyi 'brel las tshab la lan rgyag rgyur thag bcad zin’’zhes 'khod 'dug de'i thog nas dar be'i don rkyen la bod sa gnas srid gzhung gi the gtogs bya rgyur ngan bskul dang rgyab skyor byed mkhan dbyin ji yin pa gsal por mtshon thub/ skabs der si khron gyi cun nyi shu pa'i li'u shang gis cun nyer brgyad pa'i te shi'i ha'u dang cun nyer dgu pa'i than sung ya'o bcas dang mnyam 'brel byas te/ cun nyer bzhi pa'i li'u wun hu'e la ngo rgol byed pa'i nang 'khrug langs nyer yod pa dang khams bod khul du dgun dus zin pas phyogs gnyis kar dmag rgyag rgyur dka' ngal yod pa ma zad/ mi tshos shis khams phyogs su gyod gzhi gang mgyogs khrun thag chod pa byas te stobs shugs gcig sdud kyis si khron gyi gnas tshul thag gcod rgyur re ba byed pa bcas kyis khams bod gnyis zhi mthun yong rgyur skul 'ded byung ba red/lo deri zla ba bcu pa'i nang tā las mda' dpon khyung ram pa btang nas khron khams mtha' srung spyi khyab pas btang ba'i 'brel gtugs pa teng nang dang / cang yu wun gnyis dang gros mol byas te spyi lo 1922lo'i zla ba bcu pa'i nang sde dge'i sa khongs 'bri chu'i nub phyogs kyi gam mthor dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i cha rkyen don tshan drug gi yig char ming rtags bkod pa red/ yig cha'i nang don mdor bsdus gsham gsal/don tshan dang po/ rgya bod phyogs gnyis kyis zhi ba'i gros mthun dang len byed dgos pa dang / 'khon spang mthun sgrig dgos pa/ rgya bod 197

sanyis kyi lo rgyus thopa ska thagre ma chod nga/'i gyong/ rdan mtha' dag krung dbyang dang tā la gnyis kyis thag sacod ji gnang la bhan 'jog zhu dgos/don tshan gnyis pa/ 'bri chu'i smad rgyud kyi chu'i shar ngogs rgya dmag gi ches mdun sa chan pa dang / nub ngogs bod dmag gi ches mdun sa yi na par gtan 'khel bas/ phyogs gnyis su zhig gis kyang de nas gom pa gang yang brgal mi chogadon tshan gsum pa/ phyogs gnyis kyis sngon bskyod gdong len dmag rnams/ min go'i lo nyer gcig lo'i zla 10tshes ṭwāṃnas zla 10tshes 2〈de bod zla ṭwāṃpa'i tshes 5nas tshes 2khabar la phyir 'then byed dgos pa ste/ rgya dmag rnams o si dang / sde dge/ dpal yul bcas kyi shar phyogs su phyir 'then bya rgyu dang / bod dmagre/ rnams sga steng dang / dung pho/ 'u khreng gi nub tu phyir 'then dgos/ rgya dmag gi ches mdun sa te ho dang /dpal yul/ sde dge bcas dang / bod dmag gi ches mdun sa rem mda'/ dung pho/ 'u khreng bcas so sor phyogs gnyis kas bca' sdod dmag mi nyis brgya las brgal mi chog par/ phyogs gnyis kas mi sna btang nas phan tshun blta skul bya rgyu/don tshan bzhi pa/ dmag mtshams 'jog pa dang phyir 'then byas pa'i nyin nas bzung phyogs gnyis kas 'grim 'grul slar gso byed dgos pa dang /'tshong pa 'gro 'ong la 'gog rkyen mi yong ba byed dgos pa/ de'ang phyogs gnyis gzhung phyogs kyis sprad pa'i lag 'khyer la gzhi 'dzin rgyu/ nang bstan chos la dad pa dang / chos khrims la srung brtsi zhu dgos pa'i snying don gzhir bzung nas khams bod kyi dgon khag tu chos 'chad nyan dang 'gro 'ong byed pa'i grwa btsun tshang mar phyogs gnyis kas srung skyob byed dgos/198

don tshan lnga pa/ yig cha 'dir ming rtags bkod pa'i nyin rshanu/ bzung khas/ so so'i srid gzhung la phul te yig tshags su nyar 'jog byas nas thun mong gis brtsi srung zhu dgos/don tshan drug pa/ cha rkyen 'di dag rgya bod phyogs gnyis kar 'tshams pa zhig yin rung / gal te mi 'tshams pa yod na rjes su krung dbyeng gis tā la dang mnyam du bzo bcos gnang rgyu bcas so/ dmag mtshams 'jog rgyu'i gan rgya bzhag pa des dar be'i don rkyen las byung ba'i khams bod kyi dmyo/ga 'khrug de skabs shig ring mjug sgril zhing / mtsho bod gnyis kyi dmag 'khrug de spyi lo 1922lo'i zla 6tshes 15nyin mtsho bod chings yig la ming rtags bkod nas thag chod pa red/ chings yig gi nang don gsham gsal/don tshan dang po/ rdo bstan dgon pa'i bla sprul grwa dmangs sdod sgrig bod byogs nas sgrubs dgos pa las mtsho sngon phyogs nas the jus byed rgyu med /don tshan gnyis pa/ ching kho dang ldang mtho dgon par phyogs gnyis gdong thug mi yong phyir dmag mi bca' sdod mi byed rgyu/don tshan gsum pa/ bod phyogs kyis mtsho sngon la brnyas bcos byas na yus hru'u(skye mdo)mtha' khul du gnas pa'i mi rigs khag gi bde 'jags la 'gan len bya rgyu dang / mtsho sngon gyis bod la brnyas bcos byas na shīg rikha nyer lnga'i stong dpon dang brgya dpon tshos khul de'i bod phyogs kyi bde 'jags 'gan yongs su len rgyu/ gros mthun bzhag rjes mtsho sngon gyi dmag mi rnams dpa' phang dgon pa nas phyir 'then bya rgyu dang / 'dzin bzung byas pa'i bod dmag brgya lhag tsam yod pa rnams phyir bskyel bya rgyu bcas so/199

gong gsal mthun gros bzhag rjes bod dang mtsho sngon bar gyi dmag don 'khrug gzhi mjug sgril ba red/rgya bod gnyis kyi dmag mtshams 'jog pa'i cha rkyen gtan 'khel zin nas dmag mtshams bzhag pa des gnas skabs ring zhi lhod byung yod na'ang /dmag 'khrug gi 'byung rkyen dar be'i gnad don thag gcod yag po ma byung stabs 'gal rkyen rang zhir ma song ba dper na khams bod dmag 'khrug nang da ra rgyas dgon pa bsregs gtor song ba dang / grwa pa nyis stong lhag tsam yod pa rnams 'bri chu'i g.yas g.yon du kha 'thor te bod phyogs dang mnyam 'brel gyis dmag 'khrug nang zhugs shing / dmag mtshams bzhag rjes lhag bsdad gnad don thag gcod 'os 'tshams bya rgyu ni sa gnas bde 'jags yong rgyur dgos nges shig red/ skabs der tā la bcu gsum pa 'das pa dang / bod phyogs kyi btsan nyams kyang zhan du song bas don med zing cha mi 'byung ba'i sgo nas dar be'i lhag bsdad gyod gzhi gom gang mdun spos kyis thag gcod thub rgyu'i cha rkyen ldan yod pa red/de nas bod phyogs kyis 1924lo'i zla 5 nang mda' dpon mtsho sgo ba btang nas sde dge rdzong dpon cang yu wun dang mnyam du e mdar dar rgyas dgon pa'i grwa pa phyir log kyi gnad don thag gcod bya rgyu'i thad la gros bsdur byas shing / skabs der dar rgyas dgon pa nas kyang nan cin la grwa pa dgon par log rgyu'i re 'dun zhu bar btang yang / dar rgyas dgon pa gyang ror gyur zin pas grwa pa log kyang sdod gnas med rkyen dgon pa bskyar gso bya rgyu ni gnad don thag gcod mthar phyin thub rgyu'i 'gag rtsa zhig yin zhing /nan cin srid gzhung gis grwa pa phyir log bya rgyur mos mthun mi byed mthu med byung ba dang / grwa pa rnams sems bde po yong phyir dgon pa bskyar gso'i 200

gron dngul sgor nyis khri sprad pa dang / khams bod sa gnas srid 'dzin la gros mol gyis legs sgrub dgos pa'i glog 'phrin btang bar/ le'u wun hu'e yis btang 'byor 'phrin lan du‘‘nga tshos mi sna mngags te bod phyogs dang gros mol byas rjes zla 5tshes 17nyin grwa dmangs bkod sgrig bya rgyu'i rgya bod gros mthun don tshan bcu gnyis la ming rtags bkod zin’’zhes 'khod/gros mthun don tshan bcu gnyis ni/1 snga lo rgya bod zhi mthun bzhag pas da lta khyim tshang gcig tu gyur zhing / dar rgyas dgon pa'i bkod sgrig bya rgyur phyogs gnyis kas mthun sgrig bya thabs gros mthun 'jog rgyu/ 2 dar rgyas dgon par bkod sgrig ma byas gong phyogs gnyis go 'dzol byung yod pas/ da lam zla 5tshes 17nas zla 6tshes 6bar gyi dus yun nang der yod dmag mi rnams phyogs gnyis nas btang ba'i mi sna'i blta skul 'og phyir 'then byed dgos shing / mdun sar bca' sdod dmag mi'i mi grangs dang / sa cha sogs de sngon gam mthor bzhag pa'i gros mthun ltar lag len byed dgos/2 dar rgyas dgon pa'i mkhan po dgon pa de rang gi snyan gragatra4 yod pari mi gnyis 'dems bsko byed dgos pa de yang / mi gcig mkhan po dang gcig las rogs pa yin dgos/ mkhan po dang las rogs rgya phyogs kyi mos mthun byas rjes rgyal ba tā las bsko gzhag bya rgyu dang rgya phyog/sa kyis bsko sazhag byas pa'i yi ge sprod rgyu/ mkhan po dang las rogs pas dgon pa'i chos don gnyer rgyu las srid 'dzin dang gzhan gyi las don la the jus byed mi chos4 rgya bod phyogs gnyis kyi mi sna btang ste/ dar rgyas dgon pa'i 201
