nyams gso'i 'a/sa kar blta skul bya rgyu/5 dar rgyas dgon pa'i sa zhing mtha' dag phyir sprod bya rgyu dang /rang neos kyis 'a debs las byed chog pa/ sa zhing gi rgya khyon gzhir bzung 'bru khral 'bul dgos pa dang / khrimanu/ yi/ga gzhir bzhag 'u lag rgyugs dgos / 6 dar rgyas dgon pa ni bong kyi grwa dgon dang mtshungs pas dge lugs pa'i sdom khrims srung da gos/ shis khams srid gzhung gis dargon pa der dar mdo'i dgon khag gzhan pa rnams dang 'dra ba'i blta stangs 'dzin dgos pa dang / bdag 'doms byed dgos/7 dar rgyas dgon grwa dmangs ni shis khams kyi mi khongs yin gshis/sngar byas la rtsad gcod mi byed par bsgyur bcos byas te khrims srung byed du 'jug dgos/ kho tshor shis khams kyi 'bangs gzhan dang khyad par med pa'i blta stangs 'dzin dgos la/ da nas khrims 'gal lugs dkrug kyang byed mi chog de las ldog na khrims gcod bya rgyu/rdo dar rgyas dgon pa'i me mda' gzhung 'bul byas pa phud me mda' dgu bcu rang sor nyar chog de'ang gzhung nas ang grangs gzhir bzung tho bkod rtsis sprod bya rgyu dang / me mda' khyer nas phyir 'gro dgos tshe dus thog tu sa gnas kyi dpon rigs la dgong5 skor zhus nas chog mchan thob mtshams su gzhi nas 'khyer chog pa/kha dar rgyas dgon pa dang gzhung gnyis dbar dus nam yang 'gal rkyen bzo rgyu med/ de sngon dgon pa der dogs 'char yod pa rnams la gzhung phyogs kyis gsal bshad byed rgyu/ phyogs gnyis su yin yang 'khon 'dzin khyer nas dgra lan byed mi chog gyod gzhi 'khrug rtsod mtshams 'jog 202

byas par brten nas rkyen rtsa med par bzo dgos/10 dar rgyas dgon pa ba kod sgrig tshar rje sa kyi rgya bod bar grorngasi rno/ ro byeng dgos nga/'i don rnams snga ra ba'in gam mtho'i gros mthun ga'ir bzung krung dbyang dang tā la gnyis kyi thag gcod gan nga gyu ra brtsi srung zhu dgos/11 gros mthun bya thabs 'di rang so so'i srid ba/zhung la phul nas yig tshas/sa su nyar 'jog byed dgos/12 gros mthun 'dir dogs mi chod pa yod phyin rgya yig gzhir 'dzin byed dgos pa bcas so bong gsal gros mthun der dar rgyas dgon pas yi ma rang pa'i 'dod tshul bzung rkyen lag bstar byed thub med cing / grwa pa rnams log yong ba'i lam bar nas slar yang kha 'thor du phyin te 'gal rkyen sna tshogs bzos pa dang / 'grim 'grul bkag sdom byas pa/ mtshon cha khyer nas 'phrog bcom byas pa bcas byas te 'grul skyod byed bzhin pa'i hra'an zhi'i yi tshong 'dren ru chen gyi mi mang po bsad rmas btang ba ma zad/ te ho rdzong la phar rgol byas nas rdzoro srid gzhung gi khang pa mer bsregs btang ba dang rgyu nor btsan bcom byas te 'bri chu'i nub phyogs su log pa des rgya bod 'brel gtugs byas pa rnams thor zhig tu phyin pa'i rkyen gyis shis khams kyi mtha' srung dmag mi rnams sa gnas kyi sgrig khrims srung phyir khrims 'gre/'a byed po grwa pa rjes 'ded byed par bskyar du gtong dgos byung zhing // bod dmag gis chu ngogs su dmag mi bshams nas bkag 'gog bya rgyu'i rnam pa bton pa bcas mdor na skyar du dmag 'khrug langs rgyu'i rnam pa yod pa red/ de nas sde dge rdzong dpon chi'u li hreng gis nyen khar ma 'dzems par chu pha khar mtsho sgo mda' 203

pa'i nyen kha sel thub pa dang / dar rgyas dgon pa'i grwa pa phyir log bya rgyu'i re ba dang mthun yod/ 'on kyang des rtsa don thag gcod thad gtan 'khel byas pa tsam las zhib phra'i lag len bstar thabs bkod med pa dper na/dgon pa'i me mda' gtsang bsher byed thabs dang / 'phrog pa'i dngos rdzas phyir len tshab 'jal bya thabs/ dgon pa dzhams gso'i bya thabs sogs gsal por bkod med pas lo gsum bzhi tsam zhig nar 'gyangs su lus stabs sngar bzhin don rkyen langs kyi yod pa ma zad/ phyogs gnyis po'i bsam pa'i 'khyer so'ang sngar bzhin 'gyur ba med par gnas/ 'on kyang skabs der rgyal nang du ri 'gog dmag 'khrug langs shing rgyal yongs mi dmangs kyis dgra 'gog 'bad 'thab byed pa/ rgyal spyi'i dus bab la 'gyur ldog byung ba/ btsan rgyal ring lugs pas bod la btsan 'dzul bya rgyur do snang sngar las chung du phyin pa ma zad/ skabs der tā la'i sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i yang srid mtsho sngon du bltams pa'i gnas tshul don dngos su gyur ba bcas kyi gnas tshul 'og khams bod rtsod gzhi mu mthud nar 'gyangs bya thabs med la/ bod phyogs kyi rnam 'gyur yang yag tu song nas mes rgyal la brtsi bkur dang / dar rgyas dgon pa'i gyod gzhi mthar phyin thag gcod byas mas rgyab phyogs brtan lhing yong ba bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul bton par brten shis khams zhing chen u yon lhan khang gis krang kran krung dang / hphan khrang yon 'thus mir gtong dgos pa'i gros 'go gzhir bzung 'thus mir btang /bod phyogs kyis zur khang dbang chen tshe brtan 'thus mir btang ba/ de bzhin dkar mjes te ho rdzong gnyis dang / a mdo dang dar rgyas dgon pa bcas kyi 'thus mi sde dger mnyam 'dzoms kyis rten 'brel zhu ba dang sbrags nyin bcu bzhi'i ring gros mol byas te/ gong gsal don tshan brgyad gzhir 205

bzung gis〈dar rgyas dbosna/na pa dang grwa pa'i zhib phra'i bkod sgrig bya thabs〉don tshan bdun gros gtan 'khel zhi/nga / spyi lo 1929lo'i zla 1tshes 2nyin dngos su ming rtags balko/da pa red/ gros mthun de'i gtso bo'i nang don gsham gsal/1 dar rgyas dgon gyis hra'an zhi'i yi 'tshong zog dang mi srog gi gyong gun gsab dgos pa'i bod dngul ṭam rdo bdun brgya nyi shu'i nang nas dngos su ṭam rdo sum brgya nyi shu sprod dgos pa dang / de 'phros li'u wun hu'e nas rdo tshad nyis brgya tham pa 'bul rgyu dang / chab mdo'i dza sag bla ma dang dza sag zur khang pa gnyis nas brgya dang dgu bācu/ ka'an su'u dang hra'an zhi'i yi 'tshong dmangs kyis ṭam rdo nyi shu bcas sprad nas don de yongs su thag gcod bya rgyu/2 te ho rdzong gzhung las khang bskyar skrun bya rgyu'i gron dngul ṭam rdo brgya tham pa dgos pa'i nang nas dar rgyas dgon pas nyi shu rtsa lnga gun gsab tu sprod dgos/ de 'phros phyogs so so'i 'gan 'khur ba sger nas bsdu dgos pa ste/ krang kran krung gis ṭam rdo bco lnga dang / zur khang pas ṭam rdo bcu/sde dge 'go dpon nas ṭam rdo bco lnga/ hphan khrang yon nas ṭam rdo bcu bcas khag so sos bsdus nas sprod rgyu/2 rgya'i 'tshong pa rmas ma gsum la mi rer sgor nyi shu re dang / shi ba bzhi la mi rer ṭam rdo bco lnga re dar rgyas dgo na pas sprod rgyu/4 dar rgyas dgon pa'i 'aridu khang bskyar gso bya rgyur dkar mdzes rdzong gzhung nas zla gcig ring las mi brgya dang lnga bcu gtong rgyu dang / dar rgyas dgon pas las mi rer gla cha bod dngul sgor bcu re sprod dgos/ zla gcig gi rjes su dgon pa rang nyid kyis mi glas te nyams gso bya dgos/206

5 bod phyogs kyis dar rgyas/ dgon par sprad nga 'i rṣa ma/ da' tshang ma bad phyogarnga na rang gis phyir bsdu dgos pa dang / da ra rgyas dbo/na si 'i 'tshong nga phyir bskyod skabs rang srung bya rgyur me mda' sum cu rang 'jags 'jogre rgyu nt+ra/ bzhin rgyun du dgon pas nyar tshags byed dgos pa dang / me mda'i spor tos dang / rdzas mdel rnams/ dkar mdzes rdzong du nyar tshags byas te/dgos nges skabs dar rgyas dgon la sprod rgyu bcas so/gong gsal don tshan rnams gtan 'khel rjes phyogs so sos lag len nan tan bstar zhing / phyogs mthar 'khyams pa'i grwa dmangs rnams rim ba'in dgon par log ste dgon pa nyams gso dang / chos khrims la srung brtsi zhu dgos/ bod phyogs kyis 'bri chu'i nub 'gram du 'grim 'grul srung phyir 'go dmag nyung shas bzhag pa phud mang che ba chab mdor phyir 'then byas pa de nas bzung lo bcu la nye ba'i ring dar be'i zing cha thag chod mthar phyin byung ba red/ de rjes zla brgyad par nga rang bod du bskyod pa'i lam zhor la yangari lha dgon par 'dri rtsad byas pa der rgyu cha gra sgrig dang / dgon pa nyams gso byed pa'i sgang red/dar rgyas dgon pa'i mkhan pos gdan zhu byas pa ltar dgon par blta skor du phyin pa yin/ dgon pa'i 'du khang dang grwa shag khag gcig bskrun zimyo/ nas grwa pa sum brgya tsam dgon par log 'dug de 'phros grwa pa brgya phrag 'ga' zhig mtsho sngon dang / shis khams/ yun nan/ bod sogs su 'tshong rgyag gi yod pa dang / phyi lo'i zla ba drug pa tsam la tshang ma phyir log yong thub rgyu red zer bshad byung / chab mdor slebs skabs zur khang nas sne len gnang skabs spyir btang 'phros mol byung don ngas(zur khang) sde dger hur brtson gyis shis khams kyi 'thus mi dang mnyam du dar 207

be'i don rkyen thag gcod mthar phyin byas pa yin zhes bshad byung /gong gsal gnas tshul mdor bsdus na dar be'i rtsod gzhi'i thog nas khams bod dmag 'khrug gi rkyen rtsa byung ba des skabs de'i phyob/sa so sor shugs rkyen ci zhig thebs yod ce na/go min tang srid dbang gis bod du bya spyod spel rgyur 'gog rkyen byung bas phyogs so so'i 'gal zla je cher song ba dang gcigashis khams kyis 'bri chu shar ngos te ho dang / sde dge/ dpal yul/hri chos bcas rdzong bzhi tshur blangs nas 'bri chu'i 'gram rgyud srung ba des spyi lo 1'a1rdolo nas bzung ther tshal sbar tshal du phyin pa'i si khron gyi mtha' mtshams brtan tsam byung ba/ li'u wun hu'e si khron nas pham bros byas rjes gan sa skabs shis khams de bcad bzung bya rgyu byung ba dang gnyis/bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis shar phyogs la dpung 'jug gis sa khongs rgya bskyed byed sems la rdung rdog tsha nan 'khel bas/ mtsho khams dmag la mthong chung bya rgyu med pa'i ngos 'dzin dang dogs zon bya dgos byung ba dang gsum/dbyin ji btsan rgyal ring lugs pas ngan skul gyis khams bod 'khrug rtsod bslangs nas bar khe za rgyu'i skog g.yo ma 'grub pa dang bzhi bcas so/208

a drung bkra shis kyirsā gri gu rdzong sdod ngo tshab byed ring gi gnas tshul/smra 'o lco gartsacishrī bstan 'dzin rgya mtshos/gri gu rdzong sdod la bod sa gnas srid gzhung si rtse drung re yong mus yin cing / nga rang gis da lta dran par/ rtse drung brag g.yab dang / skal bzang lhun grub/ thub bstan tshe dpag mthu sto/bas/ rtse mgron thub bstan nyi ma/ blo gling tshe brtan grags pa dang / de nas rdzong gzhis khag gzhung 'dzin byas te skya ser re mos kyi shod drung rab sgang pa dang / byang gling rtse drung thub bstan dge byed bcas rim par 'byor ba'i nang nas gong gsal rtse mgron thub bstan nyi ma grwa bzhi dngul par do dam gyi las bya yin mus thog ngo tshab btang 'thus kyispu gri gu gzhis sdod bsko gzhag byas pa'i ngo tshab tu kho pa'i pha a drung bkra shis kyis gri rdzong lo bzhi byed ring gzhis sdod gzhan su dang mi 'dra ba'i chab 'bangs mi ser thog khyi spyang sha khrag 'a rngam pa dang gnyis su med pa'i za sems che bas de'i spyod tshul drag thabs smos med khar/ skabs re rang la khe phan yong bzo 'dug bsam nas/ — ser skya drag zhan med par/ nga'i nor bu dang / yang na/ pa phas zhes yang yang 'bod de brnab sems khog bcangs kha 'jam gyi rnam pa'i thog nas g.yo 'phrog bya rgyur byang chub pa zhig yin pa'i lo rgyus 'di lta ste/rdzong de'i khongs su gzhung sger chos gsum gyi mi ser yod cing /209

gzhung rgyugs pa grong nub/ stod pa / zhal zho/ lha sde/ gsum tshar/0/dung pa sogaru/ yo da khongs them dud re nas lo re khral 'bab 'bru khal sum brgya sko ra 'khri ba yod na ('ang / snga ra lam dngul bsgyu ra gyiru/ 9rebru kha‘la rer tsu da/ dngul ska ra phyed brgyad re sprad 'thus chog nga ltar / rdzong sdod rim pas 'a ga bstar byed mus kyang / a drung bkra shis kyis 'bru mngon mdog dgos zhi ru/ btsan 'ded byas par mi ser nas dbang med khas len mi bya mthu med byung ste sa rdo bzha' phug gi bsres lhad med pa sprod dgos byung song ba ma zad/la snyelas 'bru med par rmon mdzo tshong dgos byung ba dang / tha na khyem bdag pho mo'i rgyan chas sogs kyang gta' mar blangs song / gzhung rgyugs zhal zho bsam gtan rdo rjes de'i skor sngar gnas yong bar bod sa gnas srid gzhung pa zu/de sdug zhus par zhib sa bde zhib las khungs drung che lha'u rta ra dang /mnga' ris spyi khyab skyar srib pa yin pas thag gcod ma byas par lo gsum tsam song zhing / bsam rdor gyis nyin ltar bde zhib las khungs la zhabs bsku' zhu ba dang sbrags skabs 'gar gsang nyan byas pas ngan skyor kho na bya rtsis yod pa shes tshor byung 'phral kho pas slar yang bka' shag tu snyan 'bul zhus par bka' shag nas kho pa'i zhu don dang / zhib sa'i 'char gzhi'i dbar gnad don rnams ha lam 'dra bshus ji bzhin yin stabs zhib rtsad ngo las dang /bsam rdor kho pa 'brel ba yod nges snyam zur 'i/ba byas par bka' shag tu zhu ba zur du 'bul dgos byung ba dang bka' shag nas gyod zhib byed po bde zhib las khungs nas dpyad mtshams khra ma ma btang gong bka' shag la snyan seng zhus pa 'os min yin ces bsam rdor la rta lcag brgya dang lnga bcu tham pa btang thog bka' shag nas gri gu rdzong sdod rim pa dgu tsam la so so'i rdzong sdod las rgyun ring ji byas zhu tho blangs pa ma zad/ lho spyi mkhan chung par 210

khang thub bstan mkhyen rab la gri gu rdzong 'og gzhung rgyugs mi ser 'brel yod la de skor 'dri rtsad kyi gnas tshul snyan seng zhu dgos pa'i bkod bya btang bar lho spyis mi ser ched bskongs 'dri rtsad byas pa'i zhu tho dang / bsam rdor gyi zhu don dbar he bag med stabs bka' shag nas a drung bkra shis la nyes chad gatree/ra srang dgu dang / khyim bdag pho mo'i rgyan chas gta' mar blangs pa rnams phyir sprod dgos pa/ da dung khral 'bab sngar lam dngul bsgyur ltar ma byung yang phyed ka lhag tsam bcags te phul 'thus bcas kyi dpyad khra btang ba red/ (bsam rdor zhes pa ni zing 'khrug skabs bros byol song ste deng skangs bal yul du yod pa red/)gzhan yang gri rdzong a drung bkra shis kyis skabs re ha lam mi ser che chung med par chang dam pi re bskyal nas lug lpags re gnyis dang / tshil lu phran bu tshong rogs zer ba mi ser nas khas len mi byed thabs med khar rin yang zhu rin chog pa mi 'dug zer nas len nus kyi med/ de skabs kho pas/nga'i nor bu/ pa phas sems 'jags zhus chog zer gyi yod cing / sgo dud mang po yin pas kho par pags tshil phon che yong ba dang lo ltar de 'dra byas stabs a drung bkra shis kyis chang bskyal na mi ser gyis/ yang pags chang dang tshil chang slebs byung zer gyi yo da/ mi ser 'brog pa yod rigs la ja bag chung re gnyis lag rtags su sprad de khal g.yas/ gcig tshong rogs zer ba khas len bya rgyu rang yin la/ rin pa ga tshod yin nam 'dri khul byed kyang /rdzong dpon yin stabs g.yag rin thad kar lab ma nus par rjes su bka' mol zhus chog zer skabs kho pas/ rin pa ga tshod yin rung lam seng 'bul rtsis yod na'ang / rjes su bka' lan gan nga mtshams dam don phul chog zer ba tsam las dngos su mi sprod la/ mi ser nas kyang rjes su g.yag rin 211

'ded len byed mi nus/ de dang chabs cig kho pas g.yag spus 'tshong gnang ba bka' drin che byung yang / khal g.yag la sga chas med na las ka bskul thabs bral bas sga chas rang 'grig spus 'tshong gnang rogs sku mkhyen zer nas mthe bong ker ba'am/ nga'i nor bu dang pa pha'i nor bu zer ba sogs bshad nas khal g.yag sga chas rang 'grig 42g.yo 'phrog byas yod/snon phad thad mi ser mo hreng yan la phad bu re tshong rogs zhes ngo chen bskul nas phad bu nyis brgya) skor byung yod pa rer rin bod dngul srang do re sprad song rung / kho pas gra nang byams gling tshong dus la phad bu rer rin srang nyi shu rtsa lnga skor byas te btsongs yod pa red/ gri gu chu tshan de yang btsan bdag byas te chu tshan rgyag mkhan nye 'gyangs la ma ltos par mi re nas bod dngul ṭaṃ re dang / kha btags re/ tshong pa slebs rigs nas kyang bod dngul srang re dang / kha btags re bcas sngar med gsar len byed kyi yod cing / kho pa'i bu rtse mgron thub bstan nyi ma lo re thengs re gri gur yong gi yod pa sngon brda 'byor 'phral a drung bkra shis kyis gri gu'i gtso rgan rnams la sang nyin mi dbang che mo 'dir phebs kyi yod pas rang re rnams 'tshams zhu'i mjal dar 'bul bar 'gro dgos zer nas gri gu nas rgyang tsam sar 'khrid kyi yod/ rnam kun gnad don chung rtsag la'ang kho pas nyes chad ljid pos thag gcod byed kyi yod rung / gnad don byung skabs mi dbang che mos de skor mkhyen na des mi tshad pas dpe bsags kyi red zer nas gsang ba che mdog gis 'jigs skul byed kyi yod/de bzhin gri gu sgo mtha' dkar bu spun nang gyes skabs bgos phud bcu zur sngar lam yin zer g.yag 1 2dang gur skad grags yod pa de dang dngul phon che bcas blangs shing / gri gu mi ser lha sde ba nang kha gshin min skabs 212

bgos phud bcu zur g.yag 12 rta 5 mdzo 2 'bru khal 150 0bcas blangs/ gong dkar rdzong khongs bkra shis tshe ring (ming 'dogs la gleg po mgo ril zer )la g.yag dgu yod pa brkus par/ dngos red zer nas rgyu mtshan khungs skyel gang yang med par btsan 'phrog byas nas gleg po mgo ril nas dol gyi bshas par g.yag gcig btsong rin la byu ru'i spa phrug gcig blangs nas gri gu'i khyim tshang zhig la btsongs pa khyim der rkun dngos nyo ba 'os min yin zer nas g.yag gsum 'phrog pa dang / yang skabs shig sprang po 'ga' shas kyis gtam shun du yod pa'i kho pa'i 'bru khang la rku brgyab pas 'dzin bzung byas thog sprang dngos phran yod rnams gzhung bzhes dang 'bre'/ lus steng tshar gcod byed nye'i mtshams sprang po gcig gros byol song ba bod dmag rnying pa pa sangs zer ba rjes 'ded ched btang gis ske bcad pa dang gri gu mgon shar 'jam dbyangs kyis g.yag gcig brkus par kho pa'i khang dngos yod tshad gtsang len byas thog gdung mar btags nas nyes brerdung tshad med btang ste bsad pa red/ci de sngon kho pa yig skyel a drung byed skabs bzhon rta gcig dang khal rta gcig 'ded bskul byed bzhin yod/ thengs shig kho pa lho brag ben par 'byor skabs lam yig nang bzhon rta gcig las med pas khal rta ma btang bar kho pas bzhon rta de rta slog la bzhon stegs mtho sa zhig gi 'khris su bzung bcug ste rang nyid nas khal rta'i rgyab chas do po rgyab tu 'khur nas bzhom rtsis byas par rta slog gis de 'dra byas na rta shi rgyu las 'os med/khal rta gcig gtong gi yin zer nas gtong dgos byung 'dug yang a drung gzhan pas rdo brag tu slebs skabs bka' gtan yod zer nas lto dod sprod kyi mi 'dug ces gleng bar kho pas thengs shig rdo brag tu yong nas lto dod 213

ma sprad stabs sngon la rta bzhon te thon chog byas nas lto dod sprod ma dgos pa'i bka' gtan de nga la ston dgos zer nas yi ger lta khul gyis bka' gtan gyi thel tse btogs nas/ da 'di za dgos gsungs pa red zer nas thel tse'i kha ris zos pas rjes sa gtan tshigs phan med bzos pa red zer/༄de bas kho pa rang nyid kyis bshad par/ bka' blon bla ma byams pa bstan dar skabs khams yul yig skyel du 'gro skabs skyed rags la thel tse rgyag gi yod la/ sa tshigs 'khel yul la khri rgyab yol dang gnam yol brgyab tu bcug ste/ nang du slebs mtshams yi ge bsgril 'bog ser thig de khri steng du bzhag nga rang gdan dma' tsam zhig la sdod kyi yod/ sa tshigs su rgan pos rta kha len skabs rta bab 'phral rgan po'i mjing steng du rta lcag gnyis gsum zhig drag tu bzhus thog 'di dang po 'phrad pa'i 'dri mol yin/ nga a drung bkra shis sgo rtsar slebs pa dang bya srin bya thog steng bab pa khyad med zer ba khyod kyis thos yod shag zer gyi yod ces zer ba bcas so/214

nor gling pho brang khag cha/ bkod pa rags tsam dang sbyan bsal pho brang ba/sa ra skrun skor/ khri drung blo bzang thub bstan gyis/chor bu gling ga ni grong khyer lha sa'i nub phyogs su gnas pa'i snga rabs kyi mdzes sdug ldan pa'i skyed tshal nor thod gling ga'i cha shas yin zhing / tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa nas bzung tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyi‘‘dbyar sa'i pho brang’ yin pa dang / nor bu gling ga khyon yongs la da yod rgya khyon spyi khre gru bzhi ma phri/ sum cu so drug lhag tsam yod pa dang / gtso bo'i 'dzugs skrun gyi bkod pa ni/ bskal bzang pho brang dang / spyan bsal pho brang / rtag brtan mi 'gyur pho brang bcas gtso bo'i pho brang gsum gyi le lag dang bcas pas grub cing / de'ang lcags ri chen mo'i nang khongs lcags ri ser po'i nang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bdun pa bskal bzang rgya mtsho mchog nas rab byung bcu gsum pa'i lcags lug ( 1751) lor nor bu gling gar chab zhugs 'phrod bsten bskyangs skabs kyi bzhugs yul nor gling dbu g.yab pho brang gi rmang gzhi thog mar gsar skrun gnang thog shing phag ( 1755) lor nor gling ‘‘bskal bzang pho phrang’’gi rmang gzhi bting / de rjes shing 'brug( 17ram̐ 4)lor tā la'i bla ma sku phreng brgyad pa 'jam dpal rgya mtsho mchog gi 215

sku dus su srid skyong tshe smon gling ngag dbang tshul khrims kyis gtso bo'i thugs 'gan bzhes te‘‘bskal bzang pho brang’’dang lcags ri ser po 'dzugs skrun mjug skyong mdzad pa dang / de'i sngon tsam la pho brang lhun grub dga' tshal dang / de'i nye 'gram du chab rdzing yang gsar skrun mdzad/de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon gyis gru 'dzin pho brang dang /chos ra/ phyag dpe khang sogs gsar skrun bskyangs/ lhag par du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po dgung grangs bcu gnyis bzhes pa rab byung bco lnga pa'i me phag( 1〈rdo7)lor nor gling ‘‘chab sa lhun grub dga' tshal’’(mtsho dkyil pho brang) gyi gzim chung rgya khang nyams gso gnang thog gzim chung rgya khang gi mtha' skor du dog bde nas thon pa'i rdo cong zhi bkrol ma'i sgrom skyor gsar 'dzugs dang / de'i mthar skor gyi chab rdzing rgya bskyed dang 'brel chu'i 'byung khungs yur bu gsar gtod kyis lha sa'i shar phyogs sgrol ma'i ri zur gyi nye 'gram du gtsang po nas tshur 'then pa'i chu yur gsar pa bskrun nas glang ru dang lha sa 'ong kha/ gshong kha gling ga bye rag klu khang zam pa/ kun bde gling / lcags po ri/ bde skyid gling ga ma maṇḍal lha khang brgyud nor gling lhun grub dga' tshal gyi chab rdzing nang chab chu 'dzad med 'bab rgyu bzos pa dang / chab rdzing nang gru chung btang nas pho brang la skor ba bya yul yod la rdo zam brgyud pho brang lhun grub dga' tshal du 'gro 'ong bya yul yang yod pa sogs kyi 'dzugs skrun gnang ba dang / (de skabs 'brug pa dang 'bras ljongs sa spyod pa so sos phul ba'i spyan gzigs glang po che pho mo gnyis chab rdzing nang khrus la zhugs pa sogs byed kyi yod 'dug) de rjes rab byung bco lnga pa'i sa lug1rdzo19lor/ nor bu gling ga'i lcags ri'i phyi rol gyi lho ngos su sku srung dmag sgar dang sku srung dmag 216

sgar gyi dbus su pho brang bcas gsar skrun bskyangs/'dir bshad bya gtso ngo rgyan bsal pho brang ni tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog dgung grangs lnga bcu nga gcig bzhes pa me stag( 1926)lo sngar yod nor gling bskal bzang pho brang gi nub phyogs lcags ri ser po'i phyi rol nub ngos su pho brang 'ireka btab na gang cir dge mtsham/ ldan lugs thugs la dgongs nas sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags su ar po'i do dam spyi khyab pa byed dgos pa'i bka' phebs pa bzhin/ khong gis sngar yod‘‘ko kri pho brang ’zhes pa'i rgya khang stabs bde zhig yod pa de dag phugs brtan bab chags shig med stabs de dag bshig ral byas te sa cha de ga'i steng du pho brang gsar du bzhengs rgyur las rigs dbu chen rnams dang gros bsdur gyis sa bkra zhib tshags bkod de gtan 'khel zin mtshams sa bdag lho 'phye'i thig gdab dang lha klu spo chog sogs rgyun srol gyi byed sgo cha tshang legs par bgyis nas lo der ar las dngos gzhi 'bo/ tshugs te pho brang gtso bo rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa 'brug lor legs par grub pa dang / dus mtshungs spyan gling pho brang gi le lag ( 192ṭwāṃ) la bskal bzang bde 'khyil dang / mchi med mchog sbyin/ mdzod sbug las khungs/ las shag gsol thab mdzo mo rwa ba bcas pa rnams dang / gzhan yang chibs ra'i gzim chung gzhan phan dga' 'khyil/ zhabs brtan lha khang / khor yu/ga lcags ri chen mo sogs kyang legs par grub te nor bu gling ga'i 'dzugs skrun gyi gzhi khyon sngar las lhag pa'i rgya cher gyur/pho brang legs grub kyi dran rten ched du spyan gling pho brang gi gzim sgo'i 'gag mdun rdo gcal nang lha sa'i byang phyogs dog bde nas 'don 'dren byas pa'i thog brtsegs gnyis tsam gyi rdo ring gnyis btsugs spyan bsal pho 217

brang zhes pa'i mtshan gyi thogs tshul skor la bgres rabs 'ga' zhig gi tā la'i bla ma mchog pho brang gi bzo bkod sgyu rtsal la dgyes mnyes ha cang chen po byung stabs‘‘spyan bsal pho brang’’zhes thogs tshul dang / bgres rabs 'ga' zhig gis spyan bsal kun 'phel lags kyis ar po'i do dam spyi khyab pa byas te bzhengs stabs khong gi ju tshan de pho brang la thogs tshul gsungs 'dug na'ang bgres rabs mang che bas sngon mar bzhed la de ltar 'brel yang chags shing don du na pho brang de'i mtshan rgyas par‘‘spyan bsal pho brang bde skyid ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil’’zhes brjod/pho brang lte ba bde skyid ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil thog brtsegs gsum ldan/de'i rtse mor gser 'od 'phro ba'i gser zangs kyi thugs rgyal mtshan dang /gha ñdzi ra/ spen bad/ bkra shis rtags brgyad sogs kyi ri mos phyug pa'i spen rgyan sogs kyi bkod pas mdzes par byas/ ka gdung dang gzim sgo/zhal khra sogs phyi nang shing cha rnams kyi brkos bkrol sna tshogs phun sum tshogs shing / ldebs ris sna tshogs kyi sgyu rtsal yid dbang 'phrog pa sogs phyogs gang ci'i thad nas bod rigs mi dmangs kyi ar las 'dzugs skrun gyi ngo mtshar khyad chos mngon par byas yod/pho brang bde skyid ngo mtshar dpal 'khyil gyi shod tshoms chen nyi 'od la ka ring bzhi dang / ka thung nyi shu rtsa gnyis yod cing / de'i sdings cha'i dbus su tā la'i bla ma mchog gi bzhugs khri dang / bzhugs khri'i sku rgyab tu dngul gyi sku rin po che/ sdings cha'i g.yas g.yon dang bzhugs khri'i sku rgyab bcas kyi mchod gshom rgya rtsi ma nar mo khag gsum gyi nang gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku brnyan bcu phrag kha shas bzhugs/ (tshe lha rnam gsum gyi sku brnyan de rnams tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bcu gsum dgung skeg tu 218

phebs skabs zhol 'dod dpal gyi zangs bzo dbu chen gsum dang /zangs ngazo dbu chen gras rtse gdong ba lcang thang phun tshogs dbang 'dus dang /rtse gdong bde skyid khang gsar ba'i dzam lha sogs kyi sor mo'i 'du byed las bzhengs tshul 'dug) tshom chen nyi 'od kyi khor yug ldebs bris su ston pa'i mdzad brgya dpag bsam 'khri shing dang / tsong kha brgyad cu bcas bris yod/ tshom chen nyi 'od nang chos srid kyi mdzad sgo gnang yul dang / lo ltar se 'bras gnyis dbyar gnas grol ba'i ljongs rgyu'i mjal kha gnang yul gnang gi yod/ bar thog tu gzim chung dpag bsam 'dod 'khyil/ yang steng du gzim chung srid zhi dpal 'bar dang / gzim chung mi 'jigs sgo 'byed sogs yod/ yang steng gzim chung dbus kyi nang / gser zangs kyi thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong mi tshad che ba tsam dang / gser zangs kyi gdugs dkar mi tshad che ba tsam/ dus gsum sangs rgyas sogs sku brnyan byin can sna tshogs bzhugs/ gzim chung gi ldebs bris su/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng rim byon dang / rje gzigs pa lnga ldan sogs bar thog bar khyams kyi ldebs bris su phyug po spun bdun dang gdugs dkar/ rta mgrin/ching rgyal rabs kyi gong ma kong zhu dang / gong yum tshe zhi'i dus su bzhengs pa'i pe cin gi spro gling dbyi ho yon gyi yul ljongs bkod pa sogs bris yod/spyan gling pho brang bskal bzang bde 'khyil thog brtsegs gnyis ldan la rtse mor thug dang rgyal mtshan/ gha ñdzir sogs kyis brgyan yod pa dang /gzim chung mdo sbug rnams kyi rten du gser zangs dang rgya dngul sogs las grub pa'i thub dbang dang / thugs rje chen po/ 'jigs byed sogs kyi sku brnyan byin can sna tshogs bzhugs/ ldebs bris su/ ri bo gru 'dzin gyis zhing bkod dang / rgya gar rdo rje gdan/ rgya nag ri bo rtse lnga/ dpa la ldan 219

'bras spungs mchod rten/ dga' ldan yid dga' chos 'dzin sogs bris yod/ spyan bsal pho brang gi ar skrun sgyu rtsal gyi khyad chos ni bod rigs mi dmangs kyi ar skrun sgyu rtsal gyi khyad hūṃs thun mong ma yin pa yin gshis/ phyi rtseg gi rtsig rmang 'dru rgyu shin tu gting ring la rtsig zheng che zhing / rtsig rdo rnams gcig la gcig mthud ha cang tshags dam por sbrel thog rdo phreng re rer gseng rdo nan por brgyab pa yod pa dang rdo chen phreng re'i mtshams rdo chung leb mo zhib tshags ngang sgrigs pa sogs byas yod/ rdo gcal gyi rgya rdo dang / rdo g.yam rnams mthud mtshams khod snyoms legs shing / rgya rdo ring ba'i gras la dkyus su kung khri bdun dang phyed ka dang / zheng la kung khre gang tsam byas pa/ pho brang gi gzim sgo'i mdun gyi sgrom skyor dang / rdo skas g.yas g.yon du rdo cong zhi 'jam mnyen ldan pa brkos dang ri mo sna tshogs kyis rgyan spros/sgo spe g.yab steng gi thog khebs rdza g.yam rtsi lngam/ ri mos phyug pa bya spu gnon ltar sgrig pa/ sgo chen gyi thod du glang sma ze kyog dang / yang na phag rna bre kyog pad brtsegs sogs rim pa ltar brtsegs nga de bzhin brkos bkrol dang mdzes ris sogs gang ci'i thad la ha cang ru nga zhib tshags bcas byas yod pas bkod pa shin tu brjid nyams ldan la sra brtan phugs 'pher gyi bzo skrun khyad chos ldan pa zhig yin/ de'i skabs sku srung ru dpon phur bu don grub ni/ spyan gling pho brang gsar bzhengs kyi ar 'ul sku srung dmag mi'i 'go byed gtso bo'i gras shig yin 'dug pas/ khong gis rgyun du brjod don/pho brang gi brkod pa legs pa'i thog sra mkhregs phugs 'pher byung yod pa dang / ar skrun sgyu rtsal thad/ snam bu'i spus tshad la cha bzhag na/ shad ma dang / spu phrug bying ma bcas rab 'bring zhan gsum yod pa las/220

shad ma ni spus tshad ang dang por slebs gshis/ de dang 'dra ba'i pho brang ar skrun sgyu rtsal thad ang dang por slebs nges yin lugs ngom bzo dang sbrags shod rgyun yod tshul nga rang blo bzang thub bstan de sngon khri byang bla brang du sdod skabs go thos thengs mang byung myong / 'on kyang do snang che rigs med rung / da cha nor bu gling gar lo mang rgyun sdod ring pho brang gi ar skrun sgyu rtsal rnams zhib tu mthong skabs de snga sku srung ru dpon phur bu don grub kyis bshad pa'i skad cha de dag dngos 'brel yin pa gzhi nas shes tshor thub kyi 'dug spyan gling pho brang ma lag rnams ar las grub nye'i skabs nu mthud phyi khorayug lcags ri chen mo rgya bskyed dang / shar nub lho byang so sor rdzig nyams ldan pa'i sgo chen bzhi dang bcas pa legs skrun gnang /spyan gling pho brang gsar skrun gyi ar po'i do dam spyi khyab pa sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel yin pa dang / de 'og ar po'i do dam pa zhol pa(rjes sor rtse phyag dar rgan byas pa) dang / las bya skya ser mi grangs drug ar 'ul sku srung dmag mi'i 'go byed sku srung ru dpon phur bu don grub dang /sku srung ru brgya gzhan dag kha shas thog gzhan yang nyams myong can‘‘pā sag rdar lags’’zer ba zhig dmag sgar gzhan dag gi ar 'ul 'go pa dmag sgar so so'i ru brgya lding gsum gyis byas pa bcas bgres rabs rnams kyi gsung rgyun nas lam rob drangs pa tsam las/ de min ar po'i 'go pa dang las bya gzhan dag ji yod zhib gsal zhu rgyu med/rdo shing ni lha sa ar po'i las khungs nas dbu chen dang dbu chung / rdo shing byings bcas btab ba dang / de'i khar nye 'khor grong gseb nas 'byor ba'i rdo shing re zung / gzhan yang sku srung dmag mi'i khongs nas rdo shing lag rtsal pa zur 'then byas pa bcas yin pa dang / kho tshor zhogs ja 221

dang / nyin gung thug pa/ dgong ja bcas kyi thog gla phogs ar po'i las khungs kyi rgyun gtan gyi gla phogs gang yod ar po'i las khungs rang nas sprad thog 'phar bsnon phran bu sprad yod tshad 'dus/ 'on kyang gong gsal sku srung dmag mi'i khongs nas 'then pa'i rdo shing tshor rgyun gtan gyi dmag phogs yod mus thog kha snon 'os 'tshams sprad yod tshad dang / zhol 'dod dpal bzo grwa nas zangs bzo dang dngul bzo lcags bzo bcas las rigs so so'i dbu chen/ dbu chung / byings bcas gang dgos btang ba de tshor ja thug gong dang mtshungs shing / gla phogs thad rnam kun 'dod dpal bzo grwa rang gi gla phogs gang yod thog 'phar snon 'os 'tshams sprad 'dug dmangs rgyugs 'os mi'i thad rdzong gzhis khag nas mi ser bskong 'gugs bya rgyu brdab gsig gi rgyur brten mi ser bskong 'gugs ma dgos pa byas te/ ar 'ul thad gtan sdod nor gling sku srung dmag sgar gyi dmag mi yongs rdzogs thog las ka brel ba che skabs nga dang rgyal rtse dmag sgar dang / tha dang brgyad sna dmag sgar nas dmag mi btang ste kho tsho'i gla phogs thad rgyun gtan gyi dmag phogs thos/ zhogs ja dang / nyin gung rtsam thug dgong ja bcas sprad/ gzhan yang lha sa'i byang phyogs dog bde nas lcags ri chen mo'i rtsig rdo rgya rdo rnams dbor 'dren byed mkhan lha sdod ja dang / nya dang / tha dang dmag sgar bcas kyi dmag mis dbor 'dren byas pa dang / kho tsho'i phogs dang ja thug sogs gong gsal dmag mi rnams dang spyi mtshungs byas/ar skrun gyi rgyu cha'i thad/ shing cha rnams thog ma/'i gra sgrig ltar na lho brag lha khang khul nas 'don 'dren gyis bsam yas su 'byor skabs sku bcar thub bstan kun 'phel lags ngo ma bsam yas su bskyod de shing cha drag rigs 222

'dems sgrug byas nas bsam yas sgor mkhar la brgyud mi dang khal ma'i thog dbor radren byed bcug kyang / lha sar shing cha khag gcig 'byor mtshams lho brag lha khang khul gyi shing cha rnams bed spyod ma byas par gtso bo lha sa khul gyi gzhung gling khag dang / de min nye 'khor rdzong gzhis khag nas thon pa'i shing cha/ de'i thog kong po nas kha snon dbor te de dag bed spyod byas/ rdo chen dang / rdo ring / rdo cong zhi sogs lha sa'i byang phyogs dog bde nas 'don 'dren byas pa dang / sa len yul nor thod gling ga'i khongs gtogs gser ṭam yur bu'i nye 'gram nas dbor 'dren byas pa/ ar ka dang / rdo g.yam/ sa dkar/ spen bad kyi rgyu cha shing spen ma sogs nye 'khor zhol 'og rdzong gzhis khag gi sa khongs nas 'don 'dren bcas byas/jimar po'i 'dzugs ston dang / bar ston/ gron ston bcas la 'go dmangs tshang mar ston mo gzab rgyas bstar zhing / lhag par du grol ston nyin tā la'i bla me mchog nas ar po'i 'go byed dang / bzo rigs dbu chen dbu chung dang byings/ 'ul mi dmag sgar khag gi dmag mi/ zhol 'og rdzong gzhis khag gi skyel 'dren 'ul mi bcas yongs rdzogs la pho brang ar po'i las ka 'thus tshang legs grub byas par dmigs bsal gyi mjal kha dang phyag dbang gnang ba sogs dgyes mnyes chen po'i gzigs pa thob pa ma zad/thob thang che chung la gzhigs pa'i go gnas dang / gzigs bzos kyi gnang cha yang bstsal/ gong gsal ar po'i rgyu 'gro dang gron dngul/ gtong sgo mtha' dag rtse phyag las khungs dang / bla phyag las khungs/ zhol pa las khungs bcas nas 'gan len gyis btang yod pa red/spyan gling sogs nor gling du glog bzhu thog mar 'dzugs stangs ni de sngon dbyin yul lun tun du sku drag gi bu phrug khag gcig 'phrul las lag rtsal 223

slob sbyong du gtong gnang mdzad khongs nas byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rje glog 'phrul gyi las ka slob sbyong thon nas dog bde chu shugs glog khang gsar skrun legs zin gyis grwa bzhi dngul par khang gi dngul par thad glog 'phrul gyis par 'debs byed thub pa byung ba dang / de rjes nor gling spyan bsal pho brang du glog bzhu 'dzugs dgos bka' phebs bzhin byang ngos pa rig 'dzin rdo rjes gtso 'gan 'khur te spyan bsal pho brang gi lcags ri'i phyi'i shar ngos tsam la chu shugs glog 'don babs tshugs chung gras shig gsar 'dzugs dang 'brel spyan bsal pho brang nang glog bzhu thog mar btsugs nas pho brang gi phyi nang tshang ma glog bzhu'i 'od snang gis khyab pa byas/ spyan bsal gling gar sngar gyi gla tshal dang / chu shing 'o bu sogs spyir btang gi skye shing thar thor rtsam las med kyang / spyan bsal pho brang gsar bzhengs grub rjes pho brang gi mtha' skor sa cha rnams khod snyams thog spang bting ba dang / shing sna'i gras kham bu dang / star kha/ se'u/ rgun 'brum dkar nag sogs 'bras ldan shing sna sna tshogs sdong rkang brgya phrag 'ga' shas dang / gzhan yang thang shing / gro ba shing / smyug ma/ yom 'bog sogs rtsa rkang ngo grangs stong phrag kha shas (de rjes rim par shing sna 'debs 'dzugs byas pa bsgril na da cha rtsa rkang ngo grangs khri phrag brgal yod)'debs 'dzugs byas yod pa ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma mchog nor gling gru 'dzin pho brang du 'jigs byed bsnyen mtshams su ma bzhugs gong tsam la gru 'dzin pho brang gi nye 'gram lho ngos su ku shu sdong po zhig kyang phyag bstar gyis 'debs 'dzugs gnang yod tshul bgres rabs mang po'i gsung rgyun las thos/spyan bsal pho brang dbus su nor gling pho brang khag gi khor ra bo/ ra yug rnams su bskal bzang me tog dang / hwa kring / sgrol ma me tog lcang ma 224

me tog rgya sal/ drang srong me tog rigs gsum me tog la sogs pa'i me tog sna kha mi 'dra ba bcu phrag 'ga' shas yod pa de dag gi khrod du tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum gang nyid sku ngo mas 'debs 'dzugs gnang ba'i me tog 'ga' zhig kyang yod skad / pho brang gi nye 'khor du spyan gzigs srog chags glang po che dang / stag gzig shwa ba/ dred mong / dom/ rma bya/bse ru la sogs pa'i rigs mi 'dra ba bcu phrag gnyis tsam yod/nor bu gling ga'i gzhung sgo'i mdun gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis su 'gying nyams ldan pa'i rdo'i seng ge pho mo de gnyis ni/ de snga grwa bzhir man ching gong cha/'i am ban gyi ya mon zhes khrims khang las khungs shig gi rgyal sgo'i 'gramadu bzhag yod skad dang / dus rabs nyi shu pa'i dus 'gor man ching gong ma 'i srid gzhung rul sungs nyams zhan du gyur te am ban sogs lha sdod mi sna phal che ba phyir log bya dgos byung stabs gong gsal rdo'i seng ge sogs bod sa gnas srid gzhung rang nas bdag sprod kyis de rjes rdo'i seng ge gnyis ka nor gling gzhung sgo'i sgo 'gram du 'dzugs rgyur sku srung dmag mis ltag la brgyab nas dbor 'dren byed bcug 'dug 'on kyang rdo'i seng ge gnyis dbor 'dren byas pa'i dus tshud skor shod srol khag gnyis yod pa ste khag gcige gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog gi sku dus su spyan bsal pho brang dang / khor yug lcags ri chen mo sogs gsar skrun legs grub zin pa'i mjug tu rdo'i seng ge gnyis grwa bzhi nas dbor 'dren byas lugs dang /yang bgres rabs khag gis tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi si mchog dbu skyes gtsug phud 'bul gnang grub pa'i rjes rjes su sku srung dmag mi gtong gnang gis dbor 'dren byas lugs gsungs mkhan byung ba ma zad/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng gnyis kyi zhabs zhu byed myong ba chung dus sku srung dmag mi dang / de 225

nas nor gling gi me tog zhabs zhur 'byor pa a zhu ser khang nas skal bzang dbang rgyal dang / a khu sbyin 'brug skal bzang phun tshogs zer ba'i bgres po gnyis deng skabs nor bu gling ga'i nang las 'khyur ngal gso byas te bsdad yod pas khong pa gnyis sar nga rang blo bzang thub bstan ched mngags bskyod nas ngo 'phrad kyis dogs 'dri byas par gzhigs na/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu bzhi pa mchog sku na phra ba'i dus su grwa bzhi nas sku srung dmag mis dbor 'dren byas yod pa dang / rdo'i seng ge gcig bye rag nang zhag gcig lus te de'i sang nyin gzhi nas dbor 'dren thub pa red ces nges gsal gsung rgyu 'dug pa bcas so/226

lha smon khyim tshang gi lo rgyus rags tsam brjod pa/chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs dang /lha smon bsod nams lhun grub kyis/khyim tshang gi thog ma'i 'byung khungs dang mi nabs ji byung sogs/‘lha smon zhes pa ni yul ming la lha rtse dang khyim tshang la smon skyid pa zhes pa'i bsdus ming yin zhing / gnas yul ni sngar bod dbus gtsang khri skor bcu gsum du grags pa'i nang tshan la stod byang bdag khri dpon gyi dgun sa'i pho brang ste/ de snga'i lha rtse rdzong khang gi gsham du lha rtse zhol zhes pa'i grong brdal gyi lho ngos sne mor chags yod/nga tsho'i mi rabs gong ma ni sngar kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che'i chab 'bangs kyi khongs su gtogs shing bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring spyir btang zhig yim/ pa las/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog skad grags yod pa'i khyim rgyud che gras gang yang min/ nga tsho'i thog ma'i mi rgyud ni lha smon ma yin par lha rtse rdzong bongs rta thog ces pa'i zhing khul du sger lhug skyid pa zer ba zhig yod pa'i mi rgyud yin par grags/ de yang tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i skabs 227

zhabs 'bring dkyus ma zhig zhu myong bas lha rtse nyu/ga skyid nga zhes 〈rnam thar du kū la'i gos bzang 〉nang 'khod yod pa red ces pha mes tshos gre/sungs pa go myo/nga /de rjes bod rab byung bcu gnyis nga/'i sa sprel ( 172ṭwāṃ) lor lha rtse dang /ngam ring / phun tshogs gling bcas rdzong 'go gsum paṇa chen sku phreng lnga pa/ blo bzang ye shes la bdag skyong grenang rgyur phul ba dang / rdzong khag de gsum khongs yod pa'i gzhung zhabs rnams kyang paṇa chen rin po che'i ( nabs khongs su tshud par brten lha rtse lhug skyid pa yang de nas bzung bkras nyu/na bla brang gi zhabs 'bring gi khongs su gyur yod/ de rjes kyi mi rabs so so'i lo rgyus zhu rgyu med kyang / pha ma'i zhal las thos regs dran gso byed skabs/ dus rabs bcu dgu pa'i nang paṇa chen sku phreng bdun pa'i sku dus su lhug skyid pa'i mi ngo bstan rgod ces pa zhig byung ba des bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring zhus shing /lha rtse khul bkras lhun bla brang gzhung gi gzhis khag gi gzhung bogs bsdu dam byed mkhan bkar rgya ba'i las 'khur yun ring byas par brten mi tshos khong la bkar chen zhes zer gyi yod pa red/ khong la bu gcig byung ba de'i ming la bsod nams tshe brtan zer zhing / de ni nga tsho'i mes po red/ khong gi yum snga sa nas grongs pa red 'dug de dus lha rtse rdzong dpon du rta nag nas yin pa'i bla zhabs bre srang lags zer ba'i mi rgod skad grags can zhig slebs pa de'i bu mo zhig lhug skyid bstan rgod kyi mna' mar blangs shing / de la bu mo zhig las bu ma skyes pa red/ bstan rgod ni nang mi dang 'khor g.yog sogs la dam bsgrags dang tsha gcun chen po byed mkhan zhig yin par grags/ nga tsho'i mes po de yang chung dus nas thugs gshis gyong po zhig yod par brten yab kyis rtag par gshe gshe dang rdung rdeg tshad med gtong gi yod pa red/bsod nams tshe brtan dgung lo bcu grangs la son skabs yab kyis dam 228

gcun ji tsam byas pa de tsam gyis khong spyod pa je gyong du phyin nas nyin ltar phyi logs su 'khyams te brgyan btsugs nas sho rgyag pa sogs gnang stabs/yab kyis ka bar bsdams nas rta lcag gzhu ba dang zhabs la lcags brgyab nas khang pa'i nang 'jug pa sogs byas kyang phan 'bras ma thon par grags/ de ltar khong tsho pha bu'i dbar gyi 'brel ba je zhan du gyur mthar dga' nye gnyen tshan rnams kyis bar mol zhus nas bu gcig pu de zur du thon rgyu byas pa red/'on kyang bstan rgod lags nas 'bog skal nor nyan pas gang yang ma sprad par sdod shes tsam gyi nang chas stabs bde zhig dang / g.yog skal mi lnga/'tsho rten du bla brang rtse phyag las khungs su bogs ma phran bu 'bul dgos pa'i mang maspar khab 'og rtse lho byang 'don rkang phyed gnyis lhag tsam yod pa'i sa zhing dang / khang gog bcas sprad nas bsod nams tshe brtan dgung lo bcu dgu tsam la zur du bzhugs pa red/ lha rdzong bre srang lags nas nga tsho'i mes po der re mthong chen po byas nas gzhis rtser mnyam khrid thog mes po mchog bkras bla'i zhabs sdod zhu rgyu sogs la rogs ram yang chen po byas skad 'dug de dus nga tsho'i spo bo lags dang shangs khul 'chum gnas rngog pa zer ba'i grong chen gyi bu mo zhig mthun 'brel byung ba ma zad/ khong la mes po de'i bu gcig kyang skyes pa de ni nga tsho'i pa phu bgres pa de red/ khong gi mtshan la bsod nams phun tshogs zer zhing / lcags stag( 1rdo90)lor 'khrungs pa red/ 'on kyang rgyu rkyen 'ga' zhig la brten nas spo bo bsod tshe lags gnas rngog pa'i bu mo de dang gnyen sgrig gnang ma thub par bu de'ang chung dus a mas nyar skyong byas pa red/ de rjes bre srang lags lha rtse rdzong sdod ljophos pa'i tshab mes po bsod nams tshe brtan lags su bsko bzhag byung nas lha rtser phebs/ khong gis rdzong dpon gnang ring drang shugs dang 229

'jon thang chen po yod pa'i skad grags kyang byung ba red/ skabs der lha rtse rdzong gi las drung smon skyid phur bstan zer ba zhig yod pa de 'das grongs song nas shul 'dzin med pa dang / bla brang gzhung la 'bru dngul gyi chad bun yang gang 'tshams 'bul rgyu bsdad yod stabs/ mes po mchog nas paṇa chen rin po cher snyan zhu phu'/ don‘‘las drung smon skyid pa'i gzhung bun rnams 'ja'/ sgrub dang / las drung gi zhabs rkang go 'pher zur 'dzugs bcas nga rang nas 'gan len zhus chog par lha rtse smon skyid pa'i khang khungs dang drung rten rkang phyed kyi sa zhing bcas gus pa mi nu/sa rgyud bcas la 'jags gnas gsol ras yong ba’’zhes zhus par don smin 'bo/ mchan bstsal thob ltar de nas bzung nga tsho'i mi rgyud kyi khyim tshang la lha rtse smon skyid pa zer ba de ltar 'go tshugs pa red/ mes po bsod nams tshe brtan de nyid kyi mdun thabs su lha rtse sger skyid sbug pa'i bu mo 'i/ga bsu gnang mdzad par me sprel ( 1rdo96)lor bu gcig byung ba de ni nga tsho'i a khu lags yin cing / khong gi mtshan la phun tshogs rgyal po zer ba dang / da dung bu mo tshe brtan chos skyid zer ba zhig kyang byung ba de nyid rjes su shangs 'chum gnas rngog pa'i bu zhig gi mna' mar ster ba red/ mes po mchog gis bkras lhun bla brang gi phyi nang las tshan rim brgyud gnang zhing / go gnas kyang rim bzhi'i bar 'phar nas mdzad jus lam lhongs byung ba dang / lhag par paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa sku gzhon nu'i skabs gzigs bskyangs chen po gnang nas snga rjes su bla brang gzhung 'dzin khongs lha rtse rdzong skyong gdong dga' sa stod gzhis ka dang / mtsho po gzhis ka/ bkras lhun bla brang gi rtse phyag las khungs kyi khongs lha rtse chu shar gzhis ka dang / gra phu sems chen gzhis ka bcas gtan 'bebs gzhung bogs dang / mchod rgyun gyi 'gro cha sngar yod rnams sgrub phyin bsod nams 230

tshe brtan mi mus rgyud bcas la ji srid bar 'jags gnas su stsal ba yin zhes pa'i sbug dam bka' gtan gtsang btsan rim par thob pa bcas mnga' khongs bdag dbang bya yul rgya cher gyur par brten rim bzhin lha rtse khul skyid smon lhug gsum zhes skad grags yod pa'i khyim tshang che shos kyi gras su tshud thub pa byung ba red/ —de nas slad phyin bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring rgyud 'dzin zhu dgos pa dang /khyim tshang gra rgyas su song khar gzhis ka mang po'i do dam gnyer skyong yang byed dgos pa sa bu rgan pa bsod nams phun tshogs shangs nas lha smon du bsus te bla brang gi zhabs sdod zhus pa dang / bu gzhon pa phun tshogs rgyal po gzhis kyi 'gan 'khur bya rgyur bkod sgrig gnang thog khong gnyis thun mong la shangs rnam gling rdzong khongs gzhung zhabs sger smon skyid gling pa'i bu mo dkon mchog dbyangs can mna' mar blangs/ khong ni nga tsho'i skyes ma yin cing /khong la bu drug dang bu mo gcig bcas ming sring bdun skyes pa de yang bu rgan shos ye shes tshul khrims dang / de 'og bu mo bsod nams chos 'dzom sa/bu gnyis pa phun tshogs rdo rje/ bu gsum pa phran tshe brtan phun tshogs/ bu bzhi pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug bu lnga pa skal bzang dbang phyug bu drug pa phran bsod nams lhun grub bcas yin/ rirī pha gzhis dang / zan g.yog lo de'i dpal 'byor gtong yong sogs/dpal 'byor byung song gi grangs 'bor zhib phra blor nges dka' yang bsdoms 'bor dran tshod rags rtsis ltar na/ gong gsal gzhis khag gdong 231

dga' sa stod dang / mtsho po/ khab 'og chu shar/ gra sems bcas gzhis ka lnga nas lo re'i ston 'bab 'bring tshad khyon bsdoms na 'bru rigs ru'i khal ṭwāṃ500tsam zin pa nas bla brang bkar steng gzhung bogs dang /rtse phyag las khungs su bogs 'bru bcas bsdoms na lo re gzhung 'bul dgos pa 'bru ru'i khal 2000lhag tsam dang / sngar lam dgon khag la mchod rgyun gtong sgo/ ser srung gi gla phogs/ zhing g.yog mi ser la 'char can gnang cha sogs phyi 'gro khyon bsdoms 'bru ru'i khal 1ra00tsam/ gzhis khag gzhan bzhi'i zhing g.yog tshang ma mi ser nas byed pa dang / khab 'og gi 'debs skyong tshang ma rang khungs nas byed dgos stabs mdzo glang 20dang /bong bu 20skor gyi gsos chag lug rdzi khag gsum dang / nang zan gyi gla phogs sogs khyon bsdoms 'bru ru'i khal 600tsam 'gro ba phud na/ lo rer yong 'bab 'bru ru'i khal 4000lhag tsam 'bab kyi yod pa red/gong gsal lug rdzi khag gsum la bsdoms ra lug grangs 2000yas mas tsam yod na'ang gsod gcod spangs stabs gtso bo khab 'og gi lud gsog dang / lo re rgyab bal khyon bsdoms bal mon do 20tsam re yong ba las/ gzhan gyi khe 'bab med pas rdzi bo'i gla phogs dang kha 'thab tsam yin/de min gyi yong 'bab gzhan zhig ni 'bru dngul bun gtong gi skyed khe len rgyu de yin cing / bun lon gtong yul ni skabs de'i lha rtse rdzong khongs yongs la khyab pa ma zad/ da dung phun gling rdzong khongs dang ngam ring rdzong khongs kyi mi ser nyung shas la'ang gtong gi yod/ lo re bun gtong ma 'bor zhib gsal ma nges kyang / spyir btang byas na ma 'bru ru'i khal 10000yas mas tsam dang / ma dngul srang 200rkya0yas mas tsam yin/skyed 'bab thad mang che ba lnga drug 'gro ba dang bun rnying 'khyer zhan rigs la 232

drug bdun 'gro'am/ bcu skyed sogs sna tshogs yod/ lo re 'i skyed khe bsdoms na ha lam 'bru ru'i khal 170kyatsam dang / skyed dngul srang 2500tsam yong gi yod pa 'dra/ de dus sger drag tshos bun lon satong skabs thabs shes 'di 'dra zhig spyod kyi 'dug pa ste/ sa gnasaco srid gzhung ngam/ bkras/ lhun bla brang gi skyed 'gyur gzhung 'bru gzhung dngul thog nas 'bru dngul phran bu re bun lon zhus te sger bun gtong skabs gzhung 'bru gzhung dngul 'di dang de'i thog nas btang ba yin zhes gan rgyar 'god srol yod/ de ni gzhung bla'i ngo bo ldan pa zhig yin pas phyin chad bun len do bdag bud stong gyur na khag theg la 'gel dkri byed bde yong ba'i ched du yin cing / nga tsho'i khyim tshang gis kyang bla brang rtse phyag chibs gsos ma 'bru'i thog dang / gzhung dmag phogs ma dngul steng nas bun lon phran bu blangs te gan rgya'i nang ma rtsa de dag yin zhes 'god kyi 'dug de min lha rtse rdzong ni bkras lhun bla brang gi mnga' khongs nas rdzong 'go che shos shig yin la/ 'bru rigs kyi thon 'bor bzang shos shig kyang yin/ nga tsho'i khyim tshang ni de gar chags pa 'i dpon rigs shig yin pa ma zad/ mes po dang a khu/ bu rgyud rim pa'i dus lha rtse rdzong dpon nam/ yang na yong bzhes ba/ bkar rgya ba sogs sa/ gnas de ga'i khral bsdu khrims gnon gyi las 'dzin gang rung zhig ha lam rgyumyo/ ma chad par byas pa red/ de dag so so las gzhung 'bab phul 'phros ngapal 'byor gyi kha lhag mang nyung la ma bltos pa zhig yong gi yod pa ma zad/ rdzong yong bkar gsum la dmigs bsal gyi dbang cha dang / khral 'ul nges can re bskul chog pa de tshos kyang sa gnas de gar gnas pa'i khyim ritshang la khe phan mi nyung ba zhig 'thob kyi yod pa bcas mdor na dus rabs 'di'i stod char lha smon ni lha rtse sa khul du dbang grags che shos kyi khyim tshang 233

zhig tu gyur pa red/ gong gsal lo re'i yong 'bab de tsho'i thog nas khyem tshang gi 'gro gron dang / mchod rgyun gyi 'gro song btang 'phros rnams slar yang mi ser la bun skyed btang nas rang khyim gyi dpal 'byor 'gan srung dang 'phel rgyas phran bu yong thabs bya rgyur brten gyi yod pa red/ bran g.yog thad/ gong gsal gzhis ka lnga'i khongs mi ser them dud khyon bsdoms 160skor la mi grangs 700lhag tsam yod pa mang che ba gzhi rkang bkras bla'i gzhung 'bangs yin rung mi cha mang ba'i them dud su 'os nas g.yog po dang g.yog mo gang dgos 'dems skong chog gi yod/ 'on kyang lto gos dang gla cha sogs sger pa gzhan dag gi bran g.yog las drag tsam yod par brten rang khongs min nga 'i sa/yog po 'ga' zhig kyang yod pa bcas bran g.yog dang nang zan pho mo khyon bsdoms mi grangs 20lhag tsam yod/nga tsho'i khyim rgyud kyis tshong don gnyer skyong byed myong med kyang / rang la yod pa'i 'bru rigs sprad nas khyim tshang gi mkho byed brje tshong ngam/ nyo sgrub byed kyi yod/ thad ka'i brje tshong bya yul ni stod phyogs kyi byang 'brog rnams yin cing / la rgyab lho byang dang / 'brong pa stod smad/ nag tshang /nub rgyud sogs kyi 'brog pa rnams nyer mkho'i bza' 'bru sgrub ched ston tshong dang dgun tshong zhes zhing khul du yong srol yod pa ltar lha rtse khul ni 'bru rigs thon 'bor bzang zhing / rin thang yang yas mas tshang ma las cung zad khe ba yod gshis byang 'brog mang po zhig lha rtser yong lam yod/ de yang ston tshong ni g.yag pa yin la/ dgun tshong ni lug pa yin/ rgyu mtshan ni yar lung gtsang pos ga tsos pa'i lam bar gyi chu bo rnams dar 'khyags ma thebs gong ra lug rnams brgal thabs med pa'i rkyen gyis red/byang 'brog gi thon zog gtso bo mar dang / bal/ sha/ tshwa/ bul 234

tog khu rtsid/ ra spu/ bsha' g.yag bsha' lug phyur ba sogs dang / da dung la lar byang gser phran bu dang / gla rtsi/ gcan gzan gyi pags rig/sa kyang nyung shas tsam 'khyer rgyu yod pa red/ khong tshos mkho sgrub bya rgyu gtso bo nas dang / gro/ rtsam pa/ gro zhib/ rta gsos sran ma/ pad snum sogs dang / 'tsho ba'i yo chas ha yang dang / zangs/ lcags slang / skyogs/ gri/ mdong mo sogs yin la/ da dung 'go snam mtshal ljang dang / ras cha/ sring skud/ ja/ dar cog 'brog pa 'byor ldan tshos gos chen dang / skyin kheb/ g.yu byur/ me mda'/ mde'u sogs kya nga nyo mkhan yod/brje tshong byed stangs thad/ tshwa rnams so so'i rgyab/ tshwa dgos nges tshwa sgrub pa nas ngos sbyor blangs te grangs bcad nyo ba phud/ de byings yongs rdzogs gzhung tshwa sgrub pas ga cig gyur gyis brje len byed pa dang / de min zhing 'brog thon zog ga'an rnams 'dod nyo 'dod 'tshong byed kyi yod pa /dngos zog gtso bo'i brje res kyi sde thang thad lo rabs bzhi bcu pa'i nang 'bri mar ser po 'degs khal rer brgyad sde zhes 'bru gshor kha'/ rdore dang /mar dkar po 'degs khal lnga rer bdun sde zhes gshor khal 7re tsam/bal kha' rer bzhi sde zhes 'bru gshor khal 4re/ tshwa ru'i khal bcu tham pa la dru ga cu ca/ zhes 'bru ru'i khal 6re/ phyur ba skam po ru'i khal rer do ma zhes 'bru ru'i khal 2re tsam byed/ 'on kyang zhing 'brog gi lo phyugs legs nyes kyis sde thang la 'phar chag phran bu yong gi yod pa red/ sha dang / bsha' g.yag bsha' lug sogs ni spus tshad la bltas nas rin gong gtan 'khel byed srol 'dugang tsho'i khyim tshang gis lo re mar 'degs khal 150tsam dang /235

tshags tha bubs 15tsa ma/ lug sha kho sha 100 skor tshwa ru'i khal 12 0tsam/ de min phyur ba dang / bunu/ toog khul rtsid sogs kyang phran bu re nyo sgrub byed pa bcas khyon bsdoms 'bru rigs ru'i khal 2 00khyeyaṭashrī mas tsam gyi 'brog zog nyo gi yod/de min nyer mkho'i rgya zog sgrub stangs mi// skabs der lha rtse bye ma sgang pa dang / gzar 'du khang pa/ chu 'thag bar pa/ rta dbang sob/sa tshong pa che khag tshor dpyid dus byang 'gro'i skabs 'bru ru'e khal brgya phrag 'ag9re shas/ mabo 3don byas te kho tshos byang nas ba'/ nyo sgrub kyis dgun dus rgya gar du 'tshong bar skyod skabaru nga tshos rgya zos dgos mkho tho sprad de nyo 'khyer byed cing / rgya gar gyi ma gnas la tshur lam gyi bad(la gla bsnan nas rtsis/ rgyag byed pas tshong khrom nas nyos pa las khe bar rag gi yo/da/ dngos zog gco bo ther ma dang / 'go snam/ ras cha sna chogs/ sring skud dkar sngon/'jur rta sogs dang / bza' bca' yang man dang / sman 'bras / ci ni/ bu ram/ byi ril/ se pan sogs do po kha shas/ de min rgya gar rta sga cha chang dang / sa bzhu/ shel sgo che chung sogs skabs bstun dgos mawo/ sna tshogs nyo mngags byed kyi yo da/ga'an yang lag dngul yo nga khungs gco bo yang sto da dang byang khul du 'gro mkhan tshong rigs la 'bru dang / gro/ rta drel gyi gsos chag sran ma sogs lha rtse rang du thad 7ra 'tshong ba dang / dbyar dus gtsang chu rgyas skabs lha phun khul nas ko pa glas te gzhis rtser 'bru sran gro sogs gzhung ko'i thos/ ('bebs sa/tong byed kyi yo/da/ ko ba cha sbre'/ re re'i nang tshad gzhi 'bru rigs ru'i khal 2re yod pa'i rda po 40re 'gro ba/ ko cha bdun brgyad tsam btang nas gzhis rtser nga tsho rang gi khang pa yod stabs 'bru gong 'phar chag me 236

dpags nas rim tshong byed kyi yod/ 'bru mang che ba gzhis rtse zhol du yod pa'i rgyun gtan charo kho na ljoritshong ma/ban chang ma chen po rnams dang / nartsa/cimakhe pa zer ba'i rgyun gtan 'bru rigs si‘ra 'tshong rgyag mkhan tshos nyo ba dang /gro ri sperne dzitsugs gro 'thag khang tshos nyos te rgya bag btags nas 'tshong be yod nga rad sra/na ma ni saridzas rtse khu'/ gyi khams pa tshong pa rta drel mang po yod mkhan dang gzhi sa rtse khul phiong rgyag mkha na phing /bang 'ga' shas yod pa de tshos nyo ge (redub/ rin gong bar khyad ni dper na lha rtser 'bru ru'i khal rer) rin dngu(la sra/nga 1 5tsam byed dus gzhis/ rtser ru'i khal rer srang 1ra 1btsam yong bas bdal gla phuḍasne/ 'bru rin brgya cha nyi shu lhag tsam 'phar gyi yod pa /'dra/ gzhis rtse nas/ gco bo nyer ma kho'i ja dang / phing / rgya tsho pe ga sogs lhotsho sgru/ ba byed kyi yod nga/ red/mdor na nga tsho'i khyim tsha nga gi thon khungs gtso bo 'bru rigs yen pa de le sgyu ra byanu/ nas rang gi mkho chas rnams sgrub rtsol byed pa las nyori / pa'i dngos zog rnam rsā mkhe tshong rgyag pa'i goms srol med na'ang / skabs de'i dngoskyug zog brje len dang 'tsho ba skyel stangs de ltar yin pa ni gtsang khul gyi khyim tshang che gras mang po zhig dang thun mong gi mthun cha yod par brten 'dir dpyad gshe tsam du bkod/khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor dan rgud sogs/ spyi lo'i dus rabs nyi shu 'go 'tshugs pa'i yas mas su/ dbyin 'i btsan rgyal ring lugs nga ru/ bod du btsan 'dzu'/ dang dkrug shing gi spyod ngan spel baṭadang / rang rgyal man ching srid sa/zhung rul sungs su gyur te phyi 'jam ca 2 37

nang rtsub mi rigs gnya' gnon gyi srid jus nor 'khrul can lag len bstar ba/ gzhung bla'i zhabs 'bring gtso gnad 'ga' shas kyi byed pa mi legs pa sogs phyi nang gi 'gal rkyen sna tshogs la brten na sa/ tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa dang / paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa gnyis phyi rgyar thugs snang mi mthun pa'i rnam pa chags shing / gzhung bla'i dbar phan tshun 'gal zla dza drag tu gyur nas bya rog dang 'ug pa'i ngang tshul ltar bkra mi shis pa'i rtsod gzhi mang po langs pa red/ lo rgyus kyi khor yug de lta bu'i 'og chu ma bde na nya mi bde ba'i dpe bzhin/ bla brang gi zhabs 'bring tsho yang sdod bzos bde po zhig yong ga la srid/ skabs der gtsang yab gzhis kyi 'dzin khongs mus /bang gsar gzhis kar stod tsho dka' chen zer ba zhig gis khrims 'gal lugs dkrug tshabs chen byas rkyen khang gsar gzhis sdod kyis kho pa 'dzin bzung dang 'brel rta lcag gzhus te btson 'jug bgyis pa btson khang du nad 'das song zhing / bod rnying pa'i khrims lugs ltar na nyes can khrims 'og tu shi bar brtsad gcod byed srol med na'ang / rtsa ba'i 'dzin bdag yab gzhis yin rung las byar nga tsho'i pha bsod nams phun tshogs lags kyang yod pas sa gnas srid gzhung nas stod tsho dka' chen rkyen bsad btang tshul gyod gzhi brtsad 'dri byas te yab gzhis phyag sbrel rim bzhi dang nga tsho'i pha bcas lha ṭasher ched bkug thog gyod zhib kyang bgron gnyer che mo bstan pa dar rgyas dang rtsis dpon lung shar gnyis la bskos te 'dri brtsad zhu len mthar nyes chad du rtse pho brang nas nor bu gling kha'i bar dang / rtse pho brang nas bye rasnib/ gzam pa bar gyi gzhung lam gsar bzo bya rgyu gsum gnyis yab gzhis dang /gsum gcig nga tshor bkal zhing / gzhung lam gyi zheng tshad spyi khres gsum tsam dang / mtho tshad ha lam kung phin drug cu tsam lon pa mtha' gnyis la 238

rdo rtsig dang lam gzhung sa skyong rdo skyong bcas bzo ru bcug pa ma zad/ spu ri ri tshad mi lo tshul gyi bsnyad 'dogs bskyar bzo yang yang bya dgos byung ba sogs sa rdo 'bor chen bong bu kho nar brten nas 'dren gsog dang / lam bzo'i 'ul mi lha sa'i g.yas g.yon nas gla 'tshol mi byed thabs med byung ba bcas de lta bu'i 'dzugs skrun gyi 'gro gron yongs rdzogs khyim tshang sger zhig nas gtong dgos byung rkyen lha sar gzhung sger gang sa nas dngul bun yang 'bor chen len dbos byung ba red/yang de nas lo shas song rjes/ lha rtse khul du yod pa'i ru gnon grom pa rgyang gi lha khang nyams gog tu gyur pa sa gnas srid gzhung nas nyams gso bya rgyu'i ar po'i do dam rtse drung skyid stod pa zer ba zhig lha rtser 'byor te mi ser thog khral 'ul khyon che bskul te lo kha shas ring nyams gso dang rgya skyed byas pa ma zad/ lha khang khag mang la mchod pa 'phar 'dzugs byas pa'i mchod rgyun gtong dmigs med stabs/ de gong lha rtse rdzong rnying byed mkhan rnams la lo rgyun ring thung ltar rtsis pa'i ‘‘rgyang mchod phogs ’’zhes pa'i chad 'don 'bor chen bkal bas nga tshor yang 'bru khal stong phrag 'ga' zhig 'khri ba sgrub dgos byung / dus mtshungs sa gnas srid gzhung gis zhib 'phar dmag phogs zhes pa'ang bkras lhun bla brang khongs gtogs dang bcas par gzhan las lci ba 'gel dkri byas pa ltar nga tsho'i 'dzin khongs gzhis khag lnga la'ang khyon bsdoms 'bru ru'i khal stong phrag lhag tsam re lo ltar 'phar du sprod dgos byung ba sogs kyis lha smon khyim tshang gi dpal 'byor 'bab yong thad la nyams rgud tshabs che tsam byung myong ba red/khyim tshang gyes 'dus kyi 'gyur ldog sogs/paṇa chen sku phreng dgu pa mes rgyal nang sar byol phebs gnang dgos 239

byung mthar bod du phyir log gnang ma thub pa dang / paṇa chen sku phrengatshobacu pa nga/nga 'phral 'phral gdan sar phebs ma thub pa bcas yun ring lo ngo sum cu tsam gyi ring bkras lhun bla brang gi dbang cha yongs rdzogs sa gnas srid gzhung nas btang ba'i dza sag bla ma ngo las kyis bzung zhing / bkras bla'i zhabs 'bring rnams la mthong chung brnyas bcos/ phog pa ma zad/ chag sgo nam 'phrad kyi dogs nyen rtag tu 'khur ke/ rbegs kyi yod/ thabs shes drag shos ni so so'i bu tsha zhig sa gnas srid gzhung gi 'bas 'bring khongs tshud pa'i thabs shes bya rgyu de red/ khyim tshang che gras 'ga' zhig gis rang gi bu rgyud gzhung zhabs la mag par bster ba'am/ khyim tshang zla bsgril gtong ba sogs thabs shes sna tshogs kyis gzhung zhabs zhu gi yod par brten/ lha smon khyim tshang la bu drug tsam yod khar nga tsho'i a ma'i gcen po gzhung zhabs rim bzhi chab spel bar bu med pas slad phyin zhabs rkang zhu mkhan zhig dgos pa stabs 'khel gyis nga rang bu gsum pa tshe brtan phun tshogs spyi lo1942lor chab spel gyi ming thog tu sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhabs sdod zhus pa yin/de rjes spyi lo194khalor slebs skabs bu chung ba rnams kyang rim bzhin lo na son pas gnyen sgrig byed ran pa/sa slad phyin bza' tsho mang po khyim tshang gcig nang gshib rgyu dge mtshan ma che bar brten nga tsho'i khu bo dang / a ma lags gtso bor byas pa'i bu phrug rgan pa rnams nang khul mnyam gros byas te bu gnyis pa phun tshogs rdo rje gnyen sgrig zin par pha gzhis gra sems gzhis ka dang / skal dngos 'os bab phul nas zur bzhugs thog de byings bu rgan pa ye shes tshul khrims dang / bu chung shos bsod nams lhun grub gnyis pha ma gnyis dang mnyam du lha smon ma tshang gi khang zhing thog lha rtse mtsho po gzhis ka/ dang / chu shar gzhis ka bcas khyim tshang gcig dang / bu bzhi pa mkhyen 240

rab dbang phyug dang bu lnga pa skal bzang dbang phyug gnyis la pha gzhis gdong dga' sa stod ba/zhis ka dang / ga/zhis rtse'i nor sgang khang khungs/ khang pa gsar rgyag bya rgyu 'i dod du 'bru ru'i khal 20kya0spyi thog narngashrī zur bcad bcas khyem tshang gcig bu gsum pa chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs bza' tshor pha gzhis mang mkhar khab 'og le lag dang bcas pa khyim tshang gcigade min lha smon gyi phyi nor nang rdzas gang yod dang / gzhung bla brang la 9rebul dgos chad bun phar 'gro dang tshur yong 'bru dngul bun skyed du btang ba bcas yong rdzogs dum bu gsum du bgos te tshang ma mos mthun lab rtsod ba/nga yang ma byung bar ngatso/'a dbye 'dzum gyenu/ kyi ma zur khyim tshang gsum du gtan 'khel gan 'jog thog bu gsum pa chab spel tshe brtan phun tshogs skabs 'phral zur gyes su phyin pa dang / bu lnga pa skal bzang dbang phyug dang / bu drug pa bsod nams lhun grub gnyis lo na phra zhing / khyim thabs bsu len zin med stabs lam seng log gyes ma byas mur gnas skabs bkras lhun zhabs kharibring sger ldan yul lhun po bar sras mo gnyis 'gro stangs ran bzhin pa'i stabs 'khel lha smon dang ldan lhun sngar nas 'brel zab la brten phyogaskyushrī gnyis pyi/tsho yab yum bka' gros kyis lha smon gyi bu lnga pa skal bzang dbang phyug ldan lhun sras mo tshe ring chog pa'i mdun thabs su ster nas skal thob lda/na lhun pha gzhis/ khongs gdong dkar dga' bo gnang ste logs su ba'ag pa dang /ldan nyu/na sras mo padma chos 'dzoms lha smon bu drug pa bsod nams lhun grub kyi mdun thabs la bsu len zin ma thag1kha51lo bod zhi bsdu bcings 'grol 'byung thabs skor gyi gros mthun don tshan bcu bdun la ming rtags dngos su bkod nga 'i dus 'khel zhing / bod zhi bas bcings 'grol thopa rjes spyi lo191/ 2lor kun gzigs paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng bcu pa ston 'khor 241

bod du chibs pasgyur gnang ba dang lhan du nga tsho'i gcen po lha smon ye shes tshu' khrims mchog kyang khyimyo/ thabs rgya rigs thang khrun ming bu phrug dang bcas phyir phebs byung zhing / lo shas song rjes bla brang gi byes phebs zhabs 'bring gtso gras rnams la yun ring dka' sdug khyad bsad kyis zhabs 'degs hur thag zhus par byas rjes la dpag nas gzigs bzos gnang ba ltar gcen po ye shes tshul khrims la'ang lha rtse mang mkhar phu gnas gzhis ka dang / gzhis rtse gdong dkar gzhis ka bcas kha 'dzin gtan 'jags su gnang ba red/skabs de nas bzung dus bab 'gyur ldog che bas lha smon gyi khyim tshang kha gyes sngon gtan 'khel ba'i gnas tshul la'ang rang shugs kyis shugs rkyen thebs nas 'di byed gtan ma 'khel mur lo shas song rjes/ 1959lo bod kyi ngo log zing 'khrug zhod 'jags su btang zhing / dmangs gtso'i bcos sgyur byas pa'i nang nga tsho lha smon gyi khyim rgyud ma zur tshang ma zing 'khrug khongs med stabs blu nyo'i srid jus thob/lha smon khyim rgyud kyi mis gzhung bla'i las gnas go ming ji 'khur sogs/nga tsho'i mes po bsod nams tshe brtan gyis bkras lhun bla brang gi zhabs 'bring zhus nas gcen lung gzhis sdod dang / lha rtse rdzong sdod/ lha rtse bkar rgya ba/ bla brang rtse phyag las khungs kyi rtse phyag las 'phar/ lha ngam phun gsum gyi spyi khyab rim bzhi sogs gnang myong ba red/nga tsho'i pha bsod nams phun tshogs kyis bla brang gi zhabs 'bring zhus nas mus khang gsar gzhis sdod dang / rgyal rtse brag khug gzhis dzod/ lha 242

rtse rdzong dang / yong bzhes pa/ lha sa'i mi khang 'go pa las tshan pa sogs gnang ba red/nga tsho'i pha grongs rjes a khu phun tshogs rgyal po la bla brang gi zhabs 'bring zhu dgos phebs pa ltar zhus nas lha rtse rdzong dang / bkar rgya ba/ yong bzhes pa sogs gnang myong ba red/nga tsho'i gcen po ye shes tshul khrims nas paṇa chen rin po che sku phreng dgu pa byes/ phebs kyi zhabs 'bring zhus nas dang thog tshan zhabs pa dang de nas bzhugs sgar nang sgang gi las tshan pa/ rtse mgron/ drung yig che mo/nang sgang gi dza sag rim pa gsum pa sogs gnang myong ba red/bu gnyis pa phun tshogs rdo rjes bla brang gi zhabs 'bring zhus nas las tshan pa'i go ming bzhes myong ba red/ bu gsum pa tshe brtan phun tshogs kyis sger chab spel ba'i ming thog sa gnas srid gzhung gi zhabs 'bring zhus nas bka' shag gi 'gag pa dang rgyal rtse rdzong sdod/ gzhung rtsis zhib khang gi las bya/ legs rtse bla ko'i tshwa sho/skyid grong rdzong sdod/ shangs rnam gling rdzong sdod rim pa lnga pa'i las tshan pa bcas byed myong yod/bu bzhi pa mkhyen rab dbang phyug gis bla brang rtse drung zhus nas lha rtse yong bzhes pa dang / rtse drung las tshan pa/ bla brang yig tshang las khungs kyi drung che gzhon pa/ paṇa chen rin po che'i sku bcar mkhan chung rim pa bzhi pa sogs byed myong ba red/bu drug pa bsod nams lhun grub kyis bla brang gi zhabs 'bring zhus nas nang rnam gyi go ming dang / paṇa chen rin po che'i yig 'dri'i zhabs 'degs zhu myong ba bcas yin/243

lha/ smo na mi rgyud kyi khrod nas myori dzasto tna/ rjos cung che ba ni lha smon ye shes tshusnye / / khrims rang yin/ khong gis paca// chen dgu pa'i sku tshe'i smad la mtshan nyid dang phyag dpe'i zhabs zhu bzhed dngo/ngas dang mthun pa zhu gnang mdzad pa dang / yul dus kyi dal/'a ngal ha cang che ba'i gnas tshul 'og bla brang nang sgang bzhugs sgar thor zhig tu mi 'gyur ba dang / rngapreṇa chen sku phreng bcu pa yang srid ngos 'dzin khri gso'/ dang 'a brel gdan sar spyan 'dren thog mes rgyal gong bu gcig gyur gyi bya gzhag chen po bcas sgrub pa'i nang khong gis 'don 'os pa'i nus pa mi nyung ba zhig legs skyes su 'bul gnang mdzad yod pa red/dus mtshungs nga tsho'i khyim rgyud nang ma/sa rig gnas mkhas pa'ang ye shes tshul khrims kho na yin te/ khong dgung lo gzhon nu'i dus nas bod kyi rig gnas slob sbyong thugs brtson ha cang che bas rang— rtogs kyis mkhas pa mang po'i zhabs la gtugs nas bod yig 'obri klog dang / sum rtags dag yig sogs brda dag rig pa la mkhas par mdzad pas dgung lo bcu bdun tsam nas mkhas pa mgu ba'i rtsom rig brtsams 'go tshugs shing / lhag par pha mas kyang bkag ma thub par sadan sa chen po se ra theg chen gling du chos zhugs gnang ba ma zad/ grwa rgyun dbul phongs kyi 'tsho ba nyams su bzhes nas dge bshes mkhas pa du ma slob dpon du bsten te gzhung chen bka' pod lnga ‘ro gsan sbyong dang rtsod rīr rtag zhugs sogs nyin mtshan g.yel med du 'bad brtson mdzad stabs ser byes mkhas mang grwa tshang khongs dpe cha ba gzhon skyes kyi khrod du mkhas pa'i snyam/ grags gzengs su thon pa byung / de rjes mes rgyal nang sar phebs dgos sharonas nga ṇa chen sku gong ma dang / la wo/ rin po che sogs mdo smad kyi mkhu/ pes/ nga/ mang po bsten 'os rigs gzhung snyel 3ji1

thugs brtson mdzad pa bcas sku tshe'i stod la mkhas pa'i bya ba gsum la rtag 'grus su gzhol bar mdzad/ gsung rtsom mang du yod pa'i gtso bo 〈rje btsunami la'i rtogs brjod〉snyan tshig gi lam du drangs pa ches phul du byung ba zhig dang / 〈〈skya seng bu lnga'i byung ba brjod pa blo ldan yid dbang 'dren byed rmad byung 'phul gyi shing rta〉 〈dge sbyong gzhon nu dang nags lha sgeg mo'i 'bel gtam mkhas pa bzhad pa'i sgra dbyangs〉 bcas nas phyi ma gnyis da lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod cing / bka' rtsom gong ma dang de min mang po zhig ci dus kyi 'gyur ba sna tshogs pa'i rkyen dbang gis rtsa med du gyur mod/'on kyang da yod kyi rtsom rig gnyis po'i thog nanu/ bltas na/ khong ni dus rabs 'di'i nang byung ba'i bod kyi mkhas pa'i khrod du snyan ngag smra ba la mi 'jigs pa'i gdengs dang ldan pa'i rtsom rig mkhas can zhig yin zhes mgrin pa gzengs su bstod nas bshad chogalha smon khyim rgyud kyi spyi tshogs 'brel ba gtso che ba/gong 'khod bzhin lha rtse sa khul du de snga lhug skyid pa dang lha rtse skyid sbug pa gnyis nga tsho'i pha mes kyi dus nas gnyen tshan gyi 'brel ba yod la/ lha rtse rdzong khongs yongs la skyid smon lhug gsum zhes mi drag che shos kyi khyim tshang gsum yin stabs phan tshun gzhogs 'degs su rgud su dar gyis rogs ram lta skyong byed pa'i 'brel ba dam zab yod pa dang / nga tsho'i a ma'i pha gcig ma gcig gi spun mched sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs rim bzhi chab spel ba dang / bka' drung smon skyid gling pa/ shod drung 'chum bkras pa 245

bcas la gnyen nye'i 'brel ba ha cang dam zab byed myong yod/ nga tshos mi rabs 'di'i bza' zla'i khyim tshang sa gnas srid gzhung gi dpon rigs mdo zur ba dang bla brang gi zhabs 'bring khongs ldan yul lhun po ba sogs dang gnyen nye'i 'brel ba dam zab byed kyi yod pa bcas so/246

rtsa hreng rdzong khongs kyi mtha' mtshams la sgo khag la de snga phyi phyogs tshong las sogs kyi 'gro 'ong byed srol yod pa'i skor/mnga' ris sa gnas srid gros lo rgyus rtsom 'bri tshogs chung gis/sngar zhang zhung gi yul sde rnams bod kyi mnga' 'og tu bsdus pa'i thog ma'i dus skabs su de'i mtha' mtshams khag la sa mtshams gtan 'khel gsal po byung med kyang / de rjes tā la'i bla ma sku phreng lnga pa'i sku dus su dga' ldan tshe dbang gis la sing dmag phyir ldog mdzad rjes gzhi nas rim bzhin la sgo khag la sa mtshams gtan 'khel mdzad lugs grags la/ de bzhin sa gnas kyi 'brel ba dang / chos 'brel/ gnyen 'brel yang mi nyung ba zhig byung yod pa red/phyi phyogs su 'brel lam byed sgor mtshon na ram spur rgyal po nas rtsa hreng rdzong la ‘lo gsum pho nya’’zhes pa btang nas 'bul mtshan du spos a ka ru dang /ras ka shi pub gsum bzhi tsam/ me mda'‘‘kru pi dar’’gcig bcas yig rgya lkogs ldan dang sbrags gtong srol yod pa dang / de lan rtsa rdzong nas rta co pa(lo sngon ma'i rti'u) gcigre/ dang / yig rgya kha btags bcas gtong dgos pa ma zad/ lam bar sa tshigs so sos rta khal dang / 'o ma/ rtsam pa/247

bza' sha/ sdod sgrig thab shing sogs sprod gtong bya srol yod/ ga(nan yang rtsa rdzong mtsho pad mar gnas mjal 'gro dus khu nu bas lam bar la sdod sgrig dang rta thab sogs gong bzhin sprod gtong bya srol dang / rtsa rdzong gi/sa la sgo khag la lo ltar tshong 'brel skor dang / yul 'u/nga pha na tshun bde 'jags yod med 'tshams 'dri byed par lho steng dang byenu/ dka/ra/ za reng bcas yul tshan gsum nas pho nya mi gnyis re 'gro dgos shing / pho nya mi gnyis po de spyir btang bod zla gnyis pa tsam la gtong gi yod la/ 'gro dus lo ltar rtsa rdzong nas khu nu mi da mangs la bsku ra ba'i yig rgya lko gas ldan gcig yod pa de nyid thog mar‘‘spor sber mo’’zhes nga/ra 'bul dgos nga/ dang / spor sber mo zer ba de spor pa ni gi'i bza' zla yin cing / ne gi ni sngar ram spor rgyal po'i bka' blon yin pa red/ spor sber mo nas mu rang ngo pa la sprad rjenu/ jo pas bod yig de mon yig la bsgyur te gzhi nas khu nu'i mi dmangs la brgyud bsgrags byed kyi yod pa red/ gong gsal pho nya gnyis po skyod skabs phar lam ne sang brgyud bskyod tshe tshur lam kun dang rtsa hreng brgyud phyir log dgos pa dang / phar lham kun dang rtsa hreng brgyud bskyod tshe tshur lam ne sang brgyud phyir log byed srol dang / pho nya gnyis po phyir lo ga gdong khu nu'i mi dmangs nas kyang rtsa hreng rdzong la yig rgya lkogs ldan zhig 'bul srol yod pa ma zad/pho nya gnyis por hin sgor gnyis re dang za chas sdod sgrig dang 'brel bca' dngos skyel mkhan du yul tshan so so nas 'khur po 'khur mkhan mi gnyis gtong sro'/ yod/ de bzhin grong gnyis rong la'ang rtsa hreng rdzong nas lo ltar rwa dpon zer ba'i mi ser khongs nas pho nya mi gnyis re gtong danyos shing /de gdong rtsa hreng rdzong nas rong par snam dkar bub gcig dang / g.yag si rnga ma dkar po gcig ja sbag gcig yig rgya lkogs ldan zhigre bcas 248

bskur srol dang / pho nya phyir log gdong rong nas kyang rtsa rdzong la ras ka shi 'doms lnga bcu dang / dzwa ti/ mngar cha lug phad phyed ka bcas bskur srol yong/ yang rtsa hreng rdzong nas/ lo ltar mkhar srur yul tsho ba/nyis kyi rgan po mi gnyiru/ dang bar rdzong nas mi sa/cig bcas tshong sa brgyud bho 'khor du tri ri rgyal po'i ngo tshab sar hin rdu khul mi phyugs tshang ma bde 'tshams yod med kyi gan/sa tshul 'dri zhib byed par mngags gtong gis bde 'tshams yin na hin rdu'i miskyu4 rdo gcig bcag ste phyed ka kho tshos nyar thog phyed ka rgan po gnyis brgyud rtsa hreng rdzong la 'bu'/ bskur byed srol de ni phan tshun gnyis kas mtha' mtshams kyi mi phyugs bde 'jags la 'gan 'khur dgos pa'i chod yig ‘lta bu sngar sro94 yin pa red/ srib skye nas kyang khu nu nyin pa phyogs la pho nya 'gro srol yang yod/ hin rdu nas tshong spyi sa/ra sha dpon zer ba de skyo nam la sbo dang / srib skye la sgo gnyis la lo re motra4 kyis brgyud de sgar dbyar sa'i tshong ra dang rgya nyi ma'i tshong ra gnyis gtso bor byas te bskor bskyod byed skabs ngo g.yog nyi shu lhag tsam yo nga bar nga tshos sa tshigs lam 'khel so sos rta khal lnga bcu lhag tsam dang / thab shing / 'o ma sogs/ gtong dgos pa dang /phan tshurme/ yun ring tshong 'brel dang / gnas skor sosas kyi 'brel ba chags pa brgyud spun mched mang po yod pa ma zad/ khu nu nyin pa dang / spu ba bro ba gling khab rnam rgyal/ cang pa/ na go spi ti/ khu nu grib pa/kun rtsa rang bcas ni rang re'i myo/tham mtshams mang tshogs dang chos lugs/gom/sa gshis/ skad lugs 'tsho ba'i spyod stangs sos/sa gcig mtshungs yin cing // rgan rabs kyi shod srol du'ang lho steng dgon la kun dang / rtsa hreng gnyisarme cha/sa grwa rgyun gcig dang / ne sa nga mi dmangs nas bye dkar dgon pa grwa rgyun gcig gtong sro la byung yod skad 'dugasna 249

tshong 'brel byed phyogs thad/ hin rdu sa khul du grong gnyis tshong ra dang / bho 'khor tshong ra/ drug khag tshong ra/ ram spor tshong ra/ cang nag tshong ra/ spi ti sogs la rang ljongs kyi 'brog pa rnams tshwa bal/sems can/ mar phyur sogs 'ded 'khyer gyis tshong rgyag tu 'gro ba dang /rang ljongs khul du rwa dmar dang / spu gling / spu gling gsum mdo/zangs tshong sa/ dong pa rwa sogs la rong pa'i 'bru rigs da nga / zangs snod/ rag snod/ lcags zangs / tshal slang sogs 'tsho ba'i yo byad/mngar cha'i rigs dang / sa cha/ 'bu ras/ 'go snam/ bal ther/dag rdzas/ tsag kra sur ti/ tha mag dar lcog shing 'bras rigs sna tshogs sogs 'khyer nas tshong rgyag gi yod pa ma zad/ rang mos kyis yul tshan so so'i dud tshang gi sgo 'gram du chong rgyag par 'gro 'ong byed srol yod pa red/ dper na/ dong pa rwa tshong rar cha mtshon na/ dong pa rwa zer ba ni/da lta bsri yag chus khongs lhug zer ba yi na/ 'brog sa zhig tu bod zla 6 pa'i tshes 'go nas zla mjug bar nyin bco lnga nas nyi shu tsam tshongarnar tshogs pa der hin rdu'i tshong pa khu nu grib pa zer ba sngar ram spur rgyal po'i mnga' khongs kyi mi se ra yin pa'i 'thod drug yul drug zer ba'i 'tsho pa gnyis kyis ra lug la 'bru bka' nas za reng chus khongs drug phag la sgo brgyud nas yong ba dang /rang re'i tshong pa nas 'brog zer ba kha sto/da 'tsho pa (deng sang shang rtse chus khongs) dang phyi 'brog zer ba (deng sang bkras sgang chus khongs) glang ngar skor gnyer/ bkras sgang dgon gyi la stod skor pa dang chibs dpon/gzhung so drug rgya smu ga bcas nas lug la tshwa bkal nas ngo nga ste/ snga mo nas so sor ngo shes re yod pa de dag la rang rang gi chong rgyag pa las/gzhan gyi tshong pa su byung gi tshwa 'bru brje len mi chog de min gyi dngos rdzas 250

sna rigs tshong rgyag chog gi yod cing / byang rong gnyis dus bkag 'dzoms dus kyi gan rgya bzhag yod pas dus 'gyangs byung tshe chad pa 'gel gyi yod/tshwa 'bru brje res byed pa'i thang gzhi sngon ma nas gtan 'khel bzos yod pa ste 'bras dkar po rgyab gcig la tshwa rgyab gsum dang / 'bras dmar po rgyab gcig la tshwa rgyab gnyis/ sne 'bru rgyab gnyis la tshwa rgyab gsum/ bra phye rgyab gcig la tshwa rgyab gnyis/ rgyam 'bras rgyab gnyis la tshwa rgyab gsumyo// rdzong kor rgyab gcig la tshwa rgyab gnyis/ tse tse rgyab gcig la tshwa rgyab gcig so 'bru rgyab gcig la tshwa rgyab gcig bcas dang / tshwa rgyab re'i rjes la bal rgyab re sprod dgos/ bal rin rgyab bal rer dbyin sgor phyed ka re dang / yang na bal sher bdun la rin sgor re sprod pa/ (bal mon sher lnga la rgya ma bzhi red) spyorabrog pa'i lug gdang la btags nas bal de lug thog nas rong pas 'dreg dgos pa dang / tshwa'ang rong pas 'jal gyi yod pa red/ 'bras 'bru sogs byang pas gshor srol yod/ de min sa khul de'i 'brog pa dang /phyogs gzhan nas 'ong ba'i 'brog pa rnams kyis rta dang / ra lug bong bu/ mdzo/ khyi/ bal/ mar phyur/ le na/ pags rigs/btsugs phrug btsugs gdan/ thag pa/ 'phya ra/ sgye/ chang dang a rag sogs kyi tshong las byed cing / dus thung de'i ring tshong ra 'khrug po gang 'tshams yod pa red/ rin gong thad so so'i rang mos kyis bsgrigs kyi yod/tshwa 'bru lhag 'phros yod na gzhan gyi tshong pa su byung gis dngul lam dngos po gang rung sprad nas nyo tshong chog gi yod pa red/ sngar tshong ra der rtsa hreng rdzong gis sku tshab mngags nas khral bsdu byed kyi yod pa dang / lhug pa mi ser gyi 'go pas tshwa 'bru gshor kha rgyag pa las/ gzhan gang byung gis gshor kha rgyag mi chog pas gshor kha rgyag mis tshwa gla zer ba dang / steb gla zer ba'i 251

gla cha len gyi yod pa ma zad/ sku tshab dang 'go pa gnyis la byang rong gnyis nas lto dod kyang sprod kyi yod cing / de rjes lhug rnga/ gzhung rgyugs mi ser gyis snyad 'dogs byas nas rtswa rin chu rin len pa dang / rdzong gi sku tshab nas ngo tshong yin zhes spus bsgyur btang ba sogs byas stabs byang rong tshong pa'i blo la ma babs par sgar dpon lhan rgyas sar rong pa'i 'go gtso spor gzim khang gi ne ge zer ba dang / nang 'brog pa'i 'go gtso rab gling gnyer pa ngag don dang / phyi 'brog pa'i 'go gtso bkras sgang dbu mdzad sogs 'thus mi mi drag khag gcig gis gzhung gtug byas nas 'gro song ji snyed cig btang ba'i mthar sngar bzhin rang mos kyi tshong rgyag chog pa dang / sa cha yang rtswa chu 'dzoms sar sngon gyi tshong ra nas spyi le gnyis kyi bar thag yod pa'i rta rwa mug rum(da lta spyi ming la dong pa ra zer) zer ba'i sa char tshong ra tshugs pa red/ der rtsa rdzong nas sku tshab gtong ma dgos la/ci lhug pa nas 'go pa yang gtong ma dgos par sgar dpon gnyis nas sgar tham 'byar ma'i bka' gtan sprad yod pas kha rgyun du gser dngul gyi thang ka nyos yod zer nas kha dpa' shod bzhin rang mos kyi tshong rgyag gi yod pa bcas/252

de mo sprul sku sku gong ma'i skor de snga'i spyi tshogs thog gi shod srol gang thos thor bu/ blo bzang rgya mtshos /de mo a chi ho thog thu 'phrin las rab rgyas mchog nas tā la'i bla ma sku phreng bcu gsum pa chen po'i dbu skra'i gtsug phud bzhes pa dang yongs 'dzin dang rgyal tshab kyi thugs 'gan bzhes pas skyabs mgon rtse shod (tā la'i bla mar rtse dang rgyal tshab la shod )zhu/ rtse drung ye shes chos 'byor zer ba de mo rin po che'i gzim zhabs su sdod dgos bka' phab 'dug par kho pas bslab skyon byung tshul gyis gzim zhabs dgongs zhu byas kyang dgongs pa ma 'khrol bar zhabs gras su thugs nyar mdzad/ nub gcig rtse drung ye shes chos 'byor gyi rmi lam la‘‘skyes pa gos dkar gyon pa zhig gis de mo'i mjal khar gtong rogs zer/ da lta dus tshod snga po red lab kyang gser thang khug gang 'bul rgyu yod ces dbu nan che bas mjal khar gtong skabs gser thang khug de gsol cog steng du bzhag de nas bstan gling dgon pa rtsa zhig song ba dang chabs cig thal rlung gis lha sa sgrib pa ltar langs pa’’zhig rmis pa dang /gnyid sangs 'phral rmis ltas ngan snyam sems 'tshab nas nam langs ma thag mi lam gyi gnas tshul rnams de mo rin po cher zhus par rgyal tshab kyi las 'khur 'dis bstan pa chab srid kyi mtshan lar mi dman tsam yong nges kyang /253

rang sger dang bstan gling bla brang la 'tshub lhongs che ba'i mtshan ma red/ de skor phyag mdzod nor bu tshe ring (de mo'i phyag mdzod )la ma shod gsungs/phyag mdzod nor bu tshe ring gis rgyal dbang sku phreng bcu gsum pa mchog la ngan gtad 'jug dgos pa'i dang po'i bsamyo/ ngan byung rkyen ni kong po ba khyim pa 'byor ldan zhig dang dbul phongs pha bu gnyis dbar rtsod gzhi chen po zhig byung mthar phyogs gnyis kas lha sar gyod don zhu gtugs byed par song zhing / 'byor ldan pa der bden don med kyang bstan gling de mo rgyal tshab kyi phyag mdzod nor bu tshe ring la nang 'byar byas te bden brdzun go ldog gi rgyal kha thob re byas/ gyod ya pha bu gnyis kyi bden don spyi dang / lhag par de mo'i phyag mdzod nor tshe dang / 'byor ldan khyim bdag gnyis gsang ba'i ngan 'brel byas nyes tshabs chen yod pa'i rgyu mtshan zhu gtugs byas kyang dag 'bud ma thub par phyag mdzod nor tshe'i dbang shugs ngan skul 'og nyes pa gang yang med pa'i bu de lha sa zhol las khungs kyi btson khang du bcugabatson lto skyel skabs dngos po sne re 'byor lan gyi tshul du yin gcig min gcig phyir log bskur gyi yod 'dug nyin zhig pha des ke tshang rin po che'i sku mdun du bcar nas gyod don zhib lhongs dang 'brel bden pa rang nyid la yod na'ang bden thog 'khyol bzo ma mngon pa 'di mur sdug 'khur mi byed mthu med lags kyang bu de srog skyon mi yong bar btson 'grol yong thabs zhu phyogs gang drag yong ba zhes ngu 'bod dang sbrags skyabs 'jug zhus par ke tshang rin po ches rogs ram gnang rgyu'i zhal bzhes gnang ba ltar tā la'i bla ma mchog la nang snyan gsol zhing / tā la'i bla ma ma chog nas kyang de mo rgyal tshab la brgyud zhu gnang ste don smin yong ba mdzad rgyu'i dbu mna' bzhes te de mo rgyal tshab la gnas lugs snyan gsol mdzad don/ de mos nor bu tshe ring 254
