'a/ bka' brtsad gnang yang / nor tshe dang kong si da 'byor ldan dbar gyi tshabs che'i byas nyes mthil rtol dogs kyis bu de bcom/ /kharo nang bsang/bu de'i a phas lto chas bskyel bar mu mthud 'gro skabs nyin gnyis gsum so nga yang 'byor brda dngos po bskur mkhan med stabs bsad tshar ba'i ngos 'dzin byas te slar yang ke tshang rin po che'i sar bcar nas smre sngags 'don bzhin par gnas lugs snyan seng dang sbrags thugs smon skyabs 'jug zhus/ke tshang rin po che yang thugs 'gyod ha cang chen po byung ste ri mor bris pa'i gzugs/ brnyan ji bzhin bzhugs/ de skor tā la'i bla ma mchog nas de mo rgyal tshab brgyud bka' brtsad ba/nang yang phyag mdzod nor tshes btson khang du yod pa'i kong po ba dbul phongs kyi bu de bzhin gsang ba'i sgo nas rkyen lam du btang zin par brten tā la'i bla ma mchog dgongs tshom chen po byung ste las don gang ci ngan pa byas rgyal 'di dbang song na bod 'bangs nyams chung 'tsho thabs bral nges la dgongs te da cha bod kyi chos srid skyong lugs ji 'gab dang / da lam don rkyen 'di'i byed gte brtsad zhib mthar phyin mdzad phyogs dgongs bzhes gnang bzhin pa'i skabs su bod ljongs tshogs 'dus de mo rgyal tshab la da cha rgyal dbang mchog nas chos srid thugs 'gan bzhes rgyu skabs su babs pas rgyal tshab gang nyid dgongs zhu gnang na legs gnas dang 'di skor bod bzhugs am ban la snyan seng zhus med pas gsang rgya gnang 'os zhes zhus parobarten rgyal tshab gnang yun thung yang dgongs zhu gnang dgos 'byung 'char la brten de mo'i phyogs gtogs blo yid ma 'tshim pa sogs kyis 'gal rkyen mang dag chags shing / lhag par de mo'i phyag mdzod nor tshe nas rang nyid 'gebs srung ched nyag sprul dang 'phyongs rgyas dpal ri tshogs rgyal sprul sku dang ngan 'brel byas te ngan bsngags 'khor lo 255

dang / ling ka'i ri mo 'dri bzhin skabs nor tshe'i g.yog po zhig gis ja skye‘smu bar yong skabs mthong bas nor tshes gsang ba'i bya ngan phyi gyar 'byung dogs kyis de 'phral g.yog po der las ka yod tshul bshad de mdzod khang nang khrid nas bsad pa rjes su bstan bla gzhung bzhes kyis mdzod khang zhib bsher skabs ja sgam brtsigs gseng nas phung po thon pa red/ nor bu tshe ring can nas ngan sngags 'khor lo bcug pa'i zhabs lham gcig bzos te de mo rin po che'i 'bul ba yin khul gyis gter ston bsod nams rgyal po brgyud tā la'i bla ma mchog la 'bul rgyu bskul don bzhin phul ba dang / pho brang(po tā la'i)phyogs bzhir ngan ltas sbas pa/ da dung ngan bsngags 'khor lo bcug pa'i chibs sga gcig kyang bzos yod skad/ zhabs lham de tā la'i bla ma mchog nas ga dus bzhes na'ang shang khrag 'bab kyi yod pas gsol gzim tsho dogs pa byung nas bka' shag la snyan seng zhus pa dang de 'brel gnas chung chos skyong gzim chung spyan 'dren zhus par‘‘gter ston ming can la 'dri ba gyis’’zhes lung bstan pa ltar gter ston bsod rgyal gdan zhus brtsad zhib thog sngon phul zhabs lham de phral skabs lham mthil bar nas ngan ltas 'khor lo gsal thon byung bas de 'phral bar gzhis spyi mkhan dang / bka' blon bshad sgra bas gtso bo 'gan bzhes te de mo rin po che rgyal dbang mchog gi zhabs brtan dbu bzhugs su phebs dgos tshul gdan zhus ltar phebs ma thag rtse shar chen lcog tu btson 'jug byas pa dang / 'on kyang de mo rin po ches phyag mdzod nor tshe'i phyogs gtogs kyi bya ngan de rigs gsal po mkhyen gyi med skad 'dug de nas de mo rin po che bstan gling spro khang du bzang btson lta bur spo bzhugs gnang rjes dgongs pa rdzogs/ rgyal thog skabs thab brten gsar du phul ba rdzong gzhis dang / dgon sde sogs dang bstan bla gzhung bzhes 256

spu//nang ba tsam las/ bstan gling grwa tshang dang / de mo rgyal thog gong thab brten phul yod pa rnams rang 'jags gnas/ yadzee bshad sgros gzhan 'ig la nge mo rin/ po che stod mnga' ris su rgyang 'a bud btang zhing / gdan sa gsum gyi zhu ngos nyes can gzhan 'gro srol ji bzhin ma dgos pa lha sa skyid chu'i khad bar phebs skyel zhus te chu shur bar ko thog phebs/ de mo'i gsang yum 'od zer sgrol ma pher ba zhig yod pa chu shur bar mnyam phebs chog pa byung / skabs der de mos‘‘ko ba mtshan la gtong dgos/ sde pa gzhung gi bka' red/ mnyan dpon bsod nams 'brug rgyal/ 'od zer chu la zags yong / de mo nga ni drag 'gro/ mnga' ris kham bu zas chog de las bstan rgyas gling dang / 'od zer sgrol ma bsdug ga’’zhes gzhas tshig 'di 'dra zhig bzos gnang yod pa de dag dmangs khrod du khyab yod zer/de bla'i phyag mdzod nor bu tshe ring la gzhung nas gzhung sa'i phyag las mdzad rjes bzang bas tha'i ji'i go gnas stsal ba ltar gsar mjal 'phral du zhu dgos lugs g.yo thabs kyi yig chung btang 'byor bzhin kho pa gzab mchor dang bcas rtse pho brang du bcar ma thag btson 'jug byas mthar la thigs brgyab pa sogs khrims chad 'og rkyen lam du btang / nyag sprul 'dzin bzung byas te rtse shar lcog tu btson 'jug byas rjes kho pa kasang spyod nang gri btsugs nas rang shi brgyab/ 'phyongs rgyas dpal ri tshogs rgyal sprul sku ya nga do dam rjes btson khang nang 'das/ slad tshogs rgyal sprul sku'i yang srid brtsad gcod mi chog pa dang tshogs rgyal bla brang gi lo re'i yong 'bab ji yod 1kha5〈lo'i bar lo ltar 'phyongs rgyas rdzong nas dpal ri bkar 'jug ces zur du bkar 'jug byed mus yin/gong gsal nyes don zhib brtsad byed bzhin pa'i thog gnas chung chos 257

skyong spya na 'dren dgongs skor zhus par ngan gtad sbas yod pas 'phyongs rgyas spyan g.yas ra mgo can la 'don du 'jug dgos kyi lung gsal ltar ra mgo can gyi sku rten ched 'bod spyan 'dren zhus pas ra mo che rdo gcal nang lcang rgan 'og nas sdig pa rwa can gyi gzugs brnyan shin tu che ba zhig bton pa de'i khog nang nas tā la'i bla ma mchog gi na bza' tshal bu yod pa rgan rabs tshos mthong 'dug nyag sprul gyi phung po gnyan kha nag tu sa sbas btang steng du mchod rten bzhengs pa de bzhin gas pa dang skabs der tā la'i bla ma mchog rtse pho brang dang nor gling du yar mar ga dus phebs kyang de nyin dmigs bsal thal rlung chen po langs kyi yod pa ma zad/ lhag par dbyin ji'i dmag skabs dbyin ji phag rir 'byor skabs dbyin jis zhi mol bya rgyu'i 'dod tshul ston pa rgyal dbang mchog la snyan seng zhus pa de skor gnas chung chos skyong zhus pa'i lung du 'gog rgol bya dgos gsal ba ltar byas par dmas/pham ste dbyin dmag chu mig shan 'gor 'byor/ yang dbyin jis gong bzhin 'dod tshul ston pa snyan seng zhus par gnas chung chos skyong zhus pa'i lung gsal du 'ching mol byed dgos gsal ba ltar gros mol bya bar lha sding mda' dpon sogs phebs par dbyin ji'i g.yo 'og tshud de dmar gsod btang nas dbyin dmag rgyal rtser slebs/ de don snyan seng zhus par chos skyong nas lung don snga phyi phyogs 'gal byung stabs dogs gcod mdzad phyir slar yang chos skyong la zhi drag ji 'gab lung zhu phul lan la rgol na rgyal kha thob nges gsal bar brten tā la'i bla ma mchog nas 'phral mar chos skyong la rgyug rdung tshad med gtong gnang thog lung don phyogs 'gal snga phyi yong rkyen zhib 'jug gnang skabs nyag sprul gnas chung du rdzus pa ra 'phrod byung gshis gling tshang rin po che gdan zhus gdon 'dre nyag sprul drag po'i sbyin bsrigs 258

gnang rjes gling sprul cham nad lta bus bsnyun mur dgongs pa rdzogs skad nyag sprul gyi gnod pa zhig med par slar yang rmin gling rdor 'dzin rnam grol rgya mtsho dang nyag sprul de snga blo slob gcig gyur la brten rmin gling rdor 'dzin zhus kyis zhi ba'i sbyin bsregs gnang bas de nas bzung nyag sprul gyi gnod pa zhi skad bcas so/

de snga'i bod sa gnas srid gzhung gis lha sar yod pa'i go min tang don gcod khru'i mi sna sogs phyir slog btang ba'i snga rjes kyi lo rgyus dum bu/bshad sgra dga' ldan dpal 'byor gyis/de sngon mes rgyal nang sar gung khran tang gi dbu khrid 'og skam sa chen po'i khyon la bcings 'grol gtong ba'i g.yul 'gyed la rgyal kha 'thob bzhin pa'i grags pa tha gru yongs su khyab cing / go min tang dang de'i ngan rogs btsan rgyal ring lugs kyi stobs shugs yongs rdzogs pham nyes su 'gro bar skyobs thabs bral nga'i nyen kha'i gnas su je nyer 'gro ba'i gnas tshul 'og bod du yod pa'i btsan rgyal ring lugs stobs shugs kyis sa phyogs gang sar dkrog gtam dang / mi sems dkrug pa'i thabs ngan gang yong byed par shugs snon brgyab pa'i nyer len gyis bod kyi dbang sgyur shog kha dang / go rtogs ma sad pa mang por 'jigs snang chen po skyes te gung khran tang gi stobs shugs bod la mi slebs pa'i thabs shes gang yong bya rgyur bsam gzhigs yod rgu byed bzhin pa'i skabs der lha sdod rgya gar gzhung tshab dbyin ji pa ri car san zer ba des bod kyi nang srid skor la rogs ram yin khul gyis the jus byed kyi yod lugs yongs grags thog bod sa gnas srid gzhung dang rgya 260

gar gzhung phan tshun 'brel ba byed skabs de snga'i bod gzhung phyi rgyal las khungs su ri car san ngo bskyod byed pa 'am/ skabs 'gar phyi rgyal do dam dza sag ser skya gnyis re sne'u shar thub bstan thar pa dang / zur khang zur pa dbang chen tshe brtan rgya gar sku tshab sdod yul bde skyid gling gar 'gro ba dang /skabs re phyi rgyal las khungs kyi do dam dza sag sne'u shar drung jar 'gro zhor du bde skyid gling gar bskyod de 'phros mol byas pa'i tshig tho bka' shag tu 'bul gyi 'dug‘‘rgya mi phyir 'bud’’zer ba'i don rkyen de byung dus rang nyid bka' mgron gyi las gnas yin pas sa glang(1949) lo'i zla 6pa'i nang bka' blon tshos rang nyid la nyin gcig glo bur du 'gan dkri byas don bka' shag shod kyi〈srin mo gan deb〉nang gsal mtha' 'dul yang 'dul gyi gnas rten dang / lha khul dge 'phel dbu rtse/ jo mo sil sil/ lcags zam chu bo ri/lho khul bsam yas has po ri la sogs pa'i srid pa'i lha chen dang / bod skyong sku lha gnas yul ri chen khag tu rang khungs so so'i chog grwas bstan srid bde thabs su rgyag brngan lha bsangs dang / dkar phyogs skyong ba'i lha srung rnams dbu 'phangs bstod pa'i gsol mchod gnad smin tshugs rgyu'i mchod chas bsnyin yon dod bsgril dngul 'bab(dngul srang nyis brgya lnga bcu skor yin tshod/ sngar lam nas spar cha byas yod) dang rlung dar 'dzugs pa bcas gong zhus rdzong gzhis nyi shu skor la bka' rgya zhus te rta shad brgyud khungs so sor btang don rdzong gzhis sne sdod ngo ma so so gnas rten khag la ngo bskyod thog dar 'dzugs dang / zhabs rim ji sgrub tshes cha dang bcas snyan 'bul dgos rgyu zhes btang don bzhin rdzong gzhis khag nas zhabs rim sgrub tho'i snyan zhu rim 'byor byung song ba dang / de min 'char can thugs dam 'bul 261

yul dga' ldan khri gdan zur dang / yongs 'dzin sogs dang gzhung bsten dgra lha gnas chung dang dga' gdong chos skyong gnyis la lung phul phyir phebs zhabs rim rnams kyang legs sgrub byas song / de nas nyin gcig go min tang gi lha sdod don gcod khru'i khran khru'u krang bka' shag tu bos thog bka' shag nas‘‘gung khran tang gis rgya gzhung (go min tang) la dza drag gi dmag 'thab byed pa 'di dag rang mal du zhi nas gzhung phyogs la rgyal kha thob ched du dmigs/ 'di nas dmigs bsal gyi zhabs rim ched tshugs bya rgyu yin’’lugs brda sprod) byas song bar khran khru'u krang gis‘‘de ltar dgongs bzhengs mdzad pa thugs rje che zhu rgyu ma zad/ srid gzhung la'ang de don rlung 'phrin 'bul rgyur smon lam 'phar tshugs zhabs rim gyi skyabs tho'i zhal bshus gcig gnang rogs’’zhes zhus song yang / skyabs tho dmigs bsal med gshis zhabs rim gyi〈dpyad khra'i〉ngo bshus shig sprad song / de nas smon lam 'phar ma nyin 'ga' shas tshugs rjes 'bras spungs tshogs chen dbu mdzad kyis sne drangs pa'i se 'bras dga' gsum gyi grwa dmangs klu sbug tu phebs te bden tshig zhal 'don dang / sder thang du tshogs khro'i nang gsol ja bskol ba 'bul gtong byed ran mtshams su gnas chung chos skyong khog brlams byas te rten mdung gis tshogs khro dkrugs nas kha sbub bslog rgyu'i stangs ka dang rten mdung khro nang du bskyur mtshams mtha' 'khor du yod pa'i mi tshos shugs brgyab nas tshogs khro kha sbub bslog pa'i ja sa steng du 'khyil 'gro skabs grwa dmangs kyis bzlog bsgyur byas song zhing / 'di skabs ltad mo lta mkhan ha cang mang ba'i thog go min tang gi don gcod khru'i las byed dang /bde skyid gling gi nang sdod pa'i ri car san sa heb kyang ltad mo lta bar slebs 'dug tshogs khro de kha sbub nas bzhag pa'i steng sbra yol byib g.yogs thog 262

mtha' 'khor la sa tham gyis mnan te sngar srol rag stobs pas srung bcug cing / de nas nyin bdun song mtshams zhabs brtan do dam pas tshogs khro kha phye ste de'i 'og rtags mtshan ji yod rtogs zhib tho 'god byas pa de dang /rag stobs pas tshogs khro srung ring rtags mtshan ji byung shod babs bcas bka' shag tu chabs cig snyatsha/ seng zhus song / (tshogs khro kha sbub pa'i mtshan mo tshogs khro'i nang sing sgra drag po grags tshul dang / tshogs khro kha sbub pa'i sa shul du phru gu'i rkang rjes gsal tshul sogs rtags mtshan 'ga' shas yod lugs zhus pa thos) de rjes nyin gcig bka' shag nas lha yod go min tang don gcod khang gi khran khru'u krang yang bskyar bka' shag tu ngo 'bod byas te khru'u krang la gdan dmar 'bol steng gos kha dang / cog tse khra cog brgyab pa dang / skad sgyur bkras dbang la stag gdan bcas brgyab par 'khod thog mgron ja btang zhing / bka' blon bla ma ram pa bas khru'u krang la 'jam mkhas kyis 'tshams 'dri byas rjes don gnad ba shad don du‘‘da phan gzhung gnas nas rgya bod mthun lam bzang po rgyun gnas yong ched/ go gung nang 'khrug 'phral thag chod rgyu dang / go min tang la rgyal kha thob rgyu'i thugs re chen po yod kyang bar lam nas rang phyogs sa shor phams nyes yong mus la brten bod phyogs nas rgyab skyor zhu thub pa'i cha rkyen gzhan med gshis/bod 'di chos ldan zhing khams la brten rang phyogs la rgyal kha thob rgyur dmigs/ rnam kun gal 'gangs ha cang che ba'i dus skabs la ma gtogs byed srol med pa'i dmigs bsal zhabs rim(gong gsal gnad sa gsum gyi dge 'dun pa smon lam 'phar tshugs thog tshogs khro kha sbub pa'i mngon spyod kyi las thabs byas pa der zer)yang byas te rang phyogs la rgyal kha thob re chen po byung yang da cha go min tang la rgyal kha thob re bral ba'i gnas tshul khyab gdal 263

du yong 'dug cing / de ltar gung khran tang la srid dbang thob tshe lha sdod go min tang gi sku tshab de gung khran tang gi sku tshab tu ming bsgyur khyab bsgrags byas pa tsam gyis bod la gung khran tang gi sku tshab yod par gyur rgyu ma zad/rda dung dbus gtsang khams gsum du dmar po'i gsang nyul mang po zhig kyang yod tshod 'dug na gung khran tang ni chos lugs rtsa med bzo ba'i ru su dmar po'i lam lugs 'dzin mkhan yin par brten bod 'di'i chos srid gnyis ldan gyi bzhed srol dang me chu lta bu'i mthun thabs med pa'i 'gal zla che gshis rang sa rang srung thub pa'i zhi drag 'du 'god mi gnang mthu med la brten bod ljongs tshogs 'dur mol bsdur byas pa'i bsam gros gcig mthun byung ba'i nang don srid skyong stag brag rin po cher snyan zhus brgyud thugs thag gtsang chod kyi don bzhin go min tang gi khru'u krang ngo las dang / dogs gnas yod pa'i rgya rigs bod sar sdod pa rnams dus bkag thog bod nas phyir thon byed dgos pa'i gsal bshad zhu rgyu yin cing / des na khru'u krang ngo las rgya gar brgyud phebs rgyur rta khal sogs lam bgrod bde ba'i srung skyel rgyarbe skyor zhu rgyu yin’’zhes yongs grags su bshad song ba ma zad/ de don gzhis rtse spyi rdzong la bka' rgya dang / mdo spyi bka' blon lha klur gnas tshul btang yod 'dug pa ltar dogs can khag khungs so so nas phyir slog byas 'dug cing / lha sar yod pa'i dogs can khag dus thog rdog thon thub pa'i skul lcag lta rtog byed mi shod phyag nang sogs khag bgos kyis ngo sprags 'gan dkri byas pa red/khru'u krang ngo las tshang ma spyi lo 1949lo'i zla 7pa'i nang lha sa nas rgya gar brgyud thon skabs srung skyel byed mi dang / thon khar gzhung gi phebs skyel gsol ston dang bcas rtse shod phyag mdzod nas phebs rdzong kyang phul/khru'u krang ngo las glo bur thon dgos byung bas mnyam 'khyer mi thub pa'i gzhung 264

sger gyi 'dzin chas klu sgug rtag sa tshang nang zla bsgril btang ste bar khe ba khag gcig la sdebs tshong byas 'dus gong gsal go min tang gi khru'u krang ngo las rnams phyir thon dgos pa'i brda sprod byas pa nas bzung gung khran tang gi gsang nyul du dogs gnas yod pa ming gsal rnams dngos gzhi rdog thon ma zin bar bka' blon rnam pa nga 'di skor nang bcar zhu mi'i byed dka' gleng lhags mi 'byung ched sger shag so sor ma phyin par bka' bla ram pa ba bla brang steng khang gnyer gyi las shag dang / bka' blon zur khang dang / ka shod gnyis dpal lha lcog g.yab 'khor lha khang khag gnyis nang spo sdod byas pa dang /gtsug las khang gi gzim sgo khag la srung bya'i dmag mi yang btsugs song /'di skabs spyi tshogs thog gleng phyogs su rgya rigs nyul ma'i dogs can phyir 'bung byas pa khag gcig lha sa nas thon khar‘‘nga tsho slar yang mgyogs po mjal yong’’zhes bshad lugs dang / ‘‘gung khran tang la srid dbang thob mtshams da lam gyi gnas tshul 'dis bod la gung khran mgyogs tsam 'byor rgyu'i rkyen slongs su gyur gyi red/ bod gzhung gis gung khran tang 'gog thub pa'i stobs shugs med pas las ka 'di yag po ma red’’ces zer ba las/'grig song zhes shod rme khan ma thos la/ mtho rim 'ga' shas kyis kyang 'di skor‘‘yag po e yong’’zhes blo g.yeng byas shing / gung khran gyi gsang nyul ming gsal ngo sprod ri car san nas byas pa zhig las bka' shag gis gnas tshul gsal po rtogs kyi med pa'i gleng phyogs kyang byung song /gong gsal yong rkyen de dag gi thog nas btsan rgyal ring lugs kyis rgya bod 'brel ba'i thad dbyen sbyor dkrug shing byas pa'i mtha' dus skabs de 'dra zhig tu slebs dus kyang mtshams 'jog byas pa'i dpe mtshon gsal shos shig tu mtshon pa red/ 265

—‘glebam̐dzi lkospra tshezachaṭwā oṃdzeersālkomo 1rkoṭwāṃ khyuṣṭha ñtsāpaṃṭwāmakṣu lkoklo daru gling dpon pad ma skal bzang / dga' tshe dpal bsam grub/dpa sgrag 'gan 'khur pa/ dezlo tshe tshedaga' bad — bzang brtan/ rgyal/rmapho oṃ.oṃ āoṃsgrolko༈༈rtsom bsher pa/ skyid sbug don grub phun tshogs/dhra/khro7snye༈ ṣpephrokha byang jus 'god pa/ karma rdo rje tshe ring /rsā41ṣṭhasnuṭwāṃ mi4rwaṣā7par zhus 'gan 'khur pa/ tshe ring mtsho mo/bod kyi lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha bdams bsgrigs/(103(spyi'i 'don byengs 19pa)bod ljongs srid gros lo rgyus rig gnas dpyad gzhi'i rgyu cha u yon lhan khang gis rtsom sgrig byas pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gis bskrun zhing 'grems spel byas pa/mi rigs dpe skrun khang gi rtsis 'khor nas dpar bsgrigs/1996lo'i zla 7par par gzhi 1po bsgrigs pa/1996 lo'i zla 7 rnga4ra pe cin du par thengs 1po brgyab pa/deb rer sgor 8 60
